article.articleHeadline: Tekan Malaria di Batas Negara, Kader Juru Malaria di Keerom Gencar Pendataan Pakai Aplikasi Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curb Malaria at the Border: Malaria Cadres in Keerom Intensify Data Collection Using a Digital Application
article.articleSummary: Malaria cadres in Keerom Regency, Papua, Indonesia, intensify border malaria control by conducting door-to-door Mass Mosquito Net Survey and recording results via the digital ONA app for real-time central monitoring. The effort targets 16 villages along the Indonesia–Papua New Guinea border within the Arso Barat health district and runs from October 5 to October 15, 2026. By October 8, three sites—Kampung Sanggaria, Yamua, and Dukwia—had been completed. Dukwia village cadre Sukarti reported high-precision data collection; in about four hours, 18 households were surveyed in detail, capturing family size, sleeping arrangements, number of nets distributed previously, and the current condition and use of nets. Cadres also educated residents on maintaining nets to prevent Anopheles mosquito bites. Community reception has been positive, though some bed nets were found damaged or unusable.}

triage.headline_ja: 国境でのマラリア抑制：クリオムのマラリア担当者がデジタルアプリを活用しデータ収集を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・パプア州ケーロム県における定例の蚊帳調査・マラリア予防活動の報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にLiberia, Papua New Guinea, Indiaが含まれるが、記事本文はインドネシア・パプア州ケーロム県での蚊帳調査活動のみを扱っており、他国は無関係のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 'หมอยง' ไขข้อข้องใจความเสี่ยง 'กาฬโรค' จะเกิดขึ้นในไทยมากน้อยแค่ไหน!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Dr Yong' clarifies the plague risk: how likely is it to occur in Thailand?
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) risk for Thailand remains low as of 8 October 2026, according to Prof. Yong Poovorawan of Chulalongkorn University. He cites historical and recent references: in September 2009, an outbreak of pneumonic plague occurred in Ziketan, Qinghai Province, China, with 3 deaths among 9 cases and one severe case linked to a dog that ate a rodent, involving fleas during burial. The plague pandemic history includes Europe’s Black Death (1890–1894) causing 17–28 million deaths, and later outbreaks in China and Hong Kong (1900s). Yersin identified the bacterium and named it after him. Current global control strategies include quarantine, isolation, rodent control, and encouraging cats; public health readiness remains essential. A pneumonia case in Russia is not confirmed to be plague; testing is straightforward and no plague detected. Plague is bacterial and treated with antibiotics; post-exposure prophylaxis is recommended. Thailand’s risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 「ヨン博士」がペスト発生リスクについて解説:タイで発生する可能性はどの程度か
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイの専門家による歴史的ペスト流行（2009年中国青海省の事例等）の解説と現在のタイでの低リスク評価に関する教育的・安心喚起的な内容であり、新規の発生事例や進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2009年の中国青海省（Ziketan）での肺ペスト流行の歴史的事例を引用しつつ、現在のタイにおけるペストリスクは低いとする専門家の見解を伝えるもの。ロシアの肺炎症例もペストではないと明記されており、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria infections worrying public health experts in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Malaria infections worry public health experts in Keralam as indigenous and imported cases rise. As of October 5, 2026, four indigenous and 974 imported confirmed cases have been recorded, with one indigenous death and six deaths from imported cases this year; last year saw no indigenous deaths and two imported deaths. The uptick follows 2021’s spike (252 imported cases and one indigenous death). Indigenous cases have been highest in Malappuram, Kozhikode, and Kannur, while Kollam is in a recovery phase. Officials attribute mosquito abundance and constant traveler influx to transmission, and call for strengthened surveillance, migrant screening, and intensive testing of asymptomatic fever cases. Plans include insecticide-treated bed nets in homes in regions reporting indigenous cases to curb endemicity. Public health experts warn climate change and domestic worker mobility could expand malaria to new areas, noting delayed detection worsens indigenous spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でマラリア感染が増加、公衆衛生専門家が懸念
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でマラリア感染（固有・輸入例）が増加し死亡例も発生。専門家が気候変動や人口移動による拡大を懸念し、サーベイランス強化を呼びかけており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりが見られる。
triage.notes: 輸入症例（主に旅行者由来）が大半を占めるが、固有感染例と死亡例の増加、蚊媒介による継続曝露、気候変動・人口移動による拡大懸念が専門家から指摘されている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Apa Itu Influenza Tipe A yang Kasusnya Sedang Meningkat?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Type A influenza, whose cases are currently increasing?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is described as different from ordinary flu. The Indonesian video notes several treatment options; viewers should watch the video for full guidance. As of 2026-10-08, the article notes Influenza A management options are discussed in video format. Authorship credits include Intan Maharani (writer), Darojatun Athoilah (script, narration, and video editing), and Pythag Kurniati (producer). The piece is tagged with Health, Disease, EvergreenLab, Influenza Type A, and influenza symptoms. It does not provide case counts, geographic locations, or outbreak timing in the text; the video is intended to outline treatment approaches and the associated symptoms. The article remains concise, focusing on treatment rather than epidemiology.

triage.triage_reason: 記事は一般的な健康情報・解説動画であり、症例数や発生地域、アウトブレイク時期などの疫学的情報が一切記載されていないため、シグナルとしての根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は治療法や症状の解説を目的とした一般健康情報コンテンツであり、具体的な発生地域・症例数・時期の記載がないため、インドネシアでの実際のアウトブレイクと断定できない。

article.articleHeadline: В одной из провинций ДР Конго ситуация с Эболой вышла из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In one of the provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has gotten out of control.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that Ebola outbreak in North Kivu province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has spiraled out of control, with the northeast accounting for about 40% of new confirmed cases nationwide. The outbreak began in April 2026. As of October 8, 2026, the cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in DRC reached 8,603, with 4,148 deaths. MSF statements, cited by Africanews, describe rapid case growth and uncontrolled spread in North Kivu. The figures underscore ongoing transmission in a region facing a major public health crisis within the DRC's Ebola response, highlighting the need for intensified control measures and urgent public health action. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のある州でエボラ出血熱の状況が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC北キブ州で制御不能な拡大を見せ、累計8,603例・死亡4,148例に達しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当、国際的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、MSFが支援強化を要請している。北キブ州での感染拡大が全国新規症例の約40%を占めるとの報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Dugaan Keracunan Resto Korea di Bandung, Kenali Sumber-sumber Kontaminasi Makanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral: Suspected Poisoning at a Korean Restaurant in Bandung; Learn the Sources of Food Contamination.
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to 88 Seoul restaurant in Bandung, Indonesia, with diners experiencing diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fever after meals. Bandung City Health Office is investigating the contamination source; no specific menu item or microorganism identified yet. Early findings point to hygiene and sanitation gaps: inadequate food separation, proximity of cleaners to foods, tight workspace, and unclear implementation of FIFO/FEFO, labeling with intake, opening, and expiry dates, zoning, and temperature monitoring. While storage temperatures have not been confirmed as noncompliant, temperature monitoring remains crucial to control microbial growth. Potential pathogens discussed include Bacillus cereus from rice (which can cause vomiting and diarrhea); Salmonella and E. coli from beef, chicken, and shrimp via cross-contamination or undercooking; risks from fermented foods like kimchi; and vegetable contamination, including nitrite formation from nitrates in stored produce. Cross-contamination via shared utensils and surfaces is also noted.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンの韓国料理店で食中毒疑い、食品汚染の原因を知る
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの食中毒疑い事例であり、原因病原体も未特定のため国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響は現時点で認められないが、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一施設での食中毒疑い事例。原因病原体は未確定（Bacillus cereus, Salmonella, E. coliなどが疑われる）。地元保健当局が調査中で、現地メディアで話題になっているため社会的関心はあるが、感染症としての広域拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di Bali, Apa yang Perlu Diwaspadai?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Case Detected in Bali, What Should Be Watched Out For?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A detected in Bali, Indonesia, with 9 positive cases identified from 113 ILI/SARI samples collected January–September 2026, all currently under medical care. National week-38/2026 surveillance reported 148 influenza A positives among 265 sentinel specimens, including samples from Bali, signaling rising activity but not yet dominance. Typical symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, muscle pains, headache, and fatigue; most cases are mild and may resolve at home, though risk groups (young children, elderly, those with comorbidities) may face greater severity. Bali Dinas Kesehatan issued preventive guidance (PHBS) and recommended masking when needed, urging consultation if symptoms persist. In Denpasar, RSUD Wangaya serves as sentinel SARI testing site; January–September 2026 data show 82 SARI cases with 75 tested (6 positive for Influenza A) and 30 ILI cases with 28 tested (4 positive), totaling 10 Influenza A cases in Denpasar, all recovered and back to normal activity.

triage.headline_ja: バリでインフルエンザA型の症例を検出、注意すべき点とは？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の検出であり、重症例や異常な流行拡大の兆候はなく、現地保健当局も通常の予防的対応にとどまっている。
triage.notes: 季節性サーベイランスの一環として報告された通常の季節性インフルエンザA検出事例。全例軽症または回復済みで、国家レベルのサーベイランスでも優勢株ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ситуация с распространением Эболы в провинции ДР Конго вышла из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in a DR Congo province has spiraled out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled out of control, according to MSF. North‑east regions now account for nearly 40% of new confirmed cases nationwide. The outbreak began in April 2026; the latest counts report 8,603 confirmed cases and 4,148 deaths. MSF warns transmission is escalating, calling for intensified containment, surveillance, treatment capacity, and community engagement in the DR Congo. The epicenter remains DR Congo's North Kivu province, where transmission has intensified. In cross-border developments, Kenya reported its first Ebola case: the patient was infected about a month ago, received care in several DR Congo hospitals, and died after arriving in Nairobi, highlighting cross-border transmission risks. Public health actions, including laboratory confirmation, infection prevention, and cross-border cooperation, are urgently needed to curb exports and further spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴの州におけるエボラ感染拡大の状況が制御不能になった
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でのエボラ流行が制御不能と国際機関(MSF)が警告し、致死率約48%・8,603症例という深刻な規模に加え、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認されたためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの初症例(ナイロビで死亡)にも言及しているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生地はDRC北キブ州であり、越境拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Вспышка Эболы в провинции Северное Киву в ДРК вышла из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu Province in the DRC has gotten out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is described as out of control by Doctors Without Borders (MSF). MSF warns of a sharp rise in Ebola cases in the province, now the country’s epicenter, with North Kivu accounting for roughly 40% of new confirmed infections. Since the outbreak began in April 2026, the DRC has recorded 8,603 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 4,148 deaths. The acceleration is straining health systems and demands urgent response measures, according to MSF. In addition, an imported case is being investigated in Israel: a patient who recently returned from the DRC developed fever and was hospitalized in isolation pending laboratory testing to confirm Ebola. The report underscores the need for intensified surveillance, containment, and health-system support in North Kivu and the wider region.

triage.headline_ja: MSF:コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州のエボラ流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ流行が制御不能とされ、致死率の高い大規模感染（8,603例、死亡4,148例）に加え、イスラエルでの輸入疑い例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: イスラエルでの疑い例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際拡大リスクの根拠として記載。

article.articleHeadline: While the world is watching reports of plague in Russia, deadly Ebola is breaking borders
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case: a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for seven years traveled by road through DRC and Uganda, then flew to Nairobi where he tested positive for Ebola and died days later. He was detected after arrival at Nairobi Hospital; port health screening had not identified symptoms. Africa CDC and Kenya are conducting expanded contact tracing, listing 57 contacts with 10 quarantined, including aircraft cleaners and passengers from the flights involved. DRC’s Ebola outbreak remains the largest and fastest-growing, with over 8,500 cases and more than 4,000 deaths; hotspots show gaps in care, with more than 70% of new cases outside known contacts and about 60% of deaths occurring outside treatment centers. Uganda closed its border with DRC; Kenya has heightened surveillance, designated a gate at its main airport, and launched an Ebola hotline. The situation highlights cross-border transmission risks via air travel and multi-country journeys.

triage.headline_ja: 世界がロシアのペスト報道に注目する中、致死性エボラが国境を越えて拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行がケニアへの輸入症例として国際拡大し、ウガンダが国境閉鎖するなど渡航制限も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは出血熱の流行国として主題に含まれるため記載。航空機による越境感染リスクが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 美CDC准备筛查西伯利亚旅客 中俄鼠疫演练后书记突消失(图)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC prepares to screen Siberian travelers; after Sino-Russian plague drill, the party secretary suddenly disappeared (photo).
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, the U.S. CDC says related pneumonic plague cases in Siberia remain unconfirmed and the immediate risk to the United States is very low, but CDC is prepared to screen travelers from Siberia. About 200 flights from Siberia to the US annually, mainly to JFK, with port-of-entry quarantine in place. The concern centers on a death of a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Shelekhov, Irkutsk Oblast, reportedly after breaking a vial containing Yersinia pestis and developing severe pneumonia; hospital death recorded Oct 2. Russian authorities say the epidemiological situation is stable and no outbreak risk. A month earlier, China and Russia staged a cross-border infectious disease emergency drill in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, including a plague-import scenario; the Irkutsk institute head Sergey Balakhonov attended. US ex-officials commented on historical ties to Soviet-era bio programs.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、シベリアからの渡航者スクリーニングを準備 中露ペスト対応訓練後に書記が突然失踪(写真)
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所でペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）暴露による死亡例が発生し、米CDCが渡航者スクリーニングを準備するなど注目度が高いため、情報不足ながらフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所内での実験室感染（死亡1例）であり、対象国リストに含まれるロシアはない。中国（黒竜江省）は事前の合同訓練の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染事例発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ロシア当局は流行リスクなしと説明しているが、米CDCが監視を強化している点から社会的関心は高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Mỗi ngày có trên 100 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: More than 100 dengue fever cases per day.
article.articleSummary: Dak Lak province in Vietnam is experiencing a dengue fever surge, with more than 100 new cases daily. By Oct 7, 2026, the province had 8,433 dengue cases, up 25% from the same period last year, with recent days over 100 cases per day. Two dengue deaths have occurred this year, in Tan An ward and Quang Phú commune; the second death is a 58-year-old woman from Ea Máp, Quang Phú. High-risk areas with transmission include Buon Ma Thuot city wards Buon Ma Thuot, Tan Lap, Tan An, Ea Kao, and the communes Ea H’leo, Hoa Phu, Tan Tien, Krông Pắk, Ea Tul, Cu M’gar; Thanh Nhất ward and Ea Knuech, Pong Drang, Ea Drông, Ea Na, Ea Drăng are also high risk. Prolonged rain has fostered Aedes aegypti breeding; some control efforts are reported as challenged and public complacency persists. CDC Dak Lak is directing environmental cleanups, vector surveillance, and vehicle-based insecticide spraying to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省:1日100人超のデング熱患者が発生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省で季節性のデング熱患者数が増加し死亡例もあるが、ベトナムでは例年発生する風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ダクラク省での季節性デング熱流行。雨期の蚊媒介拡大と防除体制の課題が指摘されているが、国際的な拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは報告されていない。現地CDCが対応中であり、外部支援の必要性は明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Caso Lito Sousa: o que faz a proteína prion ficar infecciosa? Novo estudo mostra que depende de onde ela está - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of Lito Sousa: What Makes the Prion Protein Infectious? A New Study Shows That It Depends on Where It Is.
article.articleSummary: Lito Sousa, 59, a Brazilian aircraft mechanic and YouTube creator, died on 1 October 2026 after publicly announcing a Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) diagnosis 41 days earlier. CJD is a rare, progressive neurodegenerative disease; most cases are sporadic, non-contagious, with no required mutation. The disease results from misfolding of the prion protein. Researchers at NB3, the Laboratory for Diagnosis and Development of Therapeutic Strategies for Infectious Diseases at Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ), investigate how the prion protein, anchored to cell membranes, forms aggregates. Using vesicles made from the lipid phosphatidic acid and adjusting temperature to change membrane order, they observed identical amounts of aggregated material but distinct internal architectures depending on membrane state. This indicates the environment of assembly shapes the final structure, potentially explaining clinical variability and informing research on Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. Studies rely on simplified models; fully in vivo confirmation remains forthcoming.

triage.headline_ja: リト・ソウザ氏のケース:プリオンタンパク質が感染性を持つ要因とは?新研究が示す、それは存在する場所に依存するということ
triage.triage_reason: 単一の孤発性CJD症例に関する科学研究報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: CJDは孤発性かつ非感染性の神経変性疾患であり、本記事は個人の死亡事例を契機にした基礎研究の紹介記事。感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nanyuki residents demand clarity on Laikipia Air Base quarantine plan after Kenya's first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola case, an imported infection involving a patient who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo; authorities emphasize it is not a domestic outbreak. In Nanyuki, Laikipia County, residents seek clear details on whether the controversial quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base would be used to isolate Ebola patients, reflecting a divide: some see containment value, others recall violent protests that left two dead. The potential threat is set against El Niño‑related flood risks that could strain healthcare and disease‑control efforts. Community leaders urge regular public updates on the situation. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale told NTV that Ebola response measures have been activated and that Kenya has been preparing since the WHO and Africa CDC confirmed the outbreak in May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例を受け、ナニュキ住民がライキピア空軍基地の検疫計画について説明を求める
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ輸入症例がケニアで確認され、国際的拡大・重篤な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでのアウトブレイク（WHO/Africa CDCが2026年5月に確認）が背景として明記されているためDRCを計上。ケニア国内の対応・社会的反応については参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จัก 'กาฬโรค' ทำความเข้าใจสาเหตุ การแพร่เชื้อ อาการ และวิธีป้องกัน - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding the plague: causes, transmission, symptoms, and prevention - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) warning from Thailand's Department of Disease Control after a death in Russia prompts awareness. Plague is primarily transmitted by fleas from infected rodents, but can spread via direct contact with infected animals, laboratory exposure, or through respiratory droplets in pneumonic form. Incubation is 1–7 days. Three clinical forms: bubonic plague (fever, headache, chills, weakness, and lymph nodes); septicemic plague (fever, chills, severe weakness, abdominal pain, shock, bleeding under skin causing tissue necrosis and blackening of fingers, toes, or nose); and pneumonic plague (most severe, with fever, headache, pneumonia, shortness of breath, chest pain, cough with clear or blood-tinged sputum, and person-to-person transmission). Prevention focuses on eliminating rodent harborage, avoiding handling wildlife, and protecting against flea bites. Travelers returning from risk areas should seek medical care for fever or respiratory symptoms and report travel history. Antibiotics are effective when treated early.

triage.headline_ja: ペストを知る：原因、感染経路、症状、予防法について理解する - The Bangkok Insight
triage.triage_reason: タイ疾病管理局によるロシアでの死亡例を受けた一般啓発記事であり、タイ国内での発生報告はなく、対象国での具体的な感染拡大事例もないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアでのペスト死亡例を契機としたタイ国内向けの啓発・予防情報であり、タイ国内での発生事例ではない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Конго вышла из-под контроля: врачи бьют тревогу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo has gotten out of control: doctors are sounding the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is rapidly spreading in North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with MSF warning the outbreak has spiraled beyond control. North Kivu now accounts for about 40% of all new confirmed Ebola cases in DRC, many linked to unknown transmission chains. MSF Ebola treatment center coordinator in Butembo, Stephanie Hoffmann, reports about 75% of deaths occur in communities, as individuals die at home and do not seek care, raising household transmission risk. New foci have appeared nearly every week, while health facilities in North Kivu operate at maximum capacity. As of September 23, WHO records 7,890 confirmed Ebola cases in DRC with 3,799 deaths; North Kivu had 1,480 cases and a province case fatality rate of 59.7%. No specifics on spillover source or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が制御不能に:医師たちが警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが制御不能なレベルで拡大しており、致死率が高く(59.7%)、未知の感染経路や地域コミュニティでの死亡が多数発生していることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクのあるシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: MSFが制御不能と警告しており、北キブ州で新規症例の約40%を占める。死亡の75%が地域コミュニティで発生し、感染経路追跡が困難な状況。続報・公式WHO発表の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spirals out of control in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo -- NGO
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease surge in North Kivu and Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with MSF reporting the outbreak has spiraled out of control. North Kivu now accounts for nearly 40% of the country's new confirmed Ebola cases. Most new infections are not linked to earlier transmission chains, and 75% of deaths occur in community settings, as many patients stay at home rather than seek treatment. Reluctance to acknowledge infection and access specialized care, driven by fear of Ebola centers, is fueling transmission. The outbreak, which began in Ituri Province and was identified in May, has spread from the Butembo area to all neighboring health districts, with new outbreaks emerging weekly and insufficient treatment capacity. Bundibugyo strain is implicated; the episode is described as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, with over 8,600 cases and more than 4,100 deaths reported by the latest figures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部で制御不能に拡大 ― NGO報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で制御不能に拡大し、史上最多の感染者・死者数を記録しているため、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（8,600例超、4,100人超死亡）であり、治療拒否・コミュニティ内死亡率の高さ（75%）から感染制御が極めて困難な状況。国際的な支援・監視強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: La peste sigue presente: estos son los lugares donde aún se reportan casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague is still present: these are the places where cases are still being reported.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium, remains present in 2026, with ongoing human cases reported in Africa—specifically the Congo and Madagascar—and about seven annual human cases in rural western United States, per the CDC. A recent Siberia incident raised alarm after a laboratory worker died from pneumonia; Russian authorities say tests showed no plague, though the institute was quarantined. Ancient evidence shows plague in the Lake Baikal region for at least 5,500 years. Bubonic plague is the most common form, causing painful swollen lymph nodes (buboes) and fever; pneumonic plague affects the lungs and can be transmitted via respiratory droplets; septicemic plague involves the bloodstream. Transmission occurs via fleas from wild rodents or contact with infected fluids; pneumonic form requires close contact. Timely antibiotics are curative; a vaccine exists for high-risk groups, but not specifically effective against pneumonic plague, and no US vaccine is available.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは今も存在する：いまだ症例が報告されている場所はここだ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・マダガスカル等でのペスト常在状況を概説する解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増などの具体的動向は示されていないため、現時点ではシグナルとしての緊急性は低いが継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史的・地理的背景を解説する内容であり、具体的な新規症例数や発生時期などの詳細データが不足している。マダガスカル・米国・ロシアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lo que sabemos sobre el presunto caso de peste en Rusia: Informe Especial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What We Know About the Suspected Plague Case in Russia: Special Report
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a suspected plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia. Daria Shipilova, 28, a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Plague Institute, died Oct 2 in a hospital near Shelekhov after pneumonia of unknown origin; samples showed no microorganism linked to her work. About 200 contacts were quarantined; authorities have not officially declared a plague diagnosis, and media reports are being removed. U.S. officials describe limited information; The Washington Post notes a diplomatic request for details about the death and quarantines. Plague is a zoonotic disease caused by Yersinia pestis and can spread from animals to humans, via respiratory droplets or contact with contaminated fluids. Globally, plague persists on all continents except Oceania; most human cases are in Africa (Madagascar, DRC) with Mongolia reporting cases. Early detection and antibiotics are effective; the case raises questions about whether the bacterium originated in a research facility, given the Irkutsk institute’s plague and bioweapon-related work.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト疑い症例について分かっていること：特別報告
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所勤務者の原因不明肺炎による死亡、約200人の接触者隔離、情報公開の制限や外交的問い合わせなど異常性と公衆衛生上の懸念が高く、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 事件の主な発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事中で言及されたマダガスカルやDRCは世界的なペスト流行の背景説明として記載されており、本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: В одной из провинций ДР Конго вновь зафиксировали вспышку лихорадки Эбола - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola outbreak has been recorded again in one of the DRC's provinces - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), focused in North Kivu province in the northeast, with Doctors Without Borders warning of a sharp rise in cases. North Kivu accounts for about 40% of all new confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC. The outbreak began in April 2026. By 2026-10-08, the toll reached 4,148 deaths among 8,603 laboratory-confirmed cases. Congolese Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba had previously stated that the peak had passed. The report, citing MSF and Africanews, notes ongoing transmission despite claims of a peak. The article does not provide infection source details or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のある州で再びエボラ出血熱の流行が記録された - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で発生中のエボラ流行は致死率約48%、感染者8,603人・死者4,148人に達し、ピークを過ぎたとの当局見解に反して感染が継続しているとMSFが警告しており、深刻性・異常性・拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、国際機関(MSF)が症例急増を警告。政府は「ピークを過ぎた」と発表しているが現場報告と矛盾しており、情報の正確性・今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: PMC issues notices to four ward malaria officers over dengue, chikungunya surge
article.articleSummary: PMC issues show-cause notices to four ward malaria officers amid a dengue and chikungunya surge in Pune. MOs of Kothrud, Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri, Aundh-Baner, and Dhankawadi-Sahakarnagar wards must explain the surge, actions taken, and daily activities; they were summoned to submit action-taken reports. Between Jan 1 and Sep 30, 2026, Pune logged 2,391 dengue and 106 chikungunya cases, with dengue rising from 166 in June to 956 in September (Sept ~40% of nine-month total). Dengue ward counts: Kothrud 229, Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri 222, Aundh-Baner 212, Dhankawdi-Sahakarnagar 139, Yerawada-Kalas-Dhanori 137; chikungunya peaked in July (51), falling to 16 in September, with Aundh-Baner reporting 19. The department outlined outbreak-control measures (5-km house-to-house inspections, container surveys, fever surveys, spraying, fogging, malaria slides) to run for 15 days during outbreaks. An entomologist found mosquito breeding at a PMC godown in Aundh-Baner; authorities were directed to clear material and intensify control with biolarvicide and housing-area spraying.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市当局、デング熱・チクングニヤ熱の急増を受け4区のマラリア担当官に通知書を発行
triage.triage_reason: インド・プネーにおけるデング熱・チクングニヤの季節的増加に対する地方自治体の行政対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないが、症例増加傾向が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道で地方自治体（PMC）レベルの行政対応が主題。死亡者数や重症度の詳細情報は記載なし。季節性の蚊媒介感染症増加であり、現時点で国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜11歲女童患甲流情況嚴重　衛生署料流感活躍度未來數周高水平波動 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza | An 11-year-old girl with H1N1 flu in serious condition; the Department of Health says flu activity will fluctuate at high levels in the coming weeks | am730
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Hong Kong: An 11-year-old girl with underlying medical conditions developed severe influenza and pneumonia and is currently in the pediatric intensive care unit. She presented with cough and fever; on Oct 3 she experienced breathing difficulty and vomiting at a private clinic and was transferred to Queen Mary Hospital's emergency department. Respiratory testing confirmed Influenza A(H1). The case occurs as Hong Kong entered the flu season in late June; activity has remained high for the past two weeks, with forecasts of high-level fluctuations in the coming weeks. The circulating strain shifted from H3 to H1, potentially extending the season due to altered post-COVID immunity. To date this season, 23 pediatric severe cases and one death have been recorded, about 80% of severe cases having risk factors such as chronic illness. Authorities urge vaccination for children and high-risk groups and prompt medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ｜11歳女児がH1N1インフルエンザで重篤化　衛生署は今後数週間、インフルエンザ活動が高水準で変動すると予測
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザながら、小児重症例・死亡例が継続して報告されており、株がH3からH1へシフトしシーズン延長の懸念があるため、重症度・流行継続性の観点からピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例であり、対象国リストのChina (1814991)に含めた。季節性インフルエンザの株シフト（H3→H1）とシーズン延長の可能性、小児重症例23例・死亡1例の報告があり、継続的な動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu cảnh báo viêm phế quản phổi sau cúm A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning signs of bronchopneumonia after influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A can lead to bronchitis or bronchopneumonia, even after fever and sore throat subside. After apparent recovery, some patients develop renewed cough, fever, or shortness of breath, indicating possible respiratory complications rather than simple post-viral effects. Key warning signs include persistent or worsening cough with sputum, fever relapse, dyspnea, chest tightness, fatigue, and changes in sputum; in children, rapid breathing and poor feeding require medical evaluation. The illness may predispose to secondary infection due to airway mucosal injury and excess secretions, with higher risk in young children, the elderly, or those with underlying conditions. Advice emphasizes rest, fluids, nutrition, ventilating living spaces, avoiding self-prescribed antibiotics or cough/anti-inflammatory drugs. A 26-month-old in Van Don Regional General Hospital, Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam, was diagnosed with influenza A complicated by pneumonia. WHO reports influenza A dominates globally since October, including A/H5N1, A/H7N9.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA後の気管支肺炎の警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な季節性インフルエンザAの合併症（気管支肺炎）に関する健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。H5N1/H7N9への言及はWHOの一般的な世界状況報告であり、本記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの合併症に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、Quang Ninh省の小児1例は通常の臨床例として紹介されているのみ。H5N1/H7N9への言及はWHOの世界的傾向の文脈で触れられているに過ぎず、ベトナムでの鳥インフルエンザ発生を報告するものではないため、ベトナムをverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Qdenga vaccine set for approval to tackle dengue
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces a severe dengue outbreak, with more than 1,000 infections daily and several deaths; the past 24 hours saw 8 additional deaths and 1,860 hospital admissions. Amid the surge, the government is considering importing the Qdenga dengue vaccine for individual use, after its July approval in India and WHO prequalification. No Bangladesh trial is planned, and officials say a local study is unnecessary given international data, though public health experts warn that a short local trial would help address safety perceptions and guide age-targeting and future rollout. Qdenga, developed by Takeda, protects against four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and requires two doses 3 months apart; it is in use in more than 40 countries. India’s market has not yet stocked Qdenga, with entry expected in 2027. Vector control remains essential to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策としてQdengaワクチンが承認される見込み
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題であるデング熱の重大な流行はバングラデシュで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。インドはワクチン承認・市場動向の文脈でのみ言及されており、インド国内での流行発生を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はバングラデシュ（対象国リスト外）。インドは2026年7月にQdengaを承認した背景情報として言及されているのみで、インド国内でのデング熱流行拡大を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Measles is roaring back: Why the world - and India - should worry
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surge in the US and worldwide, driven by vaccination gaps. In the United States, 3,887 confirmed cases as of Oct 1, 2026, with Pennsylvania over 1,000 cases and five deaths, and New York declaring a disaster emergency amid outbreaks in under-immunised rural areas. Globally, WHO/UNICEF warn that measles remains highly contagious and coverage is far below the 95% two-dose target: 84% first dose, 76% second. Bangladesh reports 1,134 suspected or confirmed measles deaths this year and about 175,000 hospitalisations since March. Europe/Central Asia saw nearly 34,000 cases in 2025, down from 2024, but 19 countries still have endemic transmission. The Americas exceed 47,000 cases by July 2026. In India, second-dose coverage is 71.8% and full immunisation 87.1% (NFHS-6), with pockets of outbreaks in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi, and Madhya Pradesh and at least 31 child deaths. Vaccine hesitancy and disrupted services fuel risk.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再び猛威を振るう：世界が、そしてインドが懸念すべき理由
triage.triage_reason: インド国内（マハーラーシュトラ、グジャラート、デリー、マディヤ・プラデーシュ）で麻疹の集団発生が報告され、31人の子どもの死亡を含む重症例があり、世界的なワクチン接種率低下という流行しやすい状況が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・バングラデシュ・欧州など複数地域の麻疹流行を扱うが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみ。インド国内ではマハーラーシュトラ州、グジャラート州、デリー、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州で発生が確認され、31人の子どもの死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯鼠疫病例消息影響，病原檢測及抗感染概念股上漲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News of Russian plague cases drives gains in pathogen-detection and anti-infection concept stocks.
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia, Russia has sparked gains in Chinese pathogen-detection and anti-infection concept stocks as markets reopen after the National Day holiday. On Thursday local time 10:03, Huabei Pharmaceutical (600812 CH) rose 10%; DaAn Gene (002030 C2) advanced 2.8%, after briefly hitting the daily limit; LuKang Medicine (600789 CH) gained 3.3%. The investment reaction follows foreign press reports about the Siberian case and heightened concerns over plague risks. The World Health Organization urged Russia to disclose more information as the risk posed by the suspected plague remains undetermined. No confirmed case counts or infection sources are provided in the report; it cites market activity and regulatory commentary rather than epidemiological details.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト症例のニュースが、病原体検査・抗感染症関連銘柄の上昇を後押し
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの肺ペスト疑い例についてWHOがロシアに情報開示を求めており、重篤かつ人-人感染のリスクがある疾患であるため、情報不足でもフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は中国株式市場の反応を主題としており、実際の感染症発生地はロシア（シベリア）であり対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。症例数・感染源など疫学的詳細は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 6月底至今錄逾20宗兒童流感嚴重個案　衞生署指病毒株若變異易患重症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Since the end of June, more than 20 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded; the Department of Health says that if the virus strain mutates, it is more likely to cause severe illness.
article.articleSummary: From late June through Oct 8, 2026, Hong Kong has recorded more than 20 severe pediatric influenza cases. The Department of Health notes that about 85% of the cases involve influenza A H1, with influenza A H3 the next most common strain. Differences in immunity to flu strains mean that if the virus mutates, children may be more prone to severe illness. Authorities explain that when H3 immunity was lower, severe cases appeared, and a shift to H1 could alter risk, potentially continuing to drive severe outcomes. Parents are advised to monitor ill children closely and seek urgent care if symptoms worsen—rapid breathing, blue lips, altered consciousness, or persistent fever—by presenting at emergency departments. The report underscores ongoing concerns about mutation-driven severity in pediatric flu in Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 6月末から現在までに20件超の小児重症インフルエンザ症例、衛生署はウイルス株が変異すれば重症化しやすくなると指摘
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児の重症インフルエンザ症例が継続的に発生しており注視が必要だが、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内で国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な懸念は現時点でない。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例であり、中国(1814991)に分類。季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例の増加が報告されているが、新型株や異常な変異の確認はされていない。続報（ウイルス株の変異有無、症例数の推移）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Распространение вируса Эбола в ДР Конго вышло из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo has spiraled out of control, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF) via Africanews. North Kivu now accounts for about 40% of new infections. The situation is worsened by widespread reluctance to seek care, with many patients remaining at home under family observation, accelerating transmission. Approximately 75% of Ebola deaths occur outside medical facilities, as people die before reaching treatment or transit centers. Some individuals refuse to acknowledge illness, hindering care. The hemorrhagic fever outbreak began in April, and in five months more than 8,500 people have been infected and over 4,000 have died. The report underscores challenges in access to care and late presentation, complicating containment efforts in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスの拡大が制御不能に陥った
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが制御不能と報告されており、感染者8500人超・死者4000人超という深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: MSF報告に基づく記事。北キブ州での医療忌避・在宅死亡率の高さ（75%）が感染拡大を助長していると指摘されており、既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイクの深刻化を示す重要な続報。

article.articleHeadline: 流感上周死亡、重症人數近五年新高 防疫概念股大漲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza deaths and severe cases last week hit a five-year high; epidemic-prevention concept stocks surged.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a peak in influenza activity, with last week recording 219 severe cases and 44 deaths—the highest on record. Circulating virus is Type A, with A/H1N1 accounting for 90.7% of Type A. Influenza-like illness visits reached 139,060, down 1.4% week-on-week. In the 114-115 influenza season, 65+ individuals comprise 66.4% of severe cases and those with chronic diseases 83.6%; 67.2% of severe cases were unvaccinated. Health authorities urge high-risk groups—including the elderly, children, and people with chronic conditions—to complete vaccination to reduce pneumonia, cardiovascular risk, and progression to severe disease or death. Internationally, Japan’s flu activity is rising, with increases also seen in Mainland China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Singapore, and the United States. The epidemic could end as early as November due to strong vaccine uptake. Epidemic-prevention stocks surged in response.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ先週死亡・重症者数が過去5年で最高、防疫関連株急騰
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザの流行報告であり、対象国（中国等）は附帯的言及に留まり主題ではないため、ピックアップ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: La peste nunca desapareció: estas son las regiones del mundo donde enfermar por 'Yersinia pestis' es aún real
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague never disappeared: these are the regions of the world where contracting Yersinia pestis is still possible.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains biologically incurable to eradicate, persisting as an enzootic disease in wild mammal reservoirs and their flea vectors, causing ongoing global reemergence. Endemic foci are active in at least 26 countries across Africa (e.g., Burkina Faso, Chad, DRC, Madagascar, Uganda, Zambia, Niger, Mali, Ethiopia, Somalia), Asia (Mongolia, China, Russia), and the Americas (Peru, United States), with approximately 1,000–2,000 human cases annually. Primary human transmission occurs via infected flea bites or direct contact with virulent animal tissues; the disease requires continuous global surveillance, particularly at rural and urban–wildlife interfaces. Yersinia pestis infects through a diverse reservoir of >200 mammal species (notably rodents) and >30 vector species, especially Xenopsylla cheopis, whose fleas amplify transmission. Three human forms are Bubonic (80–90%), septicemic, and Pneumonic—the latter being the most severe and, if untreated, near 100% fatal and directly transmissible via aerosols. Public health authorities classify plague as a mandatory reportable disease under IHR.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは決して消えていなかった:『エルシニア・ペスティス』感染が今なお現実である世界の地域

article.articleHeadline: बिहार में डेंगू पर राहत की खबर: इस साल राज्य में शून्य मौत, पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में मामलों में भारी गिरावट - bihar dengue update zero deaths cases drop significantly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue relief in Bihar: Zero deaths in the state this year, cases down sharply compared to last year.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 5, 2026, Bihar records 857 dengue cases this year with zero deaths, and Patna along with other districts show a decline. The state logged 3,902 dengue cases in 2025, though the report also cites tallies of 5,033 (2024) and 1,817 (2025) in another section, indicating internal inconsistency. No dengue hotspots are identified in Patna, Gaya District, or Samastipur. Control efforts emphasize public awareness, timely testing, regular surveillance, effective fogging, larval control, adequate test kits and platelets, and GH/public education. The IHIP portal provides ongoing monitoring; Aug–Sept training covered 90 medical officers and 86 laboratory technicians in dengue/chikungunya management and ELISA reader use. Preventive measures focus on eliminating standing water around homes, and regular cleaning of coolers, pots, tires, and other water-accumulation sites. Districts operate 318 fogging machines with 172 kg Malathion stock; NS1/ELISA/IgM kits are available; platelets are supplied as needed.

article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports one new severe pediatric influenza case, an 11-year-old girl with a chronic illness. This season’s circulating strains have shifted from H3 to H1, and the absence of a winter flu season from January–March is thought to have affected population immunity and prolonged the season; a peak occurred early last month. To date, 23 severe pediatric cases have been recorded, including 1 death, with about 80% having risk factors. Authorities urge vaccination for children and other high-risk groups and prompt medical attention if symptoms appear.

article.articleHeadline: Det här vet vi nu om det misstänkta pestfallet i Ryssland

Hospitals restricted visits; pregnant women at maternity clinics completed pest-exposure checklists; masks used at a large aluminum plant. WHO deems public risk low and urges more transparency about the pathogen and any second suspected case.

article.articleHeadline: Sum na nevarno pljučno kugo - Kakšni so simptomi in tveganja? - Med.Over.Net -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Dangerous Pneumonic Plague - What Are the Symptoms and Risks? - Med.Over.Net -
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is the most contagious form and can spread between people via respiratory droplets or by progression from another form to the lungs. Prompt recognition and treatment are crucial: untreated mortality ranges from 30% to 100%, while timely antibiotics and supportive care improve survival. Confirmed cases require patient isolation and thorough contact tracing with prophylaxis for exposed individuals. Symptoms can appear quickly, sometimes within 24 hours. A Russian researcher’s death at a plague institute linked to exposure has prompted questions about control, but current European risk is considered low because the exposure occurred in a laboratory and contacts were quarantined; EU health authorities monitor the situation. Globally, plague remains endemic among rodents in Africa, Asia, and the Americas, with human cases annually; pneumonic outbreaks have occurred in the DRC and Madagascar. A plague vaccine exists but is not intended for the general population.

Environmental conditions are cited as a risk factor for transmission; officials anticipate possible case increases as the rainy season approaches year-end.

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카 동부까지 뚫렸다... 케냐서 에볼라 첫 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Breaks Through to Eastern Africa... First Death in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) has caused 8,603 confirmed cases and 4,148 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of June 6 (per ECDC). The virus has now spilled over to Kenya, where a Kenyan national—a long-time resident of DRC who fell ill about a month earlier—died after arriving on Oct 3. The patient traveled from north DRC (Buta) to Kisangani, then by domestic flight to eastern Beni, crossed into Uganda by land, then flew to Nairobi, passing through three countries and their border/airport screenings without detection. 57 contacts have been identified, with 10 isolated; Kenya has established 240 isolation beds across five facilities. Uganda cited a short stay and normal departure temperature; the route across borders remains unclear. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; Kenyan authorities intensified border controls and contact tracing.

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO Siswa Kelas III SD di Wanagiri Buleleng Bali Digigit Monyet Liar saat Hendak ke Toilet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: A third-grade elementary school student in Wanagiri, Buleleng, Bali, was bitten by a wild monkey while heading to the toilet.
article.articleSummary: A nine-year-old, in the third grade at SD Negeri 2 Wanagiri, Sukasada, Buleleng, Bali, was bitten by a wild monkey at school on 7 October 2026. The hand wound was categorized as Category III; treatment included 15 minutes of wound cleansing with soap, two sutures, and tampon application. The patient received the first dose of rabies vaccine (VAR) and will be reviewed for a wound check on Friday. Local health officials, including Buleleng Dinas Kesehatan head Dr. Sucipto, confirmed the incident. Wanagiri has a long-standing presence of monkeys that have disrupted facilities; authorities are coordinating with BKSDA and a local foundation to mitigate conflicts. Officials suggest drought-related food scarcity may drive increased monkey activity near settlements, with initial public health measures focusing on reducing monkey hiding spots around the school.

article.articleHeadline: Russian lab worker's death sparks plague scare, biosecurity concerns
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old female worker at the Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East in Shelekhov, Irkutsk, Russia, died on Sept 29 with conflicting reports over cause: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor cites pneumonia of unknown origin, while media outlets claim pneumonic plague after she reportedly dropped a tube with live Yersinia pestis. About 200 people who may have been exposed are under monitoring; Irkutsk officials said no infectious microorganisms linked to the institute were found in her samples, and the death’s cause remains pneumonia of undetermined etiology. No new staff cases have been reported. Internationally, WHO/CDC assess the risk as very low with no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis; pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets, has 1–7 day incubation, and is treatable with antibiotics when diagnosed early. Most global human cases (2019–2025) occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所職員の死亡、ペスト感染への懸念とバイオセキュリティ上の懸念を引き起こす

triage.notes: 事件はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所内で発生したものであり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC・マダガスカル等）は過去の疫学的文脈として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。ロシア自体も対象国リストに含まれない。WHO/CDCは人-人感染の証拠なしと評価し、リスクは非常に低いとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Wabah Ebola Bundibugyo Mematikan di Kongo Terdeteksi di Negara Tetangga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Kongo is deadly and has been detected in a neighboring country.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths, with spread toward neighboring regions and a case detected in Kenya. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said some areas show signs of slowing while others continue to grow; daily contact-tracing alerts total about 2,000. Clinical trials of Ebola Bundibugyo treatment are underway with more than 600 participants enrolled; vaccine trials are expected to roll out by the end of October 2026. Kenya reports a single case: a Kenyan citizen who fell ill in the DRC, was treated in several facilities there, then traveled to Nairobi via Kampala and died on Oct 5, 2026. Kenyan authorities are monitoring 55 contacts. WHO does not recommend broad travel or trade restrictions, prioritizing screening, contact tracing, and transparency, as the outbreak occurs amid a prolonged humanitarian crisis near the South Sudan border.
