article.articleHeadline: 衞生署指本港流感季節持續　未來數周在高水平波動
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Health says Hong Kong's influenza season continues, with high-level fluctuations expected in the coming weeks.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's influenza season continues, with high-level fluctuations expected in coming weeks. On 8 October 2026, the Department of Health reported one severe pediatric influenza case: an 11-year-old girl with chronic illness diagnosed with Influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia, currently in the PICU in critical condition. Leung Yiu-hong, head of the Emergency Response and Programme Management Office, said the flu season began in late June and has lasted more than three months, with activity remaining high in the past two weeks and fluctuations likely ahead. The extension is attributed to the absence of a winter flu season from January–March and a shift from A(H3) to A(H1), affecting population immunity. The season has recorded 23 pediatric severe cases, including 1 death; about 80% had risk factors such as chronic illness. The peak occurred in early September; activity is expected to ease gradually but more slowly than usual.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署、香港のインフルエンザシーズンが継続中、今後数週間は高水準で変動の見込みと発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、流行株の変化による季節延長は既知の現象として説明されている。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性はなく、新興感染症としての異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例報告。小児重症例23件（うち死亡1例）が報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザとして想定内の範囲であり、H3N2からH1N1への株シフトによる免疫動態の変化が季節延長の原因として説明済み。香港（中国特別行政区）の事例として中国に分類。

article.articleHeadline: Китай та росія разом працюють над проблемою чуми - Новости Весь Харьков
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China and Russia are working together on the plague problem - Kharkiv News
article.articleSummary: China and Russia are intensifying cooperation on infectious disease prevention and control, with a focus on plague, following a Siberia outbreak, according to Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun. About a month earlier, the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Prevention completed joint emergency-response training with China, aimed at outbreak response and monitoring to curb cross-border spread. Exercises emphasized monitoring and containment in border regions. Irkutsk Oblast lies north of Mongolia and is a major transport hub with frequent air and rail links to Chinese cities, Bloomberg notes. Mongolia’s Ministry of Health says the risk of spread beyond the region is low. Ongoing work on border security and health surveillance along the Russia border will continue.

triage.headline_ja: 中国とロシアがペスト対策で協力 - ハルキウ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ロシア（シベリア）でのペスト発生を受けた中露の協力体制に関する外交的報道であり、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報がなく、モンゴル保健省も拡大リスクを低いとしているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、記事の主題は中国・ロシア間の越境感染症対策協力。中国は発生国ではなく協力相手国として言及されているため、対象国リストには該当せず verified_locations は空配列とした。モンゴルも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF предупредила о быстром распространении Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns of rapid spread of Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with North Kivu province contributing almost 40% of newly confirmed cases. Butembo-based MSF Ebola treatment center coordinator Stephanie Hoffmann notes about 75% of deaths occur outside medical facilities, with patients dying at home or before reaching care or temporary shelters. This pattern increases transmission risk as relatives and caregivers in home settings attend to the sick and deceased. The findings underscore significant gaps in access to timely treatment, complicating containment in North Kivu's ongoing outbreak. No total case or death counts are given in the article beyond the North Kivu share and the proportion dying outside facilities.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクで北キブ州における感染拡大、院外死亡率75%という高いヒト-ヒト感染リスクが示唆されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に明示されていないが、MSFが医療アクセスの欠如と家庭内感染リスクの増大を警告しており、継続中のアウトブレイクの深刻化が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Dugaan Wabah Pes di Rusia, Kemenkes Pastikan Pengawasan di Pintu Masuk Indonesia Diperkuat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected plague outbreak in Russia, Ministry of Health confirms strengthened surveillance at Indonesia's entry points.
article.articleSummary: Suspected plague outbreak in Russia prompts Indonesia's Ministry of Health to strengthen surveillance at entry points. A tube allegedly containing Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes plague, was linked to a laboratory worker's death in Russia on September 25, 2026. Indonesia's health authorities, including the Health Quarantine Center, hospitals, public health laboratories, and regional health offices, are increasing preparedness and vigilance in response to the developing situation. However, there has been no formal notification through International Health Regulations, the National Focal Point, or the WHO Event Information Site regarding a heightened alert. The Indonesian response focuses on monitoring and readiness rather than reporting any confirmed imported cases, as of the published date October 8, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行の疑い、インドネシア保健省が入国地点での監視強化を確認
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの実験室作業員の死亡（Yersinia pestis関連の疑い）を受けインドネシアが予防的に監視を強化しているが、正式なIHR通報や確定症例はなく、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症事例（検体に関連した死亡）はロシアで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは確定症例がなく、入国地点での予防的監視強化のみのため、対象国としてのverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: റഷ്യന്‍ സൈനിക ലാബില്‍ ജീവനെടുത്ത് മാഹാമാരി; സത്യം മറച്ചുവെച്ച് റഷ്യ; വരുന്നത് മരണത്തിന്റെ വിത്തു വിതയ്ക്കുന്ന 'ന്യൂമോണിക് പ്ലേഗ്' തന്നെയോ? മാസ്‌കും വാക്സിനും കൊണ്ട് തടുക്കാനാവില്ല; മനുഷ്യരാശിയെത്തന്നെ... | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In a Russian military laboratory, a plague has claimed lives; Russia hides the truth; is it the pneumonic plague that will sow the seeds of death? Masks and vaccines can't stop it; it will come to humanity itself...
article.articleSummary: An incident at a Russian military laboratory has claimed a death from plague, prompting global concern as authorities withhold details; the World Health Organization has asked Moscow for an explanation. The disease is caused by Yersinia pestis, typically carried by rodents. Pneumonic plague, the most dangerous form, spreads rapidly between people via respiratory droplets and can also arise from bubonic or septicemic forms that progress to pneumonia if untreated. Worldwide plague cases range about 1,000–3,000 annually; Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo report the highest numbers, but cases are also documented in Russia, India, China, and the United States. Symptoms begin with fever, chills, headache, severe body pains, and weakness, followed within 24 hours by cough, chest pain, breathing difficulties, and often bloody sputum, leading to rapid respiratory failure. Early antibiotics (streptomycin, gentamicin, doxycycline, ciprofloxacin) for 10–14 days and strict isolation are critical; there are currently no vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの軍事研究所でペストにより死者が発生；ロシアは真実を隠蔽；迫りくるのは死をもたらす『肺ペスト』なのか？マスクもワクチンも効かない；人類全体への脅威か…
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシア軍事研究所における単発の死亡例に関する憶測的な報道であり、対象国（DRC・インド・中国等）は世界的な症例数の背景情報として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため対象国での発生事例とは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラヤーラム語メディアによるセンセーショナルな見出しの憶測的報道で、信頼できる公式情報源や詳細な確認情報が欠如している。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、DRC・インド・中国は世界の年間ペスト症例数の文脈でのみ言及されており、実際の発生国としての記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Dugaan Kasus Keracunan Makanan di 88 SEOUL Bandung, Begini Faktanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral: Alleged Food Poisoning Case at 88 Seoul Bandung, Here’s the Truth.
article.articleSummary: In Bandung, Indonesia, the 88 Seoul restaurant in the Paskal area faced an alleged food-poisoning incident after patrons dined on October 2–3, 2026. By October 6, Bandung City Health Office reported 24 people with gastrointestinal symptoms—diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fever—some requiring medical care; one case involved appendicitis surgery. The restaurant temporarily closed for cleaning and a review of hygiene SOPs; authorities are investigating hygiene and food-handling standards. Early information points to possible microbial contamination; common agents include Salmonella and Escherichia coli, often linked to raw meat, dairy, or fresh produce. Patrons with similar symptoms are urged to report to local health facilities. First aid emphasizes oral rehydration with water or ORS, easily digestible foods, rest, and avoiding spicy, fatty, or caffeinated drinks; seek medical care if symptoms persist.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンの『88ソウル』レストランで食中毒疑惑が拡散、その真相とは
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの局地的な食中毒疑い事例であり、原因病原体も未確定、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: SNSで話題になっているが、単一施設の食中毒事案であり病原体も未確定。地元保健当局が調査・対応中で、公衆衛生上の重大なリスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن والصحة العالمية تطالبان موسكو بتفاصيل إضافية وشفافة بشأن مرض الطاعون - سواليف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington and the World Health Organization call on Moscow to provide additional and transparent details about the plague.
article.articleSummary: Darya Shibelova, 28, an employee at the Irkutsk Institute of Research on Plague, died on 2 October from acute pneumonia of unknown origin. The case has sparked international scrutiny amid unconfirmed reports of a laboratory incident involving Yersinia pestis; Russia says there are no confirmed plague cases and no infections among the deceased’s contacts, with around 200 people monitored or quarantined before measures were eased after negative tests. The World Health Organization has not received data confirming plague in Irkutsk and has requested details on the pneumonia’s cause and the etiologic agent, plus any additional unknown-origin pneumonia cases. The United States, coordinating with U.S. health authorities, has urged Russia to share precise, timely information. China and Mongolia are monitoring the situation along their borders; currently no evidence that the death is due to plague, as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンとWHO、ペストに関してモスクワに追加の透明性ある情報提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の急性肺炎で死亡し、研究所内事故の未確認報道やWHOの情報要請があるが、ペスト確定例はなく対象国での発生も確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 事象の主体はロシア（対象国リスト外）。中国とモンゴルは国境付近で監視中と言及されているが、自国内での症例発生は報告されていない。中国は監視活動の主体として言及されているため参考として記載。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯鼠疫｜世衞向俄查核實驗室「第二名患者」　美國大使館籲在俄公民離開 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian Plague | WHO asks Russia's verification laboratory to verify the 'second patient'; U.S. Embassy urges citizens in Russia to leave
article.articleSummary: In Siberia, Russia, a 28-year-old researcher, Daria Shipilova, died from unknown pneumonia at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute; reports indicate a second lab staff member infected with unknown pneumonia, with unverified claims of a further death. The WHO urged Russia to confirm whether a second case exists and to clarify the causative agent behind Daria’s illness; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus requested more information. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said there is no emergency and criticized media reports as misinformation; Reuters found no evidence of a second death. The U.S. Embassy in Moscow issued a health alert, urging American citizens to leave Russia and avoid travel, while the State Department maintains a Level 4 Do Not Travel advisory. Border controls were tightened by Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Mongolia; Uzbekistan and Mongolia announced heightened preparedness. China said it remains in close cooperation with Russia on plague and other infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト｜WHOがロシアに研究所の「第二の患者」の確認を要請、米国大使館はロシア在住の自国民に退避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所で研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、第二の感染例も疑われる中、WHOが情報提供を要求し、米国を含む複数国が渡航制限・国境強化措置を取っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 本事案はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク）で発生しており、対象国リスト（中国含む）には該当しない。中国はロシアと協力関係にあると言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола вышла из-под контроля в дружественной России стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Has Gone Out of Control in a Country Friendly to Russia
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has spiraled beyond control. By 2026-10-08, registered cases exceed 8,600 with over 4,100 deaths. About 75% of Ebola deaths occur outside healthcare facilities, as patients die at home or while traveling to care. North Kivu accounts for nearly 40% of the country’s new confirmed cases, with most new infections not linked to existing transmission chains. The outbreak, initially centered in the Butembo area, now spans all neighboring medical districts, and new foci emerge weekly. Fear of Ebola and care centers drives many patients to remain at home, with relatives providing care and increasing transmission risk. Context: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Congo is a reliable friend and partner of Russia at a Beijing event.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがロシアと友好的な国で制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の症例が8,600人、死亡者4,100人を超え、感染連鎖が追跡不能な新規感染が大半を占めるなど、制御不能な拡大を示しており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの政治的文脈（プーチン発言）を含むが、主題は北キブ州でのエボラ流行拡大であり、感染症危機として重大。地域感染連鎖の追跡不能化、医療機関外死亡割合の高さ（75%）から管理困難な状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Распространение вышло из‑под контроля. В Конго резко растет число заболевших Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak has gotten out of control. In Congo, the number of Ebola cases is rising sharply.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has intensified since it began in April, with 8,603 people infected and 4,148 deaths reported. North Kivu now accounts for about 40% of all new confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in early September, described the current epidemic as the fastest-growing in history and noted transmission chains remain unknown to clinicians. The report cites Doctors Without Borders via Africanews, highlighting a rapidly worsening epidemiological situation in the region. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Data reflect ongoing, escalating transmission in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as of October 8, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大が制御不能に。コンゴでエボラ感染者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でのエボラ流行が「史上最速の拡大」とWHO事務局長が指摘しており、致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクもあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が『史上最速の拡大』と発言し、感染経路が臨床医にも不明なままであることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。感染者数8,603人、死亡者数4,148人という規模も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 衛生署：料未來數周流感仍維持高水平 籲高危人士接種疫苗 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health: Influenza is expected to remain at a high level in the coming weeks; urges high-risk individuals to get vaccinated - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong remains high into October 2026, with 23 severe pediatric cases since late June and a peak in September; the season is unusually long, and high-risk individuals are urged to vaccinate. Over the past two weeks flu activity stayed elevated without a rise. Since school term started in September there have been about 370 influenza-like illness outbreaks in schools, affecting roughly 2,200 people. The circulating strains are influenza A H1, accounting for more than 85% of cases, followed by H3; genetic analysis shows these strains align with global circulating strains and no evidence of heightened virulence or antiviral resistance. The season started later, with no winter season Jan–Mar; a shift from H3 to H1 may reduce population immunity and prolong the season. Parents should monitor children for rapid breathing, blue lips, confusion, or persistent fever and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署：今後数週間、インフルエンザは高水準を維持する見込み；高リスク者にワクチン接種を呼びかけ - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザが異常に長期化し、小児重症例23例・学校アウトブレイク約2,200人発生という重症度・異常性が見られ、衛生当局も注意喚起を行っているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありと判断。
triage.notes: ウイルス学的には流行株は世界的流行株と一致し、病原性増強や薬剤耐性の証拠はないとされている。H3からH1への株シフトにより集団免疫が低下し季節が長期化している可能性が指摘されている。香港（特別行政区）はChinaとして集計。

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫燒到中國? 東北三省瘋傳「封城」警訊 疾呼儲糧、準備「這些藥」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague reaches China? Lockdown warnings spreading across Northeast China's three provinces; urgent calls to stockpile food and prepare “these medicines.”
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Russia’s Siberia, with an Irkutsk plague research institute reporting the death of a female laboratory worker. Russia says the death is due to pneumonia of unknown origin; health authorities have not confirmed plague. WHO requests additional information. Europe’s Lithuania says border controls could be considered if confirmed, but EU coordination is planned; ECDC reports no second case and no sustained human-to-human transmission; overall European risk remains low. The United States pressures Moscow for transparency; President Trump says he may discuss the issue with Putin. China–Russia talks are planned for mid-October; China has not stated whether the outbreak is on the agenda. In northeast China (Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang), social media warns residents to stockpile food and medicine; no verified evidence of lockdown. CDC lists antibiotics (ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, doxycycline, gentamicin, streptomycin) for plague treatment or post-exposure prophylaxis, to be used under medical guidance. No large-scale outbreak confirmed; misinformation circulating.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストが中国に波及？東北三省で「封鎖」警報が拡散、食料備蓄と『これらの薬』の準備を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト疑い死亡例をめぐりWHOが追加情報を要請し、複数国（米国・リトアニア・EU）が懸念を表明、渡航制限検討の動きもあるためIHR基準が複数該当。また中国東北部でSNSを通じた強い社会的関心（買い占め・封鎖懸念）も見られる。
triage.notes: 実際の疑い症例・死亡はロシア（イルクーツク州、対象国リスト外）で発生。中国東北三省（遼寧・吉林・黒竜江）はSNS上の憶測・パニックのみで、確認された症例やロックダウンの事実は報告されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК заявили о быстром распространении Эболы в Северном Киву
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, authorities report rapid spread of Ebola in North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Since early September, North Kivu accounts for nearly 40% of the country’s newly confirmed cases, up from 24% at the end of August, per MSF. New foci are emerging weekly as the northern province is expanding, with the health system short of specialized beds. By 28 September, 34% of confirmed EVD patients were treated in non-specialized facilities, and MSF notes over 60% of Ebola deaths occur in communities where relatives and friends provide care. In Butembo (≈2 million residents) two new Ebola treatment centers have opened, but capacities remain insufficient, and some patients are referred to other facilities with limited safe care. The current flare began in Ituri province and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with growth in Beni suggesting potential rebounds in Butembo and surrounding areas. Separately, Kenya quarantined 29 people after the first imported Ebola death; the patient, Kenyan by nationality but resident in DRC for ~7 years, traveled via Uganda to Kenya, with eight family members and 21 healthcare workers monitored.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)当局、北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラが急速に拡大し医療体制が逼迫、ケニアへの越境輸入例も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの輸入例およびウガンダ経由の渡航歴が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。北キブ州・イトゥリ州はDRC国内の地域として集約した。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumonic plague spread to PH highly unlikely, says health expert
article.articleSummary: On Oct 8, 2026, Philippine infectious-disease expert Rontgene Solante said the international spread of pneumonic plague to the Philippines is extremely unlikely. The caution follows concerns after a Russian lab technician suspected to have died from pneumonic plague due to a broken test tube; WHO reports low risk and no outbreak signs in Russia. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is a rare, more fatal form of bubonic plague that affects the lungs and transmits via respiratory droplets, unlike flea-borne bubonic plague. Symptoms include fever, cough, and difficulty breathing; mortality is high but the disease is treatable with available medicines. Russia is conducting tests and quarantines as part of the response. Solante emphasized zero likelihood of the Philippines' involvement despite modern air travel.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストのフィリピンへの拡大の可能性は極めて低いと専門家が発言
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疑い事例はロシアの検査技師1名（研究室内事故）に限られ、WHOも低リスク・アウトブレイクの兆候なしと評価。フィリピンでは実際の症例はなく、専門家が拡大の可能性を否定するコメントのみであり、対象国における実質的な公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 実際の疑い事例発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。フィリピンは当該疾病の発生国ではなく、専門家コメントのみのため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin về việc giám sát, đánh giá nguy cơ dịch hạch tại Nga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health provides information on the monitoring and assessment of plague risk in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Death of a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk on 2 October 2026 after pneumonia of unknown etiology prompted international monitoring for plague risk. By 7 October 2026, the World Health Organization is coordinating with Russian authorities to verify information and assess health implications. No plague cases have been reported in Irkutsk. Russian epidemiologic investigations and preventive measures identified contacts for health surveillance and testing; no high-risk pathogen has been detected among exposed individuals, and contact surveillance is complete. The Vietnamese Ministry of Health continues to coordinate with WHO to monitor the situation and update risk assessments. Public guidance emphasizes staying calm, following official sources, maintaining hygiene, and rodent and flea control; avoid handling sick or dead rodents without protection. People with fever, lymph node swelling, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath after exposure should seek prompt medical care and not self-medicate with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシアにおけるペスト流行リスクの監視・評価について情報提供
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、ペストリスクとしてWHOが調査・監視を行っている異常事例であり、ベトナム保健省も注視・情報発信を行っているため社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナムは保健省がWHOと連携し監視・情報発信を行っているのみで、国内発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。ペスト確定例は報告されておらず、曝露者からの病原体検出もなし。

article.articleHeadline: República Dominicana atenta por brote peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dominican Republic on alert for pneumonic plague outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague concerns Dominican Republic, which has intensified epidemiologic surveillance at airports, seaports, and border crossings to quickly identify and notify any suspected cases among travelers from risk areas. The Ministry of Public Health emphasizes that plague is not endemic in the country. Internationally, a possible outbreak in Siberia, Russia, is being investigated after the death of a 28-year-old woman in Shélejov; two theories are considered—infection acquired in Thailand (Yersinia pestis) or a laboratory accident with a pathogen tube. The World Health Organization is monitoring the situation and has requested additional information from Russia. PAHO notes natural plague foci in Bolivia, Brazil, Ecuador, the United States, and Peru but does not indicate active outbreaks. No confirmed imported or exported cases are reported for the Dominican Republic.

triage.headline_ja: ドミニカ共和国、肺ペスト流行に警戒
triage.triage_reason: シベリア（ロシア）での肺ペストによる死亡例とタイでの感染疑いが国際的に調査されており、WHOも情報提供を要請しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性からIHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 実際の死亡例はロシア・シェレホフで発生しており、タイでの感染は未確定の仮説の一つに過ぎない。ブラジル等は自然疫源地の存在のみが言及され、活動的な発生は報告されていないため、対象国リストに該当する確定的な発生国は無い。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯暴发了鼠疫吗？这里是我们了解到的信息
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has Russia experienced a plague outbreak? Here’s what we know.
article.articleSummary: Russia faces unresolved questions about a potential plague-linked situation after the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova at the Irkutsk-Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute from a mysterious pneumonia earlier in October 2026, prompting isolation of hospital staff and institute contacts. The New York Times compiled available information and consulted experts to clarify the situation, noting many unknowns and urging calm. Plague remains endemic globally, with hundreds of cases annually, primarily in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, but also reported in the United States, Russia, and other countries. The causative agent is Yersinia pestis. Human infection occurs in three forms: bubonic plague (flea bite, lymph node swelling), septicemic plague (bloodstream infection), and pneumonic plague (rapid lung infection, highly contagious via coughing or sneezing). No panic is advised while investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行は発生したのか？分かっていることをまとめる
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所関係者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し隔離措置が取られたが、ペストとの因果関係や拡大状況は未確認であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク）における原因不明肺炎死亡例であり、対象国リストに該当なし。マダガスカル・DRCはペストの世界的流行状況説明の一般的文脈として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯暴發了鼠疫嗎？這裡是我們了解到的信息
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did Russia experience a plague outbreak? Here is what we know.
article.articleSummary: Darya Shipilova, 28, an employee of the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute, died earlier this month from a mysterious pneumonia, leading Russia’s health authorities to quarantine the hospital where she died, the institute, and others who had contact with her. Plague remains present globally, with hundreds of cases each year, mainly in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo, but also reported in the United States, Russia, and other countries. The causative bacterium is Yersinia pestis, transmitted primarily by fleas from rodent and other small mammal hosts. Human infection occurs in three forms: bubonic plague (lymph nodes), septicemic plague (bloodstream), and pneumonic plague—the most severe form that can spread via coughing or sneezing. The article notes ongoing uncertainty about any current outbreak in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト流行が発生したのか？現在分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、病院・研究所・接触者が検疫対象となるなど異常性と重篤性が認められ、IHR基準で2項目以上該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクでの事例であり、対象国リストにロシアは含まれない。DRC・米国・マダガスカルはペストの一般的な流行地域として背景情報的に言及されているのみで、本事例の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de peste na Rússia preocupa. Pode chegar cá?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A case of plague in Russia causes concern. Could it reach here?
article.articleSummary: On Oct 2, 2026, a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, at the Irkutsk Institute of Antipeste in Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, died after several days of hospitalization with pneumonia; authorities are investigating whether pneumonic plague caused the death. Contacts are being traced and monitored, with preliminary test results reportedly negative so far, though the specific pathogen is not yet confirmed. Media reports suggest about 200 people are under observation and several hospitals, including a maternity hospital, are under quarantine, though official statements have varied. The World Health Organization says the risk is moderate-to-low for Irkutsk, low for Russia, and very low for the WHO European region, and is conducting an investigation. China reports ongoing cooperation; the United States and the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control are monitoring. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis; pneumonic plague affects the lungs and allows human-to-human transmission, unlike bubonic or septicemic forms, and is linked to local animal reservoirs in Siberia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト症例が懸念を呼ぶ。ここまで広がる可能性は？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し肺ペストの可能性が疑われており、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある重篤な感染症で国際的な監視（WHO・中国・米国・ECDC）が行われているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。中国は協力・監視国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外した。病原体は未確定（肺炎による死亡、肺ペストの可能性を調査中）。

article.articleHeadline: 川普表示安排與普丁通話討論俄羅斯鼠疫　中國東北居民也緊張
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump says he has arranged a call with Putin to discuss the plague in Russia; residents of Northeast China are also anxious.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Western Siberia reports the death of a laboratory worker from an unknown pneumonia, with officials saying tests show no link to work and the cause remains unconfirmed. Government and U.S. sources caution the possibility of pneumonic plague, which would spread mainly via respiratory droplets in close contact if confirmed. A U.S. demarche and embassy health alert signal concerns over transparency; Washington warns Americans against travel to Russia. President Trump says he arranged a call with Putin to discuss the issue. Central Asia’s border states—Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan—tighten health checks along Russia. Northeast China’s three provinces—Heilongjiang, Jilin, and Liaoning—remain anxious due to Siberia’s proximity and memories of the 1910 Northeast plague that killed about 60,000. Background includes a late-August cross-border epidemic drill in Heilongjiang and a October 2 report of a suspected Siberian plague outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Lima langkah sederhana untuk mencegah penularan influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Simple Steps to Prevent the Spread of Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based guidance on influenza A highlights five preventive steps: 1) maintain health with balanced nutrition, regular exercise, and adequate sleep; 2) annual vaccination, updated to circulating strains as immunity wanes over time; 3) wear masks in high-risk settings such as crowded or enclosed spaces; 4) proper cough and sneeze etiquette, using tissue or elbow instead of hands; 5) strict hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizer. Influenza A spreads via respiratory droplets; symptoms commonly include fever, chills, sore throat, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue, appearing about 1–4 days after exposure. High-risk groups—children under five, the elderly, pregnant individuals, and those with chronic diseases—are more likely to develop severe illness and pneumonia. Diagnosis uses rapid antigen tests from nasal or nasopharyngeal swabs; PCR or other molecular tests offer higher sensitivity in severe or at-risk cases. Guidance provided by Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, a Diponegoro University-trained clinical microbiologist, in Jakarta.

triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、一般的な予防啓発に関する記事であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar: Masker bantu kurangi risiko penularan influenza tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert: Masks help reduce the risk of Influenza A transmission.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based expert warns masks reduce Influenza A transmission. Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, Microbiology Specialist at Diponegoro University, states masks lower respiratory droplets from the sick and protect others, especially in crowded or enclosed settings. Annual influenza vaccination is advised, particularly for children, the elderly, and those with chronic conditions, since the virus evolves and antibody protection wanes. Emphasize cough etiquette (tissues or inner elbow) and hand hygiene with soap and water or sanitizer. Maintain general health with balanced nutrition, regular exercise, and adequate sleep. Influenza A presents with fever, chills, sore throat, headache, myalgia, and fatigue 1–4 days after exposure; pneumonia is a key complication. Diagnostics include rapid antigen tests from nasal/nasopharyngeal swabs and PCR for higher sensitivity in severe or high-risk cases in Jakarta, Indonesia. Published 2026-10-08.

article.articleHeadline: Трамп зробив насторожуючу заяву про чуму в Росії: що насправді сталося
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump made an alarming statement about the plague in Russia: what really happened.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 7, 2026, US President Donald Trump said Washington does not currently view the death of a Russian laboratory employee who studied plague as linked to biological weapons. The Washington Post, citing the White House, reports the United States intends to investigate but regards a bioweapons link as unlikely for now. Trump noted Russian officials told the US the situation is under control, but warned Moscow’s statements resemble early 2020 behavior when China claimed to control the outbreak that later became the COVID-19 pandemic. He called for more information from Russia and emphasized that US experts are analyzing incoming data. The remarks come amid heightened attention to a possible infectious disease outbreak in Russia; no public evidence was presented to substantiate a bioweapons connection, and Washington seeks clearer explanations from Moscow.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、ロシアのペストについて警戒すべき発言：実際に何が起きたのか

triage.notes: 記事はロシアの研究所でのペスト関連死とそれに対する米国の反応を扱っており、対象国リスト（中国含む）のいずれにも実際の発生国として該当しない。中国への言及は2020年COVID-19との比較の文脈のみで、現在の中国での発生事実ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "Врачи без границ" предупредили о резком росте случаев Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warned of a sharp rise in Ebola cases in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Doctors Without Borders warns of a sharp rise in Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in North Kivu. The northeast region accounts for nearly 40% of new cases nationwide, with transmission seemingly leaving control. Stefanie Hoffmann, MSF’s Ebola Treatment Center coordinator in Butembo, says most new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, complicating containment. A major constraint is weak community engagement, as many people fear admitting illness and seeking care. On 21 September, the Congolese National Institute for Public Health reported 3,699 confirmed Ebola deaths across seven of the DRC’s 26 provinces, illustrating the outbreak’s breadth. Ongoing transmission and geographic spread threaten control efforts, highlighting the need for intensified surveillance, robust community outreach, and rapid isolation of suspected cases to halt further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱症例の急増を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC北キブ州を中心に急増し、未知の感染経路が多く制御が困難となっており、死者数も多数（3,699人）に上るため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSFが地域社会の協力不足と未知の感染経路の多さを指摘しており、制御困難な状況が継続している。7州にまたがる大規模流行で、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Aldai MP urges govt to urgently trace passengers who flew with Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease case involves a Kenyan resident who had lived in the DRC, traveling from the DRC to Kampala, Uganda, then on an Entebbe–Nairobi flight on Oct 3. He arrived at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport at about 1:10 pm and was isolated at Nairobi Hospital; the Ministry of Health confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease and the patient died. Initial tracing identified 28 contacts (family and healthcare workers); authorities targeted 23 passengers and four crew on the same flight. By Oct 7, 2026, 57 contacts had been identified, with 10 under quarantine. Aldai MP Marianne Kitany urged rapid identification and monitoring of all passengers and crew on the Entebbe–Nairobi flight, stressing exposure risk increases with delays and calling for a full movement map from the airport to Nairobi port and all interactions before isolation. Kenya has intensified surveillance but says there is no outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アルダイ選出国会議員、政府にエボラ感染者と同便搭乗者の追跡を緊急に求める

triage.notes: 本事例はケニア（対象国外）での輸入エボラ症例が主題。患者はDRCに居住歴がありウガンダ経由でケニアに入国したが、DRC国内での流行発生自体は本記事で明確に述べられていないため、verified_locationsへの含有は参考情報として注記する。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cas de peste en Russie ? Héritage soviétique, maladies dangereuses... que sait-on du laboratoire où travaillait l'employée décédée ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of plague in Russia? Soviet legacy, dangerous diseases... what do we know about the laboratory where the deceased employee worked?
article.articleSummary: An Irkutsk Institute of Plague, established in 1934 in Siberia, specializes in studying and monitoring highly dangerous infectious diseases, including plague (Yersinia pestis), cholera, and anthrax. In early October 2026 a 28-year-old technician, Daria Shipilova, died on October 2; authorities indicate the death could be linked to a pulmonary form of plague. Created by the Soviet Union to combat plague outbreaks in Siberia and the Russian Far East, the institute’s history includes early leadership by microbiologist Alexei Skorodoumov, who worked on outbreaks in Siberia, Mongolia, and China. Yersinia pestis naturally circulates among some small mammals and their fleas in the region. While NPR notes possible links between Soviet plague facilities and bioweapons programs, there is no evidence this institute conducted weapon research. Today it operates under Russia’s consumer health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, continuing surveillance and monitoring of plague circulation to prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染か？ ソ連時代の遺産、危険な病原体…死亡した職員が勤務していた研究所について何が分かっているか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が肺ペストで死亡した可能性があり、異常性が高く社会的関心も強いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべき事案と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）の研究施設であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。モンゴル・中国への言及は過去の歴史的背景（研究所創設者の活動歴）であり、現時点のイベント発生国ではないため除外した。研究所内感染か自然感染かは不明で、今後の続報（感染経路、二次感染の有無）を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Issues Fresh Ebola Travel Advisory for Kenya
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola case confirmed in Kenya: a Kenyan man who traveled from the DRC via Kampala to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport was confirmed as the first Bundibugyo Ebola case on Oct 3. The patient was laboratory-confirmed, isolated at Nairobi Hospital, and died during treatment. By Oct 7, 10 people were in quarantine and 57 contacts (passengers and crew) traced. A further suspected Bundibugyo case emerged in Wajir County from a person reportedly arriving from the DRC. The World Health Organization advised Kenya not to close borders, stressing entry-point screening, contact tracing, and other public health measures over blanket travel restrictions, and said transparency should be rewarded. Kenya has isolation centers and checkpoints at JKIA and the Kenya-Uganda border, with President William Ruto asserting readiness to respond to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアのエボラ感染確認を受け新たな渡航勧告を発出

triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの越境感染例だが、感染者はDRCからの渡航者であり、発生源はDRCと推察される。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でDRC国内の発生状況確認が必要。

article.articleSummary: Russia’s Pneumonic Plague scare centers on a 28-year-old woman in the Irkutsk region (Shelekhov hospital) who reportedly died after exposure; some reports linked the death to pneumonic plague, while Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor states the death was due to pneumonia and no dangerous pathogen was found in tested samples. Public events were canceled and masks were mandated in some areas, with discussions of lockdown but officials urged calm. There is no confirmed spread to India as of 2026-10-08, and Russian officials deny a plague outbreak. Neighboring Central Asian countries—Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan—have heightened border surveillance in response to the situation.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Races to Trace All Contacts After First Ebola Death, Who Official Says
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death from the Bundibugyo strain, an imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The victim, a Kenyan man who had lived in DRC, flew to Nairobi on 3 October via Kampala and Entebbe and died there on Monday. Contact tracing has identified about 10 relatives under quarantine, and 21 hospital staff, lab nurses, and others who treated him; Nairobi Hospital staff are to be quarantined. Authorities are also tracing roughly 23 passengers and 4 crew members on the Entebbe–Kampala flight. WHO is supporting Kenya, the DRC, and Uganda with surveillance, screening and rapid response, coordinated with Africa CDC, IOM and UNICEF. Transmission occurs through bodily fluids; emphasis on hand hygiene, avoiding close contact, recognizing symptoms and seeking care early. The incubation period is 2–8 days, and quarantining contacts aims to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、WHO当局者によれば全接触者の追跡急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)輸入例がケニアで死亡し、国境を越えた接触者追跡（航空機乗客含む）が進行中で、IHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ死亡例とその対応だが、感染者はDRC在住歴がありDRCからの輸入例であるため発生国としてDRCを含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 山东：农村地区65岁及以上老年人和义务教育阶段中小学生，免费接种1剂次三价流感病毒裂解疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shandong: In rural areas, elderly people aged 65 and above and primary and secondary school students in compulsory education will receive a free single dose of trivalent influenza split vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Shandong Province launched a free, single-dose influenza vaccination program for rural residents aged 65 and above and compulsory-education primary and secondary students, under the rural 'one old one small' initiative. The vaccine used is the trivalent influenza split vaccine. The program started on September 29, 2026, with September–October identified as the optimal vaccination period. Eligible individuals should visit designated immunization clinics in their jurisdiction; local public health centers can provide details. The influenza season in Shandong typically runs from November to March, so early vaccination helps antibody levels reach protective levels before the peak. It takes 2–4 weeks to develop protective antibodies after vaccination, and even if the optimal window is missed, vaccination later still offers protection. Targeted groups have higher risks of severe complications from influenza infection, underscoring the public health focus of this program.

The article, dated 2026-10-08, also discusses how many Indians are currently in Russia and summarizes the Indian government’s statements in response to the plague risk. The piece centers on exposure risk, ongoing monitoring, and containment actions rather than confirmed cases or fatalities, noting that laboratory confirmation may be pursued. The infection source is linked to the plague prevention facility, with emphasis on monitoring and precautionary measures for contacts and cross-border public health considerations.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump made an alarming statement about the plague in Russia: what actually happened.
article.articleSummary: On October 7, 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump stated that the United States does not currently view the death of a Russian laboratory employee who studied plague as linked to biological warfare. The Washington Post, citing the White House, reports Washington will pursue answers but does not consider a bioweapons scenario likely at this stage. Russian officials have said the situation is under control, though Trump cautioned that Moscow has not shared sufficient information. He compared current Russian statements to early 2020 assurances from China about containing a novel virus later associated with COVID-19. The administration says experts are analyzing incoming data and more details are expected. The episode has heightened attention to a possible infectious-disease incident in Russia, including a plague outbreak context, but there is no public evidence yet to confirm causation or rule out other explanations.

article.articleHeadline: Turkana ramps up Ebola surveillance
article.articleSummary: Turkana county, Kenya, has intensified Ebola surveillance, remaining one of 12 counties classified as very high risk near international borders with Uganda, Ethiopia and South Sudan. A joint training of health officers in Lodwar and Kakuma, led with Amref Health Africa’s Imarisha Jamii and the International Rescue Committee’s Core Group Partners Project, brought together staff from all 12 sub-counties to bolster surveillance, case handling, and prevention. Kenya recorded its first Ebola death around the time of the report; preparedness activities run through Oct 31, 2026, with a possibility of extension beyond Sept 30. Turkana also held a virtual session for 303 health workers to map risks and identify priority sub-counties. KNPHI warned of vulnerability to imported cases due to porous borders with DRC; Governor Lomorukai urged proactive, staff readiness, and community-focused preventive measures, while Agnes Mana highlighted capacity-building for CHPs and adherence to procedures.

article.articleHeadline: Dokter Ingatkan Pakai Masker untuk Kurangi Risiko Penularan Influenza Tipe A.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors remind people to wear masks to reduce the risk of Influenza Type A transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, influenza Type A remains circulating in Jakarta, with doctors urging protective measures. In Taman Sari at Klinik Pratama Aisyah, residents receive the influenza vaccine Flubio. Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, a clinical microbiology specialist, states that mask use can reduce transmission of respiratory particles from the sick and provide protection to others, especially in crowded or enclosed spaces. Annual vaccination is advised, particularly for high-risk groups such as young children and the elderly, with vaccine composition updated to match circulating strains though antibody protection wanes over time. Additional precautions include proper cough and sneeze etiquette, avoiding hand-to-hand contact with mucus, frequent hand washing with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizer, and maintaining general health through balanced nutrition, regular exercise, and adequate sleep. Influenza Type A infections present fever, chills, sore throat, headache, myalgia, and fatigue, and can lead to pneumonia, especially in vulnerable populations.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya puts travellers from 10 countries under tighter Ebola screening
article.articleSummary: Kenya tightened Ebola screening after confirming its first imported Ebola case and death, involving a traveller who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo on October 3. The patient was admitted to Nairobi Hospital and died after. Travellers from the DRC, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Angola, Zambia, Ethiopia, South Sudan and the Central African Republic will undergo screening at JKIA Gate 16, with health declaration forms and symptom checks. Five hospitals are designated to treat confirmed Ebola patients: Kenyatta National Hospital (8 beds), Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital (50), National Police Hospital (49), Portreitz (4), and Nairobi Hospital (130). Isolation centres include Malaba Health Centre, Busia Border, Kocholia; Alupe Sub District Hospital is under renovation. A Sh2.6 billion preparedness fund has been set aside; authorities will pursue contact tracing, quarantine and intensified surveillance, while the public is urged to practice hygiene and report suspected cases through official channels, toll-free 719.

article.articleHeadline: جنوب السودان يرفع حالة التأهب للإيبولا بعد تأكيد كينيا للحالة وفاة - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sudan raises Ebola alert level after Kenya confirms a death case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed an Ebola-related death, while South Sudan has reported no confirmed cases as of 8 October 2026. In Juba, the acting Health Minister announced heightened national readiness due to regional proximity to Congo’s outbreak zones and cross-border movement with Uganda and Kenya. South Sudan has activated eight infectious-disease units for isolation and case management and intensified border and airport screening across 15 high-risk states, including Juba International Airport. WHO notes national preparedness has risen from 29% in May to 65% currently (45% in June). Officials highlight surveillance, rapid-response capacity, and laboratory testing enabling swift action; Uganda’s outbreak was stopped in 92 days after 20 cases and 2 deaths. The public is urged to report suspected cases presenting fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or abnormal bleeding, practice hand hygiene, avoid contact with patients, and call the free hotline 6666 for reports.

article.articleHeadline: Thông tin kết quả phân tích vụ cá chết bất thường tại bờ biển Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Information on the analysis results of the unusual fish kill incident along the coast of Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: Unusual fish-kill along Hà Tĩnh coast, Vietnam, prompted chemical- and biology-based analyses. Water samples from Thiên Cầm and Vũng Áng, collected in late September, show seawater within normal limits per QCVN 10:2023/BTNMT; no pollution detected. Fish samples from cage-culture in Vũng Áng: 2/2 grouper (cá giò/cá bớp) tested positive for Red Sea Bream Iridovirus (RSIV); 1/2 samples showed Trichodina sp. In Thiên Cầm coastal area, Vibrio spp. bacteria (V. parahaemolyticus, V. fluvialis, V. alginolyticus) were found in 3/6 grouper and 3/5 other fish samples. These bacteria are common in marine environments and may cause opportunistic illness, but current data are insufficient to confirm Vibrio or RSIV as direct causes of the die-off. Authorities advise fish farmers to monitor health, adjust feed, supplement vitamins/minerals, sanitize nets, and dispose of dead fish per regulations, while maintaining coastal surveillance for prompt response.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省沿岸での魚の異常死事案に関する分析結果について

triage.notes: 本事案は魚類（養殖グルーパー）の異常死に関するもので、ヒト感染症のシグナルではない。Vibrio parahaemolyticusはヒトに感染しうるが、本記事では魚体からの検出のみで、ヒト症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Inquiétudes sur la peste en Russie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns over the plague in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 8, 2026, Russia quarantined 200 workers at the Irkutsk plague research institute in Siberia after the suspected death of technician Darya Shipilova, 28, from pneumonia (admitted Sep 29; died Oct 2). Authorities ended surveillance for 90% of staff after about 5,000 tests; some homes were disinfected. Russian officials have not confirmed a plague diagnosis. Pneumonic plague, if untreated, carries 80–85% mortality; prophylaxis was likely given to exposed individuals. There are three forms of plague caused by Yersinia pestis: bubonic (from infected flea bites, with swollen lymph nodes), pneumonic (can be transmitted from person to person), and septicemic. Lab work on pathogens carries higher risk due to enormous pathogen loads. Globally, six countries reported confirmed plague cases to the WHO 2019–2025, averaging over 500 cases annually, mainly Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo. In North America, plague persists in wildlife in the West; Canada last case 1939; the United States fewer than ten cases per year. Military use is deemed very unlikely; Soviet-era work on weaponization did not succeed, per experts.

article.articleHeadline: PNP warns public against spreading false info on pneumonic plague
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Philippine authorities urge caution over misinformation about pneumonic plague after reports from Irkutsk, Siberia, where a laboratory worker died at an anti-plague research institute. Russian authorities say no plague cases are confirmed, and the World Health Organization is seeking more information, with the overall risk deemed low. The Department of Health is closely monitoring developments and is prepared to respond, while the Bureau of Quarantine continues traveler screening and surveillance for rodents and their fleas on incoming cargo and vessels. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. calls for responsible social media use, warning that unverified claims can provoke public fear. The public is advised to rely on government agencies and credible sources, noting that freedom of expression has limits when public welfare is at stake.

article.articleHeadline: Deep Learning Reads Chest CT Scans to Stage COVID-19 Patients Faster
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 staging in ICU via COV-DSNet, a 3D CNN with mixed convolutions and attention, reads chest CT to classify patients as in progression or remission. Developed by Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, the Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School, and the National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology at Nanjing University, the model focuses on diseased lung regions to guide management. Data from 578 COVID-19 patients were used; after filtering, 297 CT scans from 156 patients entered analysis. In binary staging, mean AUC-ROC was 0.820 (SD 0.030; 0.792–0.844); verification set AUC was 0.864 (0.750–0.947) with sensitivity 0.708 and specificity 0.921, higher specificity than manual reading. Adding the AI-derived stage to a baseline model (APACHE II + PaO2/FiO2) raised AUC from 0.908 to 0.978, suggesting improved triage and ICU decision-making for severe COVID-19 cases.

article.articleHeadline: Nyutu warns Kenya against relaxing Ebola vigilance after first imported case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease case. A Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo traveled via Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on October 3, 2026; the patient was isolated at Nairobi Hospital and died after testing positive. The case triggers intensified public health actions: contact tracing expanded from 28 identified contacts (family, health workers) and 23 passengers plus 4 crew on the same flight to 57 contacts by October 7, with 10 under quarantine. The Health Ministry has maintained heightened Ebola alert since May 2026, screening over 652,000 travellers and testing 267 samples by October 6. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale says there is no outbreak, only an imported case; WHO supports surveillance, tracing, and other measures. Senator Nyutu warns against relaxing vigilance and urges sustained border screening, faster tracing, and quarantining exposed individuals, stressing prevention as national security.

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế chính thức phản hồi vụ nhân viên chống dịch hạch ở Nga tử vong vì mắc viêm phổi nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health officially responds to the case of a plague-control worker in Russia who died from severe pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Vietnam’s Ministry of Health reports a fatal case linked to plague control work in Russia. A staff member at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Control was hospitalized for severe pneumonia and died on 2 October 2026 in Irkutsk. WHO has been notified and is coordinating with Russian authorities; Irkutsk reportedly has no recent plague cases. Russian authorities conducted an epidemiological investigation, identified contacts, and implemented precautionary measures; no high-risk pathogen was detected among those exposed, and health monitoring for contacts has concluded. Vietnam’s health authorities maintain ongoing collaboration with WHO to verify media reports and assess international health implications. Public guidance from the Ministry includes: follow official sources, maintain hygiene and rodent/flea control, and seek medical care promptly if fever, swollen lymph nodes, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath occur; avoid self-medication with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシアでペスト対策従事者が重度肺炎で死亡した件について公式に回答
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究施設職員が重度肺炎で死亡した単発事例で、接触者からは高リスク病原体は検出されず健康監視も終了している。対象国（ベトナム等）での発生ではなく、国際的拡大リスクも限定的だが、ペストという重大疾患かつWHO通知済みのため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。ベトナム保健省は国内発生ではなくロシアでの事例に関する公式見解・注意喚起を発表しているのみで、ベトナムでの発生は確認されていないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Opposes Travel Bans as Kenya Reports First Ebola Death - NewsFire.GR | English Version
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its first Ebola death linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak after a symptomatic traveler passed airport screening and died within 48 hours of arrival. The victim, a Kenyan who had lived in the DRC for seven years, entered Kenya via Nairobi on Saturday after traveling through Uganda; he had shown Ebola symptoms for about a month before departure. Kenyan Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said the patient sought care in the DRC before returning home. The case raises questions about screening effectiveness. The WHO confirmed the Kenyan case, bringing the cross-border outbreak to four countries: DRC, Uganda, France and Kenya, with the Bundibugyo strain; as of Sept 23, WHO records 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths (≈50% CFR). Contact tracing: 23 passengers on the flight; 28 Kenyan contacts for 21-day incubation. WHO opposes travel restrictions, emphasizing detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例報告を受けても渡航制限に反対
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが国境を越えて拡大し、空港スクリーニングをすり抜けた症例がケニアで死亡するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの初症例報告だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: 鼠疫並未消失! 世衛警告 : 病死率11%、10國通報、6國確診、423人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague has not disappeared! WHO warns: 11% case-fatality rate, 10 countries report, 6 countries with confirmed cases, 423 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains a health concern. The World Health Organization reports that from 2019 to 2025, 10 countries notified human plague cases, with 6 confirmed and 423 deaths, about an 11% case-fatality rate from 3,847 suspected cases. Most cases are in the Congo and Madagascar, where plague remains enzootic in rodent populations and human exposure risk persists. The WHO warns that cases could occur in countries not currently reporting, suggesting the global burden may be underestimated. In Russia’s Irkutsk region, a deadly incident at a laboratory studying plague is linked to a suspected pneumonic plague event. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and spread mainly by fleas, or through contact with infected tissues or inhalation of pneumonic droplets; forms include bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic. Early antibiotics are effective; delays can be fatal. WHO calls for vigilance, stronger surveillance, diagnostics, rapid isolation, treatment, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは消えていない！WHO警告：致死率11%、10カ国が報告、6カ国で確定、423人死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがペストの国際的な拡大（10カ国報告、6カ国確定）と高い致死率（11%、423人死亡）を警告しており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当するため。DRCは主要流行国として継続的なリスクが指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる2019-2025年の世界的ペスト状況サマリー。主要流行地域はDRCとマダガスカルだが、マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所における肺ペスト疑い事案も言及されているが、ロシアも対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCにおける具体的な新規発生情報はなく、既知の常在地としての言及に留まる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông báo về ca tử vong vì 'viêm phổi lạ' tại Nga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports a death due to 'unknown pneumonia' in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia, from severe pneumonia of unknown origin occurred at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute. Vietnam’s Department of Disease Prevention informed WHO, which is actively monitoring the case with Russian authorities. Russian officials say there have been no recent pneumonic plague cases in Irkutsk; epidemiologic investigations and contact surveillance are underway, with no high-risk pathogen identified among contacts. Autopsy reportedly found pneumonia of unknown origin, not plague. WHO continues collaboration with Russia to assess any international health implications. On Oct 7, the U.S. Embassy advised Americans to avoid travel to Russia and depart if in the region; Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor stated no public health threat to Irkutsk residents. Public guidance: stay calm, follow official updates, maintain hygiene, avoid handling sick or dead rodents, and seek medical care for fever, swollen lymph nodes, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシアでの『原因不明肺炎』による死亡例を通知
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、WHOがロシア当局と監視中。米国大使館が渡航回避勧告を出すなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないためverified_locationsは空とした。ベトナムは情報伝達元（保健省がWHOに報告）として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。米国も渡航勧告を出した側であり発生国ではない。病原体はペストではなく原因不明の肺炎とされ、調査継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯鼠疫疑云：目前已知哪些信息？ - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's plague suspicions: what information is currently known?
article.articleSummary: In Russia's Irkutsk region, a 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute died after pneumonia; the laboratory was sealed and officials provided limited details, fueling speculation about plague. WHO says the immediate risk is low but information remains incomplete. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, persists globally with hundreds of cases each year, mainly in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo, but also in the United States and Russia. It appears as bubonic, septicemic, or pneumonic forms; pneumonic plague is highly contagious via respiratory droplets and can be fatal within days if untreated, though early antibiotics are effective. Russian authorities say there is no epidemiological risk to Irkutsk residents, and the deceased reportedly had plague vaccination. The episode has revived calls for transparency amid bioweapons concerns, though experts assess low short-term transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑：現在判明している情報は？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し施設が封鎖されるなど異常事態で、肺ペストの可能性や生物兵器への懸念から社会的関心が高まっているため、情報不足だがフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、CEPR対象国リストには該当しない。DRCやマダガスカルは世界的なペスト流行地域として一般論で言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないため除外した。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Маскируется под насморк. Грипп "Миссури" особенно опасен для детей
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Masquerading as a runny nose. "Missouri" influenza is especially dangerous for children.
article.articleSummary: A new influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 strain, A/Missouri/11/2025 (the so-called 'swine flu'), is forecast to spread actively in Russia during the 2026-2027 season. This modified version of the 2009 pandemic virus has been added to all Russian seasonal vaccines for 2026-2027, alongside the A(H1N1)pdm09 Hong Kong variant Darwin and influenza B Tokyo. Authorities warn the Missouri variant can cause more severe illness and serious complications. In severe cases, patients may experience cardiovascular, respiratory, and central nervous system involvement; common complications include sinusitis, bronchitis, and otitis, with children at heightened risk. Vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, and those with chronic cardiovascular, pulmonary, or endocrine diseases—may face particularly heavy disease burden. Symptoms mirror other influenza strains: fever 38–40°C, headache, myalgia, fatigue, dry cough, sore throat. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention; vaccination without delay is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 鼻風邪を装う。『ミズーリ』インフルエンザは子供に特に危険
triage.triage_reason: 新型A(H1N1)pdm09亜株（Missouri株）がロシアで2026-2027シーズンに流行予測されているが、対象国（日本・中国等）での発生事例ではなくワクチン株構成の説明記事であり、現時点で具体的な流行や症例報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザワクチン構成とMissouri株の重症化リスクに関する解説記事。発生地域にJapan/Chinaが含まれるが、これはワクチン株の命名由来（例：Tokyo株、Hong Kong Darwin株）であり、実際の発生国はロシアのみ。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans l'Est de la RDC : près de 2 000 enfants devenus orphelins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in eastern DRC: nearly 2,000 children have become orphans.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has left nearly 2,000 children orphaned or separated from caregivers, according to UNICEF. In Ituri province, 1,581 children, and in North Kivu, 322 children have become orphans or separated due to the outbreak. UNICEF notes the possibility of undercounting. A seven-month-old infant in Bunia survived after the mother died. Fear of transmission when a parent is hospitalized or dies discourages relatives from caring for affected children, complicating protection and support. To address this, UNICEF operates twelve creches near Ebola Treatment Centers to host children whose parents are in care and to enable medical follow-up for early symptom detection. UNICEF is also identifying foster families and organizing care for separated children. Overall funding needs are $113 million; only $40 million has been mobilized to date. The outbreak's social impact undermines traditional solidarity and leaves many children in vulnerable situations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ出血熱:約2,000人の子供が孤児に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続しており、感染拡大・社会的影響（孤児2,000人、資金不足）が深刻でIHR/WPRO基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中エボラアウトブレイク（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）に関する社会的影響の続報。資金不足（$113M中$40Mのみ確保）が国際支援の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Russia Pneumonic Plague | Russia Plague Latest News | Pneumonic Plague Russia | Russia Lab Worker De | Russia Pneumonic Plague: रूस में रहस्यमयी मौत से मचा हड़कंप, ट्रंप प्रशासन ने पुतिन से मांगी जानकारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Pneumonic Plague | Russia Plague Latest News | Pneumonic Plague Russia | Russia Lab Worker De | Russia Pneumonic Plague: A mysterious death in Russia has caused an uproar, the Trump administration has asked Putin for information.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic Plague concerns rise in Siberia after the death of a 28-year-old woman at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, following severe pneumonia on October 2, potentially caused by Yersinia pestis. About 200 close contacts have been placed under medical surveillance, with thousands of tests conducted; Russia says no plague cases among contacts. WHO has requested detailed information, including lab tests on the deceased, contact investigations, and public health measures; they are awaiting a fuller picture before assessing outbreak risk. The U.S. administration has formally pressed Russia for information; the CDC rates current U.S. risk as very low but continues heightened monitoring of travelers from Siberia. Russia and European sources maintain no evidence of transmission beyond Russia. India faces potential risk via travelers, with Goa screening discussed, but no national outbreak alert has been issued.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの肺ペスト｜ロシアのペスト最新ニュース｜肺ペスト ロシア｜ロシア研究所職員死亡｜ロシア肺ペスト：ロシアで謎の死亡が波紋を広げ、トランプ政権がプーチンに情報提供を要求
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員が肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis疑い）で死亡し、約200人の接触者が監視下に置かれWHOや米国が情報提供を求めるなど国際的関心が高まっており、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク）の研究所であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドはGoaでの渡航者スクリーニングが議論されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tämä tiedetään nyt Venäjän ruttoepäilystä
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is now known about Russia's plague suspicions.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 8, 2026, Russia faces concerns over a suspected cross-border health threat linked to pneumonic plague in East Siberia. An Irkutsk Infectious Diseases Research Institute employee, a 28-year-old woman, was hospitalized abruptly after a broken tube containing Yersinia pestis; she died Friday at Shelekhov city hospital. Official accounts cite death from an unknown-origin pneumonia and say no link to her work has been established. Russia reports no further cases; health authorities note that over 90% of exposed individuals have completed medical surveillance with no signs of disease. Local outlets claim a second lab worker developed severe pneumonia; Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov dismissed such reports as largely false. Mongolia and China have increased border vigilance; WHO has requested more information, including rationale for quarantine measures in Siberia. WHO assesses low risk in Russia, very low in Europe; plague is treatable with prompt antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑いについて現在判明していること
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト菌(Yersinia pestis)の実験室関連死亡例が発生し、WHOが情報提供を要請し検疫措置も取られているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。モンゴル・中国は国境警戒を強化したのみで、事例発生国ではないため除外。
