Deaths are still occurring largely in the community, highlighting gaps in contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCでエボラ症例増加の中、一律の渡航制限に反対を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,665例・4,178人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大事例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生国はDRC。南スーダン国境付近で新たなホットスポットが出現しており、越境リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО НЕМА ЦЕЛОСНА СЛИКА ЗА СМРТТА НА ЛАБОРАНТКАТА ВО СИБИР Москва тврди дека нема чума, но речиси 200 луѓе се под медицински надзор - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has no complete picture of the lab technician's death in Siberia; Moscow claims there is no plague, but nearly 200 people are under medical surveillance - plusinfo.mk
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory worker, Darya Shipilova, died in Irkutsk, Siberia, raising concerns of pulmonary plague. The WHO has not yet received a full case picture. Rosppotrebnadzor said she died of pneumonia of unknown etiology, and no plague-associated organisms were found in her samples. Unconfirmed reports suggested a potential exposure to Yersinia pestis in the lab, which Moscow denies; no concrete evidence supports this. Investigations explore other infection sources, including travel to Thailand or proximity to Mongolia, but none confirmed. About 200 people in contact with Shipilova remain under medical surveillance; over 60 institute staff were isolated, with quarantine extending to several nearby hospitals. Nearly 5,000 tests on ~200 people found no dangerous pathogen; ~60% have been released from quarantine. WHO seeks lab results and contact-tracing details; Russia says information was shared per procedures; US notes low risk to the United States. Yersinia pestis is the plague bacterium; pneumonic plague is highly transmissible and treatable with antibiotics if identified promptly.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはシベリアでの検査技師死亡について全容を把握しておらず、モスクワはペストを否定するも約200人が医療監視下にある - plusinfo.mk
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員がペスト疑いのある原因不明肺炎で死亡し、約200人が医療監視下に置かれWHOが情報収集を行っている。異常性・重篤性が認められ、国際機関の関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 事例はロシア・イルクーツク州シベリアで発生。モンゴルやタイへの渡航歴の可能性が言及されているが、いずれも感染経路調査の一環であり、対象国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア・モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 屏東爆今年首例本土登革熱　40多歲女發燒確診、感染源不明
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pingtung County reports this year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case; a woman in her 40s with fever diagnosed, infection source unknown.
article.articleSummary: Pingtung County reports this year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case: a woman in her 40s diagnosed in early October after fever, headache, muscle pains, and diarrhea; dengue virus type 4 detected. She is hospitalized; cohabiting contacts are asymptomatic, and the infection source remains under investigation. With no international travel history, officials classify it as locally acquired; viral sequencing will be performed to clarify the source. Public health measures include emergency chemical vector-control around the residence, mosquito-density surveys, environmental risk assessment, and intensified source reduction and education. Nationally, Taiwan has 188 confirmed dengue cases this year, including 13 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung City 10, Changhua County 2, Pingtung County 1) and 175 imported, mainly from Vietnam (48), Indonesia (29), and the Philippines (21). Temperatures remain suitable for mosquitoes; residents are urged to apply preventive measures and seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 屏東県で今年初の国内感染デング熱症例　40代女性が発熱で確診、感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の局地的なデング熱症例報告であり重大な国際拡大の兆候はないが、感染源不明かつ国内感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。記事中のフィリピン・インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入症例の感染源国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo bảo vệ sức khỏe sau ca bệnh ở Nga tử vong do viêm phổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health advises protecting health after a pneumonia-related death in Russia.
article.articleSummary: On 2 October 2026, a female laboratory staff member at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, died after pneumonia of unknown origin requiring hospital care. By 7 October 2026, the World Health Organization had shared initial information and is coordinating with Russian authorities; no recent plague cases have been reported in Irkutsk. Russian epidemiological investigations and control measures identified and monitored contacts; no high‑risk pathogen was found among those exposed, and medical surveillance is complete. WHO continues to assess any international health implications and to gather additional data. Vietnam's Ministry of Health urges calm, adherence to official updates, and routine hygiene measures; individuals with exposure or fever, lymphadenopathy, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath should seek prompt medical evaluation and avoid self‑medication with antibiotics. Updates will follow.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの肺炎による死亡例を受け、保健省が健康保護を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡した事案で、WHOが情報収集中だが高リスク病原体は検出されておらず、対象国での発生でもないため現時点では継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事はベトナム保健省が自国民向けに注意喚起している内容であり、ベトナム国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: गांधीनगर में राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस की तैयारियों पर डेंगू का साया: CRPF जवान की मौत, 43 भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue casts a shadow over National Unity Day preparations in Gandhinagar: CRPF jawan dies, 43 admitted.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has cast a shadow over Gandhinagar's National Unity Day parade preparations in Gujarat, with infections spreading among security forces stationed for the event. A 26-year-old CRPF jawan from Assam, Amal Barman, died during treatment after dengue was confirmed on October 3. Initial recovery followed by sudden deterioration and a drop in platelets led to his death, with chest pain and other complications noted. Currently 43 in-patients among BSF, CRPF, and ITBP personnel have been hospitalized, up from 24 earlier; reports among others with fever and pain are awaited. Authorities have ordered comprehensive anti-larva spraying, fogging, and door-to-door fever surveys at temporary housing and parade grounds. State data through week 40 of 2026 show over 150,000 serological tests and 2,345 dengue positives in Gujarat, signaling heightened outbreak activity ahead of the October 31 event.

triage.headline_ja: ガーンディーナガルの建国記念日準備にデング熱の影が：CRPF隊員死亡、43人入院
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例を含む集団感染がインドの国家的行事（National Unity Day）の警備要員間で発生し、州全体でも感染者数が急増しており、公衆衛生上の懸念と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: グジャラート州で2026年第40週までに15万件超の血清検査中2,345件が陽性と、季節的流行が継続中。国家的行事前の警備部隊内クラスターであり、政治的・社会的関心が高いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 屏東爆今年首例本土登革熱！40多歲女染第4型住院中「感染源待釐清」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pingtung reports this year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case; woman in her forties infected with dengue serotype 4 hospitalized, source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, dengue virus serotype 4, is Taiwan’s first locally transmitted dengue case this year, reported in Pingtung City, Pingtung County. The patient is a woman in her 40s who developed fever, headache, myalgia, and diarrhea in early October and was hospitalized after dengue confirmation and serotype 4 detection. Infection source under investigation; no international travel history; local transmission suspected. Nationally, 188 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases this year, including 13 local (Kaohsiung City 10, Changhua County 2, Pingtung County 1) and 175 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (48), Indonesia (29), and the Philippines (21). Public health actions include perimeter chemical control, vector-density surveys, and expanded testing; sequencing to clarify infection source. Clinicians should collect TOCC data and consider NS1 rapid testing. Residents should follow inspect, drain, clean, and scrub to reduce breeding; use DEET, Picaridin, or IR-3535 outdoors and seek prompt medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 屏東で今年初の本土感染デング熱確認！40代女性が第4型に感染し入院中「感染源は調査中」
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の本土感染デング熱症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、対象国（台湾は対象外）での発生でもないため。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（屏東・高雄など）での本土感染デング熱症例報告であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 台灣去函查證鼠疫疑雲「俄方未回覆」　疾管署：藥物、檢驗已整備
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan Sends Formal Inquiry to Verify Suspected Plague Case; "Russia Has Not Responded" — CDC: Drugs and Tests Ready
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC is coordinating with Russia and the WHO over a suspected plague case in Irkutsk Oblast after a laboratory staffer died of severe pneumonia and a second suspected plague death was reported on Oct 6. Russia reports no plague cases as of Oct 6; WHO says available information is insufficient to determine public risk, and epidemiologic investigations with contact tracing are underway with no high-threat pathogens detected among contacts. Taiwan has strengthened border fever screening and maintains ready diagnostic capacity and antibiotics for treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis; Taiwan has not had a plague case since 1953. Globally (2019–2025): 3,860 suspected plague cases, 2,646 confirmed, 423 deaths (roughly 11% CFR) across 10 countries. About 98% of confirmed cases are in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar; China has 19 confirmed cases, Mongolia 17. WHO will continue risk assessment and coordination with Russia.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾が鼠疫（ペスト）疑惑事案についてロシアに照会「ロシア側未回答」　疾病管理署：薬剤・検査体制は整備済み
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で検査技師の重症肺炎による死亡とペスト疑い死亡例が報告され、WHOがリスク評価を継続中。公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性があり、国際的な注目（台湾CDC・WHO関与）も高いためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストには含まれない。記事中のDRC・マダガスカル・中国・モンゴルの言及は2019-2025年の世界的統計（過去の確定例数）としての引用であり、今回の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。台湾側はロシアの未回答や自国での症例なし（1953年以来）という受信側の立場であり、イベント発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Melakukan Pemakaman Pertama Korban Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Holds the First Burial of Ebola Victims
article.articleSummary: Kenya held the first burial with strict infection-control protocols for an Ebola Bundibugyo virus case imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the nation’s first Ebola death. The victim, a Kenyan national who had previously lived in Congo, fell ill there, then traveled by road through Uganda before flying into Nairobi on 3 October. He died days after admission to Nairobi Hospital and isolation; laboratory confirmation identified Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. Health authorities emphasize there is no outbreak in Kenya, with the confirmed case being imported. Contact tracing expanded from 55 to 57 contacts; 10 contacts are in quarantine and about 17 were traced and located at the time of reporting. The burial occurred at Lang'ata Cemetery, about 7 km from Nairobi's central business district, under rigorous health safeguards. Kenya has screened over 652,000 travelers, tested 267 suspected cases, and trained nearly 5,000 health workers in prevention and management.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ犠牲者の初の埋葬を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染・発症した患者がウガンダ経由でケニアに渡航し、同国初のエボラ死亡例となった事例。越境移動を伴う輸入症例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大・渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに居住中にエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に感染・発症し、ウガンダ経由でケニアへ渡航後にナイロビで死亡。ケニア当局は国内アウトブレイクではなく輸入症例と説明しているが、感染源国であるDRCでの発生状況の確認が必要。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 屏東驚爆登革病毒第四型！今年首見 40歲女性感染源不明 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pingtung sees shocking outbreak of dengue virus serotype 4! This year's first case: a 40-year-old woman with an unknown source of infection.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever serotype 4 marks Taiwan's first local DENV-4 infection this year, in Pingtung County. A woman in her 40s residing in Pingtung City developed fever, headache, myalgia and diarrhea in early October and was hospitalized after testing positive for Dengue virus serotype 4. The cohabitant has no symptoms; infection source is under investigation, with no overseas travel history. Nationally, Taiwan has 13 locally acquired dengue cases (Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2, Pingtung 1) and 175 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (48), Indonesia (29) and the Philippines (21). Health authorities expanded sampling to 39 people (all negative so far) and intensified vector control, including emergency chemical spraying, mosquito density surveys, and environmental risk assessment, plus risk communication. Preventive measures include eliminating standing water, wearing long sleeves, and using DEET, Picaridin or IR-3535 repellents; seek prompt medical care for dengue-like symptoms and disclose travel/activity history.

triage.headline_ja: 屏東で衝撃のデング熱ウイルス血清型4型確認！今年初の症例、感染源不明の40歳女性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・屏東で今年初の血清型4型デング熱の局地感染例が発生し感染源が不明であるため注視が必要だが、現時点では単発例で深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は台湾（屏東県）における局地感染例であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の出身国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄抗鼠疫实验室员工死亡 绥芬河疾控宣传防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian anti-plague laboratory employee dies; Suifenhe CDC promotes epidemic prevention.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, an employee at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia, died of severe pneumonia; the pathogen is unconfirmed, fueling concerns about pneumonic plague and potential lab infection. In Suifenhe, Heilongjiang, China, the local Center for Disease Control and Prevention is conducting daily epidemic-prevention outreach via WeChat, posters, and lectures, but higher authorities have not detailed specific measures. Suifenhe, a major China–Russia border crossing, hosts many Russian visitors; hotels report variable occupancy. Social media discussants urge Russia to disclose more information amid questions about testing results. The WHO and Russia are coordinating under the International Health Regulations; Russia says no plague among about 200 close contacts, while the WHO is verifying a second unknown pneumonia case. A cross-border drill was held Aug 24–27 in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, with Sergei Balakhonov present. Pneumonic plague can spread by droplets and progress rapidly; antibiotics are vital.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所職員が死亡、中国・綏芬河の疾病予防管理センターが防疫啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所職員が重症肺炎で死亡し病原体が未確定で肺ペストの疑いがあること、WHOがIHRに基づき調査・検証を行っていること、中国国境都市でも警戒が強まっていることから、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点でフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 確定事例はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員のみで、中国・綏芬河では予防的な啓発活動が行われているに過ぎず、対象国リストにあるロシアは含まれず中国でも確定症例が報告されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。WHOが第二の未確定肺炎症例を検証中であり、今後の情報更新を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Masker Efektif Kurangi Risiko Penularan Influenza Tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Effective masks reduce the risk of Influenza A transmission.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A transmission risk reduced by consistent mask use, according to Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, a clinical microbiology specialist. In Jakarta (8 Oct), masks lessen respiratory droplets from sick individuals and offer added protection to bystanders, particularly in crowded or enclosed spaces with high transmission risk. Influenza A spreads via droplets during coughing, sneezing, or talking; symptoms often include fever, chills, sore throat, headache, muscle aches, and extreme fatigue, appearing 1–4 days after exposure. Annual vaccination remains crucial, especially for children under five, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases, with updates needed as the virus evolves and antibody protection wanes. Other measures: proper cough etiquette, hand hygiene with soap or alcohol-based sanitizer. Early detection via rapid antigen tests or PCR; rapid treatment helps prevent pneumonia and other complications; maintain immune health through balanced nutrition, regular exercise, and adequate sleep.

triage.headline_ja: マスクはインフルエンザA型の感染リスクを効果的に減らす
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではなく、インフルエンザA型予防に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ予防に関する一般的な医療専門家のアドバイスであり、具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini Penyakit Menular, Lapas Kelas IIA Metro Gelar Skrining VCT Bagi Puluhan Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection of Infectious Diseases, Metro Class IIA Prison Holds VCT Screening for Dozens of Inmates
article.articleSummary: Metro Class IIA Prison in Kota Metro, Lampung, conducted voluntary HIV and syphilis screening for 76 inmates on 7 October 2026. The screening, a collaboration between Lapas Kelas IIA Metro and Puskesmas Iringmulyo, was carried out in the prison Aula by the Puskesmas Iringmulyo VCT team with internal medical staff. The process included registration, data collection, pre-test counseling, education on HIV/AIDS, and post-test counseling, with strict confidentiality for all results. The initiative aims for early detection and to curb transmission in the crowded prison environment, where infection risk is higher. Lapas Metro Director Tetra Destorie underscored inmates’ right to quality health services and gratitude for the partner’s support, noting that referrals would be arranged if medical indications arise. An inmate representative, JM, said counseling provided calm and improved understanding of health maintenance."

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の早期発見のため、メトロ第IIA級刑務所が収容者を対象にVCTスクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常のルーティン検診活動であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での通常のHIV/梅毒自主検診活動であり、感染拡大やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではないため対象国への計上も不要。

article.articleHeadline: Hindari Penyebaran PMK, Pemkab Bengkulu Tengah Akselerasi Vaksinasi pada Ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the Spread of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), Bengkulu Tengah Regency Government Accelerates Livestock Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), locally PMK (Penyakit Mulut dan Kuku), vaccination accelerates in Bengkulu Tengah Regency, Bengkulu Province, Indonesia, targeting 4,000 livestock (cattle, buffalo, goats). Five mobile teams will vaccinate on-site at farms to broaden coverage, with a completion target by late October 2026. FMD is caused by Aphthovirus (genus Picornaviridae); symptoms include high fever, mouth/tongue blisters, excessive saliva, and lesions on feet. In April 2026, the central government allocated 19,500 PMK vaccine doses to Bengkulu Province, up from 15,450 doses in 2025; distribution prioritizes districts with larger livestock populations and those previously affected or at risk, notably Seluma, Mukomuko, and Bengkulu Tengah. This vaccination drive is a preventive control measure to reduce the ongoing threat to cattle and buffalo within the provincial livestock sector.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫(PMK)の拡大防止へ、ベンクル・テンガ州政府が家畜ワクチン接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: 動物の口蹄疫に関する予防的ワクチン接種の行政対応であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は家畜(牛・水牛・ヤギ)の疾患であり、ヒト感染症ではないためEBSの主要対象外。地方自治体による予防的ワクチン接種の実施報告。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases 27% lower in 2026
article.articleSummary: Philippines—The Department of Health reports dengue cases for 2026 are 27% lower than 2025, with 180,770 cases recorded as of September 30, 2026. Despite the overall decline, cases have risen in recent weeks, with 21,768 dengue cases reported between September 3–16, a 3% uptick from August 20–September 2 (21,158). The DOH notes that nationwide dengue activity remains below alert and epidemic thresholds since the start of the year. The increase tracks the rainy season, with the DOH observing an upward trend since the first week of June. The year-to-date total remains well below alarm levels, though the rising weekly counts indicate continued transmission as autumn progresses.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のデング熱症例、前年比27%減
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で減少しており、全国的な流行・警戒閾値も下回っている定例的な保健統計報告であるため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: フィリピン保健省の定例統計報告。直近数週間でやや増加傾向があるものの、年間を通じて前年より減少し、警戒・流行閾値を下回っている。

article.articleHeadline: Još jedna država potvrdila prvi slučaj virusa koji uzrokuje ebolu: Pacijent preminuo, traže se putnici s njegova leta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another country has confirmed the first case of the Ebola virus: The patient died, and passengers on his flight are being sought.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed the first imported case of Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The patient, a Kenyan citizen living in the DRC, fell ill there and died. He traveled Oct 2 via Benin to Kampala, Uganda, then by air to Nairobi, where he was isolated. Lab confirmation came from the National Reference Virology Laboratory and the Kenya Institute for Medical Research. Burial followed protocol. Kenya notified WHO on Oct 6 under the IHR (2005). Authorities are tracing 28 contacts and seeking 23 passengers and 4 crew from the flight, with monitoring and quarantine for those at risk. Outbreaks linked to Bundibugy o EBOV persist in DRC; Uganda's last outbreak ended Aug 2026; France reported a travel case in Jun 2026. Kenya's preparedness increased, with thousands of travelers screened, suspect tests conducted, and health workers trained, as WHO and partners provided testing and PPE kits.

triage.headline_ja: 別の国でエボラウイルス感染症の初症例を確認：患者死亡、搭乗していた乗客を捜索中
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ症例が確認され、患者が死亡。DRCでのアウトブレイクが継続しており、国際的な人の移動を伴う拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの輸入症例だが、感染源とされるアウトブレイクはDRCで継続中であり、対象国リストに含まれるためDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。ケニア・ウガンダ・ベナン・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Russia denies Siberian plague after lab death; WHO seeks data as Hong Kong flags plague risks
article.articleSummary: Russia denies a pneumonic plague outbreak in Siberia after the 2 October death of Darya Shipilova, 28, at Irkutsk’s Anti-Plague Research Institute near Shelekhov, from sudden severe pneumonia. Unverified reports linked a possible Yersinia pestis exposure; officials say pneumonia of undetermined origin and that no plague infections have been found in the region. Despite denials, about 200 contacts are quarantined and dozens of institute staff isolated, with hospitals boosting infection controls. WHO asked Moscow for laboratory results, reasons for actions under the International Health Regulations, and verification of media reports about another employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause; Russia says no recent plague case and about 200 contacts quarantined, seeking clearer data. Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection notes plague is usually flea-borne; masks protect mainly against pneumonic droplets. Plague has bubonic, pneumonic, and septicaemic forms; untreated pneumonic plague is fatal. Since the 1990s most human cases occur in Africa (DRC, Madagascar, Peru).

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、研究所職員死亡後のシベリアでのペスト発生を否定；WHOはデータを要求、香港はペストリスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明肺炎による死亡とWHOへの情報要求、約200人の検疫という異常事態であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本事案はロシア・シベリア（イルクーツク州）のペスト研究所で発生した事案であり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC等）は記事中で過去の統計的背景として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。病原体確定やヒト-ヒト感染の有無など多くの情報が不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯傳第二例疑鼠疫　疾管署公布WHO回覆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia reports second suspected case of plague; Taiwan CDC releases WHO response.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Irkutsk region faces renewed plague concerns after a report of a second suspected case: a 28-year-old female researcher at an anti-plague institute died in early October with flu-like symptoms, but authorities say the death is due to undiagnosed pneumonia and deny links to the laboratory. WHO states no plague cases have been reported in Irkutsk as of Oct 6–7; epidemiologic investigation and contact tracing are ongoing and no high-threat pathogens detected among contacts. Taiwan’s CDC, under IHR, queried WHO on Oct 6; WHO replied Oct 7 that evidence is incomplete and a conclusive public-health risk cannot yet be determined, with ongoing dynamic risk assessment. Globally (2019–2025), WHO notes 3860 suspected plague cases, 2646 confirmed, 423 deaths (about 11% CFR), predominantly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar; China and Mongolia reported 19 and 17 confirmed cases. Taiwan strengthens border fever screening, maintains diagnostic capacity, and stocks antibiotics for treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis, urging calm.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで第二例目の疑いペスト症例、台湾疾病管制署がWHOの回答を公表
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州の抗ペスト研究所関係者の疑い死亡例について台湾CDCがWHOに照会する等、社会的・行政的関心が高まっており、異常性（研究所関連死）も認められるためフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州における疑いペスト症例（研究所関係者の死亡）。DRC・マダガスカル・中国・モンゴルは2019-2025年の世界統計の文脈での言及であり、今回のイベントの発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストに該当する発生国は確認されなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫是甚么？一文睇清感染症状、潜伏期、传播途径+3大预防方法
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is pneumonic plague? A concise guide to its symptoms, incubation period, transmission routes, and three major prevention methods.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, in Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia, a 28-year-old female technician at Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute died after breaking a vial containing pneumonic plague pathogen; officials initially attributed the death to 'unknown pneumonia.' Five hospitals were quarantined and about 200 contacts placed under medical surveillance. WHO and observers raised concern. Pneumonic plague, the most severe and contagious form of plague caused by Yersinia pestis, spreads via inhaled droplets and, less commonly, contact with infected fluids; bubonic and septicemic forms exist. Incubation is 1–4 days; symptoms include fever, chills, chest tightness, dyspnea, and a cough with blood-tinged sputum. With treatment within 24 hours, survival improves; first-line antibiotics include streptomycin, gentamicin, doxycycline, or ciprofloxacin, plus strict isolation. Prevention centers on rodent-proofing, flea-bite avoidance (DEET, permethrin-treated clothing), and avoiding contact with rodents; HK CHP reinforces these measures. Plague remains across continents; Africa accounts for most cases since the 1990s, DRC, Madagascar, and Peru.

triage.headline_ja: 肺鼠疫とは？症状・潜伏期間・感染経路を解説、予防法3つのポイント
triage.triage_reason: 主な事案はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所における実験室内感染事故であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）での発生ではない。記事中のDRC・マダガスカル・ペルーへの言及はペスト流行地域に関する一般的背景情報であり、現在進行中の具体的アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本事案はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所での実験室内感染による死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれない。記事後半でDRC・マダガスカル・ペルーに言及があるが、これはペストの歴史的・地理的背景説明であり、現在発生中の具体的アウトブレイクではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Se poate transmite ciuma pe cale respiratorie? Colegiul Medicilor explică
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can plague be transmitted via the respiratory route? The College of Physicians explains.
article.articleSummary: Pesta (plague), caused by Yersinia pestis, is a zoonotic infection transmitted mainly by fleas from rodents, with risk increased under certain conditions. Three clinical forms exist: bubonic (painful regional lymphadenopathy), septicemic (systemic infection), and pneumonic (lung involvement with potential human-to-human transmission). Pneumonic plague allows transmission person-to-person via respiratory droplets. Early diagnosis and antibiotic treatment are essential; untreated bubonic plague mortality is approximately 30–60%, while pneumonic and septicemic forms are nearly always fatal without timely therapy. The disease remains endemic in multiple regions. From 2019–2025, the majority of reported cases have originated from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. The Romanian College of Physicians’ Infectious Diseases Commission provides guidance to inform correct public information on transmission, clinical forms, and current treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは呼吸器感染するのか？医師会が解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペストの感染経路や臨床形態に関する一般的な医学教育解説記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はルーマニア医師会による一般向け医学解説であり、DRC・マダガスカルへの言及は2019-2025年の過去の疫学統計の文脈のみで、現在発生中の具体的イベントを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Commends Kenya Over Response to Imported Ebola Case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case. The patient, a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, fell ill there, traveled via Kampala, Uganda, to Nairobi on Oct 3, and was isolated on arrival at Nairobi Hospital. Lab confirmation by Kenya’s National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI established Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. He died on Oct 5 and was buried under health protocols. A contact-tracing operation identified 57 contacts, with 10 quarantined at the National Police Service Hospital in Nairobi; contacts include relatives, healthcare workers, and people linked to his Uganda journey. Kenya set up entry screening at JKIA, isolation centres at Malaba and Kocholiya, and renovated Alupe Hospital. Five hospitals were designated for Ebola care (Nairobi, Moi, National Police, Kenyatta KNH, Port Reitz). By Oct 6, over 652,000 travellers were screened; nearly 5,000 healthcare workers trained. WHO praised Kenya’s rapid reporting and urged vigilance; targeted measures are favored over blanket travel bans. Public advised hand hygiene and prompt care if exposed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアの輸入エボラ症例への対応を称賛
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来とみられる輸入エボラ症例がケニアで確認・死亡し、国境を越えた感染拡大の可能性があるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 確定症例・死亡はケニアで発生したが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者がDRCで発症した経緯があるため、感染源としてDRCを記載。ウガンダも通過地点だが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Counties on high alert after Ebola confirmation
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a single Ebola case in Nairobi, triggering heightened surveillance. Mombasa County is boosting entry-point screening and plans to screen long-distance truck drivers; Port Reitz Sub-County Hospital is on alert, with coordination across the Port of Mombasa, Moi International Airport and major corridors. Mombasa is among roughly 20–22 high-risk counties due to its trade hub link to the DRC and Uganda; an outbreak could disrupt food, fuel and industrial inputs along the Northern Corridor. Covid-19 isolation facilities are reopened as Ebola centres; in Homa Bay, sites Malela Hospital Ndhiwa, Nyagoro Rangwe, Pala Koguta South Kabuoch, Ober Kabondo Kasipul, Nyangiela Kasipul and Kandiege Hospital Karachuonyo have been assessed. Health workers have drilled for isolation and tracing. Nyamira County is assessing risk and says it is not high-risk; transport stakeholders seek coordinated measures to avoid delays. Home-based care is encouraged in some tracing cases; the Uganda border heightens concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ確認後、各郡が厳戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: ケニア・ナイロビでエボラ確定例が報告され、複数郡で検疫強化、国境を越えた感染拡大懸念（DRC・ウガンダとの交易拠点経由）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 確定症例はケニア・ナイロビで発生しており、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRC・ウガンダは貿易回廊上のリスク要因として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố vụ án vận chuyển, tiêu thụ lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indictment in the case of transporting and consuming pigs infected with African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: On 8 October 2026, Thai Nguyen Provincial Police's Economic Crime Division indicted a case under Article 317 for violating food safety rules after uncovering a truck, plate 88C-261.93, driven by Nguyen Quang Trung transporting pigs showing signs of African swine fever (ASF). The vehicle, found on 17 September 2026, carried 26 pigs totaling about 2.7 tonnes, bought in Hiep Luc and bound for local traders, including Dang Van Giang in Linh Son ward. At Giang's facility, 16 pigs (~1.5 tonnes) tested positive for ASF, with one dead. Investigators issued indictments, arrest warrants for the suspects, and are expanding the probe to clarify roles. The case highlights risks from moving and selling animals with suspected ASF and urges consumers to seek clearly sourced foods and report violations to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚の運搬・消費事件で起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は豚のみに感染する動物疾病であり、人の健康への直接的な影響はない。本記事は密輸・食品安全法違反の刑事事件報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染する動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染性はないため公衆衛生リスクとしての優先度は低い。地方警察による食品安全法違反の刑事事件として処理されている。

article.articleHeadline: Khuyến cáo sau ca tử vong do viêm phổi chưa rõ nguyên nhân tại Nga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recommendations following a death due to pneumonia of unknown etiology in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Death of a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, on 2 October 2026 after severe pneumonia of unknown etiology. WHO has been notified and is monitoring; as of 7 October 2026, no plague cases detected in Irkutsk. Russian health authorities conducted epidemiologic investigations, implemented preventive measures, and identified contacts for surveillance and testing; no high-risk pathogens detected among contacts; no outbreak identified. WHO will continue to verify reports and assess potential international health impact. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health is coordinating with WHO to monitor risk and provide guidance. Public guidance: stay calm, follow official updates, maintain hygiene, and rodent and flea control; avoid handling sick or dead rodents without protection. If exposed, seek prompt medical care for sudden fever, lymph node swelling, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath; avoid self-medication with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで原因不明の肺炎による死亡例、その後の勧告
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の検査員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、WHOに通報・監視が行われている。アウトブレイクは未確認だが、ペスト研究所という文脈と公衆衛生当局の迅速な対応・社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価の要否を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。ベトナム保健省はWHOと連携し監視・情報提供を行っているのみで、ベトナム国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。アウトブレイクは未確認で、接触者からも高リスク病原体は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ৫ দিন জ্বর থাকলেই এবার অ্যালাইজা টেস্ট! ডেঙ্গু রোখে কড়া স্বাস্থ্য দপ্তর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five days of fever? ELISA test now! Health department imposes strict dengue-prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, West Bengal reports 3,700 dengue tests with 128 positives and 256 currently hospitalized; total infections near 9,000. Murshidabad remains the epicenter, followed by Kolkata, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, and Hooghly. A virtual meeting chaired by Health Minister Dr. Shardwata Mukhopadhyay and attended by commissioners from Kolkata, Howrah, Siliguri, Bidhannagar, Durgapur, and Asansol, plus six municipalities, six corporations, medical colleges, and district magistrates, issued new dengue guidelines. Key measures: diagnose dengue in the first five days with NS-1 antigen ELISA; after day five, use IgM testing. If fever lasts beyond 10 days, evaluate for Leptospirosis or Scrub Typhus and consider hospital-acquired infection in inpatients. Do not panic over platelet counts; monitor urine output, sleep, and seizures, and seek prompt care for alarming symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 5日間発熱が続けばELISA検査を実施！デング熱対策に保健局が厳格な対応
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で季節性デング熱の拡大が見られ行政が対策を強化しているが、既知の流行状況であり国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州で季節的に流行する既知の感染症であり、行政が診断ガイドラインを更新し積極的に対応している状況。症例数・入院数は報告されているが重症度や異常性の明確な記載はなし。レプトスピラ症・つつが虫病は鑑別診断として言及されているのみで、実際の症例報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ заявили о тысячах случаев чумы в мире: сотни закончились смертью
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO announced thousands of plague cases worldwide: hundreds have died.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization briefing in Geneva reports thousands of suspected plague cases worldwide each year. From 2019 through 2025, ten countries notified WHO of nearly 4,000 suspected human cases, with 423 deaths. The disease manifests as bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic forms, caused by Yersinia pestis and transmitted mainly by fleas from wild rodent reservoirs. Incubation ranges from a few hours to 3–6 days, with high fever and marked systemic illness. Endemic foci persist in Africa (notably the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar), Asia (Mongolia and China), and the Americas (Peru and the United States). Despite the severe clinical course, modern plague is not a global threat because it is effectively treatable with antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが世界各地のペスト発生について発表：数千件の症例、数百人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOによる2019〜2025年の累積統計に基づく一般的な疫学概況報告であり、新規の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではないが、複数の対象国（DRC・中国）を含む風土病地域での継続的な感染リスクが言及されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOジュネーブ会見での世界的なペスト発生状況（2019-2025年の累積データ、約4000例・423人死亡）の総括報告であり、新規の単一アウトブレイクイベントではない。コンゴ民主共和国・マダガスカル・モンゴル・中国・ペルー・米国が風土病地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCと中国のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Prvo su rekli kuga, a onda se priča promenila: Misteriozna smrt u Rusiji i priče o karantinu zabrinule svet - evo šta se dešava
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First they said it was the plague, and then the story changed: A mysterious death in Russia and reports about quarantine have alarmed the world — here's what's happening.
article.articleSummary: Darija Shipilova, 28, who worked at the Institute for the Fight against Plague of Siberia, was admitted to hospital and died three days later in Shelekhov, Irkutsk. Initially Russian officials linked her death to plague; authorities later denied it despite reports of quarantines, masks at a plant, and a canceled event. About 197 people were reportedly under medical surveillance; Izvestiya claimed the death was due to plague. Rospotrebnadzor said the woman died of pneumonia of unknown origin, with tests showing no microorganisms linked to her work. Independent outlets reported hospital closures and a quarantine; unconfirmed. WHO and EU agencies are monitoring; US officials Trump and Rubio urged transparency. Plague (Yersinia pestis) persists in animal reservoirs in Burjatija/Buryatia; transmission by fleas, contact with bodily fluids, or aerosols; pulmonary form can incubate rapidly. The institute was to host a plague-control conference in October with scientists from China, Mongolia and Soviet states.

triage.headline_ja: 最初はペストと言われたが、その後話が変わった：ロシアでの謎の死と検疫の噂が世界を不安にさせている―何が起きているのか
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州でペスト研究機関職員が謎の死を遂げ、当局発表が二転三転、検疫報告やWHO・EU・米当局の監視が報じられており、国際的関心と不確実性が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: イベントはロシア（ブリヤート共和国、イルクーツク州シェレホフ）で発生しており、対象国リスト（中国・モンゴル等は会議参加国として言及されるのみ）には該当しないためverified_locationsは空とした。死因については当局が肺炎と発表し、ペスト関連性を否定しているが、報道・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: AI chest x-ray screening flags 18,000, confirms 877 TB cases in slum clusters
article.articleSummary: AI chest X-ray screening in Delhi's urban slums flagged 18,377 people for TB testing from a 168,568-resident cohort, with molecular tests confirming 877 TB cases. The study, published Aug 23, 2026 in the Indian Journal of Tuberculosis, used Qure.ai to analyze digital chest X-rays and identify images suggestive of TB. Flagged individuals underwent sputum collection; 16,866 (91.7%) completed molecular testing, with results showing 877 bacteriologically confirmed TB cases (5.2% of those tested; 0.52% of the total screened). From July 2025–March 2026 across 349 urban slum clusters in six Delhi districts (population ~1.83 million), the programme detected 520 bacteriologically confirmed cases per 100,000 screened; 192 screenings were needed to identify one case. The approach targets asymptomatic TB gaps, aligning with National TB Prevalence findings that over 40% of confirmed TB cases lacked typical symptoms. Community mobilisation via ASHAs and accessible testing sites aided uptake.

triage.headline_ja: AI胸部X線スクリーニングによりスラム地区で18,000人を抽出、877件の結核症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデリーのスラム地区における既存の結核対策プログラム（AIスクリーニング）の成果報告であり、異常な発生や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドにおける既知の流行性疾患であり、本記事は診断・スクリーニングプログラムの実績報告。新規または異常な公衆衛生事象ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Races to Trace Contacts After First Ebola Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case after a man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo died in a Nairobi hospital. The patient’s death marks the country’s first confirmed Ebola event; authorities have quarantined ten contacts and are tracing 57 more who may have been exposed. The man had been ill for about a month, travelling through several DR Congo cities, crossing into Uganda, and flying to Kenya undetected. Surveillance has been intensified at airports and border crossings; more than 650,000 travellers have been screened and 267 samples tested to date. Kenyan authorities have designated four hospitals to manage suspected Ebola cases. The Africa CDC is coordinating with regional partners to strengthen the response to this imported case and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ死亡例後に接触者追跡を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ患者がケニアで死亡し初症例となった事例であり、国際的拡大リスク・重症度・ヒトヒト感染の可能性があり、Africa CDCも対応に関与しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRC由来の感染経路を辿っており、DRCが感染源として関連するため含めた。ケニア国内の状況（検疫10名、追跡57名、空港スクリーニング等）は重要情報だが対象国外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Thực hư về thông tin dịch hạch ở Nga: Bộ Y tế lên tiếng và đưa ra khuyến cáo tới người dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Truth or falsehood about reports of plague in Russia: the Ministry of Health speaks out and issues recommendations to the public.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, via the Department of Disease Prevention, addresses reports of a plague-related death in Russia, after coordination with WHO and Russian authorities. As of October 7, 2026, WHO states a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute in Irkutsk died on October 2 after treatment for severe pneumonia. Russian health authorities report no recent plague cases in Irkutsk; epidemiologic investigations and exposure risk assessments were conducted, with no high-risk pathogens identified among contacts, who are under health surveillance and testing as appropriate. WHO continues to liaise with Russia to verify media reports and assess any potential international health impact. Vietnamese guidance urges calm, to monitor official information, and to implement measures reducing rodent and flea vectors, including avoiding contact with sick or dead rodents without protection.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト情報の真偽：保健省が見解を発表し国民に勧告
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員1名の死亡に関する報道だが、ロシア当局は最近のペスト症例なしと報告し、接触者にも高リスク病原体は確認されていない。対象国（ベトナム）では実際の発生はなく、単なる情報提供・注意喚起記事である。
triage.notes: 発生地としてロシア（対象国リスト外）とベトナムが挙げられているが、ベトナムは発生国ではなく当局が噂を否定し注意喚起している立場。対象国における実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: PMC Issues Notices to Four Ward Officers After Surge in Dengue Cases - Pune Times Mirror
article.articleSummary: 2,391 dengue cases in Pune year-to-date and 106 chikungunya cases from Jan to Sep. PMC issued show-cause notices to four ward malaria officers (Kothrud; Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri; Aundh-Baner; Dhankawadi-Sahakarnagar) for insufficient containment; officers must explain case rise, actions taken, and daily ground work. Dengue surge concentrated in last four months: June 166, July 518, August 751, September 956. Wardwise dengue counts: Kothrud 229; Nagar Road-Wadgaonsheri 222; Aundh-Baner 212; Dhankawadi-Sahakarnagar 139; Yerawada-Kalas-Dhanori 137. Chikungunya peaked in July (51), then 39 in August and 16 in September; Aundh-Baner led with 19. Outbreak-control measures urged: house-to-house checks within a 5-km radius, water-container surveys, fever surveys, spraying, fogging, and collecting blood slides for malaria testing; sustained 15-day outbreak response. An entomological survey implicated a PMC godown in Aundh-Baner as a breeding source; cleanup, biolarviciding, and targeted spraying implemented.

triage.headline_ja: PMC、デング熱症例急増を受け4地区担当者に通知書発行 - プネー・タイムズ・ミラー
triage.triage_reason: プネー市内でのデング熱・チクングニヤ症例の季節的増加と行政対応に関する地方記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないが、媒介蚊感染症の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方自治体(PMC)が主体的に対応しており、国際支援の必要性は低い。季節性の媒介蚊感染症増加であり、重症度や死亡例に関する情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Centre Launches JOSH Teams To Strengthen Youth-Led Efforts For TB Elimination
article.articleSummary: Centre launches Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) Teams in New Delhi to bolster youth-led efforts toward TB elimination under the TB Mukt Bharat campaign. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda announced that 58,000 volunteers will work from village to village, supported by the Ministries of Youth Affairs and Sports and Defence. In the first phase, JOSH Teams will roll out across 55 districts in 11 states, pairing Class-I officers with MY Bharat volunteers and NCC cadets to strengthen community mobilisation. The teams will disseminate information on TB symptoms, prevention, timely diagnosis and treatment completion; tackle myths and stigma; and encourage broad community participation in the national TB elimination drive. They will also target identification of individuals who may be unaware they have TB, including asymptomatic cases, through block, ward and community-level outreach from Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、結核撲滅に向け青年主導の取り組み強化のため「JOSHチーム」を発足
triage.triage_reason: 既存疾患である結核の啓発・撲滅キャンペーンに関する政策発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府によるTB撲滅キャンペーンのボランティア動員施策の発表であり、新規の感染症発生情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gov't deploys National Rapid Response Team to Upper West over Yellow fever cases - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever cases in Ghana trigger government response as a National Rapid Response Team is deployed to the northern regions, with emphasis on the Upper West Region after confirmed cases. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh said designated sections of district hospitals in affected communities have been isolated to manage suspected and confirmed cases. Surveillance has been heightened and laboratories supplied with reagents to support testing and confirmation. As of yesterday, about 450 suspected cases were reported from June to September, including 74 suspected cases from Upper West and three confirmed cases in Upper West. The minister urged calm and public cooperation while noting that all necessary response measures are in place, aiming to contain transmission and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、黄熱病症例の増加を受けて国家緊急対応チームをアッパーウェスト州に派遣 - Adomonline.com
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ北部で黄熱病の確認症例が発生し、政府が国家緊急対応チームを派遣するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な対応が取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 2026年6月から9月にかけて約450件の疑い例、アッパーウェスト州で74件の疑い例と3件の確定例が報告されている。保健大臣が病院の一部を隔離区域として設定し、検査体制を強化していることから、公衆衛生対応の規模が大きいと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Проф. Александрова: Чумата никога не си е отивала, белодробната е особено опасна
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prof. Aleksandrova: The plague has never gone away, the pneumonic plague is especially dangerous.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains present and treatable with modern medicine, though pneumonic plague can develop within 24 hours. A suspected Russian case involved a young woman from a research institute; official confirmation of death was not reported as of 2 October. Early antibiotic therapy is crucial, ideally within the first day, and rapid field diagnostic tests exist. Lab safety incidents are common, often due to procedural errors, with modern labs using plastic tubes but residual risk remains. Pneumonic plague spreads between people via respiratory droplets in close contact and is highly dangerous without timely treatment. The disease persists in regions including the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar, with seasonal patterns in some areas. Bulgaria has no widespread plague vaccine; influenza vaccines help reduce severe outcomes during the autumn-winter season. The expert urged calm and continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: アレクサンドロワ教授：ペストは決してなくなっていない、肺ペストは特に危険
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブルガリアの専門家によるペストに関する一般解説であり、対象国における新規・具体的な発生事例の報告ではない。DRC・マダガスカルは既存の流行地域として背景的に言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアでの疑いペスト症例（研究所勤務の若年女性、死亡確認は10月2日時点で未報告）に関する専門家コメンタリーが中心。DRC・マダガスカルは『ペストが存在し続けている地域』として一般論的に言及されているのみで、具体的な新規発生情報はないため対象国としてverified_locationsには含めなかった。ロシア・ブルガリアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo bảo vệ sức khỏe sau ca bệnh ở Nga tử vong do viêm phổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health advises protecting public health after a pneumonia-related death in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Irkutsk, Russia: a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute died on 2 October 2026 after pneumonia of unknown origin. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health says it has informed the WHO, which provided initial details by 7 October 2026. No recent plague cases are reported in Irkutsk. Russian authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations, identifying contacts for surveillance and testing; no high-risk pathogen has been found among contacts. WHO continues to work with Russia to verify information and assess any international health impact. Vietnamese health officials advise calm and reliance on official sources; avoid sharing unverified information. Preventive guidance includes environmental hygiene, rodent and flea control, and avoiding handling sick or dead rodents. Exposed individuals who develop sudden fever, lymph node swelling, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath should seek prompt medical care; do not self-medicate with antibiotics. Further updates will follow.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで肺炎により死亡した症例を受け、保健省が健康保護を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 抗ペスト研究所の検査員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡するという異例の事象であり、ペスト関連病原体の可能性が排除されていないため、IHR基準（異常性・重大性）に複数該当しフルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。ベトナム保健省は情報提供・注意喚起を行っているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOがロシアと情報検証中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan raises Ebola alert after Kenya confirms first case - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: South Sudan raises Ebola alert as neighboring Kenya confirms first case; no confirmed South Sudan cases as of 8 Oct 2026. Proximity to DRC hotspots and regional travel routes via Uganda and Kenya heightens cross-border transmission risk. Preparedness measures activated: border and entry screening; 15 high-risk counties; Juba International Airport; eight infectious-disease units ready to isolate and manage suspected/confirmed cases. WHO reports preparedness level rose from 29% in May to 65% currently; Africa CDC notes surveillance, rapid response and lab capacity exist. Symptoms to monitor: fever, vomiting, diarrhea, unusual bleeding. Public advised to report suspected cases via toll-free 6666; avoid direct contact with patients, practice hand hygiene, avoid handling animal(s) or corpses. Uganda's outbreak reportedly contained in 92 days with 20 cases and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、ケニアでの初症例確認を受けエボラ警戒レベルを引き上げ - Radio Tamazuj
triage.triage_reason: エボラという致死率の高い感染症が新たにケニアで確認され、南スーダンが警戒レベルを引き上げるなど国境を越えた伝播リスクが顕在化しており、WHO・Africa CDCも関与する国際的対応事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンとケニアにおけるエボラ警戒であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当国が含まれない。DRCは『近接するホットスポット』として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生状況の記述がないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ウガンダの過去のアウトブレイクは終息済み（92日間で20例、死亡2例）として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: "Они просто ждали, пока она умрет": мать лаборантки в РФ сделала заявление после смерти дочери от чумы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "They were just waiting for her to die": Mother of a lab technician in Russia made a statement after her daughter's death from the plague.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague concerns arise in Russia’s Irkutsk region after a 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, shattered a vial containing the pneumonic plague pathogen. She was admitted to hospital four days later and died of pneumonia of unknown etiology. Following her death, quarantine was imposed in several medical facilities, with roughly 100–200 people who had contact with Shipilova placed under surveillance. Russian authorities deny an officially confirmed pneumonic plague case and have not released the cause of death. The family accuses medical staff of negligence, and the burial has been delayed while quarantine continues. International response followed: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus requested information on a possible secondary infection; U.S. President Donald Trump offered assistance; The Telegraph cites Western fears about secret bioprograms; China said it supports maintaining contact with Moscow on the matter.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼らはただ彼女が死ぬのを待っていた」：ロシアの検査技師の母親が、娘のペストによる死亡後に声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで研究室事故により肺ペスト病原体に曝露した検査技師が死亡し、複数の医療施設で検疫措置、100〜200人の接触者監視が行われている。WHOや米国大統領からの国際的関心・支援申し出もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。中国・米国は本件に関するコメント・支援提案のみで、発生国ではない。ロシア当局は肺ペスト感染を公式には確認しておらず、死因も未発表のため情報の不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Кения обяви първи случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announced its first case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case, an imported infection linked to the Central Africa outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The male patient fell ill in Congo, traveled via Uganda, and flew to Nairobi on October 3, dying 48 hours after arrival; he was presumably very ill on landing. Nairobi’s status as a major transit hub raises concerns about cross-border transmission. Kenya had never reported Ebola before. The Congo outbreak began with three foci and expanded to 64 additional ones across 7 provinces amid internal migration and waning international aid. Africa CDC has dispatched a team to investigate gaps along the travel chain. International funding arrived but officials say the response remains insufficient. Seven health zones have reported no cases for 42 days, noting the 21-day Ebola incubation period.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ出血熱の初症例を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）由来のエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境侵入し死亡例が発生。DRC国内では67の感染巣に拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題はDRC発のエボラアウトブレイクの越境拡大であり、DRCでの大規模発生（7州67感染巣）が主要な背景情報として記載されているためDRCを計上。Africa CDCが調査チームを派遣し、国際支援が不十分との指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: "Вони просто чекали, поки вона помре": мати лаборантки у РФ зробила заяву після смерті доньки від чуми
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "They were just waiting for her to die": the mother of a lab assistant in Russia made a statement after her daughter's death from the plague.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, 28-year-old lab assistant Daria Shipilova shattered a vial containing pneumonic plague (Yersinia pestis). Four days later she was hospitalized and died, reportedly from pneumonia of unknown etiology. Her mother, medical worker Svetlana Shipilova, accuses doctors of negligence and contests the lab accident explanation, noting such containers are securely shielded. A regional quarantine followed, with about 100–200 people who had contact with Shipilova placed under monitoring. Russian authorities say no plague case has been confirmed and no official cause of death has been released; the funeral has not occurred due to quarantine. International reaction followed: WHO Director-General Tedros requested data on possible infection; U.S. President Trump offered help; Moscow welcomed the aid. The Telegraph cites Western fears of Kremlin bioprogrammes, while China said it supports continued dialogue with Moscow.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼らはただ彼女が死ぬのを待っていた」：ロシアの検査技師の母親が、娘のペストによる死去後に声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）の実験室感染による死亡例が発生し、WHOや米国など国際的な関心・支援の申し出もあることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があると判断。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、設定された対象国リストには含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。中国・米国は国際的反応の文脈で言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。肺ペストという病原体の性質上、バイオセキュリティ上の重大性からPICKUPと判定したが、地理的には対象国外のイベントである点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 本土登革熱再增1例！40多歲女染第4型病毒 感染源待釐清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another locally transmitted dengue fever case! Woman in her 40s infected with dengue virus serotype 4; source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports another locally transmitted dengue fever case: a woman in her 40s, resident of Pingtung City, Pingtung County, developed fever, headache, myalgia and diarrhea in early October and tested positive for dengue virus serotype 4 (DENV-4); she remains hospitalized, and cohabitating contacts are asymptomatic. No foreign travel history; infection source under investigation with planned viral sequencing. Authorities have begun emergency vector-control measures around the home, mosquito-density surveys, environmental risk assessment, and intensified source reduction and health education, with expanded testing to curb spread. Nationally, 188 confirmed dengue cases as of October 8, including 13 locally acquired cases (Kaohsiung City 10, Changhua County 2, Pingtung County 1) and 175 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (48), Indonesia (29), and the Philippines (21). Prevention advice includes home environmental cleaning, removing standing water, wearing protective clothing, and using government-approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535); seek prompt care for fever or dengue-like symptoms and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 本土感染のデング熱症例がさらに1例！40代女性が第4型ウイルスに感染、感染源は調査中
triage.triage_reason: 発生国は台湾であり対象国リストに含まれない。記事中のベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の渡航歴に過ぎず、現地での発生事象ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リスト外）での局地的デング熱症例報告。輸入症例の由来国（ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン）は発生国ではなく渡航歴に基づくものであり、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Mengintai, Dinkes Kota Pekalongan Dorong Warga Perkuat Imun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Looms, Pekalongan City Health Office Urges Residents to Strengthen Immunity.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains a concern in Pekalongan City as the dry season continues, though current activity is controllable. The City Health Office notes influenza is a viral respiratory infection presenting with fever, dry cough, sore throat, muscle and joint pain, fatigue, and headaches. Cases are fluctuating with a slight uptick but not large, and health officials emphasize prevention through strengthening immunity and strict adherence to clean and healthy living behaviors (PHBS). Preventive measures include mask use, especially for symptomatic individuals or in dusty environments, avoiding crowds when ill, frequent handwashing, nutritious meals, adequate fluids, and regular physical activity. For symptoms, patients can seek care at primary health facilities; if no improvement after more than three days, they should visit the nearest health facility (including puskesmas). Ongoing, health referrals are provided in a stepped system.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行の兆し、プカロンガン市保健局が住民に免疫力強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの軽微な増加であり、管理可能とされ、異常性・重症性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、制御可能とされている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Sarawak joins international research project to tackle African swine fever
article.articleSummary: SIDC in Kuching, Sarawak, is partnering with the University of Sheffield, University of Liverpool, Thailand's National Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology, and Sarawak's Department of Veterinary Services on a UK Research and Innovation-funded project to tackle African swine fever (ASF) in Sarawak, Southeast Asia and Britain. Led by Prof Peter J Dodd, the £3.4 million grant supports whole-genome sequencing to position SIDC as a regional genomic reference centre, informing vaccine strategies, harmonising practices, and promoting regional collaboration. SIDC chief executive Assoc Prof Ivan Yap says the project recognises Sarawak's scientific capabilities; Deputy Education, Innovation and Talent Development Minister Datuk Dr Annuar Rapaee calls it a milestone for Sarawak's research. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease of domestic pigs and wild boar, not a risk to human health, but it can wipe out herds and hurt farming communities; gaps remain in understanding its genetic diversity and spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: サラワク州、アフリカ豚熱対策のための国際研究プロジェクトに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASF対策のための研究協力体制構築を伝える内容であり、新規発生や流行拡大を示すものではなく、人への健康リスクもないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は研究協力の発表であり、ASFの新規発生報告ではない。マレーシア（サラワク州）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは研究パートナーとして言及されているが、発生国としての記載ではなく、研究機関所在国としての言及に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 山东发布10月上旬蚊虫风险预报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shandong Issues Early-October Mosquito and Insect Risk Forecast
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Shandong Province’s CDC released an early-October mosquito risk forecast. Aedes albopictus (white-striped, autumn mosquito) remains the main vector for dengue and chikungunya; Culex tritaeniorhynchus transmits Japanese encephalitis; Anopheles sinensis transmits malaria. The province is split into three risk tiers: Level 1 (low risk) in parts of the north and east; Level 2 (relatively low risk) across most areas; Level 3 (medium risk) in the south and southwest, designated as priority Vector control zones. Although Ae. albopictus activity declines with cooler temperatures, indoor overwintering and late-autumn ingress keep bite risk. Preventive guidance varies: Level 2—outdoor protection at dawn/dusk, screens on doors/windows, weekly checks for standing water; Level 3—wear light clothing, avoid water edges and dense vegetation, weekly breeding-site cleanup; Level 1—normal outdoor activity with basic precautions. High-risk groups (elderly, children, pregnant women, chronic patients) should strengthen protection, seek prompt care for fever/headache/muscle-joint pain or rash, and report travel and bite history; note cross-provincial travel during holidays may raise imported disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: 山東省、10月上旬の蚊虫リスク予報を発表
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、蚊媒介性疾患に関する予防的リスク予報であり、異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、山東省CDCによる季節性の蚊媒介疾患予防啓発情報である。具体的な症例数や発生事例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 7 millions d'euros supplémentaires de la France pour appuyer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: France adds another 7 million euros to bolster the response.
article.articleSummary: France pledges 7 million euros to strengthen the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total French support to 23 million euros this year. French Foreign Affairs Minister Jean-Noël Barrot announced at the seventh National humanitarian conference in Paris that Bunia remains the outbreak epicenter of the 17th and deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC, with about 4,000 deaths, including roughly 1,000 children under five. The funding will back the Congolese National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB) and, with the Agence Française de Développement, bolster measures to curb transmission. France and DRC also plan a project leveraging local and international NGOs to ensure access to justice for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence. The conference gathered over 300 humanitarian actors to discuss an integrated approach balancing immediate relief with resilience and protection against spillover risks to France.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：フランスが対応支援のため追加で700万ユーロを拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（約4000人死亡）に対する国際的な資金支援拡大のニュースであり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援の必要性が明記されているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 既に認知されているDRCの第17次エボラ流行（最も致死的とされる）に関する資金援助の続報。新規発生ではないが、深刻度・継続性・国際支援必要性からPICKUPと判断。Franceは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Möglicher Pest-Fall - was ist dran an den Spekulationen?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible plague case - what's behind the speculation?
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, a 28-year-old scientist at the Institute for Pest Control died after pneumonia of unknown etiology, triggering speculation about Yersinia pestis. About 200 potential contacts in Irkutsk and nearby Schelechow were quarantined; authorities denied a lab accident or plague infection and said the death was due to pneumonia with no pathogen reported. WHO has asked for more information. US CDC classifies Y. pestis as a Select Agent (Category 1) due to low infectious dose and high untreated mortality, with historic references to sieges and WWII-era releases. Some experts caution that a bioweapons link lacks solid evidence without microbiological/epidemiological data, including forensic findings, says Roman Wölfel. Plague persists globally in animals; in Siberia the bacterium circulates among rodents and fleas; Madagascar and DR Congo remain endemic. Germany is pest-free; pest research is ongoing worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト感染の可能性のある症例―憶測の真相は？
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツクで原因不明肺炎により研究者が死亡し、ペスト感染の疑いから約200人が隔離されWHOが追加情報を要請しており、社会的・国際的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCおよびマダガスカルは記事中でペスト常在地として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。病原体（Yersinia pestis）の確定は未検査で、当局は感染および研究所事故を否定している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient Dies As Disease Spreads To Kenya
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-06, a Kenyan man who had lived in Congo for seven years tested positive for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus; he traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi where he was isolated on arrival and died Monday, marking Kenya’s first Ebola death. In total, 28 contacts plus 27 others who flew on the same plane are being monitored for 21 days, Ebola’s incubation window. Kenyan authorities report heightened screening at flights from Congo; more than 650,000 travelers have been screened; 267 samples tested, only the deceased’s positive result. International partners WHO and Africa CDC are involved; officials say the situation is controlled and urge hygiene and reporting of symptoms. The Bundibugyo outbreak has been raging in Congo for months with 8,544 confirmed cases, 4,114 deaths and 824 hospitalizations; Uganda has seen earlier cases, last patient discharged in July. Bundibugyo viruses historically have 30-40% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者死亡、ケニアへ感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で数ヶ月にわたり続くブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの大規模流行（8,544症例、4,114死亡）があり、渡航者を介してケニアへ越境伝播し初の死亡例が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクが高くフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題である大規模エボラ流行はDRCで発生中。ケニア・ウガンダは越境伝播先として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Aufsehen um Fall in Russland: Möglicher Pest-Fall - was ist dran an den Spekulationen?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outcry over a case in Russia: Possible plague case — what's behind the speculation?
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, a death of a 28-year-old scientist at a plague research institute in Irkutsk near Schelechow after pneumonia of unknown cause sparked speculation she contracted Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium. Authorities restricted some clinics and quarantined about 200 contacts, but denied plague infection or laboratory accident; the death cause remains pneumonia with no pathogen disclosed. The case prompts questions about lab safety and official transparency. The U.S. CDC classifies Y. pestis as a Select Agent (Level 1) due to low infectious dose and high mortality. Historical notes reference the 1346 siege of Caffa and WWII-era flea exposure in China. The WHO requests more information. In nature, plague persists among rodents and fleas in Siberia; Madagascar and the DRC report annual cases; Germany is pest-free. Trump said he did not regard a bioweapons link.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの症例を巡る騒動：ペストの可能性のある症例 ― 憶測の根拠は何か？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所勤務の研究者が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、ペスト感染の憶測が広がりWHOも情報を求めているが、当局はペスト感染・検査室事故を否定しており確定情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 主要な発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。記事中でマダガスカル・DRC・中国への言及があるが、いずれも歴史的・流行病状況の説明であり、本件イベントの発生国ではない。当局はペスト感染・研究所事故を公式には否定しているため、事実関係の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 青岛开展狂犬病防控科普宣传活动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Qingdao launches a rabies prevention and control science popularization campaign
article.articleSummary: Qingdao launches a rabies prevention and control science popularization campaign on 2026-10-08. Technicians from the Qingdao City Animal Epidemic Prevention and Control Center visited Laixi City to the Yuanshang Town large market, educating residents on regular canine rabies vaccination and preventive measures, and answering questions. The city has advanced a dog rabies immunization system that links urban-rural areas, branded as the 'Wang Wang Action,' with a 'point + mobile + support' service model. It maintains a routine of 'six-into' activities—bringing immunization services and rabies education into communities, villages, and campuses, delivering vaccines and information to households. Qingdao reports nine consecutive years without a human rabies case. In 2026, the Government Office issued the 'Plan for Building a Rabies-Free Area Without Dogs' to accelerate a long-term prevention framework, shifting from routine to standardized, institutionalized, and regulated control under government leadership and cross-department collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 青島が狂犬病予防対策の科学普及活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防啓発活動の広報記事であり、新規感染事例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態や懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は青島市における狂犬病予防啓発キャンペーンの紹介であり、9年連続でヒト狂犬病症例なしと報告されている。感染症イベントとしての異常性・緊急性は認められないため対象国にも含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 鼠疫北来，不寒而栗_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague Arrives from the North, Fear Grips You.
article.articleSummary: Plague arrives from the north as Russia's Irkutsk region faces a critical incident. On September 25, 2026, at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Prevention, 28-year-old researcher Shipilova mishandled a vial containing highly pathogenic plague cultures; she deteriorated rapidly and died in the early hours of October 2. About 200 close contacts were quarantined; a large aluminum plant in the city issued a mask mandate, with workers in full biosafety suits seen in public, signaling severe containment concerns. Plague is a Class A, Category 1 infectious disease in our country, and could overwhelm health systems if an outbreak expands. The article places this event in historical context of plague pandemics—from 541 CE to the 1347 Black Death, and the 1894–1910 Third Pandemic (originating in Yunnan, spreading via trade routes to Harbin)—highlighting airborne/pneumonic transmission risks and the stakes for today.

triage.headline_ja: 鼠疫が北から到来、身の毛もよだつ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所での感染事故により研究者が死亡し、約200人の濃厚接触者が隔離されるなど、重篤かつ異常な事案でIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 事案発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リスト（中国含む）には該当しない。記事中の中国（雲南・ハルビン）への言及は19世紀末〜20世紀初頭の第三次ペストパンデミックの歴史的文脈であり、現在進行中の発生ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Unsterilised tools used by "wanzamai" pose infection risk
article.articleSummary: In Accra, Ghana, unsterilised shaving instruments used by mobile barbers called 'wanzamai' pose infection risks. Dr. Benard Morton of Korle Bu Teaching Hospital warns that reuse on multiple clients without proper sterilisation can spread blood-borne infections such as hepatitis B and C, and HIV, especially where skin is cut. Investigations by The Ghanaian Times at markets, beaches, pubs and communities found practitioners offering bald cuts ('sakora'), circumcision, nail care, and some traditional healing procedures, carrying sharp tools, soap, water, cloths, and alcohol-based antiseptics. Some used animal horns. Although some barbers claim to clean instruments after every use, Dr. Morton says washing with water or wiping with cloth, even with antiseptic, may not protect against pathogens, since blood and bodily fluids can persist on sharp instruments. He calls for regulatory framework and training in hygiene, sterilisation and infection prevention, and urges public caution to ensure proper sterilisation. Published 2026-10-08.

triage.headline_ja: 「ワンザマイ」が使用する非滅菌器具が感染リスクをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: これは既知の衛生慣行に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 具体的な感染者数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、理髪師による器具の衛生管理に関する一般的な注意喚起記事。慢性的なリスク要因への曝露継続（prolonged_exposure）に該当するが、急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: 秋冬季节，流感、诺如进入活跃期，这些误区要避开
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza and norovirus become more active in autumn and winter; avoid these misconceptions.
article.articleSummary: Autumn–winter in Shenzhen, China, sees rising influenza and norovirus activity. Influenza, caused by influenza virus, differs from the common cold and can cause fever, headaches, myalgia, and fatigue, with risks of pneumonia, ARDS, or organ failure. Household transmission is common and schools are high‑risk. Shenzhen has begun free influenza vaccination for eligible primary and secondary students; vaccination is the most effective prevention. Hygiene: frequent handwashing, masking, and ventilation. Norovirus infection peaks in autumn/winter and is highly contagious, spreading via fecal–oral contact, close contact, aerosols, contaminated surfaces, and contaminated food or water. Incubation is 1–2 days; symptoms include vomiting and diarrhea, with dehydration risk, especially for children and the elderly. Infected children should stay home; return to school 72 hours after symptom resolution. Disinfection with chlorine-based agents and thorough cleaning are essential. Insights from Li Junyu, Deputy Chief Physician, Longcheng Public Health Service Center, Longgang District.

triage.headline_ja: 秋冬季節、インフルエンザとノロウイルスが活発期に入る、避けるべき誤解とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・ノロウイルスに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性感染症の予防啓発記事であり、深圳市における通常の秋冬の流行パターンを説明する内容。シグナルとしての異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சலுக்கு இதுவரை 21,665 பேர் பாதிப்பு - மருத்துவ முகாமில் அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ் ஆய்வு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: So far, 21,665 people have been affected by dengue fever — Minister Arunraj inspects the medical camp.
article.articleSummary: 21,665 dengue cases have been recorded in Tamil Nadu since January 1, with 10 deaths and 301 inpatients. In Chennai, dengue cases are rising; a free medical camp organized by the Chennai Corporation in Vadapalani was inspected by Minister Arunraj, who then toured homes. He said stagnant-water sites will incur Rs 10,000 fines initially, with higher penalties later. Across Tamil Nadu, fever camps run about 1,000 daily; in Chennai, every two wards host a special camp where blood tests confirm dengue and treatment follows. 3,700 mosquito-control workers conduct door-to-door vector control, returning every seven days. With the monsoon yet to begin, vigilance is urged since dengue risk may rise. The Chief Minister has directed faster completion of canal/drain works, due by month-end. Reporters asked about the mayor’s absence; the minister said governance and administration must collaborate, not attend for political reasons.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱でこれまでに21,665人が感染 ― アルンラージ大臣が医療キャンプを視察
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で21,665例・死亡10例と規模が大きく、政府（大臣・州首相）が対策指示を出すなど行政の関心が高いため、WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）とあわせてフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性の流行病であり、モンスーン前の時期として今後感染拡大のリスクが指摘されている。行政は医療キャンプやベクター対策（3,700人の防除員）を実施中で、国際的な支援要請は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Perubahan Iklim Bisa Bikin Penyakit yang Ditularkan Nyamuk Makin Sulit Dikendalikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate Change Could Make Mosquito-Borne Diseases More Difficult to Control.
article.articleSummary: Climate change risks making mosquito-borne diseases harder to control in Indonesia, where malaria cases surged 69% from about 418,000 in 2023 to 706,000 in 2025, and dengue fever sickened roughly 161,937 people in 2025 (57.02 per 100,000). The study by Monash University researchers, published in Science Advances, links warming temperatures and shifting rainfall patterns to expanded habitat for Anopheles and Aedes mosquitoes, the vectors for malaria and dengue, respectively. While both diseases are transmitted by female mosquitoes, their propagation patterns differ and may respond differently to climate and regional conditions. Lead researcher Dr. Toby Cumming of the Health and Climate Initiative notes understanding these interacting climatic, environmental, health, and socioeconomic factors is essential to design targeted prevention strategies, including mosquito control, vaccination, treatment, and emission reductions, to curb the growing mosquito-borne disease burden.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動が蚊媒介感染症の制御をより困難にする可能性
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱の既知の増加傾向に関する学術研究報告であり、新規の異常事態や急性のアウトブレイクではないが、感染拡大傾向（マラリア69%増）は注視に値する。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動とマラリア・デング熱の関連性に関する学術研究（Monash大学、Science Advances誌）の紹介記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。マラリア症例が2023年から2025年にかけて69%増加（418,000→706,000）、デング熱も2025年に約161,937人の罹患が報告されており、長期的な疾病負荷増加の傾向として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Did plague ever fully go away? It killed millions, but never disappeared. Here's what to know amid fresh alarm
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, a worker at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, triggering unconfirmed reports of pneumonic plague; Russian authorities said tests found no plague and the institute was quarantined. A rumored second pneumonia case in Irkutsk was dismissed, and contacts underwent preventive measures with no dangerous pathogens detected. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, persists in rodent-flea cycles and is not eradicated, though antibiotics treat it if caught early. Globally, 1,000–2,000 cases occur annually, with Africa (notably Congo and Madagascar) bearing most burden; the US averages about seven cases per year, primarily in rural West. Plague has three forms—bubonic, pneumonic, septicemic—and transmits via fleas or bodily fluids; pneumonic plague can spread through respiratory droplets. A vaccine exists but is advised mainly for high-risk groups; no widespread US plague vaccine is available.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは本当に根絶されたのか？何百万人もの命を奪ったが、決して消え去ってはいない――シベリアでの新たな懸念を受けて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの肺炎死亡例はペスト検査陰性と確認されており、記事はペストに関する一般的な解説記事で、コンゴ・マダガスカルへの言及も具体的な新規発生ではなく背景説明に留まる。
triage.notes: ロシアでの疑い例は検査の結果ペストではないことが確認済み。コンゴ・マダガスカルは年間発生統計の文脈で言及されているのみで、具体的な新規アウトブレイク情報はない。対象国リストにロシアは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Colegiul Medicilor din România, precizări despre ciumă: Boala este tratabilă cu antibiotice. Cum se transmite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The College of Physicians of Romania, clarifications about the plague: The disease is treatable with antibiotics. How it is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 200 people are under medical isolation amid fears of a possible plague spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged Russian health authorities to provide transparent information to assess public health risks; Russia says tests found no microorganism linked to the patient’s activities. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is a zoonosis transmitted mainly from rodents to humans via an infected flea; direct contact is possible, and the pneumonic form can spread between people by respiratory routes. The three main forms are bubonic (swollen lymph nodes), septicemic (systemic), and pneumonic (lung). Bubonic can progress to septicemic or pneumonic. Plague is treatable with antibiotics if diagnosed promptly. Without treatment, bubonic mortality is ~30–60%, while pneumonic/septicemic forms are often fatal. Endemic in several countries; 2019–2025 cases are mainly from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar; outbreaks can be isolated or epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: ルーマニア医師会、ペストについて説明：抗生物質で治療可能な疾患、感染経路とは
triage.triage_reason: 記事はルーマニア医師会によるペストの一般的解説記事で、実際の疑い例はロシアで発生しており対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・マダガスカルへの言及は過去の流行地としての背景説明に過ぎず、今回のイベントの実発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 実際の疑い例はロシア（対象国外）で発生し検査陰性。DRC・マダガスカルは2019-2025年の一般的流行地としての言及であり、今回のイベントの発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện một số tác nhân là virus, vi khuẩn có thể gây bệnh cho cá tại vùng biển Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several agents—viruses and bacteria—that can cause disease in fish have appeared in the coastal waters of Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: In Hà Tĩnh’s coastal waters (Vũng Áng and Thiên Cầm), water samples analyzed by Oct 7, 2026 remained within permitted limits under Vietnam's QCVN 10:2023/BTNMT; fish mortality prompted investigation after deaths reported Sept 29, 2026 in Yên Hòa, Thiên Cầm and Cẩm Trung.
