article.articleHeadline: Hidden Burden: Strongyloides Parasite Infects Far More African Children
article.articleSummary: Strongyloides stercoralis infection in African children shows a 14% pooled prevalence (95% CI 12.2–15.9) across 16,358 under-14s from eight countries in 27 studies (651 records). Côte d'Ivoire leads at 27%, followed by Ethiopia 26% and Tanzania 17%, with São Tomé and Príncipe 2% and Ghana 3%; Nigeria studies often used low-sensitivity diagnostics, potentially underestimating burden, while Ethiopia contributed intensive diagnostics with local prevalences reaching 48.5%. The highest pooled estimate (36%) occurred when PCR was combined with culture and microscopy. Direct smear microscopy and formol-ether yield very low prevalence, whereas agar plate culture, Baermann, and qPCR detect more cases, revealing a large diagnostic gap. Biology enables autoinfection with larvae exiting skin intermittently, allowing lifelong persistence; most infections are mild (skin irritation at entry, dry cough, vague GI symptoms), but immunocompromised individuals may develop hyperinfection or disseminated disease, frequently fatal if unrecognized. Extreme heterogeneity (I2 = 100%) and differences by setting (21% in school/clinic vs 17% in community) are noted. Published 2026-10-08.

triage.headline_ja: 隠れた負担：ストロンジロイデス寄生虫はアフリカの子供たちにこれまでの検査結果よりもはるかに多く感染している
triage.triage_reason: 急性のアウトブレイクではなく、複数のアフリカ諸国における慢性寄生虫感染（糞線虫症）の有病率に関するメタ解析レビュー記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、8か国27研究のメタ解析による糞線虫症（Strongyloides stercoralis）の有病率推定に関する学術的レビューである。対象国の中ではGhanaのみ言及されており、有病率は3%と比較的低い。他の言及国（コートジボワール、エチオピア、タンザニア、サントメ・プリンシペ、ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: بدء التجارب على علاجات ولقاح جديد لـ إيبولا قريبا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Trials begin for new treatments and a vaccine for Ebola soon - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, has 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 confirmed deaths as of 8 October 2026. While some regions show signs of slowing, transmission persists with hotspots near the South Sudan border. Contact tracing has improved, with about 2,000 alerts for suspected cases daily, and community outreach reaching roughly 5 million people. Clinical trials for treatments have enrolled over 600 participants; a vaccine trial is due to begin later this month. Kenya reported an imported Ebola case: a Kenyan citizen infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, treated in Congo, then traveling to Nairobi via Kampala, Uganda, was isolated on arrival and died this week. Kenya is monitoring 55 contacts, including passengers and crew on the Kampala–Nairobi flight. WHO advises against broad travel or trade bans, stressing testing, tracing, and transparency.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱に対する新治療薬とワクチンの治験が近く開始 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは8,665症例・4,178死亡と大規模で、ケニアへの輸入症例（航空機接触者調査含む）が発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは経由地および輸入症例の発生地だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。本体のアウトブレイクはDRCで継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia niega un segundo caso de peste en Siberia y la OMS reclama más transparencia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia denies a second case of plague in Siberia, and the WHO calls for more transparency.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Russian authorities (Rospotrebnadzor) deny reports of a second plague case linked to the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipílova in Irkutsk, saying the cause was pneumonia of unknown etiology. Only two COVID-19 and two rhinovirus infections have been found among contacts. Initial speculation linked Yersinia pestis exposure to travel to Thailand; Thailand’s Department of Disease Control did not confirm travel but remains in contact with the WHO. Authorities reject laboratory accident theories; the family also dismisses them. Nearly 5,000 tests among contacts found no dangerous pathogens; results have been shared with the WHO. The WHO calls for greater transparency under the International Health Regulations to clarify risks. The incident has drawn interest from the United States and neighboring countries China and Mongolia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでのペスト第2症例を否定、WHOは透明性の向上を要求
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例を伴うペスト疑い事例でWHOが情報開示を求めており、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際的懸念)に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: 事例の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの渡航歴は未確認であり、中国・モンゴル・米国は単に関心を示しているに過ぎず、発生国として確認されていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda launches JOSH Teams for youth-led TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
article.articleSummary: 8 October 2026: Union Health Minister JP Nadda launched JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams in New Delhi under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan to mobilize youth for TB elimination. The program aims to spread awareness, promote early diagnosis, reduce TB stigma, and strengthen the continuum of care by encouraging testing, timely treatment, and treatment completion. JOSH Teams will engage communities, identify vulnerable populations through active case finding, and drive community-level outreach to prompt symptom-checking. India reports a 21% decline in TB incidence (faster than global 12%), and TB treatment coverage at 92% (vs 78% globally). Technology-driven screening is highlighted, including portable X-ray machines with AI-based tools to flag suspected TB for further investigation. The initiative underscores collaboration between the Health Ministry, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, and Ministry of Defence to expand grassroots participation.

triage.headline_ja: JPナッダ氏、青年主導の結核撲滅インド運動のためのJOSHチームを発足
triage.triage_reason: 政府主導の結核撲滅啓発プログラムの発足に関する発表であり、結核発生率は減少傾向にある。新規感染拡大や異常事態ではなく公衆衛生施策のニュースであるため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は結核撲滅に向けた政府の啓発・対策プログラム発足を報じるものであり、感染症の急増やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。むしろTB発生率は21%減少と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tres personas condenadas por ataques a centro de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people convicted of attacks on an Ebola treatment center in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Three men were convicted by the Ituri Provincial High Court in the Democratic Republic of Congo for inciting disobedience and assaulting Ebola response facilities and personnel in Mungamba, Ituri province. The August 2026 attacks occurred in Mungamba, a focus of the Ebola outbreak in Irumu territory about 80 km south of Bunia. The convicted are Dieuonné Katembo Kaniki, Trésor Kambale Lieke, and Javan Musubao Kavale, who received 30 months of hard labor. Five suspects stood trial; charges of theft and malicious destruction were not proved, and the others were acquitted. The trial, held in Mungamba, was presided by Judge Romain Mulenga Kasongo. All three defendants’ counsel said they will appeal. Authorities note the Ebola outbreak began May 15, 2026, with attacks on centers and staff continuing amid the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターへの攻撃により3人が有罪判決
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日発生、イトゥリ州）において対応施設・人員への攻撃が継続しており、公衆衛生対応の妨害は制御活動の遅延・拡大リスクに直結するため、フルRRAでの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は対応妨害事件に対する司法判断（有罪判決）が主題だが、背景として2026年5月15日開始のエボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、対応施設・人員への攻撃が繰り返されている点は公衆衛生対応能力に直接影響する重要情報。既存アウトブレイクの進捗・規模に関する疫学データ（症例数・死亡者数等）は本記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: กลับเข้าบ้านหลังน้ำลด เตือน 6 โรค 1 ภัยใกล้ตัว แนะวิธีป้องกัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back home after the flood recedes: six diseases and one imminent danger, prevention tips.
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces six post-flood health risks and one imminent danger as floodwaters recede (as of 2026-10-08). Dengue fever risk rises from residual standing water; eliminate standing water, cover water containers, and seek medical care for high fever, severe headache, or bleeding signs; avoid NSAIDs due to bleeding risk. Conjunctivitis follows contaminated water; wash hands, avoid sharing personal items, seek care for red, itchy eyes. Trench foot from prolonged immersion; wear waterproof boots, dry feet, wash with soap. Respiratory infections from dust and mold; ventilate spaces, wear an N95 during cleaning, seek care for fever, cough, or breathing difficulties. Leptospirosis from water/soil contact; wear boots and gloves, seek medical care for fever, headache, muscle pain. Gastrointestinal infections from contaminated water/food; drink clean water, eat freshly cooked foods, use oral rehydration salts, seek care if dehydration. Electrical hazards: avoid wet cords, shut off power and consult an electrician; if someone is shocked, do not touch and call emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後の帰宅、注意すべき6つの病気と1つの危険：予防法の紹介
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、洪水後の一般的な健康リスクに関する予防啓発記事であるため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は洪水後に注意すべき複数疾患（デング熱、レプトスピラ症、結膜炎等）の一般的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生数や集団感染の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर सेंट्रल जेल में डेंगू की दस्तक, 3 कैदी पॉजिटिव; 30 बीमार... स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue knocks at Indore Central Jail; 3 inmates test positive; 30 ill... Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, dengue cases have emerged at Indore Central Jail, Indore, India, with 3 inmates testing positive and about 30 showing fever or dengue-like symptoms. Samples from additional suspected inmates have been sent for testing, with results pending. The facility houses roughly 2,000 inmates, prompting urgent action by the Health Department and jail administration. A health team conducted a rapid health survey, testing symptomatic inmates and monitoring confirmed cases. Positive patients are receiving treatment and being closely watched. Preventive measures include larvicidal spraying, vector-control efforts to eliminate mosquito breeding sites, ensuring no standing water and improved sanitation. Surveillance is intensified to promptly identify suspected cases and prevent further transmission within the jail.

triage.headline_ja: インドール中央刑務所でデング熱発生、受刑者3人が陽性、30人が発症…保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の刑務所という閉鎖施設でのデング熱集団発生だが、既に対策が講じられており国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生危機とは言えないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 刑務所内という閉鎖環境での集団発生であり、約2000人の収容者がいるため感染拡大の可能性はあるが、既に当局により迅速な対応（幼虫駆除、サーベイランス強化等）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: صحة عالمية: بدء التجارب على لقاح وعلاج جديد للإيبولا قريباً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health: Trials for a new Ebola vaccine and treatment to begin soon.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus: as of 8 October 2026, 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths. The outbreak remains active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with new hotspots near the South Sudan border. Contact tracing has improved to about 2,000 alerts daily for suspected Ebola cases, and community outreach has reached roughly 5 million people. More than 600 volunteers have been enrolled in clinical trials for treatments, with a vaccine trial expected to begin later in October 2026. Deaths continue to occur predominantly in communities rather than at treatment centers, and contact tracing remains insufficient. A Kenyan citizen infected after illness in DRC died after traveling via Kampala to Nairobi; 55 contacts—passengers and crew—are being monitored. Kenya’s rapid reporting to WHO under IHR is commended; WHO cautions against broad travel restrictions, emphasizing testing, tracing, and transparency.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の新ワクチンと治療薬の治験が間もなく開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,665症例・4,178死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、既にケニアへの国際的な感染拡大（渡航関連死亡例）が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境感染/接触者追跡が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主発生地はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya remains safe, open, vigilant after imported Ebola case, Duale says
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case in Kenya: a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo died on 6 October 2026. Kenya’s response features the National Incident Management System (operational since May 2026) with intensified surveillance at health facilities and communities. 4,971 health workers trained; 15 Points of Entry screen more than 652,000 travellers. Contact tracing covers 57 contacts (including 23 passengers and 4 crew members linked to the flight) under monitoring. Isolation, treatment and quarantine facilities total 241 beds, with additional capacity in priority areas. Kenya’s laboratories processed 268 samples with 6–12 hour turnaround. International support includes 1,000 PPE sets from WHO and 6,000 from India; ongoing backing from WHO, USAID, IGAD, Africa CDC and partners. Kenya remains open for travel and trade; coordination with DRC and Uganda ongoing; emphasis on early detection, rapid testing, and decisive action.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、輸入エボラ症例後も安全・開放的・警戒継続とドゥアレ氏表明
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来の輸入エボラ症例がケニアで発生・死亡し、複数国にまたがる接触者追跡や国際支援が行われており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの輸入症例対応が主題だが、感染源はDRCでのエボラ流行であるため、DRCを発生国として記載。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: L'UE suspend temporairement l'entrée de viande namibienne après un foyer de fièvre aphteuse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU temporarily suspends Namibian meat imports after an outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in Namibia trigger an EU ban on fresh beef, mutton, and goat meat, plus certain processed products, effective after the October 5, 2026 decision. The outbreak began September 23 in Karasburg, Karas region, and has affected 11 farms. Only processed meats with the strictest sanitary risk-reduction treatment may enter EU; some shipments certified before Sept 23 may enter within 90 days with controls. Namibia's EU market accounts for over 80% of beef exports, so the ban risks about 300 million NAD ($18 million) in monthly sales. The EU ambassador warned roughly 25% of about 40,000 direct EU-bound jobs could be affected. Reopening depends on containment, controlled animal movements, enhanced surveillance, and robust traceability. Namibia is now among Southern African nations facing FMD outbreaks this year, alongside Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の発生を受け、EUがナミビア産食肉の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の南部アフリカ地域への拡大とEUによる貿易制限が確認されており、IHR基準（国際的拡大・貿易制限）に2項目該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒト感染症ではなく家畜の口蹄疫（動物衛生）に関するものであり、経済・貿易面での影響が中心。ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ザンビアは記事内で『今年口蹄疫の発生に直面している南部アフリカ諸国』として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Surgen nuevos focos de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreaks emerge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of October 8, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 8,500 Ebola cases, making it the fastest-growing and deadliest outbreak in the country. New Ebola hotspots are emerging in communities with little or no patient support, according to officials and emergency teams, and authorities warn there remains a long road ahead in controlling the disease that has killed more than 4,000 people. More than 70% of new cases involve individuals who are not linked to known contacts, and at least 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers, said Dr. Jean Kaseya, Director-General of Africa Health Centers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラ出血熱の感染集積地が発生
triage.triage_reason: 8,500人以上の症例と4,000人以上の死亡者を伴う急速拡大中のエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスクなどIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 70%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者と無関係であり、60%以上の死亡が治療施設外で発生していることから、感染追跡の失敗とコミュニティ内伝播の拡大が強く示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija u Kongu: Ebola probila kontrolu, Kenija prijavila prvi slučaj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: Ebola breaches containment, Kenya reports its first case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo widens with new foci; Northern Kivu now accounts for about 40% of all newly confirmed Ebola cases, up from 24% in late August. More than 8,500 cases have been reported, making this the fastest-spreading and deadliest Ebola epidemic in DR Congo’s history. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. Case fatality in Northern Kivu is about 58%, the highest among seven affected provinces; about 60% of infections die outside treatment centers. Only 23% of contacts have been identified so far, hampering containment. Response on the ground described as chaotic, with shortages of staff and supplies; distrust and late reporting hinder surveillance. The outbreak has crossed borders, as Kenya confirms its first Ebola case—a man who arrived from Congo and died during treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行:封じ込めを突破、ケニアが初の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が過去最速・最多の感染拡大を見せ、致死率約58%、国境を越えてケニアへ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例確認は国際的拡大の重要な指標だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行は8500例超、致死率58%、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であり極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Plus de 190 patients guéris de la variole du singe (Mpox) dans l'est du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: More than 190 patients have recovered from monkeypox (Mpox) in the eastern part of the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Mpox (monkeypox) is spreading in eastern Angola’s Moxico East Province, with Luau municipality as the epicenter and Cazombo reporting. Since June, 204 cases have been recorded; 192 patients have recovered and 12 remain active in various health facilities. Among active cases, six were reported in the last 24 hours in Cazombo and Luau, including a 21‑day‑old infant infected by his mother. About 582 people are under surveillance and vaccination due to exposure. Vaccination campaigns and community awareness activities continue to strengthen prevention. A mobile screening and vaccination team has been deployed at the Angola–DR Congo border to curb importations. Mpox is a viral disease transmitted by close contact with infected people or animals; symptoms include fever, body pains, lymphadenopathy, and vesicular rashes.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ:同国東部でエムポックス(サル痘)患者190人以上が回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク(DRCとの国境地帯での流行)の2基準に該当し、乳児感染例や継続的な曝露・監視対象者の多さからWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアンゴラ東部(モシコ州)での流行であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは国境地帯での移入防止対策の文脈でのみ言及されており、同国での発生報告ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: "Росіяни дуже розумні": Трамп відповів, чи пов'язує можливий спалах чуми в Росії з біологічною зброєю
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Russians are very smart": Trump answered whether he links a possible plague outbreak in Russia to biological weapons.
article.articleSummary: US President Donald Trump says the pneumonic plague case in Russia’s Irkutsk Oblast is not considered a biological weapon, and the US administration will investigate further as no final conclusions are reached. Russia asserts the situation is under control, though Trump notes such assurances have been given before. When asked if the incident echoes the start of COVID-19 in China, he cited limited public statements from both sides but emphasized Russia’s claimed containment. He did not confirm bioweapon use and urged obtaining more information. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington lacks enough data to determine the infection’s nature and called on Moscow to provide more details, not ruling out a potentially more serious development than initially reported. Earlier reports noted US readiness to assist Russia, while Russian authorities and the Ministry of Health disputed a plague death, instead citing pneumonia of unknown etiology.

triage.headline_ja: 「ロシア人はとても賢い」：トランプ氏、ロシアでの疑われるペスト流行が生物兵器と関連しているかとの質問に回答
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはロシア（イルクーツク州）で発生した肺ペスト疑い事例に関する政治的言及記事であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれにも該当しないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツク州における肺ペスト（または原因不明肺炎）疑い事例に関する米露間の政治的やり取りを扱っており、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。中国はCOVID-19との比較で言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Le chef de la diplomatie française Jean-Noël Barrot en visite à Bunia, épicentre de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The head of French diplomacy Jean-Noël Barrot on a visit to Bunia, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Jean-Noël Barrot, France’s minister for diplomacy, visited Bunia in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak that has killed more than 4,000 people. The one-day trip began with a tour of the Rwampara Ebola treatment center on Bunia’s outskirts, operated by French NGO ALIMA. Rwampara houses ALIMA’s transparent bubble facility, allowing major medical procedures—including deliveries—while protecting staff. The center is also hosting prophylaxis trials to prevent infection in people who have already been exposed. Barrot’s program concludes with a planned tour of the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) laboratory, where director Prof. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, a leading Ebola expert, participates in the visit.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:フランス外交トップのジャン=ノエル・バロ氏、エボラ流行の震源地ブニアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: 死者4,000人超に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続中であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の広範な該当、加えて国際的な政治的関心（仏外相訪問）が確認されるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス外相のブニア訪問に関する外交的側面が中心だが、背景にある大規模エボラ流行（死者4,000人超）は既に重大な公衆衛生事案であり継続的な監視が必要。フランスは支援国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 屏縣增1例本土登革熱　屏市40多歲女性中鏢登革病毒第四型
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pingtung County reports one local dengue fever case; a woman in her 40s in Pingtung City contracted dengue virus type 4.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Taiwan’s CDC reports one new locally acquired dengue fever case in Pingtung City: a woman in her 40s infected with dengue virus type 4. She developed fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, and diarrhea in early October and remains hospitalized; cohabiting contacts have no symptoms. No overseas travel history; the infection is considered local and samples will undergo sequencing to identify the possible source. Local authorities have started emergency vector control around the residence, mosquito-density surveys, and environmental risk assessment, with expanded breeding-site clearance and health education, plus expanded testing. Nationwide this year, 188 dengue cases are confirmed: 13 locally acquired ( Kaohsiung 10, Changhua 2, Pingtung 1) and 175 imported, mainly from Vietnam (48), Indonesia (29), and the Philippines (21). Public advised to follow 'inspect, drain, clean, and scrub' and use government-approved repellents; seek prompt medical care with travel or activity history.

triage.headline_ja: 屏東県で本土感染の登革熱症例が1例増加　屏東市の40代女性がデング熱ウイルス第4型に感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での単発の本土感染デング熱症例であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（屏東、高雄、彰化）であり対象国リストに含まれない。記事中のベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の感染経路国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。台湾当局は既に媒介蚊対策・疫学調査を実施しており、管理可能な単発事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ternak Mati Wajib Dikubur, Lalu Lintas Hewan di Sinjai Diperketat Imbas Dugaan Serangan Flu Burung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dead livestock must be buried, and animal movement in Sinjai tightened amid a suspected avian influenza outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Sinjai Utara, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, has caused 2,303 poultry deaths since reports began on 29 September 2026. By 5 October 2026, 2,297 of the deaths were chickens and 6 were ducks. Affected birds showed pale combs, blue- or dark-toned areas, lethargy, drowsiness, and dyspnea. Laboratory confirmation by Balai Besar Veteriner (BBVet) Maros identified avian influenza as the cause. Disnakkeswan Sulsel dispatched field teams to monitor livestock and tighten movement controls across districts to prevent spread. Head of Disnakkeswan Sulsel, Taufiq, urged stricter livestock traffic management and cautioned residents not to dispose of dead poultry improperly; burial is required. The authorities aim to contain the outbreak in Sinjai Utara as cases continue to be reported.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡した家畜は埋葬義務、鳥インフルエンザ感染疑いでシンジャイの家畜移動を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザの発生で、ヒトへの感染は報告されていないが、人獣共通感染症としての拡大リスクがあり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽（鶏・アヒル）における鳥インフルエンザ発生についての報告であり、ヒト感染例の記載はない。ウイルスの亜型（H5N1等）も明記されていないため不明とする。人獣共通感染症としての潜在的リスクから続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm phổi chưa rõ nguyên nhân tại Nga: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia of unknown etiology in Russia: Ministry of Health recommends.
article.articleSummary: One laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Control died from severe pneumonia of unknown etiology on 2 October 2026 in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. As of 7–8 October, the cause remains unconfirmed; the Vietnamese Ministry of Health is coordinating with the World Health Organization to verify details and review laboratory results, while WHO is assessing international risk. There is no current evidence of pneumonic plague or a facility-related outbreak, and no high-risk agent has been identified among contacts; contact tracing has been completed. WHO has requested additional testing results and clarification about a second, undiagnosed pneumonia case reported in local media. Public health guidance urges calm, reliance on official information, environmental hygiene, and rodent and flea control; avoid handling sick or dead rodents. Exposed individuals with fever, swollen lymph nodes, cough, chest pain, or shortness of breath should seek medical care; do not self-medicate with antibiotics. MoH will continue monitoring with WHO and provide updates.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで原因不明の肺炎：保健省が勧告
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡し、WHOが国際リスクを評価中であり、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム保健省はWHOと連携し情報収集・注意喚起を行っているのみで、ベトナム国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença que devastou a Europa continua ativa: pode a peste regressar a Espanha?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The disease that devastated Europe is still active: could the plague return to Spain?
article.articleSummary: Plague remains endemic in Africa, Asia, and the Americas, but Europe faces very low risk. A scientist died in Irkutsk, Russia, with pneumonia of unknown origin; pneumonic plague was suspected, but Russian authorities report no confirmed cases and contacts tested negative; the WHO requested additional information. In Europe, Spain has had no autochthonous plague cases for decades; the ECDC notes absence on the continent for more than 50 years. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs and fleas, and pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets. Spain updated its national protocol in April 2026, and the EU reviewed the Russian incident on October 7. Globally, Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo accounted for most cases between 2019-2025; the United States averages about seven human cases per year. Plague forms include bubonic, pneumonic, septicemic; antibiotics are effective with early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパを壊滅させた病気は今も活動中：ペストはスペインに戻ってくるのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト疑い例は否定され、記事全体はペストの歴史的背景とスペインへの再流行可能性を論じる解説記事であり、対象国における新規発生事例は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツクでの肺ペスト疑い例（確認されず陰性）を契機に、ヨーロッパ・スペインでのペスト再流行可能性を論じる解説記事。マダガスカル・DRCは2019-2025年の累積症例数という歴史的データとして言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生報告ではないため対象国として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: appel aux parents d'élèves à renforcer la vigilance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Appeal to Parents of Students to Strengthen Vigilance - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola vigilance is urged in Beni, North Kivu, DRC, with a message to parents of students at the Sainte-Thérèse de l’Enfant-Jésus school complex in Bungulu commune. The prefect warns that Ebola exists and can present as non-specific malaise, urging home monitoring of any child’s illness and regular temperature checks, as early signs may resemble common diseases. He advises keeping a child at home if a family member has a confirmed Ebola case or a death is recorded, and observing a 21-day home period when an Ebola case is registered or a death is declared positive. Preventive measures include regular handwashing with soap and use of disinfectants. The appeal targets all school communities in Beni, urging parents, teachers, and students to adopt protective behaviours to limit transmission during the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：生徒の保護者に警戒強化を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCのベニ（北キブ州）で進行中のエボラ出血熱の対応に関する記事であり、重症度が高く地域社会への影響が続いているため、フルリスク評価の対象とすべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州ベニ市におけるエボラ出血熱の既存の対応活動（学校コミュニティへの注意喚起）に関するもので、新規発生というより継続中のアウトブレイク対応の一環と考えられる。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dosen Unika Atma Jaya Bagikan 5 Langkah Sederhana Mencegah Penularan Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unika Atma Jaya Lecturer Shares 5 Simple Steps to Prevent the Spread of Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity is rising in Indonesia and Southeast Asia, with Jakarta reporting increased cases. Surveillance through early September 2026 places overall influenza activity in a medium range and showing seasonal upswings typical for Indonesia. The report quotes Unika Atma Jaya Medical lecturer Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, who notes Influenza A is caused by an influenza A virus and can occur year-round, with higher case numbers during certain periods. Common symptoms include fever, chills, sore throat, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue, often accompanied by cough and malaise. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets emitted during coughing, sneezing, talking, or breathing, especially at close range. There is no mention of laboratory-confirmed case counts, fatalities, or imported/exported cases in the article. Public health guidance emphasizes awareness of seasonal increases and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: アトマ・ジャヤ・カトリック大学講師がインフルエンザA型感染予防の簡単な5つのステップを紹介
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの一般的な予防啓発記事であり、重症例や異常な拡大、検査確定症例数の報告もなく、通常の季節性変動の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザAの予防啓発に関する一般的な医療情報であり、検査確定症例数、死亡者数、異常な感染拡大についての言及はない。ジャカルタでの症例増加は通常の季節的傾向として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ترامب يتحدث عن وفاة عاملة مختبر الطاعون في روسيا كخطر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump discusses the death of a plague laboratory worker in Russia as a threat.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 28-year-old plague research institute worker in Siberia, Russia, raises concerns about a potential outbreak. Russian authorities imposed quarantine measures in response to the incident, while public details remain scarce. President Donald Trump told reporters at the White House that more precise information is forthcoming but that the situation is not considered alarming. He said a team of experts is closely monitoring developments and that all information is routed through them. Trump criticized the limited statements from China and Russia, yet voiced confidence that Russian authorities are in control and will inform the international community in due course. The piece highlights global interest and ongoing scrutiny of Russia's handling of the case.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、ロシアのペスト研究所職員の死亡を脅威として言及
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所職員がペストで死亡し隔離措置が取られるなど異常性が高く、米大統領が公の場で言及するなど国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・シベリアで発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国は批判対象として言及されているのみで発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Russia's Latest Patient Zero
article.articleSummary: {"description":"28-year-old Darya Shipilova, employed at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East, is Russia's latest patient zero; her death is presumed pneumonic plague, though Rospotrebnadzor reports no microorganisms linked to her duties detected in samples. Dated Oct 2026, the piece situates Shipilova within the 'Age of Proximity,' arguing long-range travel makes local infections rapidly global. It frames Shipilova's death as a potential capabilities-based threat, given the lab setting and historical concerns about bioweapons. Cited examples include Cold War–era anthrax releases at Sverdlovsk and Britain's 2001 foot-and-mouth disease outbreak to illustrate agro-terror risks. The article also touches on COVID-19 debates and U.S. policy figures in relation to Wuhan research, implying wider implications for lab-origin outbreak narratives and global biosecurity discourse."}

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの最新のゼロ号患者
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシアの研究所職員の死亡（肺ペストの疑い）を起点に、バイオセキュリティや研究室起源説を論じるオピニオン記事であり、対象国における実際の感染症発生事案の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（イルクーツク、エカテリンブルク）、英国、米国、中国（武漢）に言及するオピニオン/論説記事で、実際の発生地は主にロシアであり対象国リストに含まれない。中国への言及はCOVID-19起源論争の文脈のみで、現地発生事案としての主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza testes em humanos de vacina da UFMG contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes human trials of UFMG's malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 October 2026, Anvisa granted approval to begin human trials of Vivaxin, a 100% Brazilian malaria vaccine targeting Plasmodium vivax, developed by UFMG's CTVacinas with USP and Cristália. Phase 1 will enroll 48 healthy adults (18–59), randomizing three dosing regimens and a placebo across three injections 28 days apart, with 360 days of follow-up to evaluate safety and immunogenicity. The trial will be conducted at the Hospital das Clínicas UFMG in Belo Horizonte. P. vivax accounts for about 63.1% of Americas malaria cases and, globally, ~9.9 million cases in 2024 per WHO; Brazil reported 118,037 malaria cases in 2025, over 99% in the Amazon. The parasite can relapse due to liver-stage dormancy, complicating control. If safety and immunogenicity are favorable, later phases will determine whether Vivaxin provides protection, adding to malaria elimination efforts in Brazil and Latin America.

triage.headline_ja: アンビザ、UFMG開発のマラリアワクチンのヒト試験を承認
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチンの臨床試験開始に関する研究開発ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるP. vivaxマラリアワクチン（Vivaxin）の第1相臨床試験承認を伝えるもので、既存のマラリア流行状況への言及はあるが新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 获340万英镑资助抗非洲猪瘟　砂传染病中心加入国际科研项目
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sarawak Infectious Diseases Centre joins international research project after receiving £3.4 million in funding to combat African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Sarawak Infectious Diseases Centre has joined a UK Research and Innovation–funded international project to understand, predict and prevent African swine fever (ASF) in Sarawak, Southeast Asia, and the United Kingdom. The project, led by Professor Peter Dodds of the University of Sheffield, is titled “Data-driven approach to understand, predict and prevent ASF in the UK and Southeast Asia.” UKRI announced 18 projects on October 7, with £3.4 million awarded. SIDC will collaborate with the University of Sheffield, University of Liverpool, BIOTEC Thailand, and the Sarawak Veterinary Department. ASF is a highly contagious virus affecting domestic and wild pigs; it poses no risk to humans but devastates pig populations and farmer livelihoods. The study aims to use whole-genome sequencing to establish SIDC as a regional ASF genome reference center, define vaccine strategies and regional SOPs, and provide evidence for farmers, authorities and policymakers to improve control.

triage.headline_ja: 340万ポンドの資金提供を受け、アフリカ豚熱対策でサラワク感染症センターが国際研究プロジェクトに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASF対策のための国際研究資金提供・研究協力体制の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生リスクも低い。
triage.notes: マレーシア（サラワク）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。タイ（BIOTEC Thailand）は共同研究機関として言及されているが、タイ国内でのASF発生を主題とする記事ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Dozens of suspect hepatitis A cases monitored in Bukidnon's Valencia City
article.articleSummary: 73 suspected Hepatitis A cases in Barangay Lurugan, Valencia City, Bukidnon, with 13 confirmed. Testing is underway and results pending; two cases reported in neighboring Barangay San Carlos. Most patients are students aged 10–19. The City Health Office has ordered temporary closure of eateries and other food establishments in the barangay while investigators determine the source. Laboratory confirmation is ongoing. Hepatitis A is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable liver infection caused by the hepatitis A virus; illness ranges from mild to severe and can progress to liver failure or death. Transmission occurs via ingestion of the virus from contaminated food, drink, or surfaces, and through close personal contact. At-risk groups include people who use drugs (injection or non-injection), people experiencing homelessness, men who have sex with men, residents in congregate settings, and contacts of these risk factors.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:ブキドノン州バレンシア市で数十件のA型肝炎疑い例を監視中
triage.triage_reason: 学生を中心に73名の疑い例（13名確定）が発生し、食品媒介・接触感染の可能性があり地域社会での拡大が懸念されるため、WPRO基準（異常性・継続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、保健当局が対応中で社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 感染源は調査中で、近隣バランガイへの拡大も報告されている。学校等の若年層集団での感染拡大リスクに注意が必要。死亡例の報告はなく、現時点では局所的な公衆衛生イベントと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa suspende aulas após registrar mais de 240 casos de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa suspends classes after reporting more than 240 cases of scabies.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Lagoa Santa in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 241 scabies cases, with 50 new cases in the last 24 hours, leading to school closures on 8–9 October as a precaution. The measure, not a routine recommendation for scabies management, aims to support transmission control, with health and education secretariats monitoring health units, the hospital, and families to ensure proper treatment and rapid case finding. Suspected cases should seek health assessment; households should clean clothes, bedding, towels, and personal items and avoid close contact to reduce transmission and reinfestation. Previously, Lagoa Santa closed Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Maria on 1–2 October after 21 cases among students and a teacher. Minas Gerais SES-MG notes scabies is not nationally or state-notifiable; two linked cases trigger reporting to CIEVS-Minas, and by 2026 seven MG outbreaks had been recorded, including Lagoa Santa.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ、疥癬症例240件以上報告後に授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度が低く、ブラジルでは全国/州レベルで届出義務のない疾患であり、学校閉鎖は予防的措置に留まる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトヒト感染するが重症度が低く、地域の学校閉鎖で対応可能な事例。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは見なされない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue outbreak suspected to kill 1 CRPF jawan, infecting over 50 paramilitary personnel in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: More than 50 BSF, CRPF and ITBP personnel who arrived in Gandhinagar for National Unity Day parade tested positive for dengue, with 43 hospitalized at Gandhinagar Civil Hospital. A 29-year-old CRPF jawan from Assam, Amal Barman, died during treatment; a post-mortem has been completed and the final cause of death is pending. Barman arrived at Gandhinagar Civil Hospital OPD at about 9:30 PM on October 6 and died at 6:50 AM. The dengue cases prompted the state Health Department to intensify preventive measures in affected areas, including fogging, chemical spraying, anti-larval operations and surveillance. Health Minister Prafull Panseriya convened a high-level review, and officials ordered enhanced vector control after the rising cases. Dengue is confirmed among the affected personnel; infection source is not specified.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でデング熱の集団発生疑い、CRPF隊員1名死亡、50人以上の準軍事要員に感染
triage.triage_reason: 国家統一デーのパレードに参加した準軍事要員50人超が感染し43人が入院、1名が死亡するなど深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、特定集団での急激な集団発生という異常性も認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 死因は剖検実施済みだが確定前。感染源は特定されていない。グジャラート州保健当局は防疫強化（燻蒸、幼虫駆除、サーベイランス）を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Rusko popiera medializované správy o údajne druhom prípade pľúcneho moru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia denies media reports of an alleged second case of pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: On 8 October 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor denied media reports of a second pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk Oblast. Social-media claims linked to a supposed second infection from a contact of a 28-year-old laboratory technician at a plague research institute in Shelekhov near Irkutsk were labeled false by the agency, cited by Kommersant via TASR. The deceased technician reportedly died of pneumonia unrelated to her work. Rospotrebnadzor stated she was vaccinated and immune to dangerous infections she handled, and that preventive measures after her death were lifted. Dozens of contacts were monitored with no dangerous disease detected; nearly 5,000 laboratory tests did not confirm dangerous pathogens. The pneumonia was described as acquired outside hospital. The WHO urged Moscow to explain media reports of a second pneumonia case of unknown origin; Mongolia and China requested information.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、肺ペストの第二症例に関する報道を否定
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い症例に関してWHOが説明を求め、モンゴル・中国も情報を要請しているが、実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国での発生は確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: イベントの主たる発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州・モスクワ）であり、対象国リストには含まれない。中国・モンゴルは情報提供を要請したのみで、両国内での症例発生は報告されていないため verified_locations は空とした。ロシア当局は第二症例を否定しており、死亡した検査技師の肺炎は職務とは無関係とされている。WHOの関与があるため国際的な関心の高まりは認められるが、対象国への実害は現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: Regions Calling: In Irkutsk, Locals Ask 'What Plague?'
article.articleSummary: Death of 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a lab worker at a plague research institute in Irkutsk region (Shelekhov), sparked unconfirmed reports of plague. As of Oct. 2, identified contacts are under medical observation with laboratory tests negative; officials described the deceased as possibly having pneumonia of unknown etiology. Irkutsk Governor Kobzev said Rospotrebnadzor arrived due to a suspected infection. Buryatia head Tsydenov claimed the patient had not traveled to Buryatia and that there are no outbreaks there, though he used the word plague. Public reaction is muted, with social-media rumors circulating. Independent expert Judyth Twigg urged regular, transparent updates and practical guidance. WHO data (2019–2025) record 3,847 suspected plague cases and 423 deaths globally, mainly in DRC and Madagascar, with some in rural western U.S., providing broader context for the scare. The report centers Irkutsk and neighboring Buryatia, with ongoing medical surveillance and no confirmed outbreak as of Oct. 2.

triage.headline_ja: 地域からの呼びかけ：イルクーツクの住民が『何のペスト？』と問う
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所の検査員が死亡し地域で懸念が広がっているが、感染症の確定診断はなく、接触者の検査も陰性であるため情報不足。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア（イルクーツク州・ブリヤート共和国）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国はない。DRCおよびマダガスカルはWHOの過去データの文脈として言及されているのみで、本事例の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Laporkan Kematian Pertama Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Reports First Ebola Death
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola death from the Bundibugyo strain; the imported case originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). A local man who fell ill in DRC traveled to Nairobi, via Kampala and Entebbe (Uganda) on 3 October and died on 5 October. WHO Kenya representative Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo said the coming days are crucial for tracing all contacts to prevent community spread. About 10 close relatives have cooperated and are under quarantine; 21 health workers who treated him, plus lab staff and others, have been contacted. Airline exposure includes approximately 23 passengers and four crew on the Entebbe–Kampala flight. Authorities emphasize transmission through contact with infected bodily fluids (sweat, blood, saliva) and call for hand hygiene, hand sanitizer use, avoiding close contact, and seeking care promptly if symptoms appear. The outbreak in eastern DRC is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱による初の死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がウガンダ経由でケニアに輸入され死者が発生、国境を越えた拡大とヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダでの症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源であるDRCでのアウトブレイクが継続中であり、同国が主題として該当する。航空機内での接触者(乗客・乗務員)追跡が進行中であり、今後の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La peste è ancora un rischio per i Paesi dell'Europa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is plague still a risk for European countries?
article.articleSummary: Death of a scientist in Irkutsk, Siberia, sparked fears of pneumonic plague. Russian authorities report no confirmed cases; contacts tested negative; the WHO seeks more information. Although Europe has had no autochthonous transmission for decades, Yersinia pestis persists in animal reservoirs worldwide and can reach humans via infected fleas or contact with infected animal tissues; pneumonic plague can spread through respiratory droplets. In Europe, the risk is low. Spain maintains active surveillance; in April 2026 an update to the national protocol was issued. The EU reviewed the Russian case on Oct 7; authorities await clarifying information. Globally, plague remains endemic in Africa, Asia, and the Americas. From 2019–2025, Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo accounted for most human cases; Madagascar records bubonic cases. In the United States, seven cases per year, mainly rural western areas. Antibiotics are effective; early diagnosis is key. European risk remains low, but vigilance continues.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは依然として欧州諸国にとってリスクなのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで科学者が死亡し肺ペストの疑いが報じられたが、ロシア当局は確定例なしと発表し接触者の検査も陰性。WHOが追加情報を求めている段階であり、確定診断がないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（イルクーツク）での科学者死亡事例を主題とし、欧州における疫学的リスク評価の文脈でマダガスカル・DRC・米国の流行状況が背景情報として言及されているのみで、これらの国での現在進行中の具体的発生事例を報じるものではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生地域はなしと判断した。確定診断がないため、WHOおよびロシア当局からの続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa suspende aulas em toda a rede municipal após surto de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa Suspends Classes Across the Entire Municipal Network After a Scabies Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Lagoa Santa, in the Belo Horizonte region, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports a scabies outbreak with 241 notified cases, 50 in the last 24 hours. In response, all municipal schools were closed on Oct 8–9, 2026 as a precaution; the measure is not a routine control requirement and does not on its own halt transmission. A prior count of 20 confirmed cases prompted a school closure on Sept 30; the alert began Sept 18. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged skin-to-skin contact; not via coughs or sneezes, and not linked to hygiene. Authorities conduct daily class-level symptom screening; families are advised to seek healthcare for suspected cases and adhere to prescribed treatment. Home measures include washing clothes and linens in hot water, sealing non-washables for seven days, avoiding sharing items, keeping nails short, and limiting skin-to-skin contact until treatment ends. No population-wide prophylaxis; return to school follows health guidance. Bulletins updated.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ、疥癬アウトブレイクにより全市立学校の授業を休止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州ラゴア・サンタで疥癬の症例が急増（241例、うち50例は直近24時間）し、短期間に2度の学校閉鎖措置が取られるなど地域社会的関心が高いため、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症化や死亡につながる疾患ではないが、学校単位での急速な感染拡大と2度の休校措置という異例の対応があり、地域内での感染拡大状況を継続的に監視する価値がある。国際的な公衆衛生リスクや渡航制限の必要性は現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola : formation des secouristes et infirmiers titulaires à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Response to Ebola: training of first responders and registered nurses in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo: Two-day training for Red Cross rescue volunteers and registered nurses to prepare for Ebola in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in northeast DRC. The program covers risk communication for community engagement, community-based surveillance, mental health and protection, and gender inclusion. After training, participants will continue field outreach begun in July, adding surveillance activities. The Budibogyo Ebola strain reportedly presents with symptoms similar to typhoid fever and malaria, prompting integrated surveillance to produce effective community sentinels. Health officials warn Ebola remains the deadliest outbreak in the DRC’s history, underscoring the need for community involvement. A Tuesday incident in Kabondo, at 10:00 local time on 7th Avenue bis, saw a health worker attacked; authorities stress barrier measures to cut transmission. Red Cross in Tshopo emphasizes prevention and safe, dignified burial (EDS) to protect residents.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：キサンガニで救急隊員・正看護師への研修実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで『史上最も致命的』とされる進行中のエボラアウトブレイクへの対応活動報告であり、重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性（外部支援）の観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行（Budibogyo株）に対する研修・コミュニティ対応活動の続報であり、新規発生情報ではない。医療従事者への暴力事案（Kabondo）も発生しており、対応活動の困難さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 手足口病EV71疫苗接种科普：从成分到保护效力深度解析
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease: An In-Depth Analysis of the EV71 Vaccine—from Ingredients to Protective Efficacy
article.articleSummary: HFMD due to enterovirus 71 (EV71) remains a seasonal risk in China, especially in autumn–winter and in school settings. Two EV71 vaccines exist, produced on different cell substrates: Vero cells and human diploid cells. Neither substrate is a WHO-defined gold standard; both meet Chinese Pharmacopoeia safety standards. Both vaccines are indicated for children aged 6 months to 71 months. Real-world data from Yiwu, Zhejiang (n>6,000) show overall adverse event rates of 4.8% (Vero) and 5.1% (human diploid); in the 24–35 months subgroup, 5.3% vs 2.5% respectively. Immunogenicity data from a Phase 3 trial show seroconversion of 95.5% (Vero) vs 86.0% (human diploid); GMTs 48.4 vs 26.3. The Sinovac Vero-based vaccine has rapid protection with 89.2% seropositivity at 10 days; long-term protection data: ~5 years for Vero vs ~2 years for human diploid. Recommendation: vaccinate early with a two-dose schedule (1 month apart) starting at 6 months, and choose licensed, available products based on safety/effectiveness data rather than substrate branding.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病EV71ワクチン接種の科学解説：成分から防御効力までの深層分析
triage.triage_reason: これはEV71ワクチンの成分・有効性に関する教育的・解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン製品比較・接種推奨に関する科学普及コンテンツであり、感染症発生イベントの報告ではないため対象国の発生事例としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna faz escolas da Grande BH suspenderem aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies outbreak causes schools in the Greater Belo Horizonte area to suspend classes.
article.articleSummary: Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) outbreak in Lagoa Santa, Belo Horizonte metropolitan region, Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 241 confirmed cases and 50 new notifications in the last 24 hours. Lagoa Santa closed all municipal schools for Oct 8–9, 2026; the precautionary closure aims to curb transmission, not a routine control step. Daily monitoring continues via a municipal Situation Room involving Health, Education, Social Welfare, Epidemiological Surveillance, and UBS management. Earlier, Oct 1–2, 2026, the municipality suspended classes at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Maria after 21 cases and one teacher. Transmission is mainly through prolonged direct contact and contaminated items. Symptoms: intense itching, especially at night, and skin lesions on hands, wrists, elbows, armpits, waist, buttocks, and genitals. Prevention: wash clothing and linens in hot water, sanitize personal items, seal non-washables for at least a week, avoid sharing items, and promptly assess close contacts. Treatment varies per case, often topical creams; sometimes oral meds.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の集団発生によりベロオリゾンテ都市圏の学校が休校
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州で疥癬の集団発生（241例、直近24時間で新規50件）が確認され、学校休校など地域の対応が強まっているため、WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行性）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 疥癬自体は重症度が低く国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、学校単位での急速な感染拡大と自治体の緊急対応（休校・状況室設置）が確認されており、地域の公衆衛生対応として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EU Temporarily Suspends Namibian Meat Imports After Foot-and-Mouth Disease Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Namibia’s Karas region (Karasburg district) prompted EU to suspend imports of fresh Namibian beef, sheep and goat meat on Oct 5, 2026, after initial detection on Sept 23. The outbreak has spread to 11 farms in the Kharas region; some processed meat shipments face restrictions, with only high-risk-reduction products allowed. Namibia’s EU market is the largest, absorbing over 80% of beef exports; the ban threatens about 300 million Namibian dollars (≈$18 million) in monthly export revenue and thousands of jobs tied to European sales. The livestock sector contributes about 3% of GDP. Some pre-Sept 23 shipments may enter within 90 days under conditions, subject to border controls. Containment requires limiting spread, movement controls, enhanced surveillance and traceability. Regional FMD alerts persist in Southern Africa, including Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe.

triage.headline_ja: EU、口蹄疫発生を受けナミビア産食肉の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜のみに影響する動物疾患であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響はない。また発生国ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれず、ザンビア等への言及も地域アラートの一環に過ぎず主題ではない。
triage.notes: 本事例はナミビアの家畜（牛・羊・山羊）における口蹄疫発生とEUの輸入停止措置に関する経済・貿易関連ニュースであり、ヒトの公衆衛生事象ではない。ザンビア等近隣国への言及は地域的なFMD警戒情報として付随的に記載されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: RSUD Muhammad Zein Belitung Timur Tak Punya Alat Deteksi, Kasus Influenza Tipe A Belum Terdiagnosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Muhammad Zein Regional General Hospital, East Belitung Lacks Detection Equipment; Influenza A Case Not Yet Diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Influenza Type A is under surveillance in East Belitung Regency, Indonesia, where no laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported yet. Doctors at RSUD Muhammad Zein Belitung Timur warn that, while suspected cases may arise, formal confirmation cannot be made due to the absence of dedicated virus detection equipment at the hospital. Clinically, Influenza A is described as a 'super flu' with high and variable fevers, severe body aches, marked fatigue, red and teary eyes, pale tongue with a bitter taste, and heavy cough and nasal symptoms; in some patients, symptoms can extend to diarrhea, abdominal pain, nausea/vomiting, and skin rashes, depending on age and comorbidities. Given children are most vulnerable, parents should monitor for dangerous fever. Treatment pathways vary by age: under 18 treated in Pediatric Clinics; adults may be referred to Internal Medicine or Pulmonology if respiratory distress is present. No confirmed cases as of 2026-10-08.

triage.headline_ja: ムハンマド・ゼイン東ブリトゥン地方総合病院、検査機器不足によりインフルエンザA型症例が未診断
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例がなく、検査機器不足による地域病院の運用上の問題を報じる内容であり、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA型の疑い症例に関する地域報道で、検査体制の課題を指摘する内容。確定診断例なし。

article.articleHeadline: الدرن الرئوي.. كيف ينتقل؟ ومن الأكثر عرضة للإصابة به؟ | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulmonary tuberculosis: How is it transmitted? And who is most at risk of contracting it?
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is infection of the lungs by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, transmitted via airborne particles from someone with active pulmonary TB, especially in poorly ventilated indoor spaces. Many infections are latent, with bacteria persisting without symptoms and non-contagious, but activation can occur if immunity weakens. Active pulmonary TB presents with a cough lasting three weeks or more, chest pain, sputum or blood, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, and sometimes shortness of breath. Risk factors for progression include HIV, diabetes, kidney disease, malnutrition, immunosuppressive therapy, and silicosis. TB is curable with anti-TB drugs, but adherence is essential to prevent drug resistance. Globally, TB remains a major challenge: about 10.7 million cases and 1.23 million deaths in 2024, with 150,000 HIV co-infected. Thirty high-burden countries drive most cases; eight—India, Indonesia, Philippines, China, Pakistan, Nigeria, DR Congo, Bangladesh—together account for roughly one-third of global cases. Seek evaluation for persistent cough or systemic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 肺結核：どのように感染するのか？最もかかりやすいのは誰か？
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、特定の発生・アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の一般的な教育・啓発コンテンツであり、特定国での新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。挙げられている国々（インド、インドネシア、フィリピン、中国、パキスタン、ナイジェリア、DRC、バングラデシュ）は世界的な結核高負荷国として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生事象ではないため、対象国であってもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: മുഖ്യമന്ത്രിയുടെ ഔദ്യോഗിക വസതിയിൽ പകർച്ചവ്യാധി; 5 പൊലീസുകാർക്ക് ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of an infectious disease at the Chief Minister's official residence; five police officers test positive for dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Five police officers on duty at the Chief Minister's Cliff House in Thiruvananthapuram tested positive for dengue fever, indicating a cluster at the residence. Through September 2026, Kerala reported 11,281 dengue cases and 42 deaths. By contrast, 2025 saw 10,886 dengue cases. June recorded the year's peak, with 1,802 cases and 15 deaths. The article does not provide details on the infection source, symptoms beyond the dengue diagnosis, or whether any cases are imported or exported. The incident highlights ongoing dengue activity in Kerala. No further details are provided in the article. The report focuses on the cluster among police at a high-profile government residence.

triage.headline_ja: 首相官邸で感染症発生；警察官5名のデング熱感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州首相公邸という高注目施設でのデング熱クラスターが発生し、州全体でも継続的な流行（死亡42名）が見られるため、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: ケララ州における季節性デング熱流行の一環であり、感染源や症状の詳細、輸入/輸出例の有無は不明。首相公邸という高注目施設でのクラスターのため政治的関心が高まる可能性がある一方、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
