article.articleHeadline: 九龍醫院康復科男病房爆甲流　8病人中招
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kowloon Hospital Rehabilitation Department Men's Ward hit by influenza A (H1N1) outbreak; 8 patients infected.
article.articleSummary: Eight patients in Kowloon Hospital's Rehabilitation Department, Male Ward, in Hong Kong have laboratory-confirmed influenza A (H1N1) infections as of 8 October 2026. Illness onset began after Friday, 2 October 2026, with ages from 47 to 90 years. Laboratory tests confirmed H1N1 in all eight; one patient remains admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for unrelated medical needs. All patients are stable. The hospital has strengthened infection-control measures per established guidelines and will continue close monitoring of the ward. The case cluster has been reported to the Hospital Authority Headquarters and the Centre for Health Protection for follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 九龍醫院リハビリテーション科男性病棟でA型インフルエンザ（H1N1）集団感染、8人の患者が感染
triage.triage_reason: 香港の単一病院内での季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の院内クラスターであり、患者は安定しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。既知の病原体で管理可能な事例。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の院内感染クラスターで、全患者が安定状態。病院・保健当局（Centre for Health Protection）へ報告済みで通常の院内感染対策の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Russian plague scare: Everything we know as health chief calls for information | The National
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague concerns in Siberia after the death of a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute in Shelekhov (Danya Shipilova, 28) on Oct 2, leading to >200 contacts in quarantine. Russia says no confirmed pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk Oblast; WHO has demanded more information, including lab test results and rationale for the quarantine, under the International Health Regulations, and has flagged a second employee reportedly with pneumonia of undetermined cause. WHO offered technical support on plague and biosafety but has not completed a risk assessment. The US CDC is monitoring the situation, noting pneumonic plague—caused by Yersinia pestis and spread via respiratory droplets—requires rapid treatment with antibiotics; no broader US threat is indicated. Context includes the 2025 Arizona pneumonic plague death and endemic activity in Madagascar, the DRC, Peru, and occasional US cases."

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト騒動：保健当局が情報提供を呼びかける中、分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員が肺ペスト疑いで死亡し200人超が隔離、WHOがIHRに基づき情報提供を要求しており、重大性・異常性の両面でIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストには含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。マダガスカル・DRC・ペルー・米国は文脈説明として言及されているのみで、本事象の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பரவல் : ''தண்ணீர் தேங்கியிருந்தால் ரூ.10,000 அபராதம்...'' - அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ் எச்சரிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue spread: 'If water stagnates, a Rs. 10,000 fine...' - Minister Arunraj warns
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Tamil Nadu, India: since January 2026, 21,655 dengue cases reported across the state with 10 deaths. The government is implementing pre-monsoon preventive measures statewide. In Chennai’s Vadapalani neighborhood, a fever and dengue prevention camp was held and inspected by Health Minister Arunraj. He warned commercial establishments and construction sites to prevent mosquito breeding and larval growth, detailing a Rs 10,000 fine for non-compliance. He urged public cooperation with vector-control workers and stressed households must prevent water stagnation, including avoiding standing water in apartment complexes. The article underscores ongoing authorities’ efforts to curb transmission as Tamil Nadu ramps up prevention ahead of the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の拡大:「水が溜まっていれば1万ルピーの罰金…」- アルンラージ大臣が警告
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱が季節的に流行し死者も出ているが、インドで毎年見られる既知の流行パターンであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らないが経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 州全体で21,655例、死亡10例と報告されており、季節性のデング熱流行として州政府が予防策を実施中。モンスーン前の対策強化段階であり、特段の異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Kangra: लंपी वायरस का कहर! गाय की आंख की पुतली बाहर निकली, पशुपालक चिंतित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kangra: Havoc of Lumpy Skin Disease! The cow's eye pupil protruded; the cattle owner is concerned.
article.articleSummary: As of October 8, 2026, Kangra district's Gangath area reports renewed Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle. In Khadol village of Rappad Panchayat, a cow developed severe LSD signs, with large body nodules, heavy swelling of legs, and one eye's pupil protruding outward with the eye turning white, causing partial vision loss. Gangath veterinary teams are treating the affected animal; overall, about 60–70 LSD cases have been reported across 14 dispensaries under Gangath Hospital, with the situation now reportedly under control and the spread slowed. Authorities urge continued vigilance: keep stalls clean and protect livestock from flies, mosquitoes, and ticks; suspected LSD animals should be isolated and reported to the nearest veterinary facility.

triage.headline_ja: カングラ:ランピースキン病の猛威!牛の目の瞳孔が飛び出す、家畜飼育者が懸念
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患(ランピースキン病)であり人獣共通感染症としての人への影響報告はなく、当局により状況は制御下にあるとされているため、ヒトの公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。地域の獣医チームが対応中で、拡大は鈍化・制御下にあると報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana já provocou surtos em sete cidades de Minas; saiba onde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies has already caused outbreaks in seven cities in Minas Gerais; find out where.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies outbreaks have reached 241 cases in Lagoa Santa, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, with 50 new cases in the previous 24 hours. Seven municipalities in Minas Gerais have reported outbreaks in 2026: Andradas, Lagoa Santa, Itapecerica, Lavras, Joaquim Felício, Coronel Xavier Chaves, and Alfenas. Lagoa Santa closed schools on Oct 8–9 as cases mounted. Scabies is not on Brazil's or Minas Gerais' official lists of notifiable diseases, so there is no consolidated state total; municipalities must report two or more linked cases to SES-MG via CIEVS-Minas or the responsible technical area. The SES-MG monitors the outbreaks, provides technical support, and advises on isolation periods, prevention, and control measures. Municipal health teams, with SES-MG support, coordinate with schools and communities to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州7都市で疥癬の集団発生、発生地域を紹介
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州7都市で疥癬の集団発生が報告され、学校閉鎖など地域社会への影響と行政の関心が高いため、WPRO基準（異常性・継続曝露・流行しやすさ）を満たしフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジルおよびミナスジェライス州の届出義務疾患リストに含まれておらず、州全体の集計データが存在しない点に留意。重症度は低いが、学校閉鎖や複数都市での同時多発的な発生など社会的関心が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades russas desmentem segundo caso de peste pneumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian authorities deny a second case of pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: As of October 8, 2026, Russian authorities in Irkutsk deny a second pneumonic plague case after social-media rumors of a contact to the deceased patient. Rospotrebnadzor stated the rumor is false, clarifying that Daria Shipilova, 28, died of pneumonia of unknown etiology in an Irkutsk hospital. The agency reports only two confirmed COVID-19 cases and two rhinovirus infections to date, and more than 90% of contact investigations have been completed. Nearly 5,000 tests among contacts found no pathogenic microorganism, and officials stressed no epidemic risk in Irkutsk, with no lab accident, and vaccination/strong immunity noted for the deceased. Initial reports linked the patient to Yersinia pestis from Thailand, but Thai authorities say they are in contact with the WHO and have not confirmed travel. The WHO requests greater transparency under the International Health Regulations; neighboring nations (USA, China, Mongolia) have shown interest in the situation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア当局、肺ペストの2例目感染を否定
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明肺炎による死亡例を巡り当局が二例目のペスト感染を否定しているが、WHOが透明性を求め近隣国も関心を示しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり対象国リストに含まれない。タイでの感染経路は当局により未確認、中国・米国・モンゴルは関心を示したのみで発生国ではないため、いずれも verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh measles outbreak worsens as experts blame govt's vaccine procurement failure
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh’s measles outbreak has intensified, with over 32,000 suspected cases and more than 250 deaths (mostly children) since mid-March, and more than 21,000 hospitalisations. The outbreak began in January in Rohingya refugee camps near the Myanmar border and has spread to 58 of 64 districts. It follows the interim government’s September 2025 decision to halt vaccine procurement via UNICEF in favor of an open tender, a process later delayed, causing vaccine shortages and faltering routine immunisation. Procurement through UNICEF was reinstated in April, alongside an emergency vaccination drive, but authorities warn containment will be slow given rapid transmission. Only 59% of eligible children received measles vaccines in 2025 before figures were removed from official sites. Vitamin A distribution campaigns have failed since 2024, weakening immunity. A Supreme Court lawyer filed a complaint with the Anti-Corruption Commission over alleged vaccine-procurement failures under the interim government. 2023 CE Survey showed first- and second-dose coverages at 86% and 80.7%, below earlier levels, with 95% typically needed to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹流行が悪化、専門家は政府のワクチン調達失敗を批判
triage.triage_reason: 3万人超の疑い症例、250人以上の死亡、2.1万人の入院が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてMyanmarが付与されているが、記事サマリーによれば流行の主体はバングラデシュ（ロヒンギャ難民キャンプおよび58/64県）であり、ミャンマーは国境付近の地理的言及に過ぎない。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dood Russische laborant wekt zorgen over pest en roept vragen op over transparantie rond covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a Russian laboratory technician raises concerns about the plague and raises questions about transparency surrounding COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East died after developing severe pneumonia; local reports suggest a breakage of a vial containing plague-causing bacteria, though authorities have not confirmed plague cases in the region. About 200 contacts were quarantined without symptoms, and the health officials described the death as community-acquired pneumonia of unknown origin. The World Health Organization requested information under International Health Regulations, but Moscow replied after three days, outside the expected 24-hour window; a WHO official called the delay unacceptable and insufficient for risk assessment. The incident drew analogies to early COVID-19 information gaps. Separately, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo across 64 health zones in seven provinces with nearly 4,000 deaths, while Kenya reported its first Ebola case; in the United States, measles infections exceed 1,000 in Pennsylvania, prompting New York to declare a state of emergency to bolster vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの検査技師の死亡でペストへの懸念が高まり、COVID-19を巡る透明性にも疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアでのペスト疑惑とWHOへの情報開示遅延を主題とするが、対象国であるDRCのエボラ流行（64保健ゾーン、死者約4000人）がケニアへ拡大した事実も報告されており、深刻性・国際拡大・異常性の複数のIHR基準に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクでのペスト疑惑による死亡例とWHOへの情報開示遅延だが、ロシア・米国・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行（ケニアへの拡大含む）のみ対象国として抽出した。

article.articleHeadline: Are flights safe amid Kenya's Ebola case? Explained
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case, a passenger who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. Flights remain safe with precautions; Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood or body fluids, not by airborne transmission, and WHO says travel-associated transmission risk is low. Travelers should avoid contact with contaminated fluids, practice good hand hygiene, and not fly if unwell. CDC guidance advises ill travelers to isolate and seek assessment before flying. In Kenya, the Civil Aviation Authority has Ebola measures: fever screening at entry (38°C or higher), and electronic surveillance or health declarations for passengers from DRC or Uganda; operators must provide access to forms. Airlines play a key role: crew trained to recognize sick travelers, use PPE, and disinfect aircraft. If symptoms develop onboard, follow procedures and notify authorities; cleaning varies with symptoms (routine if none like vomiting/diarrhoea/bleeding; otherwise enhanced disinfection).

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ症例発生時、飛行機は安全か？解説
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラがウガンダ経由でケニアに輸入され、国境を越えた伝播が確認されたため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク）に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本事例はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行に関連する輸入症例であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行自体が記事の背景として主題に含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố vụ vận chuyển lợn dương tính với dịch tả châu Phi ở Thái Nguyên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indictment in the case of transporting pigs positive for African swine fever in Thai Nguyen
article.articleSummary: On Oct 8, 2026, Thai Nguyen Province police indicted a case for violation of food safety regulations after discovering 16 pigs infected with African swine fever virus, totaling about 1.5 metric tons. The investigation centered in Linh Son Ward, Thai Nguyen City. Earlier, in Kha Son commune, Economic Police found a truck, plate 88C-261.93, driven by N.Q.T. (born 1993, resident of Tan Khanh commune), transporting many pigs showing disease signs. A check revealed 26 pigs weighing about 2.7 tonnes. According to initial statements, these pigs were purchased by Trung in Hiep Luc to be sold to local households, including D.V.G. (born 1979, Linh Son Ward). Lab tests confirmed 16 pigs positive for ASF; one of these had died. The case remains under investigation; authorities urge the public to buy food with clear origin and report violations.

triage.headline_ja: タイグエンでアフリカ豚熱陽性の豚の輸送事件を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響はなく、法執行事案としての報道に留まる。IHR基準・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: 動物（豚）の感染症であり、ヒトへの感染事例の報告はない。食品安全・違法輸送に関する刑事事件としての報道。

article.articleHeadline: "Ya no sé a quién creer", los siberianos viven entre rumores y miedo a la peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I don't know who to believe anymore: Siberians live amid rumors and fear of the plague.
article.articleSummary: Death in Shélejov, a town in Russia's Irkutsk region, has spurred fear of plague after 28-year-old laboratory worker Daria Chipilova, associated with Irkutsk's Institute of the Fight Against Plague, died last week. Authorities say the death was due to pneumonia of indeterminate origin, with around 5,000 tests showing no dangerous pathogens and no emergency declared. The deceased was vaccinated and immune to the pathogens she handled. Amid widespread rumors and fear, residents report mask use and frustration over official guidance, including unfounded theories like a 'Hong Kong syphilis' disease. The World Health Organization urged clarification of reports of a second case, while the Kremlin urged trust in authorities; no confirmed plague and no epidemiological risk detected, six years after the COVID-19 pandemic. Some international actors offered assistance, though details remain uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: 「もう誰を信じればいいのか分からない」―ペストへの恐怖と噂の中で暮らすシベリアの人々
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所関係者の原因不明肺炎死亡を契機に住民の間で強い不安と噂が拡大し、WHOが追加症例報告の明確化を求めるなど社会的・国際的関心が高まっているため、確定診断がなくてもフルRRAでの精査が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 主たる発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州シェレホフで、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。香港は『香港梅毒』という根拠のない噂として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外。確定したペスト症例はなく、5000件の検査で危険病原体は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Update: बिहार में डेंगू का असर हुआ कम, शून्य मौत के साथ पिछले साल से काफी घटे मामले dengue update the impact of dengue has diminished in bihar with zero deaths and a significant decrease in cases compared to
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Update: The impact of dengue has diminished in Bihar, with zero deaths and a significant decrease in cases compared to last year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Bihar shows progress with zero deaths reported this year. As of October 5, 2026, the state recorded 857 dengue cases, with historical totals cited as 5,033 (2024) and 1,817 (2025). By October 5, 2026, 372 cases surfaced this year, and no area in Patna, Gaya district, or Samastipur was designated a dengue hotspot. The health department emphasizes strong public awareness and vector-control measures: timely testing, regular surveillance, effective fogging, larva control, adequate testing kits and platelets, and IHIP portal monitoring. In August–September, 90 medical officers were trained in dengue/chikungunya clinical management, and 86 lab technicians in ELISA-readers. NS1, ELISA, and IgM-ELISA kits are stocked; testing is available at district and medical college hospitals. 318 fogging machines are operational with 172 kg of malathion stock. Designated blood centers prepare platelets; hospitals are instructed to provide platelets as needed.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱アップデート：ビハール州でデング熱の影響が減少、死者ゼロと前年比で症例数が大幅減少
triage.triage_reason: 死者ゼロ、症例数が前年より減少しており、公衆衛生対策も機能しているため、深刻性・異常性・拡大リスクいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の状況改善（死者ゼロ、症例数減少）を報告する内容であり、対策も地元保健当局により適切に管理されているため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se esparce por África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads across Africa.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Kenya in a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, traveling through DRC and Uganda to Nairobi; symptoms began about a month earlier and he died after hospital isolation, with laboratory confirmation. Africa CDC urged stronger border surveillance as the itinerary was not detected at entry; Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. By Wednesday, Kenyan health authorities had identified 57 contacts, with 10 in quarantine, including airline passengers, crew, and cleaners. A joint probe with the DRC, Uganda, and Africa CDC will investigate the itinerary and detection gaps. Kenya expanded border screening, launched a symptoms hotline, designated five isolation centers with 241 beds, and opened a dedicated airport gate for travelers from 10 epicenter countries. Bundibugyo ebolavirus can incubate 2-21 days, with initial symptoms such as fever and fatigue, followed by gastrointestinal and hemorrhagic signs; diagnosis requires laboratory testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカ全土に拡大
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ確認例が発生し、DRC・ウガンダを経由した越境感染の可能性があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 確定症例はケニアで発生したが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者はDRCに居住歴がありそこからウガンダを経てナイロビに渡航しており、感染源としてDRCでの継続的なアウトブレイクが示唆されるためDRCを含めた。ウガンダも経由国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: distribution des thermo-flashs dans différentes écoles de la ville pour lutter contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: Distribution of Thermal Scanners in Various City Schools to Combat Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Butembo-Lubero's Children's Parliament in North Kivu, DRC, launched an Ebola prevention drive by distributing Thermo-flash thermal scanners to schools. Initially, three institutions—Institut Mgr Henri Pierrard, Kitulu Primary, and its kindergarten—each received two devices. The initiative, funded by a national deputy who supplied 302 Thermo-flash units, aims to equip numerous schools in Butembo and Lubero, with a continued emphasis on educating students about strict barrier measures to counter the 17th Bundibugyo-ebola outbreak in the area. Kavira Vuhavirwa Aline indicated that at least ten more schools will benefit. Beneficiaries praised the gesture but urged more handwashing facilities, noting only four sinks for over 30 classrooms. Separately, Nord-Kivu II education authorities and UNICEF have launched a handwashing-sink distribution in Beni to sanitize schools and safeguard learners from Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：エボラ対策のため市内の様々な学校へ赤外線体温計を配布
triage.triage_reason: 第17次Bundibugyo-ebolaアウトブレイクへの予防対策（体温計配布）の報告であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の情報はないが、進行中のエボラ流行に関連するため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の第17次エボラアウトブレイク（北キブ州ブテンボ/ルベロ）に対する学校での予防措置（体温計・手洗い設備配布）に関する活動報告であり、新規感染拡大の情報は含まれない。UNICEFや国会議員の関与があり社会的関心は一定程度あるが、新規性・異常性は低いためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Trois personnes condamnées à 30 mois de prison après le saccage du centre de traitement d'Ebola à Mungamba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Three people sentenced to 30 months in prison after the looting of the Ebola treatment center in Mungamba.
article.articleSummary: Three people in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, were sentenced to 30 months in prison for civil disobedience after the August 2026 looting of the Ebola Treatment Center in Mungamba, a known Ebola hotspot about 80 km south of Bunia. Five suspects had been charged; two were acquitted for lack of evidence on charges of theft and malicious destruction. The on-site trial, held October 5, 2026, aims to deter hostility toward public health responders battling Ebola. The ruling by the Ituri High Court emphasizes protecting teams delivering Ebola response activities. The lawyers for the defendants said they will appeal. The incident underscores ongoing tensions around health interventions in the region during an Ebola outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ムンガンバのエボラ治療センター襲撃事件で3人に禁錮30ヶ月の判決
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ治療センター襲撃事件に関する裁判結果の報道であり、新たな症例発生や感染拡大等の疫学的変化を示す情報は含まれていないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行対応中に発生した治療センター襲撃事件の司法手続きに関するもので、地域住民の公衆衛生対応への敵対感情・妨害リスクを示唆する点で、対応活動の管理可能性(manageability)および流行しやすさ(epidemic_prone)の観点から間接的な懸念材料となるが、新規症例や感染拡大の直接情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin về ca tử vong do viêm phổi chưa rõ nguyên nhân tại Nga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health provides information about a death due to pneumonia of unknown etiology in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Death in Russia from severe pneumonia of unknown etiology, involving a laboratory staff member, reported on 2026-10-08. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, in collaboration with the World Health Organization, has verified the incident and conducted a risk assessment. Russian authorities say there have been no recent plague cases in the area where the death occurred. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or whether the case is imported or exported. The notification highlights ongoing international coordination to monitor potential public-health implications and determine if the pneumonia case indicates an emerging infectious threat or requires enhanced surveillance or measures.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ロシアでの原因不明肺炎による死亡例について情報提供
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の重症肺炎による死亡例（検査技師）が報告され、WHOとベトナム保健省が連携してリスク評価を実施しており、異常性・重大性の観点からIHR基準を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 事案はロシアで発生しており、対象国リストに該当しない。ベトナム保健省はWHOと連携して情報確認・リスク評価を行っているのみで、ベトナム国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。検査技師が罹患者であることから実験室関連感染の可能性も示唆されるが、詳細情報（病原体特定、感染経路、ヒト-ヒト感染の有無）は不明。続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 【新聞第一線】俄爆添3亡！北京怕疫砍峰會？美擬轟伊朗能源！ | 鼠疫 | 沈伯洋 | 中共
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [News Frontline] Russia reports 3 more deaths! Beijing fears the epidemic will derail the summit? The US plans to bomb Iran's energy sector! | Plague | Shen Boyang | CCP
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, Russia reports suspected pneumonic plague with 3 additional deaths, triggering emergency alerts and intensified infection-control measures; the initial deceased building was disinfected three times and authorities allegedly attributed the actions to cockroach extermination. Beijing trims the APEC summit’s closed-door format due to epidemic concerns. The report also covers potential US-Israel plans to strike Iran’s energy sector, Houthi attacks on Saudi airports causing 3 deaths and 36 injuries, and a US reward for CCP hackers tied to COVID-19 vaccine research. Shen Boyang’s interview drew wide attention. The piece highlights public health risk communications and containment logistics amid cross-border tensions and geopolitical developments around the same date.

triage.headline_ja: 【ニュース最前線】ロシアでさらに3人死亡！北京は疫病でAPEC首脳会議に影響？米国はイランのエネルギー施設爆撃を計画！｜ペスト｜沈伯洋｜中共
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアでの肺ペスト疑い事例と地政学的ニュースを混在させた政治色の強い報道で、対象国（中国含む）における実際の疾病発生は確認できず、信頼性にも疑問がある。
triage.notes: 実際の肺ペスト疑い事例はロシアで発生しており対象国リストに含まれない。中国（北京）への言及はAPEC首脳会議運営上の懸念に過ぎず、同国内での疾病発生を示すものではない。情報源（NTDTV）は政治色の強いメディアであり、記事内容も陰謀論的な表現（ゴキブリ駆除を装った消毒など）を含み信頼性に疑問がある。
