article.articleHeadline: Foco de gripe aviária é encerrado após inspeção em 70 propriedades no RS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreak contained after inspection of 70 properties in Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleSummary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in Selbach, Alto Jacuí, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, was deemed closed after the Official Veterinary Service inspected 70 properties within a 3-km radius of the outbreak site. A commercial farm within 10 km was also inspected, but had no birds at the time. The emergency response related to the event concluded, though regional sanitary surveillance will continue under state teams. Laboratory confirmation came from the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA) in Campinas, on Oct 5, 2026, after a mortality notification on Oct 1, 2026. The virus was identified in backyard/domestic birds; no involvement of a commercial farm was confirmed. This follows a July 2026 IAAP focus in Coqueiros do Sul (subsistence birds) and the May 2025 Montenegro incident in a commercial hatchery, underscoring differences in response for commercial versus non-commercial poultry. Surveillance remains in the region.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州の70施設で検査後、鳥インフルエンザの発生終息
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（裏庭飼育）での高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生で、既に当局により終息が確認されており、ヒトへの感染や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（非商業的な裏庭飼育）における動物衛生イベントであり、公式獣医サービスによる調査後、緊急対応は終了済み。ヒトへの感染報告はなし。モンテネグロの言及は過去（2025年5月）の別事例であり、今回のイベントとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para risco de retorno do sarampo ao Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of the risk of measles returning to Brazil
article.articleSummary: Measles risk returning to Brazil as outbreaks in the United States and parts of Latin America prompt intensified vaccination. As of 2026-10-08, Brazil reports 52 imported cases, with 41 in São Paulo and additional cases in Rio de Janeiro and Amazonas; no domestic transmission. the United States currently has the highest measles burden in more than 35 years, concentrated among the unvaccinated, while Peru, Guatemala, Mexico and Canada also face transmission waves. Brazil’s 2019 outbreak exceeded 20,000 cases and led to loss of elimination status; since 2023, the proportion of unvaccinated children fell 86%, and in 2024 Brazil regained elimination certification. This year saw four large vaccination campaigns, delivering over 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and 192,000 in Amazonas, with border actions toward Colombia and Peru. A dose zero for infants 6 months and older, followed by routine doses from 12 months, is offered free by SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ブラジルへの麻疹再流入リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで52例の輸入麻疹症例が確認され、米国・中南米各地で麻疹流行が拡大する中、保健省が警告を発し公的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除認証を再取得したが、輸入症例（主にサンパウロ）が増加。国内伝播は未確認だが、米国・ペルー・グアテマラ・メキシコ・カナダなど周辺国で流行が継続しており、国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみで、他国（米国、ペルー、グアテマラ、メキシコ、カナダ）は対象外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rusi popierajú druhý prípad moru na Sibíri. WHO a Čína žiadajú od Moskvy vysvetlenie | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Russians deny the second case of plague in Siberia. WHO and China are asking Moscow for an explanation | Info.sk
article.articleSummary: On October 8, 2026, Russia’s consumer health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor denied reports of a second pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk Oblast. Rumors on social media linked a supposed second patient to contact with a 28-year-old laboratory technician from a plague research institute in Shelekhov near Irkutsk. After the technician’s death, authorities said she died of pneumonia unrelated to her work; she had been vaccinated and had immunity against dangerous infections. All preventive measures tied to the incident have been lifted. Intensive monitoring of dozens of people who had contact with the deceased yielded nearly 5,000 laboratory tests, none detecting dangerous pathogens, and officials stated there is no epidemic risk in Irkutsk and the Irkutsk Oblast. The World Health Organization has asked Moscow for a thorough explanation, and Mongolia and China have formally requested details.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでの2例目のペスト感染を否定。WHOと中国がモスクワに説明を求める | Info.sk
triage.triage_reason: ペスト（肺ペスト）疑い事例についてロシア当局が否定し、感染拡大の証拠はないが、WHO・中国・モンゴルが説明を求めており国際的関心が高まっているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 事象はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国（中国・モンゴル含む）ではWHOへの説明要求のみで実際の症例確認はない。中国・モンゴルは情報提供を求めている立場であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局は感染拡大リスクを否定し、約5000件の検査で病原体は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Warum schweigt Russland zu den mutmasslichen Pest-Fällen?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Russia silent about the suspected plague cases?
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory worker at a plague-research center in Irkutsk, Siberia, died last week of pneumonia of unknown origin, reportedly after a broken test vial, raising questions about pneumonic plague. In Irkutsk and Schelechow, several facilities reportedly limited operations and about 200 contacts were placed in quarantine; a second possible plague death in Irkutsk is also reported by local media cited by the Daily Mail. Experts say a wider outbreak is unlikely; pneumonic plague is bacterial, treatable with antibiotics if diagnosed early, and human-to-human transmission requires close contact, making large-scale spread unlikely. Russia’s handling, and its opaque communications, fuel concern: Rosptrebnadsor denied quarantine measures; the WHO has asked for information; US officials have urged transparency; Harvard experts call the silence abnormal. Plague persists globally, with hundreds of cases annually, concentrated in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Siberian rodents as carriers.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアはなぜ疑わしいペスト症例について沈黙しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: シベリアのペスト研究施設で研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、肺ペストが疑われている。約200人が隔離され、WHOが情報提供を要請するなど国際的関心が高く、ロシア当局の不透明な対応も懸念材料である。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・マダガスカルは記事中で『世界的にペストが流行している地域』として言及されているのみで、本事象の発生地ではないため除外した。ロシア当局の情報開示の不透明さがWHOや米国当局から懸念されている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: ಯರಹಳ್ಳಿ ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರಿಗೆ 'ಟಿಬಿ' ಅರಿವು
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis awareness among Yarahalli villagers.
article.articleSummary: World Tuberculosis Day awareness program was held in Yarahalli village, Mysuru district, Karnataka. Organized by the Mysuru District Health and Family Welfare Department and the District TB Control Center, the event advised villagers on TB symptoms and the importance of prompt testing. Key signs include a cough lasting two weeks or more, fever (notably in the evenings), chest pain, weight loss, loss of appetite, and coughing up blood. Participants were urged not to self-treat but to visit the nearest government health center for appropriate testing; TB diagnosis and treatment are free at all public facilities. To support nutritional recovery, TB patients receive a monthly incentive of Rs 500. Early detection and completing the full treatment course can lead to cure. The program involved PHC EOs Ashok and Aralappa, ASHA workers Manjula and Shila, health staff, and villagers.

triage.headline_ja: ヤラハッリ村民への結核（TB）啓発
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核啓発活動に関する地域報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は通常の結核啓発キャンペーンに関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Surge: DRC reports 4,178 deaths; Kenya confirms first fatal case
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths, with transmission slowing in some areas but rising elsewhere, including near the South Sudan border. WHO reports improved contact tracing (about 2,000 alerts daily) and nearly five million people reached, while more than 600 individuals have been enrolled in Ebola therapeutic trials and a vaccine trial is expected later in October to ensure equitable access. Despite these advances, most Ebola deaths continue to occur in communities rather than treatment centres, and transmission hotspots persist amid a prolonged humanitarian crisis. Kenya has reported its first imported Ebola case, a person who became ill in the DRC and traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, where he died; 55 contacts, including passengers and crew, are being monitored. WHO stresses preparedness and screening and that travel restrictions are less effective than contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱急増：コンゴ民主共和国で死者4,178人、ケニアで初の死亡例確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱死者数が4,178人に達し、国境を越えてケニアへの輸入感染による死亡例が発生するなど国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大とケニアへの輸入症例（死亡）を主題としている。ケニア、ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Eyes on schools as exams draw near
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case, a citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years and traveled home via Uganda on Oct 3, dying Oct 5. The Bundibugyo strain is confirmed, with no vaccine or specific treatment available. Health authorities have traced 57 contacts who are under monitoring. Officials stress there is no panic and say preparations for national examinations beginning Oct 23 will proceed, with Basic Education Principal Secretary John Ololtuaa noting exams are progressing and that the Ministry of Health would handle health issues, while subcounty visits to brief field officers start soon. The case raises concerns about school closures, recalling West Africa’s 2013–2016 outbreak (7–9 months closures) and Kenya’s Covid-19 disruption in 2020 affecting about 17 million learners. Ebola spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids, underscoring limited containment if transmission escalates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の懸念：試験が近づく中、学校に注目
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ出血熱症例（ブンディブギョ株）が確認され死亡、57名の接触者を追跡中であり、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ民主共和国に7年間居住後、ウガンダ経由でケニアに帰国し発症・死亡。症例確認はケニアで発生しており、DRC・ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないか、または実際の発生国ではなく渡航歴に過ぎないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、全国試験（10月23日開始）や学校閉鎖への懸念が社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia desmiente noticias de un segundo caso de peste en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia denies reports of a second case of plague in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor and the Kremlin dismiss reports of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, after the death of 28-year-old laboratory technician Daria Shipílova at the Irkutsk and Far East plague research institute. Authorities say no plague cases have been confirmed; nearly 5,000 lab analyses found no dangerous pathogens, and 90% of contacts of the deceased have been traced. Rumors of a second case circulated online, which Moscow rejects, and the World Health Organization has not confirmed new cases. The deceased reportedly died from pneumonia of unknown etiology; the Russian health agency denies contact with Yersinia pestis. Thailand's health department is in contact with WHO but has not confirmed travel to Thailand. The US and WHO urge transparency; WHO has offered technical support and asked for more details to determine the causal pathogen and to clarify a suspected second worker with pneumonia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでのペスト第二症例の報道を否定
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所関連の原因不明肺炎による死亡例があり、WHOや米国が透明性を求めているが、ロシア当局は病原体の確認を否定しており情報が不確実なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: イベントはロシア（対象国外）で発生しており、タイは接触確認・渡航歴は未確認のため対象国リストに含めない。情報が錯綜しており、WHOの技術支援要請やロシア側の否定など、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: China's Malaria success offers lessons for East Africa's 2030 elimination push
article.articleSummary: As East Africa approaches 2030, four years remain to eliminate malaria, drawing lessons from China’s seven-decade journey. Nairobi hosted the 2nd East African Community Malaria Stakeholders Meeting to discuss shifting from broad control to rapid, case-focused surveillance. China eliminated indigenous transmission by 2017 and was certified malaria-free by the WHO in 2021 after reporting, investigating, and responding to each confirmed case within a 24-hour, 3-day, 7-day timeline. The elimination shift treats every remaining case as an emergency, not just increasing population coverage. Mass drug administration can reduce morbidity but cannot alone deliver elimination. East Africa faces climate change, population growth, drug and insecticide resistance, and weak surveillance, with Africa accounting for about 94% of global malaria cases and 95% of deaths in 2024. China still records thousands of imported cases—largely from Africa—emphasizing border controls and regional information sharing; Kenya calls for stronger regional mechanisms.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のマラリア撲滅成功、2030年目標に向けた東アフリカへの教訓
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、中国のマラリア撲滅成功事例から東アフリカが学ぶ政策会議に関する報道であり、緊急性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は東アフリカ共同体マラリア関係者会合に関する政策レビューで、中国は成功事例・輸入症例の文脈で言及されているのみ。ケニア・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれず、中国も新規発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine Delays Fuel Bangladesh Measles Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh began January in Rohingya refugee camps near the Myanmar border, spreading to 58 of 64 districts with over 32,000 suspected cases and more than 250 deaths (predominantly children) and over 21,000 hospitalisations since mid-March. The crisis accelerated after September 2025 when the interim government halted UNICEF vaccine procurement for measles-rubella, shifting to open tender, causing procurement delays and weakened routine immunisation; Bangladesh reinstated UNICEF procurement in April and launched an emergency vaccination campaign. 2025 first-dose MR vaccination coverage was reported at 59% of eligible children (data later removed). 2023 first-dose MR coverage fell to 86% and second-dose to 80.7%, below the 95% threshold generally needed to interrupt transmission. Experts warn rapid spread limits near-term containment, and corruption allegations in vaccine procurement under the interim government are being reviewed by the Anti-Corruption Commission. Health system under strain with most deaths among children.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン供給遅延がバングラデシュの麻疹流行を助長
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹が58/64県に拡大し、3万人超の疑い例と250人超の死亡が報告されており、ワクチン調達停止による免疫ギャップが背景にあるため、重症度・流行継続性・社会的関心の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてMyanmarが付与されているが、記事本文ではロヒンギャ難民キャンプ（ミャンマー国境付近）が流行の起点とされているのみで、実際の流行拡大・死亡例はバングラデシュ国内（対象国リスト外）で発生している。バングラデシュは評価対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Tradisi Brandu Kembali Sebabkan Penularan Antraks di Gunungkidul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brandu Tradition Returns, Causing Anthrax Transmission in Gunungkidul
article.articleSummary: New anthrax case reported in Kalurahan Mulusan, Kapanewon Paliyan, Gunungkidul Regency, DI Yogyakarta. On Sept 29, 2026, a resident developed hand lesions consistent with cutaneous anthrax; local DPP Gunungkidul collected soil samples, with laboratory results returning positive for anthrax. Authorities could not locate the suspected infected goat, which had been slaughtered and distributed under the Brandu traditional practice. Compensation under Perbup No. 10/2025 for depopulated or culled animals is available, funded from the APBD’s Unforeseen Expenditures (BTT). Residents are urged not to slaughter sick or dead livestock; owners should report sudden livestock deaths to Puskeswan to access compensation and preventive actions. Ismono, Head of the Health Office, did not respond to requests for comment. The report highlights ongoing anthrax surveillance in the region and potential risks associated with traditional animal-sharing practices.

triage.headline_ja: ブランドゥの伝統が再び炭疽感染を引き起こす、グヌンキドゥルにて
triage.triage_reason: グヌンキドゥルで既知の風土病的な皮膚炭疽事例が発生。伝統的な病死家畜共有慣習（ブランドゥ）による継続的曝露リスクがあるが、重症度は低く地域当局により管理されているため、フルRRAには至らない。
triage.notes: グヌンキドゥル地域では炭疽症が繰り返し報告されており、今回は皮膚炭疽の単発例。感染源とされるヤギはブランドゥ（病死・屠殺動物の共有）慣習により既に消費・分配済みで追跡不能。地元保健当局が土壌検査・補償制度の案内等の対応を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Sorge vor einer neuen Pandemie - wie riskant freigesetzte Pest-Bakterien heute tatsächlich wären | Tiroler Tageszeitung Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern about a new pandemic — how dangerous released plague bacteria would actually be today
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis (plague) remains a public-health concern after the death of a 28-year-old scientist at Irkutsk’s Pest-Bio Research Institute in Siberia, with officials citing pneumonia as the cause and denying confirmed plague infection or a laboratory accident; about 200 contacts are quarantined. WHO is seeking more information amid speculation. The US CDC classifies Y. pestis as a Select Agent (Category 1) due to low infectious dose and high mortality, noting historical biowarfare use, though no evidence links this case to such activity. President Trump also stated he does not see a bioweapons connection. Plague is not extinct: hundreds of human cases occur annually worldwide, concentrated in Madagascar and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with wildlife reservoirs in Siberia and the western United States. Diagnostics, vaccine development, and antibiotic-resistance surveillance require laboratories that handle live bacteria. The article references historical episodes, including Caffa, to contextualize biowarfare concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなパンデミックへの懸念 ― 流出したペスト菌は今日どれほど危険なのか
triage.triage_reason: イルクーツクの研究所関連者の死亡がペスト感染によるものか未確定であり、公式には否定されているため情報不足。国際的な関心（WHO照会、政治発言）はあるが対象国での発生ではなく、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所関連死亡事例であり、感染確定もラボ事故も公式には否定されている。マダガスカル・DRCは一般的なペスト流行地域として背景的に言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。対象国（DRC等）での実際の発生情報ではないため、地域的な優先度は低いが、国際的関心の高さから経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯"不明原因肺炎"事件发酵 股市医药板块波动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's "pneumonia of unknown origin" incident escalates as the stock market's pharmaceutical sector fluctuates.
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a case of pneumonia of unknown origin in Irkutsk Oblast, involving a staff member at the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute; the patient died on October 2 after severe pneumonia. WHO says there are no recent plague cases in Irkutsk region and no high-threat contacts, with comprehensive anti-epidemic measures in place as WHO follows the situation. In China, the A-share pharmaceutical sector on October 8 shows volatile moves as vaccines, antibiotics, and diagnostic reagents attract funds; Daan Gene, North China Pharmaceutical, Run Du Shares, and Weilan Bio briefly hit limits or opened higher before retreating. YaHong Medicine signs a conditional exclusive license with Theramex for APL-1702 in Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Turkey; rights elsewhere remain with YaHong. The ES MO 2026 meeting (Oct 23–28) will feature 28 China-led trials and 29 LBA drugs across ADCs, bispecifics, and EGFR-TKI–resistant NSCLC. CICC maintains that Chinese innovative-drug internationalization remains a key theme, with short-term volatility giving way to long-term opportunities around clinical catalysts and Q3 results.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの『原因不明の肺炎』事件が拡大、株式市場の医薬品セクターが変動
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡するという異常事象があり、WHOも状況を注視している。IHR基準で深刻性と異常性の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 事象発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン等）には含まれない。記事中の中国言及は株式市場の医薬品セクター反応に関するものであり、感染症の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOはペスト症例ではないとしているが、原因不明の重症肺炎で死亡例が出ている点は要注意。

article.articleHeadline: Why single Ebola death in Kenya has prompted fears of wider African spread
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first fatality from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, expanding an outbreak that began in the DRC earlier this year. The Bundibugjo variant has no vaccine. The DRC outbreak has killed about 4,148 people among 8,300 cases; Uganda reported about 20 cases before being declared Ebola-free in July. The Kenyan patient traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Kenya by road and air, fell ill about a month before travel, received initial treatment in the DRC, then moved overland to Uganda in early October and flew to Nairobi, arriving the next day. Airport screening failed; rapid testing confirmed the diagnosis. The patient died and was buried per Ebola protocols. Authorities identified 28 Kenyan contacts and tracked 23 passengers and 4 crew; quarantine is under consideration. Ugandan officials suspect symptom-masking medication; investigations continue. Cross-border mobility and trade complicate containment; further cases may emerge; regional cooperation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでのエボラ死亡例1件がアフリカ全域への拡大懸念を引き起こした理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、致死率約50%）がウガンダを経てケニアに拡大し死亡例が確認された。空港スクリーニングの失敗や国境を越えた人の移動など国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題となるアウトブレイクの起点はDRCであり、対象国リストに含まれるためDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ケニア・ウガンダは拡大先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株である点、航空機での渡航歴がある点は特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर सेंट्रल जेल में डेंगू की दस्तक, 3 कैदी मिले पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue knocks at Indore Central Jail; 3 inmates test positive.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, dengue concerns have risen at Indore Central Jail in Madhya Pradesh, after fever cases prompted a medical survey by the district malaria department. Of about 32 inmates tested, three were confirmed dengue positive by ELISA and are receiving treatment under surveillance. A jail inmate death has been clarified as unrelated to dengue; the deceased had sickle cell anemia with other blood disorders and died due to non-dengue causes. The health authorities are intensifying inspections of jail barracks and water-collection sites to curb vector breeding, with anti-larval measures in place. Over 100 inmates and jail staff have been trained to identify and destroy larvae. Some patients also tested positive for typhoid, and ongoing fever investigations continue. Malaria department remains vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: インドール中央刑務所でデング熱発生、受刑者3名が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での小規模なデング熱発生であり、既存の対策（防蚊対策・サーベイランス）が機能している。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、季節性のデング熱流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 刑務所内という閉鎖空間での限定的な発生であり、地元の保健当局・マラリア部門が既に対応（検査・幼虫駆除・職員訓練）している。インドではデング熱は季節性流行が毎年見られ、本件は異常事態とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Mögliche Pest-Tote in Russland: Was wir wissen und was nicht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible Plague Deaths in Russia: What We Know and What We Don't
article.articleSummary: Two deaths from pneumonia of unknown origin near Russia’s Pest-Control Institute in Irkutsk, Siberia, have sparked questions. A 28-year-old female scientist at the Institute for Pest Control died Friday in Schelechow; clinics and other facilities reportedly restricted and around 200 potential contacts quarantined. Russian officials deny a lab accident or plague infection; the cause is listed as pneumonia, pathogen unspecified. WHO has called for more information. U.S. President Donald Trump said he would speak to Vladimir Putin and expressed no belief that the case involves a bioweapon. The CDC classifies Yersinia pestis as a Select Agent (Level 1) due to low infectious dose and high mortality; historical references to its use in biowarfare are noted. Pest bacterium circulates in Siberian rodents and fleas; plague occurs worldwide, including Madagascar and the DRC, with Austria currently pest-free. Antibiotics treat plague.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト感染による死亡の可能性：分かっていること、分かっていないこと
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト対策研究所近辺で原因不明肺炎による死亡例が発生し、WHOが追加情報を要請、約200人が隔離されるなど異常性と公衆衛生上の懸念が高く、国際的な社会的関心も高まっているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRC・マダガスカルはペストの世界的流行の文脈で言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため除外。原因病原体は未確定（当局はペスト感染を否定）であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ash Dykes faces crocodiles, disease and isolation on Congo expedition
article.articleSummary: Ash Dykes launches Mission 01 of Project 6, paddling 700+ km along the Sangha River from Nola in the Central African Republic to Mossaka in the Republic of the Congo, where the Sangha meets the Congo River. The Congo Basin spans CAR, Cameroon, the DRC, Equatorial Guinea and Gabon, hosting vast tropical rainforest and biodiversity including Nile crocodiles, hippos, forest elephants, gorillas and chimpanzees. The inflatable kayak route requires deflation and portage through dangerous sections; Dykes faces malaria, infections, extreme heat and humidity, contaminated water and long distances from medical care. He carries medical supplies, satellite communications and emergency evacuation plans, and travels with a small team including a local guide and videographer, while learning from the BaAka. A visa hiccup and luggage loss en route via Cameroon delayed start; the 3–4 week expedition targets Mossaka in late Oct/early Nov 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アッシュ・ダイクス、コンゴ探検でワニ、病気、孤立に直面
triage.triage_reason: これは冒険家の探検に関する娯楽記事であり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。マラリアは探検中のリスク要因として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ共和国での個人探検に関する記事であり、マラリアのアウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントの報告ではない。対象国（DRC含む）における具体的な感染症発生事例ではないため該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: बांग्लादेश में खसरा हुआ बेकाबू, विशेषज्ञों ने सरकार की वैक्सीन खरीद नीति को ठहराया जिम्मेदार | Measles crisis exposes cracks in Bangladesh's health system: Report (File image)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spiraled out of control in Bangladesh; experts blamed the government's vaccine procurement policy | Measles crisis exposes cracks in Bangladesh's health system: Report (File image).
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh intensifies from mid-March, with over 32,000 suspected cases and more than 250 deaths reported through early October 2026. The surge began in Rohingya refugee camps near the Myanmar border and spread to 58 of Bangladesh’s 64 districts, resulting in more than 21,000 hospitalizations. Government vaccine procurement policy, notably a September 2025 halt on UNICEF-facilitated purchases via an open-tender process, is blamed for vaccine shortages and disruptions to routine immunization. Procurement resumed through UNICEF in April 2026 and emergency vaccination campaigns were launched, yet transmission remains hard to curb. Routine first-dose measles-rubella vaccination coverage fell from 88.6% in 2019 to 86% in 2023, while second-dose coverage declined from 89% to 80.7%, far below the ~95% target. A 2026 Coverage Evaluation Survey signals waning immunity; a Supreme Court lawyer filed a complaint with the Anti-Corruption Commission over procurement failures.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹が制御不能に拡大、専門家は政府のワクチン調達政策を批判｜麻疹危機がバングラデシュの保健システムの脆弱性を露呈（資料写真）
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹の大規模流行（疑い例3.2万人超、死亡250人超、58/64県に拡大）が発生しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とワクチン調達政策の不備という異常性からIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはバングラデシュ国内（ロヒンギャ難民キャンプ発、ミャンマー国境付近）で発生しているが、記事の主題はバングラデシュであり、ミャンマー自体での流行は確認されていないため対象国リストに該当なし。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por la peste neumónica que estremece a Rusia: la OMS se ofreció a investigar el patógeno que mató a una trabajadora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague alert gripping Russia: WHO offered to investigate the pathogen that killed a female worker.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague alert grips Russia as authorities probe the death of a female laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Siberia, with the World Health Organization offering technical assistance to identify the agent. The case remains unconfirmed; Moscow says international health protocols were followed, while the WHO seeks more information to resolve circulating versions and assess preventive measures. Russia has conducted an epidemiological investigation and monitored the deceased worker’s contacts; officials report no ongoing plague cases in Irkutsk and no dangerous agents among those tested, though public details are scarce. The EU’s Health Security Committee notes limited data and maintains vigilance, with no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. United States, China, and Mongolia requested information; the Kremlin denied quarantines of a second patient. President Donald Trump said it is not a biological weapon and compared information gaps to early Covid-19 days. The WHO continues data collection on origin and risks.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアを震撼させる肺ペスト警戒：WHOが死亡した女性作業員の病原体調査を申し出る
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクで研究所勤務の女性が肺ペストで死亡し、WHOが調査支援を申し出るなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）が2つ該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: イベントはロシア（イルクーツク・モスクワ）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・米国・モンゴルは情報要請を行った立場であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito da dengue: 49,2 dos munícipios avaliados estão em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquito: 49.2% of evaluated municipalities are on alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health reports that 49.2% of the 3,732 municipalities evaluated in the second cycle of LIRAa (Rapid Indices for Aedes Aegypti) are in alert or at risk for Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The majority of identified breeding sites are in daily-use containers, with plant pots and saucers, bottles and other water-holding items accounting for 42.3% of habitats; additional sites include water tanks and drums, tires, and solid waste such as PET bottles and cans. The May–August cycle aims to tailor surveillance, prevention, and control actions according to local conditions. With summer approaching and El Niño-related climate, results help states prepare for higher vector risk and emphasize the public's role in eliminating standing water. Dengue probable cases dropped about 70% in 2026 vs 2025; by Sept 26, 2026, 470,500 cases, down from 1.5 million. Chikungunya fell 43%, Zika 35%.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱媒介蚊：評価対象自治体の49.2％が警戒レベル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健省による定例のAedes aegypti媒介蚊サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は前年比で大幅に減少傾向にあるため、新規の公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のベクターサーベイランス（LIRAa）の定例報告であり、2026年のデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数はいずれも前年比で大幅減少（デング熱約70%減）。公衆衛生上の緊急性は低く、通常の予防啓発活動の一環と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: نقص الكوادر والتمويل يعرقلان مكافحة "إيبولا"‏
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: A shortage of staff and funding hampers the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 8, 2026, the World Health Organization reports staffing shortages, limited international partners, and funding gaps hindering Ebola response expansion in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading beyond the Bunia epicenter to six other provinces. A decentralized strategy is expanding treatment closer to affected communities. About 1,400 beds are available across 59 treatment centers, one of the fastest expansions seen, yet international organizations capable of running Ebola treatment centers remain limited due to funding shortfalls. The agency estimates a need for 1,600 more beds; at three staff per bed, the planned 3,000-bed capacity would require roughly 9,000 staff. Official figures put the outbreak at 7,022 cases and 3,398 deaths, with 1,671 recoveries to date, underscoring the ongoing, worst-in-country outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：人員不足と資金不足がエボラ対策を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）が複数州に拡大し、死者数・症例数が過去最悪規模に達しており、国際支援と資金不足が深刻化している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 7,022症例・3,398死亡（致死率約48%）、6州に拡大、WHOは病床1,600床・人員約9,000人の追加必要性を指摘。国際的な資金・人員不足が対応の障壁となっている、史上最悪規模の同国内アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: बांग्लादेश में खसरा हुआ बेकाबू, विशेषज्ञों ने सरकार की वैक्सीन खरीद नीति को ठहराया जिम्मेदार - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles has spiraled out of control in Bangladesh, experts blame the government's vaccine procurement policy - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Measles has spiraled in Bangladesh, with more than 32,000 suspected cases and over 250 deaths since mid-March. As of 8 October 2026, the outbreak is blamed on the interim government's September 2025 decision to suspend UNICEF-facilitated vaccine purchases and delays from an open-tender process, disrupting routine immunization. The Daily Star reports warnings that vaccine supply would falter. The outbreak began in January in Rohingya refugee camps near the Myanmar border and has spread to 58 of 64 districts, hospitalizing over 21,000. Official data showed 2025 first-dose measles-rubella vaccination at 59% coverage (later removed), and second-dose at 80.7% (down from 89%), below the ~95% typically required. Vitamin A campaigns have also failed since 2024, weakening immunity. In April, purchases via UNICEF resumed and emergency vaccination campaigns were launched, but containment remains unlikely. A Supreme Court lawyer has filed a complaint with the Anti-Corruption Commission over procurement failures.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹が制御不能に拡大、専門家は政府のワクチン調達政策を批判
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例32,000人超、死亡250人超という大規模麻疹流行であり、ワクチン調達政策の失敗という異常事態、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスク、社会的・政治的関心（最高裁訴訟、汚職調査）も高いためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生国はバングラデシュであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。発生地域にMyanmarが含まれるが、記事はロヒンギャ難民キャンプ（バングラデシュ領内、ミャンマー国境付近）での発生を指しており、ミャンマー国内での発生ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: बांग्लादेश में खसरा हुआ बेकाबू, विशेषज्ञों ने सरकार की वैक्सीन खरीद नीति को ठहराया जिम्मेदार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles has run rampant in Bangladesh; experts blame the government's vaccine procurement policy.
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces a severe measles outbreak with more than 32,000 suspected cases and over 250 deaths since March, spanning 58 of 64 districts and prompting over 21,000 hospitalizations. The surge is blamed on the interim government's 2025 decision to halt UNICEF-facilitated vaccine purchases via an open-tender process, delaying supply and weakening routine immunization after years of reliance on UNICEF funding from Gavi and other donors. Measles-Rubella first-dose coverage fell from 88.6% in 2019 to 86% in 2023, while second-dose coverage dropped from 89% to 80.7%, below the commonly cited 95% target. The outbreak began near the Myanmar border in Rohingya refugee camps in January and has since spread nationwide. Vaccination procurement resumed via UNICEF in April and emergency campaigns were launched, but containment remains unlikely with rapid transmission. A complaint about procurement failures has been filed with the Anti-Corruption Commission; 2024 Vitamin A campaigns are blamed for weakened immunity.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹が制御不能に拡大、専門家は政府のワクチン調達政策を批判
triage.triage_reason: 32,000人超の疑い例、250人超の死亡、21,000件超の入院を伴う大規模麻疹アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とワクチン調達政策の失敗という異常事態が確認されるため、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの発生地はバングラデシュであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。記事中のミャンマー国境付近のロヒンギャ難民キャンプはバングラデシュ領内であり、ミャンマー自体での発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le parcours d'un patient complique le traçage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a patient's journey complicates contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is underscored by a Kenyan death in Nairobi of a patient infected in DRC, complicating contact tracing across borders. The case reportedly traversed Nord-Kivu before crossing into Uganda and then Kenya, with Kenyan authorities claiming the patient was treated in several Congolese hospitals, a claim Kinshasa has not confirmed. Reconstructing the patient’s movements remains uncertain: transport modes, places visited, and hospitals involved are not disclosed. Public-health authorities in the DRC have provided little information, while Nord-Kivu’s outbreak dynamics are described as worsening. Experts warn that tracing exposed contacts outside Kenya is difficult, especially with public transport use and surveillance gaps; some contacts may be asymptomatic or pre-symptomatic, delaying detection. A Beni public health official declined to comment on hospital visits, noting that coordination rests between Kenyan and Congolese health ministries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：患者の移動経路が接触者追跡を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラがウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内（北キブ州）の感染拡大が主な発生源とされる。

article.articleHeadline: बकरी प्लेग की आशंका से इंदौर में अलर्ट, 8 लाख से अधिक पशुओं का हुआ PPR टीकाकरण alert in indore over suspected goat plague over 8 lakh animals vaccinated a
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Indore over suspected goat plague; PPR vaccination of more than 8 lakh animals.
article.articleSummary: An alert in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, about suspected goat plague underscores ongoing Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR) control under the NADCP. Free PPR vaccination for sheep and goats aged four months and older is being rolled out across the Indore division, including Indore, Dhar, Alirajpur, Barwani, and Burhanpur districts. The campaign is in its third phase (initiated in 2020) targeting eradication by 2030. To date, 842,259 animals have been vaccinated, with the drive continuing until 15 October 2026. Authorities stress vaccination as the most effective prevention against this highly contagious viral disease, which can be severe and fatal. Farmers are urged to vaccinate all eligible animals, isolate sick livestock, and report suspected cases to the nearest veterinary facility.

triage.headline_ja: インドール（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州）でヤギペストの疑いにより警戒、80万頭以上の家畜にPPRワクチン接種実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患(PPR)であり、既存の国家管理計画(NADCP)下での定例ワクチン接種活動の報告であって、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: PPRはヒトに感染しない家畜(ヤギ・ヒツジ)の疾患であり、本記事は家畜衛生当局による定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告である。

article.articleHeadline: GIS wydał komunikat ws. Eboli. Pierwszy importowany przypadek i śmierć u podróżnego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GIS issued a statement on Ebola. The first imported case and the death of a traveler.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Ebola virus disease case (BVD); the patient, who traveled through the Democratic Republic of the Congo, died after returning home, and 28 contacts have been quarantined. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak—ongoing since May—reached 8,603 confirmed cases and 4,148 deaths as of October 6, with 896 people in isolation. The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for 6,450 cases and 2,968 deaths, with transmission also recorded in six other provinces. Europe’s risk remains very low according to ECDC; WHO and ECDC do not urge border closures. They advise exit screening at international airports, seaports, and main border crossings from outbreak areas, while entry screening is not recommended if pre-departure controls were adequate. GIS continues monitoring per WHO/ECDC guidance. Previously, four imported cases in Europe involved medical or humanitarian workers evacuated from the DR Congo region.

triage.headline_ja: GISがエボラ出血熱に関する声明を発表。初の輸入症例と渡航者の死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（8,603症例、4,148死亡）が継続中で、ケニアへの国際的な症例の拡大（輸入症例・死亡）も確認されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際拡大の事実としてIHR基準の国際的拡大に反映した。WHO/ECDCは国境閉鎖を推奨していないが、出国時スクリーニング強化を助言している。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus can mimic Kawasaki disease and damage children's coronary
article.articleSummary: Seven pediatric scrub typhus patients in Guangdong Province, China, developed coronary artery lesions indistinguishable from Kawasaki disease, signaling Orientia tsutsugamushi can cause Kawasaki-like coronary damage. The retrospective study from Guangzhou Women and Children’s Medical Center describes two boys and five girls, aged 11 months–8 years (median 3). All had fever and rash; six displayed an eschar at chigger bite sites; six had cervical lymphadenopathy; three had hepatosplenomegaly. Lab data showed systemic hyperinflammation with CRP 32–147 mg/L, ferritin up to 11,705 ng/mL, mild-to-moderate transaminitis, and hypoalbuminemia; CD8-dominant T-cell skewing and bone marrow hemophagocytosis were noted, with HLH diagnosed in two. Echocardiography (days 9–14) revealed coronary involvement: two true aneurysms (RCA and LAD), plus cases of dilatation or thickening. All cases occurred 2020–2026; onset clustered in June (epidemic season). In endemic regions, Kawasaki-like illness unresponsive to IVIG should prompt evaluation for scrub typhus and eschar, given widespread Asia-Pacific transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ツツガムシ病は川崎病に類似し、小児の冠動脈を損傷する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 中国広東省における小児ツツガムシ病の後方視的症例研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はないが、臨床的に重要な知見として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020-2026年の症例をまとめた後方視的臨床研究で、流行の急性拡大を示すものではない。ツツガムシ病はアジア太平洋地域の地方病であり、川崎病類似症状との鑑別診断の重要性を指摘する学術的知見として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a preocupar no Amazonas: 9 dos 10 infectados não estavam vacinados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles is once again a concern in Amazonas: 9 out of 10 infected were not vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Amazonas, Brazil, with 10 laboratory-confirmed cases from September 1 to October 6, 2026, in the Brazil-Peru-Colombia tri-border region. Nine of the ten patients were unvaccinated. A total of 26 notifications were reported; 7 cases are in Peru, and 3 in Brazil (one in Benjamin Constant, two in Tabatinga). Age distribution spans from under 1 year to 29 years: one infant <1; two aged 1–4; one 5–9; one 10–19; and five aged 20–29. Seven cases are male and three female. No deaths and no hospitalizations reported. Laboratory-confirmed measles cases in a cross-border region highlight the need for vaccination, the primary preventive measure. Findings come from the epidemiological weekly report released October 7, 2026 by FVS-RCP Rosemary Costa Pinto. As of October 8, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州で麻疹が再び懸念に：感染者10人中9人が未接種
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビア国境地帯での麻疹感染拡大（未接種者多数）が確認されており、越境伝播のリスクとワクチン未接種人口への感染拡大の可能性があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアも感染報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。死亡・入院は報告されていないが、未接種率の高さ（90%）と三国国境地域での伝播が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária no RS não deve afetar exportações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza in Rio Grande do Sul should not affect exports.
article.articleSummary: High-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) was confirmed on Oct 5, 2026, in backyard poultry in Selbach, Alto Jacuí, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The case is isolated and unlikely to immediately affect exports. Agronomist Juarez Morbini Lopes emphasized sanitary monitoring to identify additional infections and guide control measures. The SVO-RS will visit 68 properties within 3 km of the outbreak and conduct sanitary education. Samples were sent to LFDA-SP in Campinas, the OMSA reference laboratory, which confirmed the diagnosis. Under OMSA/WOAH rules, backyard HPAI does not alter the sanitary status of commercial poultry or suspend exports. Producers and residents should monitor for respiratory or neurological signs and sudden mortality, report suspicions to the nearest Inspectorate of Agricultural Defense or via WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033, avoid contact with sick or dead birds, and know that chicken meat and eggs remain safe.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州の鳥インフルエンザは輸出に影響しない見込み
triage.triage_reason: バックヤード家禽における孤立したHPAI事例であり、人への感染報告はなく、記事内でも輸出への影響はないと明言されている。公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例はバックヤード家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(HPAI)の確認であり、人への感染は報告されていない。ブラジル当局は孤立事例として対応し、商業家禽の衛生ステータスや輸出には影響しないとOMSA/WOAHルールに基づき説明している。地域の衛生監視活動（68農場への訪問調査等）は実施されるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança nas Américas e Saúde alerta para risco no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles advances in the Americas and Health warns of risk in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Measles advances in the Americas, with Brazil boosting vigilance to prevent domestic transmission. The United States reports its largest outbreak in 35 years, concentrated among the unvaccinated (over 90%). The Pan American Health Organization warns measles is spreading to Peru, Guatemala, Mexico, and Canada. In Brazil, 52 imported cases have been recorded as of last week, 41 in São Paulo, with cases also in Rio de Janeiro and Amazonas; no local transmission currently. Brazil had over 20,000 cases in 2019 and lost elimination certification, but unvaccinated children fell 86% since 2023 per WHO, helping restore elimination status. The SUS has led four major vaccination mobilizations this year: 3.8 million doses in São Paulo and 192,000 in Amazonas (border areas with Colombia and Peru), plus active case finding and contact tracing. The "dose zero" strategy targets infants from 6 months, complements routine doses from 12 months; vaccines are free in SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が米州で拡大、保健当局がブラジルでのリスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: 米州全域で麻疹が拡大し、ブラジルでも輸入症例が増加・大規模ワクチン接種対応が行われており、公衆衛生上の関心と国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 米国・ペルー・グアテマラ・メキシコ・カナダ・スペインでも麻疹の動きが言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルでは現時点で地域内伝播は確認されていないが、輸入症例増加と大規模ワクチン接種対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲:肯尼亞首位埃博拉患者病歿
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Kenya's first Ebola patient dies.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, an imported infection who died in Nairobi on October 5 at about 23:30 local time. The patient, a ~40-year-old Kenyan businessman who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, fell ill about a month prior, received treatment in DRC, then traveled by road to Uganda (Kampala) before flying back to Nairobi on October 3. He was diagnosed only shortly before death. Kenyan authorities identified 57 contacts, with 10 isolated and 21 healthcare workers who cared for the deceased under monitoring. Kenya has deployed a dedicated isolation ward with over 130 beds and has intensified screening; more than 650,000 travelers have been checked and 260+ samples analyzed, all negative except the patient. President William Ruto and the National Security Council are reviewing further measures. This is an imported EVD case.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：ケニア初のエボラ患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し死亡した初の輸入症例であり、国際的な人の移動を伴う異常事態かつ公衆衛生上重大な影響があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はケニアで死亡したが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国は患者の感染源・滞在国として記載があり対象国リストに含まれるため記載。実際の死亡・発症地はケニアである点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladés supera 200.000 casos sospechosos de sarampión en el mayor brote activo del mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangladesh surpasses 200,000 suspected measles cases in the world's largest active outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh reports the world’s largest active measles outbreak, with over 200,000 suspected cases and more than 1,100 deaths or deaths under suspicion, according to U.S. CDC. Dhaka and nationwide health authorities logged 201,625 suspected cases and 22,116 laboratory-confirmed infections; 104 deaths confirmed and 1,040 deaths suspected linked to measles. In the last 24 hours, 1,332 suspected cases, 96 laboratory-confirmed, and four new deaths were recorded as linked to measles. Since mid-March, 178,927 patients with compatible symptoms have been hospitalized, with over 171,000 discharged. A national vaccination push launched in late September targets 3.4 million children, including 2.4 million previously missed and 1 million newly eligible. Bangladesh leads current CDC-listed active measles outbreaks, ahead of Guatemala and India; provisional WHO data show 62,351 cases in Bangladesh, 30,239 Guatemala, 21,523 India.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュ、世界最大規模のはしか流行で疑い症例20万人超
triage.triage_reason: 世界最大規模の麻疹アウトブレイクで死亡者1,100人超、全国的なワクチン接種対応が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 主題はバングラデシュの麻疹アウトブレイクだが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事内でインドも症例数言及されているが主題ではなく比較対象のため参考情報として扱う。グアテマラは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: СТАВА ОПАСНО: Епидемията от ебола вече е извън контрол!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's getting dangerous: The Ebola epidemic is already out of control!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu province, Democratic Republic of Congo, described as out of control by Doctors Without Borders (MSF). The region accounts for over 40% of all confirmed new infections in the DRC. The epidemic began in April; by May the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Since its start, 8,603 Ebola cases have been reported in the DRC with 4,148 deaths. In June, a nurse returning from Congo was diagnosed with Ebola in France, representing an exported case. Ebola transmission remains via direct contact with an infected person, not airborne. The ongoing outbreak in North Kivu signals a critical public health crisis. As of 2026-10-08.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な状況に：エボラ流行はすでに制御不能に！
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州のエボラ流行がWHOによりPHEICと宣言され、死者4,148人・症例8,603例に達し、フランスへの輸出例も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸出症例は報告されているが、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みであり、国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: প্লেগের প্রাদুর্ভাব কি নতুন মহামারীতে পরিণত হবে ? এটি কতটা বিপজ্জনক ? প্রতিরোধের উপায় কী ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will the plague outbreak become a new pandemic? How dangerous is it? What are the preventive measures?
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old lab worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia died of pneumonia after reports a test tube containing Yersinia pestis broke in the lab. The WHO has asked Russia for full details, stating information remains incomplete. The 1934-founded institute studies plague, cholera and anthrax; in response, Shelekhov City Hospital was quarantined and about 200 people monitored. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, has bubonic, pneumonic and septicemic forms; pneumonic plague is the most dangerous. It is treatable with antibiotics such as gentamicin, ciprofloxacin, streptomycin, levofloxacin and moxifloxacin, with high recovery when treated early. WHO says Russia’s risk is low and Europe’s is low; Rostpotrebnadzor reports no public health emergency and about 5,000 tests found no dangerous agents, with over 90% of contacts monitored. Infection source and a second suspected case remain unclear; Madagascar, Congo and Peru report annual plague activity, though antibiotics limit severity.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト流行は新たなパンデミックになるのか？危険性はどの程度か？予防策は何か？
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの抗ペスト研究所で実験中にYersinia pestisを含む試験管が破損し研究員が死亡、WHOがロシアに詳細情報を要請しており、異常性・重大性の両面でIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 事件の主要発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。記事中でコンゴ・マダガスカル・ペルーのペスト流行は年次発生の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本イベントの主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tử vong tại Kenya làm dấy lên lo ngại Ebola lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A death in Kenya raises concerns about the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case and death linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak. A Kenyan who lived in DRC for seven years developed symptoms about a month earlier. He traveled on 2 October by road from Beni, DRC, to Kampala, Uganda, then flew to Nairobi on 3 October, where he was isolated and confirmed Ebola; he died despite care and was buried per protocol. Border screening—temperature checks and two electronic exposure forms—missed the case. Uganda is reviewing health declarations and airport records to trace contacts, including the driver to Entebbe; Kenya has identified 28 contacts, with 8 family and 21 healthcare workers quarantined, and is tracing 23 passengers and 4 crew from the Uganda flight. The DRC outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to seven provinces, with 8,300 cases and 4,148 deaths. WHO supports rapid testing and PPE and cautions against travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでの死亡例、エボラ拡大への懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例が確認され、国境スクリーニングの失敗や接触者追跡が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生源はDRC（イツリ州から7州に拡大、8,300症例・4,148死亡）。ケニア・ウガンダは越境感染経路として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲:肯尼亚首位埃博拉患者病殁
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Kenya's first Ebola patient dies.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's first Ebola virus disease death confirmed; an imported case. The patient, a Kenyan businessman around 40, who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years, traveled to Nairobi on Oct 3 after previously being treated in DRC. He arrived by air via Uganda (Kampala) and was diagnosed with Ebola shortly before his death at 23:30 local time on Oct 5 in a Nairobi hospital. Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale said the deceased tested positive; 57 identified contacts include 10 in isolation and 21 healthcare workers who cared for him. A special isolation unit with more than 130 beds was set up, and authorities have screened over 650,000 travelers and analyzed more than 260 samples, with all negatives except the patient. President William Ruto has asked the National Security Council to assess the situation and consider further measures.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：ケニア初のエボラ患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初めてのエボラ出血熱死亡例（DRCからの輸入例）が確認され、57名の接触者・21名の医療従事者が特定されるなど国際的拡大とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高く、政府も国家安全保障会議で対応を検討しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCに7年間在住し同国でエボラ治療を受けた後、ウガンダ経由でケニアに入国し死亡。実際の死亡・診断はケニア（対象国リスト外）で発生したが、感染源・背景となる流行はDRCにあるため、DRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため記載せず。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mungamba : trois personnes condamnées à 30 mois pour entrave à la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mungamba: three people sentenced to 30 months for obstructing the response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three people were sentenced to 30 months' imprisonment for obstructing the Ebola response in Mungamba, Komanda health zone, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 8 October 2026, Bunia's High Court convicted three defendants for malicious destruction of a jeep belonging to the Komanda health zone and for inciting civil disobedience during the Ebola response. Two others were acquitted due to insufficient charges. The convicted allegedly urged residents to ignore barrier measures decreed by health and political-administrative authorities in the Ebola response. Judge Romain Mulenga, president of the Bunia TGI, noted the hearing was conducted in Mungamba and stressed that justice will continue to handle cases of acts likely to hinder Ebola operations.

triage.headline_ja: ムンガンバでのエボラ出血熱：対応妨害で3人に禁錮30ヶ月の判決 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ対応に対する妨害行為への司法判断を伝える記事であり、新規症例数や流行状況の更新情報は含まれないが、地域住民の対応への抵抗が存在することは流行制御上のリスク要因として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応への妨害行為に対する司法判決を報じるもので、感染状況自体（患者数・死亡者数等）の情報は含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行対応における住民の抵抗・妨害は流行制御に影響するリスク要因として継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: TB awareness initiative JOSH launched in Palamu
article.articleSummary: Palamu, Jharkhand: The JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) TB awareness initiative was launched in Palamu as part of PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, with the national rollout at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The program aims to mobilize communities, volunteers, and local institutions to raise awareness and support TB elimination. Palamu is among eight TB-prone districts in Jharkhand selected for phase I, alongside Simdega, Gumla, Lohardaga, Latehar, Chatra, and Khunti, in a pilot covering 55 districts across 11 states. District TB officer Dr SK Ravi said Palamu has 2,722 notified TB patients in treatment, including 40 MDR cases; treatment adherence remains a challenge, with about 90% treatment success if the full course is completed on time. In 2024-25 Palamu had 34 TB Mukt panchayats, 45 in 2025-26, and a 70-panchayat target for 2026-27. Elimination by 2030 remains challenging in vulnerable, remote regions due to awareness, nutrition, and compliance.

triage.headline_ja: パラムーでTB啓発活動「JOSH」が開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策・啓発プログラムの開始を伝える通常の公衆衛生活動報道であり、異常事態や新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府の結核撲滅プログラム(PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan)の地域展開に関する平常時の啓発活動報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Plus de 50 journalistes outillés contre la désinformation sur la 17e épidémie d'Ebola à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: More than 50 journalists equipped to counter misinformation about the 17th Ebola outbreak in Beni.
article.articleSummary: More than 50 media professionals in Beni (Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo) participated in a October 6 capacity-building workshop to counter misinformation during the 17th Ebola outbreak in Beni. The training aims to equip local newsrooms with technical and ethical tools to counter rumors and community resistance and to disseminate reliable health messages to help the population protect itself. Journalists like Mervedi Kalmer emphasized the need for high-quality information for the community. Anderson Shada, director of Radio Espoir, noted the training comes at a pivotal time to address on-the-ground mistrust, stressing that understanding scientific facts strengthens efforts to counter misinformation. Participants pledged to produce preventive, rigorous information to support public health. The event underscores media as a strategic partner in the outbreak response; updates and guidance are shared via WhatsApp and LinkedIn.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ベニでの第17次エボラ流行に関する誤情報対策のため、50人以上のジャーナリストが研修を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 既知の第17次エボラ流行（DRC・北キブ州ベニ）に関するメディア向け誤情報対策研修の報道であり、新規感染拡大や症例増加などの新しい公衆衛生情報は含まれていないため、継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行（第17次、ベニ）に関する地域メディア向け誤情報対策研修の報告であり、感染状況自体の新規情報（症例数、死亡者数等）は含まれていない。既存流行のRRAが既に実施されている可能性が高く、本記事単独では新規シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Aucun centre de traitement d'Ebola n'a fermé ses portes à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: No Ebola treatment center has closed its doors in Beni.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola response authorities deny social media rumors that Ebola treatment centers have closed. The coordinator, Dr. Jeremie Muhindo, clarifies that only one building housing an Ebola response service underwent temporary sanitization after a healthcare worker tested positive; the emergency care service remains operational. The affected building was briefly closed to organize targeted bio-cleaning and other public-health activities, while urgent care for patients continued. The disinfection is a standard biosafety measure to protect staff and users. Muhindo warned against misinformation that could erode trust, deter patients from seeking care, and undermine the outbreak response in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ベニのエボラ治療センターは一つも閉鎖していない
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ベニでエボラ対応中の医療従事者が陽性となり、関連施設の消毒が行われた事実があり、アウトブレイク継続中の地域における公衆衛生対応の信頼性に関わる事案であるためフルRRAで状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応における医療従事者感染とデマ否定が主題。新規アウトブレイク発生ではなく既存対応の継続状況報告だが、医療従事者感染は継続監視が必要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: 四度折桂！连云港市蝉联全省寄生虫病防治技能竞赛团体一等奖
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four-Time Champion! Lianyungang City Retains the Provincial Team First Prize in the Parasitic Disease Prevention and Control Skills Competition.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, the Jiangsu Province Parasitic Disease Prevention and Control Skills Competition concluded with Lianyungang City winning the team first prize; four contestants earned six individual honors, marking the city’s fourth victory since 2015, 2018, and 2024. The event tests theory and practical skills in parasitic disease control. Lianyungang’s sustained emphasis on prevention centers on early risk detection, cross-department data sharing, and rapid response. The Health Commission and Customs coordinate inbound/outbound traveler data; CDC screens returnees from malaria-endemic regions and conducts one-on-one education and health tracking for high-risk individuals, with targeted symptom recognition and guidance. Innovations include a “one more question” rule mandating travel-history inquiry for fever patients, and an HIS-based smart warning module that flags key symptoms and prompts travel history checks. Imported malaria cases have been promptly managed, with no severe deaths due to misdiagnosis. Plans: consolidate results and strengthen triad of joint prevention, institutional innovation, and smart monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 四度目の栄冠！連雲港市、省内寄生虫病予防制御技能競技会団体一等賞を連覇
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生報告ではなく、寄生虫病予防制御技能競技会の受賞に関する行政広報記事であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は輸入マラリア症例の管理体制が良好であることを示す内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: 49% dos municípios avaliados estão em situação de alerta ou risco para mosquito, alerta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: 49% of evaluated municipalities are in a state of alert or risk for the mosquito, says the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: 49.2% of evaluated Brazilian municipalities are in alert or risk for Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector, according to the 2nd cycle of LIRAa (May–August 2026). Most breeding sites are household containers—plant pots and saucers, bottles and similar items (42.3%)—followed by water storage reservoirs like tanks (26.1%), and tires and solid waste, including PET bottles and debris (23%). Regional patterns: North Region—tires and solid waste predominate; Northeast—water storage containers; Southeast, South, and Central-West—pots, dishes, and bottles. Dengue shows a approximately 70% reduction in 2026 versus the same period in 2025; as of September 26, Brazil reported about 470,500 probable dengue cases, down from 1,500,000 in 2025. Chikungunya: 67,902 cases (down 43% from 118,885 in 2025); Zika: 2,141 cases (down 35% from 3,724). Protective measures should be year-round, intensified when conditions favor Aedes aegypti reproduction.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ：評価対象自治体の49%が蚊の警戒・リスク状態、保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: デング・チクングニア・ジカの症例数は前年比で大幅減少しているが、蚊の生息指標（LIRAa）で約半数の自治体が警戒・リスク状態にあり、媒介蚊対策の継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年より大幅に減少傾向にあり、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態とは言えないが、媒介蚊の生息状況（約半数の自治体で警戒・リスク）は季節的な再拡大リスクを示唆するため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: MG pode ter nova epidemia de dengue em 2027, alerta secretário de saúde: 'ano difícil'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais may have a new dengue epidemic in 2027, health secretary warns: 'a difficult year'.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, may face a dengue epidemic in 2027, warns Health Secretary Fábio Baccheretti, citing three-year epidemic cycles and forecast high temperatures from El Niño. Following the worst dengue wave in 2024—with over 1.6 million cases and more than 1,000 deaths—the state expects a new surge, potentially spanning the entire state due to Aedes aegypti transmission affecting dengue most, though chikungunya and Zika show regional variation. Preparations include ongoing vaccination efforts for dengue and chikungunya, and deploying Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes via a bio-factory in Brumadinho to block transmission. SES-MG is training regions and advancing funds to municipalities ahead of peak transmission. Emphasis remains on eliminating indoor breeding sites (80-90% of hotspots) with decentralized agents and drones locating water storage and waste, highlighting the role of individuals and communities in prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、2027年に新たなデング熱流行の可能性 ― 保健局長が警告「困難な年になる」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州保健当局による2027年のデング熱流行可能性に関する将来予測・警告であり、現時点で実際の症例急増は報告されていない。周期的パターンに基づく予防的警告のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年の大規模流行（160万症例・1000人超死亡）の実績を踏まえた2027年の予測警告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない点に留意。ワクチン接種やWolbachia蚊の導入など予防対策が既に進行中。続報で実際の症例数動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nach bestätigtem Todesfall: Auch in Kenia wächst die Sorge vor Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a confirmed death: Fear of Ebola grows in Kenya as well.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Kenya reports its first official Ebola death, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and contracted the disease there. The patient traveled from DR Congo to Uganda via Kampala, then flew to Nairobi, passing routine health checks on arrival. He tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola variant with high mortality, and was isolated as his illness progressed with fever, chills, fatigue, weakness, muscle pains, sore throat and bleeding under the skin. WHO and Kenyan authorities are escalating containment, including border screening and risk communication. Authorities identified 28 contacts (family and medical staff) and 23 passengers plus 4 crew from the flight. Kenya has screened about 650,000 inbound travelers, analyzed nearly 270 suspected samples, and trained around 5,000 health workers. In the DRC, over 8,600 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths; Uganda’s outbreak ended in July, but cross-border risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡例確定後、ケニアでもエボラへの懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し死亡例が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行（8,600例超、死亡4,000例超）が越境してケニアで初の死亡例を出した事例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、発生源であるDRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Moscú niega que exista un segundo caso de posible peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moscow denies that there is a second case of possible pneumonic plague.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor denies rumors of a second pneumonic plague case in the Irkutsk region, Siberia, following the death of 28-year-old Daria Shipílova from pneumonia of unknown etiology. The agency maintains there is no second patient linked to the deceased, and asserts no laboratory accident occurred; investigations show protocols were followed during handling of specimens. About 200 contacts were tested, revealing two COVID-19 cases and two rhinovirus infections. Earlier media claimed the initial patient was positive for Yersinia pestis in Thailand, but authorities dispute this link. The Irkutsk epidemiological situation is described as calm with no epidemic risk, and more than 90% of exposed contacts’ tests have been completed. Shipílova’s vaccinated mother notes strong immunity. No confirmed second-case pneumonic plague has been established.

triage.headline_ja: モスクワ、肺ペストの疑いがある2例目の存在を否定
triage.triage_reason: 身元不明の肺炎による死亡例と、肺ペスト（Yersinia pestis）陽性疑惑が報じられており、当局が否定しているものの、異常性・重篤性の観点からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はロシア・イルクーツク州での肺炎による死亡例とペスト疑惑の否定にあり、タイは陽性検査の出所として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地としては確認できないため対象国リストからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA: Ruto directs enhanced emergency measures after Kenya first case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) case in a Kenyan citizen who fell ill in the DRC, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, and died despite supportive care. President William Ruto directed enhanced emergency measures, ordering the National Security Council to tighten surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and treatment capacity. Eight family members are quarantined; 21 healthcare workers who treated the patient are quarantined and tracked. Contact tracing extends to passengers from the same flight, with 27 identified and contacted. Rapid response teams are on the ground, building on May preparedness amid Ebola activity in the DRC and Uganda. Lab confirmation came from the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI. The patient was isolated on arrival and buried per safe burial protocols. The WHO notes Kenya is the fourth country to confirm a BVD case; DRC outbreak ongoing, Uganda's latest outbreak ended in August. PSK urged vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニア初症例確認後、ルト大統領が緊急対策強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のブンディブギョウウイルス病(エボラ属)輸入症例が確認され死亡、DRC由来のアウトブレイクが複数国にまたがり拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事内でDRCでのアウトブレイクが継続中(ongoing)であり、患者もDRCで発症したことからDRCを発生国として計上。ウガンダのアウトブレイクは8月に終息済みとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: காசநோய் குறித்த கள ஆய்வுக் கையேடு - அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ் வெளியிட்டார்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leprosy Field Survey Manual Released by Minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: Leprosy Field Survey Manual released; Tamil Nadu launches Leprosy-Free JOSH team to strengthen detection, treatment, and social support for elimination. The Tamil Nadu arm is led by Class-1 frontline officers, with My Bharat volunteers and the NCC coordinating awareness and early-case finding. Field kits were distributed and the field-work plan signed by officers. At a national event in Delhi's Bharat Mandapam, Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda joined virtually to inaugurate Tamil Nadu's JOSH initiative from the state secretariat. Five districts—Cuddalore, Dharmapuri, Tiruchirappalli, Theni, and Thoothukudi—were selected for initial rollout. Under national guidelines, 2,390 village panchayats were certified as Leprosy-Free Panchayats, with certificates awarded. The government reaffirmed commitment to a Leprosy-free Tamil Nadu and India and urged every community segment to participate.

triage.headline_ja: 結核に関するフィールド調査マニュアルをアルンラージ大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はハンセン病排除に向けた行政プログラム（啓発・検出強化策）の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 内容はハンセン病排除プログラムの行政発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。見出し原文は結核(Tuberculosis)マニュアルについて言及しているが、疾患タグはLeprosyとなっており、記事サマリーもハンセン病（Leprosy-Free）プログラムについて記述している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: कीटकजन्य आजारांचा धोका वाढला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of vector-borne diseases has increased.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Dharashiv district in Maharashtra faces an elevated risk of vector-borne diseases due to stagnant water, with dengue and malaria highlighted as primary threats. District authorities—District Collector Kerti Kiran Pujar, Zilla Parishad CEO Priyavada Mhadadalkar, District Health Officer Dr. Satish Haridas, and Additional District Health Officer Dr. Vinaysheel Kulkarni—issued a joint alert urging preventive measures and prompt medical attention for fever. Do not ignore symptoms such as fever, body pains, severe headache, chills, or weakness; avoid self-medication and seek blood tests at government or authorized health centers to determine the cause. Community participation is emphasized; households should eliminate standing water inside homes and surroundings to curb mosquito breeding and disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: 媒介生物由来疾患のリスクが増大
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州の一地区でデング熱・マラリアへの注意喚起が行われているが、具体的な症例数や重症度に関する情報がなく、季節性・定例的な予防啓発の域を出ない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性の予防喚起記事であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の記載はない。デング熱・マラリアは媒介生物感染症として毎年同地域で発生する既知のリスクであり、現時点で異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: India's 1994 Plague Investigator Speaks To Times Now Digital On Russian Plague: 'Nothing To Really Fear, But We Must Be Vigilant'
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Dr N K Ganguly, who helped investigate India's 1994 plague outbreak, confirms Yersinia pestis as the cause. The outbreak originated in Maharashtra after the Latur earthquake, when migration and stored grain altered rodent populations, triggering an initial bubonic form that spread pneumonically in Surat during incubation. Lung samples and other specimens established the pathogen, with findings published in Nature. Researchers also detected small pockets of plague transmission in India and other countries, often where wild or feral animals sustain infections. The episode caused substantial economic damage through trade and travel disruptions, underscoring the need for robust surveillance. On Russia, Ganguly says there is no reason for India to panic; plague is not highly transmissible, and containment relies on rat and flea control and targeted surveillance. Investigations into possible laboratory-engineered strains show the Indian 1994 strain was clonal; current Russian cases require lab confirmation before labeling as plague.

triage.headline_ja: インドの1994年ペスト調査担当者がロシアのペストについてTimes Now Digitalに語る：『本当に恐れる必要はないが、警戒は必要』
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は1994年インドでのペスト流行を回顧する専門家インタビューであり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。ロシアの現状についても未確認情報であり、対象国でのアクティブな発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は1994年インド・ペスト流行の歴史的回顧と専門家見解であり、現在インドで新規の発生があるわけではない。ロシアの現状については未確認（lab confirmation待ち）であり、かつロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia desmiente informaciones sobre segundo caso de peste en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia denies reports of a second plague case in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s consumer health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, denied social-media rumors of a second pneumonic plague case in Irkutsk, Siberia. Daria Shipílova, 28, died of pneumonia of unknown etiology in an Irkutsk hospital. Authorities reported only two Covid-19 and two rhinovirus infections among contacts; no plague cases have been confirmed. Initially, media suggested she contracted Yersinia pestis, the plague bacterium, potentially in Thailand, which Thai officials say are in contact with the WHO but did not confirm travel. Rospotrebnadzor rejected claims of a lab accident and noted that protocols were followed. The patient was vaccinated and had strong immunity; Irkutsk’s epidemiological situation is described as calm, with over 90% of tests of contacts completed and no dangerous pathogen detected in nearly 5,000 tests reported to the WHO. The WHO called for greater transparency; the US, China, and Mongolia have sought information.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでの2例目のペスト感染報道を否定
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い例を巡る国際的な噂とWHO・米中モンゴルからの照会があり、社会的・政府的関心が高いため、確定情報が乏しくてもフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 実際の発症地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストには含まれない。タイでの感染経路は未確認の憶測報道であり、確定情報がないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 미국, 러에 '페스트 유출의심 사고' 정보공개 압박...트럼프 "생물학 무기는 아닌듯
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US pressures Russia to disclose information about a 'suspected plague release' incident; Trump: 'Not a biological weapon, I think'.
article.articleSummary: US presses Russia to disclose details of a suspected plague-release incident at an Irkutsk epidemiology/virology institute. A 28-year-old employee, Dariya Sipilova, spilled a vial containing a live plague pathogen on Sep 25; her condition worsened on Sep 27, she was hospitalized Sep 29, and died Oct 2 in an ICU. Since then, officials including Senator Marco Rubio have pressed Moscow for more information. The State Department sent a formal demarche warning that withholding details would breach international health obligations and said it is coordinating with other countries to share information. The CDC says there is no broad threat to the United States at present, though agencies remain vigilant. The Travel Advisory remains Level 4, urging Americans to depart Russia, particularly around Moscow. President Trump said the incident is unlikely to be a biological weapon and expects to learn more; he may speak with Putin, noting China also withheld information during COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ロシアに『ペスト流出疑いの事故』情報公開を圧力…トランプ氏『生物兵器ではなさそうだ』
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究施設でペスト菌サンプルが漏出し研究員が死亡、米国が渡航制限（レベル4）と情報開示を要求するなど、公衆衛生への影響・異常性・渡航制限の3基準が該当するため。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア（イルクーツク）の研究施設での実験室内感染・死亡事故であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。中国への言及はCOVID-19時の情報隠蔽比較のみで、本事件の発生地ではないため除外。

triage.triage_reason: 事案の主な発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイへの言及は霊能者による未来予言、中国への言及は国境演習であり、いずれも実際の発生事例ではないため対象国での発生とは認定できない。
