Despite mobilization, funding remains insufficient; international commitments exceed $2 billion since May 2026, with over $470 million in new pledges announced by the G20 and other donors in late September. Ongoing insecurity and armed-group violence in the East disrupt care and drive displacement, compounding fatigue among the population. The bishop calls for broad mobilization and a peaceful, diplomatic path to end the conflict fueling the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、「協力不足がエボラ対応を複雑化させている」
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行（8,300症例、4,018死亡）し、7州に拡大、治安悪化と協力不足が対応を阻害しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も該当するため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道。国際的な資金拠出（20億ドル以上）があるものの、治安悪化・住民の不信・協力不足により対応が困難化していることが報告されている。フルRRAによる状況の再評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Kano family loses five children in one week amid diphtheria outbreak
article.articleSummary: Five children (three girls, two boys) in Danbare New Layout, Kumbotso LGA, Kano State, died within seven days (Oct 1–7, 2026) from an illness suspected to be diphtheria. The deaths in one family raise concerns about possible household and wider community transmission; the cause has not yet been independently confirmed. The Kano State Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (KNCDC), led by Director-General Professor Muhammad Adamu Abbas, is investigating and urged residents to promptly report suspected infectious diseases to health facilities and seek early care. A September diphtheria vaccination campaign across five LGA—Kumbotso, Dala, Fagge, Gwale, Ungoggo—aims to curb transmission and protect vulnerable populations. Diphtheria spreads via respiratory droplets and close contact and can cause severe throat infections and breathing difficulties; vaccination, early detection, and prompt treatment are critical pending confirmation of the exact cause.

triage.headline_ja: カノ州の家族、ジフテリア流行の中で1週間に5人の子供を失う
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・カノ州で1家族5人の子供が1週間以内にジフテリア疑いで死亡しており、重篤性・異常性ともに高く、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性もあるためフルリスク評価が妥当。ただし発生国ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・カノ州（Kumbotso、Fagge、Gwale、Dala等のLGA）でのジフテリア疑い死亡事例であり、ミャンマー（Yangon Region）への言及は本文になく誤付与と判断。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: La UA pide fortalecer medidas en puntos fronterizos para evitar la propagación del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UA calls for strengthening measures at border checkpoints to prevent the spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: The African Union’s public health agency urged stronger border screening to curb Ebola spread from the DR Congo outbreak declared on May 15 in the east. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula called for traveler-history checks, temperature screening, symptom questionnaires, and rapid reporting of suspected cases at border checkpoints. Kenya reported an imported Ebola death in Nairobi, tracing to a patient who traveled from DR Congo via Uganda to Kampala and then by air to Nairobi; authorities are tracing dozens of contacts and passengers on the flight. The outbreak had also reached Uganda, where the WHO declared the end of the outbreak on Aug 26 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DR Congo) and two deaths. The DR Congo outbreak has 8,728 cases and 4,205 deaths, per the latest health institute balance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、エボラ出血熱の拡大を防ぐため国境検問所での対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は8,728症例・4,205死亡という大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大（空路輸入症例での死亡例含む）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（WHOが8月26日に終息宣言済み、20症例）およびケニア（空路輸入による死亡1例）への越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる流行地であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯鼠疫事件背后
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Behind Russia's plague incident.
article.articleSummary: An suspected plague incident occurred in Russia's Irkutsk Oblast involving a 28-year-old female researcher at the Siberian and Far Eastern Anti-Plague Research Institute. She was admitted on Sept 29, 2026 with severe pneumonia and died Oct 1–2. Investigators suspect a laboratory accident after breaking a vial containing Yersinia pestis. About 200 close contacts were quarantined; no secondary cases have been detected. Russia labels the event as unknown-origin pneumonia; WHO is monitoring and regards current public risk as low, with US CDC and ECDC watching. The article describes plague as caused by Yersinia pestis, a Class A infectious disease in China. Main hosts are rodents; fleas are vectors; marmots in Central Asia are an important source. China reports natural foci in Inner Mongolia, Tibet, Qinghai, Xinjiang, Yunnan, and Gansu with occasional yearly cases; outside foci, risk is very low. Emphasizes infection control, lab safety, and rational public messaging.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト事件の背景
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究所でYersinia pestis感染による死亡例が発生し、実験室事故が疑われる異常事態であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本事例の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。中国国内の自然疫源地（内モンゴル、チベット等）への言及は背景情報であり、現時点での実際の発生事例ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: A járvány, amely már többször letarolta Európát: visszatérhet-e a pestis?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic that has ravaged Europe several times already: could the plague return?
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) remains endemic in parts of Africa, Asia, and the Americas, though Europe and Spain have not registered autochthonous cases for decades. A Russian researcher’s death in Irkutsk from unknown-origin pneumonia rekindled fears of pneumonic plague; Russian authorities report no confirmed plague cases and contacts tested negative; WHO seeks clarification and offers assistance. In Europe, the ECDC states plague has been virtually eliminated from the continent for over 50 years, but the bacterium persists in animal reservoirs and can reach humans via infected fleas or contact with tissues/fluids; pneumonic transmission can occur between people. Spain maintains active surveillance; national protocol updated April 2026; EU/EC Oct 7 examined the Siberian case; no evidence of secondary or sustained human-to-human transmission. Globally, Madagascar and the DRC account for most recent cases (2019-2025); the United States reports ~7 cases annually in western rural areas. Antibiotics and early diagnosis remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパを何度も襲った疫病：ペストは復活するのか？
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシア・イルクーツクでの原因不明肺炎による研究者死亡を契機としたペストに関する解説記事で、確定診断はされておらず二次感染の証拠もない。DRCやマダガスカルへの言及は過去の疫学的背景情報であり、現在進行中の具体的アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国での新規シグナルとは判断しにくい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクでの未確定の肺ペスト疑い事例（確定診断なし、接触者検査陰性）。DRCとマダガスカルは2019-2025年の世界的な疫学的背景として言及されているのみで、記事が報じる現在のイベントの発生地ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ロシアは対象国リスト外。続報（ロシアでの確定診断の有無、WHOとのやり取り）を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Union Health Minister launches JOSH teams to accelerate TB elimination drive
article.articleSummary: TB elimination drive accelerates in India as Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda launches JOSH teams under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. In 2026, 67,933 Panchayats across 697 districts were declared TB Mukt. JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) teams will operate in 55 districts across 11 States and Union Territories, conducting household-level outreach to identify people with TB symptoms, encourage testing, and support patients to complete treatment. Each team comprises five NCC cadets and five MY Bharat volunteers, guided by a Class-I officer, and will function at block and ward levels. The initiative is a joint effort of the Ministries of Health and Family Welfare, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Defence, with plans to expand to additional districts after orientation and mobilisation, focusing on active case finding and ensuring diagnosis and treatment completion.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣、結核撲滅運動を加速するためJOSHチームを発足
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの拡充に関する行政施策の発表であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府による結核撲滅プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の推進策発表であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : trois cents écoles bénéficiaires des kits de lavage des mains - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Three hundred schools benefiting from handwashing kits - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Oct 8, 2026, 300 schools in Nord-Kivu's Beni region will receive UNICEF handwashing kits to curb Ebola transmission amid the Bundibugyo strain outbreak. Distribution covers Beni, Butembo, Musienrne, and Nord-Kivu Education Zone 2. Coordinated by Prisca Luanda Kamala, the initiative reinforces barrier measures and trains students to reduce school- and community-spread as Beni becomes the province’s epicenter. Rounds found some schools lacking water and thermometers; others are teaching protective practices. UNICEF kits, including handwashing stations, arrive where many Nord-Kivu 2 schools lack hygiene facilities, aiding outbreak response. Parents and teachers are urged to reinforce proper hand hygiene and protective behavior among pupils. The report does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：300校が手洗いキットの提供を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに関連する対応策報道であり、エボラは本質的に重篤・異常・国際的拡大リスクを伴う疾患であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は症例数・死亡者数を報告しておらず、UNICEFによる学校向け手洗いキット配布という予防対策の内容だが、背景にあるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが北キブ州ベニを中心に継続中であることが示唆されており、既存アウトブレイクの継続・拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PCR Drop-Off Tracks Severity of C. difficile Infection but Fails to Predict
article.articleSummary: In a China-based retrospective study at Ruian People’s Hospital (Zhejiang), 141 adults with lab-confirmed Clostridioides difficile infection admitted from Jan 2020–Dec 2023 were treated with metronidazole or vancomycin and had a follow-up PCR 7–21 days after starting therapy. Ct value (tcdB) was used to derive ΔCt, the change in cycle threshold between baseline and follow-up; rising Ct means falling toxin-gene burden. Patients’ median age was 78; 59.6% were ≥75. Severity by IDSA/SHEA criteria: 101 non-severe (71.6%), 40 severe (28.4%). Severe patients had median ΔCt +0.3 (IQR -1.0 to +1.3) vs non-severe +5.3 (IQR 3.0–6.6); Spearman r = -0.53, P < 0.001, while initial Ct did not differ by severity (P = 0.486). ΔCt distinguished severity with AUC 0.837 (0.759–0.907). For poor clinical outcome (in-hospital death or discharge against medical advice) in 50 patients (35.5%), ΔCt did not predict (P = 0.217; AUC 0.563, 0.458–0.663). The trajectory of Ct offers a potential early microbiological readout of response but is not a reliable mortality predictor.

triage.headline_ja: PCR値の低下はC. difficile感染症の重症度を追跡するが、転帰不良の予測には失敗
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の後ろ向き臨床研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国・浙江省の単一病院における臨床研究論文であり、公衆衛生イベントではなく学術研究の紹介記事であるためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Accelerated Aging and Colon Cancer; Hepatitis B From a Cat? Food Triggers in IBD
article.articleSummary: Korea: accelerated aging linked to a 93% higher risk of early-onset colorectal adenocarcinoma and a 132% higher risk of early-onset colon cancer. In China, a model using routine clinical parameters may assess pancreatic cancer risk in type 2 diabetes. Domestic cats carry a marginal risk of hepatitis B virus transmission to humans. In chronic hepatitis C, an 8-week bemnifosbuvir–ruzasvir course achieved SVR12 in 90% of patients. Mount Sinai received NIH funding to study PFAS exposure and IBD. In ulcerative colitis, nationwide cohort finds colectomy linked to lower cardiometabolic risk. Retrospective UC study shows higher 52-week colectomy with tofacitinib versus upadacitinib (42.5% vs 23.4%). Resmetirom's MAFLD/MASH efficacy appears genotype-independent. A global study links liver transplant for acute-on-chronic liver failure with markedly lower 1-year mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 加速老化と大腸がん；猫からB型肝炎？IBDの食事誘因
triage.triage_reason: 複数の医学研究トピックをまとめたダイジェスト記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染症アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国・中国・米国での各種消化器疾患研究のまとめであり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。中国は膵臓がんリスクモデルの文脈で言及されているのみで、感染症イベントとは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: ترمپ: خطر شیوع طاعون در روسیه تحت کنترول است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump: The risk of a plague outbreak in Russia is under control.
article.articleSummary: U.S. President Donald Trump says, citing Russian authorities, that the risk of a plague outbreak in Russia is under control following the death of a Russian laboratory employee in Siberia. The incident has raised questions about possible links to activities at the Institute of Plague Research. Trump told reporters in the White House that Russia asserts the danger is well managed and that he does not believe the death signals plague as a biological weapon; more information is expected soon. He plans a previously arranged telephone call with Vladimir Putin to discuss the matter. When asked if this resembles how China responded to the early COVID-19 outbreak, Trump noted Russia has largely stayed silent, similar to China at the outset, while both sides claim the situation is under control.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏:ロシアでのペスト流行リスクは管理下にある
triage.triage_reason: シベリアの研究所職員がペストで死亡し、生物兵器関連の疑念も浮上。米露首脳が直接言及するなど社会的・政治的関心が高く、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度）にも該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 事件はロシア（シベリア）での研究所関連のペスト死亡例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないため verified_locations は空。中国は比較対象として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa suspende aulas em toda a rede municipal após surto de escabiose atingir 241 casos - Aqui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa suspends classes throughout the municipal school system after a scabies outbreak reached 241 cases - Aqui.
article.articleSummary: Lagoa Santa, Região Metropolitana de Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports a scabies outbreak now totaling 241 confirmed cases, with 50 new notifications in 24 hours. The first official case was identified on Sept 18 at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda in Moradas da Lapinha, from which the parasite spread. In response, authorities suspended all in-person classes across the municipal network on Oct 8–9, extending after parental pressure from the epicenter outbreak. A return to classes is planned for Oct 19, following a 12–15 October recess. Control measures include thorough cleaning, pest control (dedetização), and sanitization of desks, toys, mattresses, carpets, and water tanks; a temporary patient care post was set up at Moradas da Lapinha school, with daily epidemiological bulletins. Guidance emphasizes keeping symptomatic students at home until medical clearance. Scabies spreads by prolonged skin-to-skin contact or contaminated fabrics; similar outbreaks have been reported in six Minas Gerais municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ、疥癬アウトブレイクが241例に達し市立学校ネットワーク全体で休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はIHR基準に該当する重篤な国際公衆衛生事象ではないが、学校休校など地域の対応拡大とブラジル国内複数自治体への拡大が見られるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚寄生虫症で国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、学校単位での集団発生と休校措置、ミナスジェライス州内6自治体での類似発生報告があり、地域的な感染症対策の観点から経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Bebê está em estado grave com suspeita de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Baby is in serious condition with suspected measles.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected measles cases in Rio Branco, Acre, Brazil involve an 11‑month‑old baby in serious condition (ICU) and a 30‑year‑old woman with non‑severe illness. Patients originate from Puerto Maldonado, Peru, and transited Assis Brasil and Brasileia before hospital admission. Early RT‑PCR tests detected measles virus; confirmatory analysis is pending, with samples sent to Fiocruz. Cases remain under investigation to determine if infection was imported, as classification depends on the likely site of infection. Preventive vaccination blocks are being organized in Brasileia and in Rio Branco health units, including Huerb and Into, targeting individuals with vaccination indications. Surveillance is coordinated by Sesacre, the Brazilian Ministry of Health, Cievs, Lacen, Renaveh, and Peruvian health authorities through international cooperation. Measles is highly contagious, presenting with fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, and eye irritation; vaccination remains the primary prevention strategy.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疑いで乳児が重体、アクレ州
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州で麻疹疑い2例（うち1例重症）が確認され、輸入感染の可能性があり国際協力下で調査中だが、確定診断待ちで感染拡大の規模は不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ペルーからの越境感染の可能性が指摘されているが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。確定検査結果待ちで、今後の情報更新を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 2.800 Ayam Mati Mendadak di Sinjai Positif Flu Burung H5, Kementan: Perketat Biosekuriti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2,800 Chickens Die Suddenly in Sinjai Positive for H5 Avian Flu, Ministry of Agriculture: Tighten Biosecurity.
article.articleSummary: 2,800 chickens died suddenly in Sinjai Utara, Sinjai Regency, South Sulawesi, between 23 September and 6 October 2026. Laboratory testing by Balai Besar Veteriner Maros confirmed Avian Influenza, H5 subtype clade 2.3.2. The Ministry of Agriculture rapid response reinforced biosecurity, surveillance, epidemiological tracing, and cleaning/disinfection at affected premises after a report received on 23 September via iSIKHNAS. RT-PCR confirmation underpinned control measures. Investigations identified risk factors including routine activities that bring fighting cocks from multiple areas in Lappa Kelurahan, with some birds sourced from outside Sinjai; poultry movement highlighted as a key factor, though not yet the sole source. Farmers are urged to report sudden deaths immediately; communities asked to improve biosecurity: keep cages clean, separate sick birds, limit poultry, people, and equipment movement. Authorities continue field work.

triage.headline_ja: シンジャイで2,800羽の鶏が突然死、H5型鳥インフルエンザ陽性 農業省がバイオセキュリティ強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: 家きんにおけるH5亜型鳥インフルエンザ発生事例であり、人への感染報告はないが、闘鶏の移動など感染拡大リスク要因が指摘されており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は家きん（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ発生であり、ヒト感染の報告はない。闘鶏の移動による地域間拡散リスクが指摘されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Acre notifica dois casos suspeitos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre reports two suspected measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected measles cases in Acre, Brazil, are under investigation after exposure linked to Puerto Maldonado, Peru. The patients, residents of Puerto Maldonado, were treated in Rio Branco after traveling via Assis Brasil and Brasileia. Initial RT‑PCR tests detected measles virus; samples will be sent to Fiocruz for confirmatory testing. Case classification remains pending, but epidemiological data point to importation with infection likely outside Acre. The 11‑month‑old child is in intensive care in grave condition; a 30‑year‑old woman is hospitalized without severe symptoms; both in Rio Branco. Investigation is coordinated by the Ministry of Health, Sesacre, and CIEVS, with Lacen, Renaveh, and municipal health secretariats participating. Border-area CIEVS monitor contacts. A targeted vaccination drive is planned in Brasileia, Huerb, and Into for those indicated. Peru authorities are involved via the International Health Regulations focal point. Symptoms include fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, and conjunctivitis. Further updates will follow.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、麻疹疑い2例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ペルーからの輸入麻疹疑い例がブラジルで確認され重症例もあるが、確定診断待ちで国内拡大の明確な証拠は不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ペルー（Puerto Maldonado）が感染源とされるが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル・アクレ州での輸入例として評価。確定診断・感染拡大状況の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情恐持續半年、致2千萬人亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The COVID-19 pandemic could last six months, killing 20 million people.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak in China could last until April next year, with an estimated 20 million deaths, according to a health official cited in the report. Oct holiday travel and dense crowding allegedly accelerated spread; crematorium data show a surge of deaths among 20–40-year-olds, including a 25-year-old, with post-infection inflammatory responses causing hypercoagulability, thrombosis, and sudden death. Hospitals report high rates of severe myocarditis or pneumonia, and antiviral drugs have been in short supply since July. Variants in circulation include BA.3.2 (70–75 spike mutations) and PJ.2.1 (78 mutations, strongest receptor binding), with claims that 3–4 strains are active. Sichuan, Chongqing, and Gansu are highlighted as high-transmission areas, with corroboration from Shandong. Officials allegedly conceal true mortality; publicly reported annual deaths are ~11 million, while internal data claim non-normal deaths triple that, totaling about 38 million excess deaths over 13 months (June last year–Sept this year).

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ感染拡大は半年続く恐れ、死者2000万人に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 大紀元という単一の非公式情報源による極端な死亡者数・超過死亡の主張であり、中国当局の公式統計と大きく矛盾する未検証情報のため、他ソースでの裏付けを待って経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 情報源が大紀元（Epoch Times）であり、匿名の『健康当局者』引用や内部告発的な数値（公式年間死亡者数の3倍、13ヶ月で3800万人超過死亡など）を含む。新変異株BA.3.2・PJ.2.1の出現情報は注目に値するが、全体として信頼性検証が必要な段階であり、WHOや他の公的機関からの裏付け情報を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: La Unión Africana pide reforzar los controles en las fronteras para evitar que el ébola se expanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union calls for reinforcing border controls to prevent Ebola from spreading.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, the African Union's Africa CDC urged stronger border controls at entry and exit points to curb the Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Wessam Mankoula warned that Ebola crosses borders and stressed information sharing, traveler-history tracking, temperature checks, and symptom questionnaires at borders. Authorities urged the public to report Ebola-like symptoms or known exposure before travel. The push follows Kenya's Ebola death in Nairobi, an imported case from the DRC; the patient traveled from Congo via Uganda (Kampala) to Nairobi by Oct 3. Kenya is tracing dozens of contacts and flight passengers. The DRC's seventeenth outbreak has caused 8,728 cases and 4,205 confirmed deaths, per INSP Congo; Uganda's outbreak was declared ended on Aug 26 with 20 cases, including 15 imported from the DRC, and two deaths. Africa should begin manufacturing its own medical supplies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、エボラ出血熱の拡大を防ぐため国境管理の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRC第17次エボラ流行（8,728症例、4,205死亡）がケニアへ輸入症例として国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（第17次流行の発生源）、ケニア（輸入症例）、ウガンダ（通過国・既に終息宣言済み）に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。Africa CDCによる国境管理強化の呼びかけは渡航制限リスクの高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: 美國務院懸賞1000萬美元 緝拿中共黑客 | 張宇 | 中共特工 | 新冠病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. State Department offers a $10 million bounty to capture CCP hackers | Zhang Yu | CCP agents | COVID-19
article.articleSummary: The U.S. Department of State has offered a $10 million reward for the capture of Zhang Yu, a hacker linked to China’s Shanghai State Security Bureau, with accomplice Xu Zewei already extradited to the United States from Italy and facing nine counts. Since early 2020, the pair allegedly stole data from U.S. universities and top immunology and virology researchers involved in COVID-19 research, including vaccines, therapies, and diagnostic technologies. They are also accused of involvement in the HAFNIUM hacking campaign, which exploited Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities to breach more than 12,700 U.S. institutions. Xu Zewei was captured in Italy in April and extradited this year; Zhang Yu remains at large. The United States is seeking tips via its Justice Rewards Program.

triage.headline_ja: 米国務省、1000万ドルの懸賞金で中共ハッカーを指名手配｜張宇｜中共スパイ｜新型コロナウイルス
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19関連の研究データを狙ったハッキング事件と司法手続きに関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はサイバーセキュリティ・司法案件に関する報道であり、COVID-19は過去の研究データ窃取の文脈でのみ言及されている。感染症の発生や公衆衛生上のリスクに関する情報は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai civic chief Ashwini Bhide directs stronger malaria, dengue prevention in G-South Ward
article.articleSummary: On Oct 8, 2026, Mumbai’s BMC Commissioner Ashwini Bhide directed intensified prevention of malaria and dengue in the G-South Ward, following inspections of the Haji Mohammed Sabu Siddiqui Municipal Maternity Home in Prabhadevi and a Prabhadevi dispensary. She asked for current malaria and dengue case data, urged stronger vector-control measures, and ordered awareness campaigns via ASHA workers to boost uptake of ABHA and Ayushman Bharat cards. The inspection reviewed HMIS-reported functioning at the maternity home and assessed the dispensary and polyclinic’s daily patient footfall, medicine stocks, and blood-testing facilities, while noting needed minor repairs and essential equipment. City data show dengue 1,563 cases (June–Aug 2026) vs 1,972 in 2025, and malaria 4,485 in 2026 vs 3,733 in 2025. The focus follows a monsoon period with overall declines in several illnesses, despite rising malaria and falling dengue relative to last year.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ市当局トップ、アシュウィニ・バイデ氏がG南地区でのマラリア・デング対策強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の季節性マラリア・デング対策という定例の行政対応記事であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生影響は確認できないが、マラリア症例数が前年比約20%増加している点は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市当局の定例的な媒介感染症対策強化の指示に関する記事。2026年のマラリア症例数（4,485件）は2025年（3,733件）より増加している一方、デング熱は減少（1,563件 vs 1,972件）。重症度や死亡例に関する情報はなく、行政の通常業務の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de gripe aviária de Selbach é considerado encerrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Selbach's avian influenza case is considered closed.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza case in backyard poultry in Selbach, Alto Jacuí, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is closed. The infection was confirmed by the Campinas Federal Agricultural Defense Laboratory (LFDA-SP) on Oct 5. Containment included culling the birds, disinfection, and tracing within a 3-km radius. Five field teams conducted farm inspections, with one team surveying agricultural supply sites. A total of 70 properties within the radius were visited; no clinical signs compatible with influenza were detected, including at a commercial poultry farm. Following review, containment activities are concluded, though local teams will maintain surveillance as part of routine monitoring and intensify checks at commercial poultry operations. The rapid, within-24-hours response reflects experience since the state’s first avian influenza outbreak in 2023 at Reserva do Taim, protecting Rio Grande do Sul’s poultry industry.

triage.headline_ja: セルバッハの鳥インフルエンザ症例、終息と判断される
triage.triage_reason: 裏庭養鶏における鳥インフルエンザ事例で、既に封じ込めが完了し終息宣言されている。ヒト感染の報告はなく、商業養鶏場への影響も確認されていない。
triage.notes: 家禽（裏庭飼育）での鳥インフルエンザ事例であり、当局により迅速に封じ込め・終息対応済み。ヒトへの感染や拡大の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस से निपटने के लिए केन्या के साथ खड़ा भारत, 6 हजार पीपीई किट की मदद भेजी - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India stands with Kenya to tackle the Ebola virus, sending 6,000 PPE kits as aid.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola virus disease case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, linked to a traveler who died on October 6, 2026. India pledged ongoing support with 6,000 PPE kits; WHO donated 1,000 PPE sets; Kenya and partners including the USA, IGAD, and Africa CDC are assisting. Kenya's Health Ministry says the imported case does not indicate wide transmission. The National Incident Management System has been active since May 2026, with national and county emergency plans on high alert. Surveillance intensified at health facilities and communities; Rapid Response Teams deployed. By October 8, 2026, Kenya had trained 4,971 health workers on Ebola prevention and response, and screened over 652,000 travelers at 15 entry points. The Indian Embassy posted the stance on X after case confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: インドがケニアと連帯しエボラ対策を支援、PPEキット6000個を送付
triage.triage_reason: DRCを感染源とするエボラウイルス病がケニアへ越境輸入され死亡例も発生、複数国・国際機関が緊急支援に動いており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入例とインドの支援だが、ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。感染源であるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。DRC国内の現地発生状況の詳細は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस से निपटने के लिए केन्या के साथ खड़ा भारत, 6 हजार पीपीई किट की मदद भेजी | Health worker takes a swab sample for COVID-19 test, Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, Africa CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India stands with Kenya to tackle the Ebola virus, sent 6,000 PPE kits as aid | Health worker takes a swab sample for COVID-19 test, Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus in Kenya is currently localized after an imported case linked to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who died on 6 October. Kenya confirms the imported case but cautions against widespread transmission; authorities maintain vigilance with surveillance and border screening. India pledges strong solidarity and support, providing 6,000 PPE kits to Kenya, alongside WHO’s donation of 1,000 PPE sets, as part of ongoing public health collaboration. Kenya’s National Incident Management System has been active since May 2026, with high-alert emergency responses at national and county levels, expanded health facility and community surveillance, and deployment of Rapid Response Teams. To date, 4,971 health workers have received Ebola prevention and response training, and 15 entry points have screened over 652,000 travelers. International partners, including IGAD and Africa CDC, continue supporting the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策でインドがケニアと連帯、6000個のPPEキットを支援として送付
triage.triage_reason: DRCからの渡航者を発端とするエボラ輸入症例がケニアで確認され、国際的な支援（インド、WHO、Africa CDC等）が動いている重篤感染症事案であり、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ輸入症例（DRCからの渡航者が発端）とそれに対するインドの支援であり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生自体は記述されていない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya remains open as Ebola response intensifies, CS Duale tells diplomats
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case on 6 October 2026; the Kenyan citizen patient died, but authorities say there is no evidence of widespread transmission. The government intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and testing, identifying 57 contacts under monitoring. The National Incident Management System is active since May 2026, with 27 counties conducting surveillance and line 719. To date, 4,971 health workers have been trained; 15 points screen travelers, with over 652,000 travelers screened and 263 alerts from 17 counties investigated. Designated isolation, treatment, and quarantine facilities with 241 beds are at Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Port Reitz, and Nairobi Hospital; additional capacity is being built in Busia and other areas. Five laboratories (including mobile) provide testing with 6–12 hour turnaround; 268 samples tested, 1 positive; the patient died and was buried per protocols. PPE: WHO 1,000 sets; India 6,000 sets.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアはエボラ対応強化の中でも開放的姿勢を維持、デュアレCSが外交団に説明
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ症例が確認され死亡者が出ており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イベント発生国はケニアであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。インドはPPE提供国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade dos municípios está em alerta ou risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: Almost half of the municipalities are on alert or at risk.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's second cycle of the Rapid Indices Survey for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa), covering May–August 2026, shows 49.2% of 3,732 municipalities reporting data are at alert or risk for Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Despite infestation alerts, dengue probable cases in 2026 are down ~70% versus the same period in 2025; as of September 26, around 470,500 probable dengue cases were recorded, vs 1.5 million previously. Chikungunya fell ~43% to about 67,900; Zika dropped ~35% to 2,141. Breeding sites remain centered on households: 42.3% in plant pots/dishes, 26.1% in water storage, and 23% in tires/waste. Regional patterns: North—tires/trash; Northeast—water storage; Southeast/South/Central-West—plant containers. Actions include training over 300,000 Community Health Agents, vector-control staff (ACE), ovitraps, intradomiciliary residual spraying (BRI-Aedes), larvicidal-distributing stations (EDL), and Wolbachia strategies, with emphasis on community participation ahead of summer and El Niño effects.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ:自治体の約半数が警戒または危険レベルに
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症の全国的なベクター指数は約半数の自治体で警戒・危険レベルだが、2026年のデング・チクングニア・ジカの症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、現時点で緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 政府の定期サーベイランス報告であり、症例数は前年より大幅減少。夏季・エルニーニョの影響による再燃リスクのため継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Acre prepara bloqueio vacinal após casos suspeitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Acre prepares vaccination blockade after suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Acre, Brazil, authorities are preparing a measles vaccination blockade in Brasileia and Rio Branco hospitals (Huerb, Into) after two suspected cases in Puerto Maldonado, Peru residents who passed through Assis Brasil and Brasileia before seeking care in Rio Branco. An 11-month-old in ICU is in grave condition; a 30-year-old woman is hospitalized with non-severe symptoms. Preliminary RT-PCR tests detected measles virus; samples will be sent to Fiocruz for confirmatory analysis, with investigators considering infection abroad. Epidemiological surveillance teams in Acre, Rio Branco, and Brasileia monitor contacts. The operation involves the Ministry of Health, Lacen, Renaveh, and municipal secretariats, in coordination with Peruvian health authorities. Vaccination will target individuals indicated by technical evaluation to reduce transmission; residents should check vaccination records and seek care if symptomatic, reporting recent travel or contact.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：アクレ州、ペルーからの疑い例を受けワクチン接種封鎖を準備
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州でペルーからの輸入疑い麻疹症例が確認され、重症例（ICU）を含み、ヒトーヒト感染拡大のリスクからワクチン接種封鎖措置が取られており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ペルー（Puerto Maldonado）が感染源とされるが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。RT-PCR陽性だがFiocruzでの確定検査待ち。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस से निपटने के लिए केन्या के साथ खड़ा भारत, 6 हजार पीपीई किट की मदद भेजी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India stands with Kenya to tackle the Ebola virus, sending 6,000 PPE kits as aid.
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case confirmed in Kenya tied to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo, who died on 6 October 2026. Kenyan Health Ministry says the situation does not indicate widespread transmission; the country remains secure, open, and vigilant. India announced support, providing 6,000 PPE kits and vowing ongoing cooperation to strengthen public health preparedness and response. Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale reported that the National Incident Management System has been active since May 2026 and that national and county emergency response mechanisms are on high alert. Surveillance at health facilities and communities has increased, with Rapid Response Teams deployed. As of now, 4,971 health workers have received Ebola prevention and response training; 15 entry points are conducting health screening, with over 652,000 travelers screened. WHO donated 1,000 PPE sets; India also provided PPE, and partners including Kenya government, WHO, USA, IGAD, and Africa CDC are assisting.

triage.headline_ja: インドはエボラウイルス対策でケニアを支援、6000個のPPEキットを送付
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC渡航者由来のエボラ輸入症例が確認され死亡者も出ており、複数国が緊急支援を行っている点で公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はケニアであり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは感染者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規発生情報はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 'हेल्थ, यूथ और डिफेंस' की त्रिशक्ति मिलकर टीबी-... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health, Youth and Defence Triad Unites for TB-...
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) elimination drive marked by the nationwide launch of the Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) teams at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta attended the event on 8 October 2026, alongside Union Health and Family Welfare Minister J. P. Nadda. Under Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership and guidance, the government is advancing the TB elimination mission, with JOSH teams rolled out across the country to actively involve youth in building a TB-free India. The article emphasizes youth engagement as a central component of the national mission. It does not provide TB case counts, outbreaks, laboratory confirmations, or infection source details. The focus remains on political backing, national coordination, and public health mobilization to root out TB across India.

triage.headline_ja: 「保健・青年・防衛」の三位一体がTB撲滅に団結
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの政策発表であり、症例数・アウトブレイク・異常事態の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生施策のニュースのためシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府のTB撲滅キャンペーン（JOSHチーム発足式）に関する政治的・組織的な報道であり、具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : 168 contacts toujours introuvables - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: 168 contacts still unaccounted for - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Ebola response teams in Kisangani, in the northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo's Tshopo province, are tracing 168 unaccounted contacts of Ebola cases. Of 273 identified contacts, 105 are actively followed and receiving post-exposure prophylaxis at the Ebola Treatment Center in Kisangani. The 168 missing include 110 in Makiso-Kisangani health zone, 49 in the Tshopo health zone, and 9 in Mangobo. A thorough investigation is underway to improve listing. Response teams are conducting search and tracing operations to locate these individuals and strengthen surveillance around confirmed or suspected cases. The effort faces community reluctance to investigations, sampling, isolation, and transfer to the Ebola Treatment Center, underscoring the need for community collaboration to detect symptoms quickly and contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: トショパ州のエボラ：168人の接触者が依然として所在不明 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、168人の接触者が追跡不能となっており、コミュニティの非協力的な態度もあって感染拡大リスクが継続している。重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性の観点からWPRO基準に複数該当し、社会的関心も高いと判断されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国トショパ州キサンガニにおける既知のエボラアウトブレイクの接触者追跡状況に関するもの。新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの継続対応であるため「異常/予想外」はNoと判断したが、接触者の所在不明やコミュニティの協力拒否など感染拡大・管理困難のリスク要因が複数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Belford Roxo, Duque de Caxias e Nova Iguaçu recebem vacinação de resgate contra meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belford Roxo, Duque de Caxias, and Nova Iguaçu receive catch-up vaccination against meningitis.
article.articleSummary: 400,000 doses of the meningococcal ACWY vaccine are being distributed by the Ministry of Health to support a catch-up immunization in Rio de Janeiro state for people up to 24 who did not receive ACWY at the recommended age. The four prioritized municipalities are Belford Roxo, Duque de Caxias, Nova Iguaçu, and the city of Rio de Janeiro. The drive runs through 31 October; individuals should visit a basic health unit with ID and, if possible, vaccination card. ACWY is a single-dose vaccine for those 11+, and those already vaccinated do not require another dose. Since 2024, meningococcal disease cases have risen in Rio de Janeiro: 70 in 2024, 95 in 2025, and 49 by September 2026 in SINAN. ACWY protects against Neisseria meningitidis serogroups A, C, W, Y. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges; symptoms include headache, fever, nausea, vomiting, neck stiffness, irritability, convulsions, rash; seek care immediately.

triage.headline_ja: ベルフォル・ホショ、ドゥキ・ジ・カシアス、ノヴァ・イグアス地域で髄膜炎に対するキャッチアップワクチン接種実施
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州で髄膜炎菌感染症の症例が増加傾向にあり、行政がワクチンキャッチアップ接種を実施しているが、現時点で大規模流行やIHR通報相当の国際的影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 症例数は2024年70件、2025年95件、2026年9月時点で49件と増加傾向にあるが、重症度や致死率の情報は記事に記載なし。公的機関による予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、現時点で緊急性は低いが今後の症例推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária: é seguro consumir carne de aves e ovos? Entenda os riscos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: is it safe to eat poultry meat and eggs? Understand the risks.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) case confirmed in backyard poultry in Selbach, northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, in early October. After confirmation, authorities inspected 70 rural properties within 3 km and a nearby commercial farm within 10 km; no birds housed there; the focus is considered closed by the DDA. Avian influenza is highly contagious, affecting wild and domestic birds and mammals; humans can be infected, though rarely. In 2025, a case at a Montenegro commercial farm led to export suspensions of Brazilian poultry. MAPA notes Selbach as the only active backyard-poultry focus in Brazil; Rio Grande do Sul regards it as closed. Three wildlife foci are under investigation: two in Santa Catarina (Garopaba and Laguna; sea lions) and one in Piauí (Coronel José Dias; a bird such as avoante or band-tailed dove). Safe to eat meat and eggs when well cooked; cooking/pasteurization kills the virus. Human infections are low risk but can be severe; symptoms resemble flu; antiviral treatment may be used.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：鶏肉や卵を食べても安全か？リスクを理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の裏庭養鶏での鳥インフルエンザ発生事例だが、人への感染はなく、当局によりfocusは既に終息済み。野生動物（アシカ等）での複数の調査中フォーカスがあり、動物間拡大の可能性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事中のMontenegroはブラジル・リオグランデ・ド・スル州の都市（2025年の商業養鶏場事例）であり、国名のモンテネグロとは無関係。対象国リストには該当しないため除外。野生動物（アシカ、鳥）での複数フォーカスが調査中である点は今後の推移に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă după ce un virus mortal care poate provoca sângerări la nivelul ochilor s-a răspândit într-o nouă țară. Un pacient a murit după călătoria cu avionul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert after a deadly virus that can cause bleeding in the eyes has spread to a new country. One patient died after air travel.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo has reached Kenya; the first imported case was confirmed on October 6, 2026 by the Kenyan Ministry of Health. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had been treated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), traveled to Kenya via Uganda and died after receiving care there. The case highlights an ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC, for which the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. The flare began in May in Ituri province; Uganda has reported 20 cases and 2 deaths and announced the outbreak over in August. Ebola virus disease is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted mainly through contact with blood and body fluids or contaminated objects, not by air. Risk is very high in the DRC and bordering countries, and low elsewhere in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 目の出血を引き起こす致死性ウイルスが新たな国に拡大、航空機移動後に患者死亡とのアラート
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境輸入され、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アウトブレイクの震源地であるDRCのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia a început operaţiunea muşamalizarea după cazurile de ciumă. China ia măsuri, iar Trump îl sună pe Putin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia has begun the cover-up operation following the plague cases. China is taking measures, and Trump is calling Putin.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Russia confirmed a plague-related death in Siberia but withheld details on the cause and circumstances; officials deny a second Irkutsk case amid rumors. About 5,000 laboratory tests have returned negative. The World Health Organization says it has not received full details of the investigation. In Irkutsk, dozens in protective suits were seen on streets and around 200 people placed in quarantine; authorities say the Moscow Institute of Research has recorded no plague case. U.S. President Donald Trump said he will seek complete information from Vladimir Putin and plans a direct call. In China, residents near the border are urged to stockpile supplies amid growing anxiety. The mother of the deceased disputes infection via a broken vial of pneumonic plague bacteria. Romanian infectious-disease experts say modern treatment reduces mortality; reference is made to the Black Death.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、ペスト症例発生後に隠蔽工作を開始。中国は対策を講じ、トランプ大統領はプーチン大統領に電話をかける
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアでペスト（肺ペスト疑い）による死亡例が発生し、当局の情報隠蔽疑惑、WHOへの情報不足、米露首脳レベルの対応など国際的関心が極めて高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: イベントはロシア（シベリア・イルクーツク州）で発生しており、対象国リストには含まれない。中国は国境付近住民への備蓄呼びかけ等の予防的措置を取っているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。情報隠蔽疑惑やWHOへの情報非開示など、透明性に関する懸念が強い点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Эталон опасности: при каких условиях есть риск распространения чумы в Украине
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Benchmark of Danger: Under What Conditions Is There a Risk of the Plague Spreading in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: Russia's plague situation remains unclear, raising concerns for Ukraine. As of Oct 8, 2026, WHO says there is no full picture of plague spread in Russia. In Irkutsk Oblast, a 28-year-old employee of the Anti-Plague Institute was hospitalized with severe pneumonia at the end of September and died; 197 contacts were identified, with 189 hospitalized and isolated. Media reports suggest pneumonic plague, but official diagnosis is unconfirmed; pneumonia of unknown etiology has been cited. The WHO has requested information to enable risk assessment; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that a complete assessment is not yet possible. Kharkiv region officials deem the Irkutsk case a very low risk locally. Globally, plague remains annual, concentrated in Africa (DR Congo, Madagascar); Madagascar experiences seasonal bubonic plague. Precautions include airport screening for travelers from Russia; antibiotics remain effective if started early.

triage.headline_ja: 危険の指標：ウクライナでペストが拡大するリスクがあるのはどのような条件か
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州で肺ペスト疑いの死亡例が発生し、WHOが情報提供を要請するなど国際的懸念が高まっており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（イルクーツク州）及びウクライナへの懸念であり、DRCおよびマダガスカルは『世界的にペストは毎年発生している』という一般的背景情報として言及されているのみで、当該事例の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当するDRCも除外した。ロシア・ウクライナは対象国リストに含まれないため、結果としてverified_locationsは空配列となる。

article.articleHeadline: 岳山：俄羅斯鼠疫疑雲與泰國通靈師的預言 | 伊爾庫茨克研究所 | 不明原因肺炎 | 肺鼠疫與黑死病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yue Shan: Russia's plague rumors and the prophecies of a Thai medium | Irkutsk Institute | Pneumonia of unknown etiology | Pneumonic plague and the Black Death.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Russia, 28-year-old Daria Shipilova, a technician at the Irkutsk Epidemiology Institute for Plague, died on October 2 from an illness officially listed as pneumonia of unknown etiology; by October 6 about 200 contacts were quarantined as investigators probe a possible pneumonic plague linked to the institute. Officials deny plague; experts doubt that breaking a test tube could cause infection, though containment includes hospital isolation and a three-week quarantine for contacts. Since October 1, ambulances transporting contacts have been escorted by the FSB. Independent reporting notes historical bioweapons concerns and a 21-day observation rule for exposed staff. Separately, Thai clairvoyant Mor Plai predicted a 2026 pandemic with origins in Russia, describing a mixed, lab-linked outbreak involving tuberculosis and the Black Death, with escalation through 2027–2030. The article also cites a China–Russia cross-border infectious-disease drill in Heilongjiang (Aug 24–27) that involved the institute’s director.

triage.headline_ja: 岳山：ロシアのペスト疑惑とタイの霊媒師の予言｜イルクーツク研究所｜原因不明の肺炎｜肺ペストと黒死病
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染疑い事例はロシア（イルクーツク）で発生しており、対象国（タイ・中国）は予言の言及や訓練の文脈で触れられているに過ぎず、実際の発生地ではないため対象国監視の観点からは見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員の死亡事例が主題であり、タイは霊媒師の予言の文脈、中国は国境を越えた感染症対応訓練の文脈でのみ言及されている。いずれも対象国における実際の疾病発生を示すものではないため verified_locations は空とした。情報源も非公式・陰謀論的要素を含む記事であり、信頼性の検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vistoria no foco de gripe aviária em ave de subsistência no RS é finalizada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inspection at the avian influenza focus in backyard poultry in Rio Grande do Sul has been completed.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza focus in backyard poultry in Selbach, northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, has been declared closed after a 3 km radius inspection. On Oct 7, 2026, DDA teams inspected 70 properties and a nearby commercial farm within 10 km where no poultry housing was found. DDA director Rosane Collares said the investigations found no suspicions or records, marking the focus as ended, though vigilance and routine inspections will continue locally. The new backyard poultry case in Selbach was laboratory-confirmed by the Federal Laboratory for Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) in Campinas on Oct 5; samples had been submitted Oct 1. Currently, Selbach is the only active backyard poultry focus in Brazil. Three other foci are under wildlife investigation—two in Santa Catarina (Garopaba and Laguna) in sea lions, and one in Piauí (Coronel José Dias) in a wading bird (avocet or band-tailed pigeon).

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州の自家消費用家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生地点の調査が完了
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セルバッキ市の自家消費用家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生地点は検査の結果、感染拡大なしと確認され終息宣言済み。人への感染報告もなく、動物衛生の通常対応事例であるため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（野鳥・アシカを含む）における動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。発生地点は既に調査完了・終息と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Russian anti-plague institute employee dies of pneumonia of unknown etiology, raising concerns; Expert says risk of plague outbreak reaching China very low
article.articleSummary: One death of a researcher at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute from pneumonia of unknown etiology is under investigation after a Sep 25 lab accident involving Yersinia pestis; the patient, Daria Shupilova (28), died Oct 2, 2026. About 200 contacts were placed under medical observation or quarantine; nearly 5,000 lab tests found no dangerous pathogens and no plague infections detected. Rospotrebnadzor reports Irkutsk and Shelekhov remain stable; over 90% of contacts completed observation; WHO is monitoring and calls for full transparency; no epidemic risk identified in Irkutsk; Kremlin says media reports are exaggerated. Expert Li Tongzeng from Beijing says pneumonic plague is not highly contagious and the chance of spread to China is very low; overall risk of plague reaching China is deemed very low.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡、懸念高まる；専門家は中国へのペスト流行波及リスクは非常に低いと指摘
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所でのYersinia pestis関連事故後に研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、WHOが監視・透明性を求めるなど社会的・国際的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: イベントの実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州・シェレホフ）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。中国への言及は専門家が拡散リスクを「非常に低い」と評価する文脈のみで、実際の発生地ではないため除外した。感染拡大や新規感染者は確認されておらず、ロシア当局・WHOともに現時点で流行リスクは低いとしているが、死因病原体の確定や研究所事故の詳細など情報不足の点もあり、続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Kenya is currently an imported-case outbreak after a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi. The man, who traveled to Kenya via Uganda on Oct 3 and was admitted to Nairobi Hospital, died on Monday, prompting extensive contact tracing. About 10 relatives have been identified and quarantined, and 21 healthcare workers and other hospital staff who cared for him are under surveillance. The response also targets the airline chain: approximately 23 passengers and four crew members on the Entebbe–Kampala flight are being traced. WHO emphasizes that containment relies on rapid contact identification and quarantine to prevent community transmission; the incubation period is 2–8 days. WHO and Africa CDC are supporting Kenya, Uganda, and the DRC with surveillance, screening, border measures, and health-worker training.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、初のエボラ死亡例後に全接触者追跡を急ぐ―WHO当局者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例がケニアで確認され、国際便を介した複数国にまたがる接触者追跡が行われており、IHR基準の大半に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴があり発症・死亡はケニアで発生した輸入症例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは感染源として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 國際促俄公布鼠疫疑慮 川普：中共過去也稱控制局面 | 俄羅斯 | 鼠疫疫情 | 普京
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International community urges Russia to disclose concerns about the plague; Trump: The CCP previously claimed to have the situation under control | Russia | plague outbreak | Putin
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, external calls urge Russia to disclose details of a suspected pathogen leakage at a Russian laboratory linked to a plague outbreak among rodents in Siberia. The report provides no concrete case or death counts. U.S. President Donald Trump said he does not believe the incident is a bioweapon, and he expects more information after speaking with Russian President Vladimir Putin, whose birthday falls on the day. Trump noted Moscow’s statements that the outbreak is under control, and he emphasized the desire for Russian authorities to share more data with U.S. personnel about the Siberia situation. He also referenced past claims by the Chinese Communist Party that COVID-19 was under control, suggesting a pattern of assurances. The article centers on lab-leak concerns rather than confirmed epidemiological figures.

triage.headline_ja: 国際社会がロシアに鼠疫（ペスト）に関する情報公開を要求　トランプ氏：中国共産党も過去に『制御下にある』と主張していた｜ロシア｜鼠疫流行｜プーチン
triage.triage_reason: シベリアでの齧歯類における鼠疫流行とラボ流出疑惑を巡り、米露首脳を含む国際的な政治的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準の異常性と社会的関心の観点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（シベリア）における齧歯類の鼠疫流行と研究所流出疑惑が主題であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（中国・米国等）は比較事例として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: China gives Kenya Sh259m for Ebola, drought preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case, prompting international support for preparedness. China provided a total of $2 million (Sh259.5 million) as a cash grant to Kenya’s National Treasury, with Sh129.5 million allocated to Ebola preparedness and a similar amount to drought response. The grant was handed over by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan. The Ebola allocation aims to strengthen preparedness in light of the imported case; no case counts or fatalities are reported in the article. This assistance highlights ongoing Kenya-China cooperation to bolster public health capacity and emergency readiness for Ebola, and to support drought response, as of 8 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ケニアにエボラ・干ばつ対策として2億5950万シリング(Sh259m)を供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ症例が初確認され、中国が緊急対策資金を供与するなど国際的な関心・支援が集まっており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例と、それに対する中国からの資金援助。中国は資金提供国として登場するのみで、エボラ発生国はケニア（対象国リスト外）であるため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。症例数・死亡者数の詳細は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tempo instável reforça alerta para prevenção das arboviroses em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unsettled weather reinforces warning to prevent arboviral diseases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: 60,965 dengue cases and 43 deaths have been recorded in São Paulo state in 2026 as unstable, rainy, and warmer weather enhances Aedes aegypti breeding, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Authorities warn that rain, humidity, and higher temperatures across regions can create breeding sites, especially in outdoor areas with standing water. Common containers include plant pots, gutters, tires, bottles, and water tanks; residents are urged to eliminate standing water inside and around homes. A state-wide campaign, The greatest danger in your home may be where you least expect, emphasizes inspecting residences for indoor breeding sites. Dengue symptoms include sudden high fever (>38°C) lasting 2-7 days, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, weakness, nausea/vomiting, and rash; warning signs—severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, dizziness, bleeding, or fainting—require immediate care. The Dengue 100 Dúvidas portal offers FAQs on dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: 不安定な天候がサンパウロ州のアルボウイルス感染症予防警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州でのデング熱の季節的流行（症例数・死亡数は一定規模）だが、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、公的な予防啓発キャンペーンの域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で毎年季節的に流行する既知の疾病であり、本記事は州による予防啓発キャンペーンの一環。症例数・死亡数は報告されているが、突発的異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Quarantine numbers climb to 66 as a suspected Wajir case adds to Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: 66 people are in quarantine at the National Police Service Isolation Centre after Kenya confirmed its first Ebola Virus Disease case imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Contacts are categorized as primary (family, rising from five to ten, including the mother and wife), secondary and tertiary; Nairobi Hospital contacts grew to include staff, cleaners and airline-linked individuals, with samples collected and results awaited. Security is posted at the isolation centre to prevent escapes. Authorities report no evidence of widespread transmission: 4,971 health workers trained, 652,000 travellers screened at 15 entry points, and 263 alerts across 17 counties. Five laboratories (including mobile units) test with a 6–12 hour turnaround; over 268 samples tested, one positive. Designated facilities provide 241 beds (Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi, National Police Service Hospital, Port Reitz, The Nairobi Hospital), with more in Busia. PPE: WHO 1,000 sets; India 6,000; China $2 million grant.

triage.headline_ja: 検疫者数が66人に増加、ワジルでの疑い症例がエボラへの懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: DRCから輸入されたエボラ確定症例がケニアで発生し、接触者が66人に拡大、複数県で警戒アラートが出ており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例とその対応だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCはエボラ流行国として対象国リストに含まれるため記載。WHO・インド・中国からのPPE支援があり国際的関心・支援が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Bas-Uélé : dix cas confirmés d'Ebola notifiés dont quatre décès. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bas-Uele: ten confirmed Ebola cases reported, including four deaths.
article.articleSummary: On 8 October 2026, Bas-Uélé province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 10 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including 4 deaths, a case fatality rate of 40%. Six individuals remain under surveillance as part of the outbreak response. Provincial authorities described the situation as relatively under control for now, thanks to vigilant field teams, while confirming that epidemiological monitoring continues. The government, speaking after the 19th meeting of the Provincial Council of Ministers presided by the governor, urged residents to maintain heightened vigilance and strictly observe preventive measures, including barrier precautions, to limit transmission. The Council noted the evolving health situation and ongoing surveillance in Bas-Uélé as the outbreak progresses.

triage.headline_ja: バ・ウェレ州:エボラ確定症例10件報告、うち4人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例10例・死亡4例(致死率40%)が報告されており、重篤な公衆衛生事案かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 致死率40%と高く、州政府は「現時点では比較的制御下」としているが監視継続中。続報でクラスター拡大や近隣国への波及有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde do AC monitora pessoas que tiveram contato com casos suspeitos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre Health Department monitors people who had contact with suspected measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases under investigation in Acre, Brazil, after two suspected cases involving residents of Puerto Maldonado, Peru. As of 8 October 2026, health surveillance monitors contacts. The patients are an 11-month-old child in intensive care and a 30-year-old woman hospitalized without severe symptoms; both were treated in Rio Branco after passing through Assis Brasil and Brasileia. RT-PCR initially detected measles virus; samples go to Fiocruz for confirmatory analysis, with investigation ongoing. Findings indicate importation, with possible exposure outside Acre; final classification depends on the investigation. Vaccination blocking measures are planned in Brasileia, at Huerb, and at Into, targeting indicated individuals. SESacre, Ministry of Health, Lacen, Renaveh, and municipal secretariats coordinate with national Cievs and Peruvian health authorities via IHR. Emphasize vaccination and prompt care if fever, rash, cough, coryza, or conjunctivitis, with travel/contact history.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州保健局、麻疹疑い例の接触者を監視
triage.triage_reason: ペルー在住者に関連する麻疹疑い例がブラジル・アクレ州で確認され、重症(ICU入院)例を含む。国境を越えた輸入事例としてIHRを通じペルー当局と調整中であり、IHR基準の重大性・国際的拡大の2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ペルー（プエルトマルドナード）在住者がブラジル・アクレ州で発症した輸入麻疹疑い例。確定検査はFiocruzで実施中。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade dos municípios está em alerta ou risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: Nearly Half of Municipalities Are on Alert or at Risk.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's health authorities report that nearly half of municipalities are on alert or at risk for Aedes aegypti–borne arboviruses. The May–August surveillance, released by the Ministry of Health on October 7, informs states and municipalities on prevention and control actions. Dengue cases are down by about 70% in 2026 compared with the same period in 2025. By September 26, Brazil logged about 470,500 probable dengue cases, versus 1.5 million in the prior-year period. Reductions were also observed for chikungunya and Zika, though the article does not provide exact counts. The findings underscore ongoing, but improved, transmission dynamics and support continued vector-control measures to reduce arbovirus burden nationwide. Across Brazil, reductions in dengue, chikungunya, and Zika suggest improved transmission control.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ：自治体のほぼ半数が警戒または危険レベルに
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱は前年比で大幅減少しており、既知の季節性サーベイランス報告であり新規性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 感染者数は前年から大幅減少しており、定例の保健省サーベイランス報告。流行継続のリスクはあるが緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Municípios em alerta para Aedes chegam a 49,2% no LIRAa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipalities on alert for Aedes reach 49.2% in LIRAa.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, Brazil’s Health Ministry reports the second LIRAa cycle: 49.2% of 3,732 municipalities are in alert or risk for Aedes aegypti. May–Aug data show dengue, chikungunya, and Zika infections declining versus 2025. By Sept 26, dengue probable cases: ~470,500 (down ~70% from 1.5 million). Chikungunya: ~67,900 (down 43% from 118,885). Zika: ~2,141 (down from 3,724). Breeding sites: 42.3% plant pots/dishes, 26.1% water storage, 23% tires/trash. Regional patterns: North—tires/trash; Northeast—water storage; Southeast/South/Central-West—domestic containers. Government actions include training >300,000 Community Health Agents by year-end, plus vector control measures (ovitrampas ~2,000 municipalities, BR Intradomiciliar spraying, Larvicide Stations, Wolbachia). Public vigilance urged to cover water tanks, dispose of waste, and empty standing water.

triage.headline_ja: LIRAaにおいてAedes警戒状態の自治体が49.2%に達する
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等は前年比で減少傾向にあるが、依然として約半数の自治体がAedes蚊の警戒・リスク状態にあり、媒介感染症の継続的な監視が必要な状況である。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年より大幅に減少しているが、約半数の自治体がAedes蚊警戒状態にあり、季節的な媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱）の継続的なモニタリングが必要。政府は既にワクチン・媒介制御対策（ワクチンテ罠、ワーコバクテリア等）を実施中で、深刻な公衆衛生危機とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo: Médicos Sin Fronteras alerta que brote de ébola en Kivu Norte está "fuera de control" - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Doctors Without Borders warns that Ebola outbreak in North Kivu is 'out of control' - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: MSF warns Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, DR Congo is 'out of control.' As of Oct 2, Congo’s INSP reports 8,442 cases and 4,080 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), across 64 health zones in seven provinces, making this the second deadliest Ebola event on record. North Kivu now accounts for ~40% of new confirmed cases, up from 24% in late August, with many diagnoses from transmission chains not yet identified. A striking 75% of virus-related deaths occur in communities, where stigma, fear, and reluctance to seek care lead to home deaths and ongoing transmission; overwhelmed health facilities in Butembo force transfer of confirmed patients, elevating transmission risk during travel. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus; WHO warns it’s the fastest-spreading outbreak to date and could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak. Globally, 2,213 recovered and 846 still in isolation or under treatment. Uganda reported 20 cases and was declared outbreak-free by WHO on Aug 26; Kenya reported its first imported case linked to DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団、北キブ州のエボラ出血熱流行が「制御不能」と警告
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州を中心にエボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が急増し（致死率48.3%）、MSFが「制御不能」と警告。史上最速の拡大ペースで国際的伝播（ウガンダ、ケニア）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの波及が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOが史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行、かつ最速拡大と警告しており、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: India News | IIT BHU Scientists Develop Novel Green Light-activated Technology to Fight Bacterial Infections
article.articleSummary: Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India-based IIT BHU researchers publish in Communications Chemistry on green-light-activated Os(II) metallophotoantibiotics for antibacterial therapy and infected wound healing. The interdisciplinary study by chemistry and biomedical engineering groups introduces Os1, Os2, Os3, activated by green light to generate reactive oxygen species that inhibit bacterial growth and disrupt biofilms. In vitro tests against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus and Bacillus subtilis show Os1 as the most promising; green-light exposure yields about 85% inhibition of biofilm formation for E. coli and B. subtilis. The compounds also accelerated healing of infected wounds in rat models, indicating potential against antimicrobial resistance challenges. Published October 8, 2026, the work underscores IIT BHU’s interdisciplinary innovation from Varanasi in addressing bacterial infections through light-activated chemistry.

triage.headline_ja: インドニュース | IIT BHUの科学者が細菌感染症と闘う新規の緑色光活性化技術を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究開発（光活性化抗菌技術）に関する学術発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、抗菌技術の研究成果発表であるため、トリアージ対象外。E. coliは研究対象菌種として言及されているのみで、アウトブレイク事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Influenza Tipe A, Masker dan Vaksinasi Jadi Pilihan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Influenza A, Masks and Vaccination Become Options.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Indonesia emphasizes preventing Influenza A with masks and annual vaccination. In Jakarta, Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, advises wearing masks in crowded or enclosed settings to reduce transmission and protect others by limiting respiratory particles. Vaccination is recommended yearly, especially for children and the elderly, with vaccine composition updated to match circulating strains; antibody protection wanes over time. The public should follow cough and sneeze etiquette—disposables tissues disposed after use; if unavailable, cover with the inside of the elbow. Hand hygiene is essential, via soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizer. Influenza A spreads through respiratory droplets; symptoms typically appear 1–4 days after exposure and include fever, chills, sore throat, headache, muscle pain, and fatigue. Pneumonia is a potential complication. Diagnostic tests include rapid antigen tests from nasal/nasopharyngeal swabs and PCR in severe or high-risk cases.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型予防のため、マスクとワクチン接種が選択肢に
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、季節性インフルエンザ予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の重大な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、一般的な予防啓発情報であるため、インドネシアを含め発生国として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Sesacre diz que investigação epidemiológica continua em casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesacre says that the epidemiological investigation continues in measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz confirmed two measles cases in residents of Puerto Maldonado, Peru, who were treated in Acre, Brazil, on 2026-10-08. The patients are an 11-month-old child and a 30-year-old woman from Peru who passed through Assis Brasil and Brasileia before receiving care in Rio Branco. RT-PCR had already detected the virus, and the confirmatory Fiocruz analysis classifies both as measles. Epidemiological investigation continues to identify the probable infection site, exposures, and contacts; current information points to possible infection outside Acre territory, but final classification as imported cases awaits the investigation. Authorities are monitoring close contacts and exposed individuals as part of the response.

triage.headline_ja: Sesacre（アクレ州保健局）、麻疹症例の疫学調査が継続中と発表
triage.triage_reason: ペルー人患者2例（乳児と成人）がブラジル・アクレ州で麻疹と確認され、接触者調査や感染源特定が継続中だが、感染地・重症度・拡大リスクなど多くの情報が未確定のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 患者はペルー(Puerto Maldonado)居住者だが、ブラジル国内（Assis Brasil, Brasileia, Rio Branco）で受診・確認されており、ブラジル保健当局が調査主体。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため、Brazilのみをverified_locationsに記載。感染地がアクレ州外（ペルー側）の可能性が示唆されているが、最終確定は調査待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Katanga : une campagne de riposte vaccinale lancée après la détection de trois cas de poliomyélite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Katanga: an immunization response campaign launched after the detection of three polio cases.
article.articleSummary: Three poliomyelitis cases have been reported in Haut-Katanga's Mufunga Sampwe and Kambove health zones. In response, provincial Health Minister Dr. Jean-Claude Kisenga Mwana Umbi launched a rapid vaccination campaign from October 8–12, 2026, in Lwambo, Kambove territory, about 30 kilometers from Likasi. The mass campaign targets children aged 0–5 years and uses a door-to-door strategy with oral polio vaccine, funded by partners including the World Health Organization. During the launch, the minister urged parents and the community to support vaccination teams and protect children from polio’s consequences; he also thanked President Félix Tshisekedi Tshilombo and Governor Martin Kazembe. He symbolically vaccinated children to inaugurate the operation. Poliomyelitis, a highly contagious disease caused by poliovirus, mainly affects under-fives and spreads fecal-orally via contaminated water or food; vaccination is the main prevention method.

triage.headline_ja: オー・カタンガ州：ポリオ3症例確認後、ワクチン接種対応キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCのオー・カタンガ州でポリオ症例が3例確認され、IHR上常に報告対象となる疾患であり、WHO支援下で緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されていることからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMalawi（Northern Region）が含まれているが、記事本文では言及されておらず除外した。ポリオはIHR Annex2において常時通知対象疾患であり、国際的な感染拡大リスクも内在するためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en África: murió un hombre en Kenia y buscan a 27 pasajeros que viajaron con él
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Africa: a man died in Kenya and authorities are seeking 27 passengers who traveled with him.
article.articleSummary: First imported Ebola case confirmed in Kenya, linked to Bundibugyo virus. A Kenyan national, resident in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, began symptoms about a month prior and traveled to Nairobi on October 3, being isolated on arrival; the patient died on October 5 and was cremated on October 6. Laboratory confirmation by the National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute identified Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Authorities are tracing 28 close contacts and 27 flight passengers from the same trip who are being quarantined. Kenya has been on alert since May 2026 after outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; 267 people tested with 1 confirmed case previously; 2,971 health workers trained; over 652,000 passengers screened on entry. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and is not airborne; early symptoms resemble flu (fever, fatigue, body aches, headache, sore throat); emphasize hand hygiene and avoiding contact with fluids, beds, and clothing of the sick.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アフリカで拡大：ケニアで男性が死亡、同乗した27名の乗客を捜索中
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ症例（ブンディブギョ株）による死亡が確認され、接触者・同乗者の追跡が行われており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住のケニア人で、ケニア入国後に死亡した輸入症例。記事の主題はケニア国内での対応（接触者追跡・隔離）であり、DRC・ウガンダでの現行アウトブレイクについては背景情報として言及されるのみで詳細な発生状況の記述がないため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCも主題として扱わずverified_locationsから除外した。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz confirma casos de sarampo em bebê e mulher no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz confirms measles cases in an infant and a woman in Acre.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, Fiocruz, Brazil’s national reference lab, confirmed two measles cases in Acre state, following initial RT-PCR detection. Patients are an 11-month-old child and a 30-year-old woman, both residents of Puerto Maldonado, Peru, who were treated in Rio Branco after passing through Assis Brasil and Brasileia. Epidemiological investigation ongoing to identify likely infection source, exposures, and contacts; provisional indications point to infection outside Acre, but definitive classification as imported cases awaits investigation conclusions. Health authorities are monitoring contacts and potential local transmission, with no additional cases reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス研究所、アクレ州の乳児と女性の麻疹感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: ペルー国境地域からブラジル・アクレ州に麻疹感染者（乳児・女性）が確認され、越境移動を伴う輸入症例の可能性があり、地域内伝播リスクの観点から国際的拡大懸念がある。
triage.notes: 患者はペルー・プエルトマルドナード在住だが、ブラジル・アクレ州（リオブランコ）で診断・治療を受けており、ブラジル国内での公衆衛生事案として扱う。感染源特定の疫学調査が継続中であり、地域内伝播の有無は未確定。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta highlights role of youth in fight against tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta emphasized that young people play a key role in India’s effort to eliminate tuberculosis (TB). Speaking at the national launch of the Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) teams at Bharat Mandapam, organized by Union Health and Family Welfare Minister J.P. Nadda, she highlighted sustained TB elimination efforts under Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The JOSH initiative seeks to fuse health, youth, and defence sectors and broaden public participation in the campaign. Gupta said the program will mobilize young volunteers, NCC cadets, elected representatives, and officials to reach out to communities, spread awareness about TB, and strengthen elimination efforts. By channeling the energy and determination of youth into this mission, the fight against TB can reach every section of society.

triage.headline_ja: デリー州首相レカ・グプタ氏、結核撲滅運動における若者の役割を強調
triage.triage_reason: 政策広報・啓発活動に関する記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド政府の結核撲滅キャンペーン（JOSHイニシアチブ）の広報活動に関するものであり、新規の感染症発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Exercice budgétaire 2027 : le paludisme placé parmi les priorités absolues de santé publique (ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiscal Year 2027: Malaria Placed Among the Absolute Priorities of Public Health (Minister of Health) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Malaria is declared an absolute public-health priority in Kinshasa’s 2027 budget, following 2025 malaria case and death counts and 2026 first-half totals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On Oct 2, 2026, Health Minister Dr Samuel Roger Kamba pledged no budget cuts to malaria control and committed to unlocking PNLP operating funds for Q3 2026, securing PNLP needs in the 2027 Finance Law, and strengthening domestic resources amid shrinking external funding. Four pillars include internal support via the Health Promotion Fund (FPS) and compulsory health insurance for simple cases, plus partner backing through a Memorandum of Understanding with the U.S. Government and the Global Fund against AIDS, TB and Malaria. Kinshasa reported 1,518,193 malaria cases in H1 2026 after 2,700,655 in 2025. Levi Mbuta, President of the Provincial Assembly, called malaria the leading cause of hospitalization, morbidity, and death in the DRC, second in Africa after Nigeria and seventh worldwide by prevalence, urging PNLP priorities be reflected in the 2027 budget and implemented by the provincial executive.

triage.headline_ja: 2027年度予算:マラリアが公衆衛生の絶対的優先事項に位置づけられる（保健大臣）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるマラリアに関する予算・政策的な報道であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCにおけるマラリア対策の予算編成・政策方針に関する内容であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。症例数は既存の流行状況の統計として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Acre investiga dois casos suspeitos de sarampo vindos do Peru e prepara vacinação de bloqueio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre investigates two suspected measles cases imported from Peru and prepares for ring vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected measles cases imported from Peru raise an Acre, Brazil health alert as of 2026-10-08. Patients from Puerto Maldonado traveled via Assis Brasil and Brasileia to Rio Branco, where they’re hospitalized: an 11‑month‑old infant in grave condition in the ICU and a 30‑year‑old woman also hospitalized but not critically ill. Initial RT‑PCR tests show detectable measles virus; samples are sent to Fiocruz for confirmatory analysis. Authorities plan ring vaccination in Brasileia and Rio Branco hospital units (Huerb and Into) for those indicated to receive the vaccine, aiming to reduce transmission if confirmed. Contact tracing is led by Cievs Acre, with teams in Rio Branco and Brasileia border region, and support from the Ministério da Saúde, Lacen, Renaveh, and Peruvian health authorities. Investigators seek the infection source, with one hypothesis that exposure occurred outside Brazilian territory.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、ペルーから持ち込まれた麻疹疑い2例を調査し、封じ込めワクチン接種を準備
triage.triage_reason: ペルーからの輸入麻疹疑い症例がブラジル国境地域で確認され、ICU収容の重症乳児例もあり、国際的拡大と異常性の両面でIHR基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ペルー（Puerto Maldonado）由来の輸入例であるため、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれず除外。ブラジル・アクレ州での国境を越えた感染拡大と対応状況が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Cusat shifts classes online amid surge in chickenpox cases
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox has prompted the Cochin University of Science and Technology (Cusat) to suspend offline classes at its Thrikkakara and Marine campuses in Kerala, moving to online delivery through Oct 16 after two hostel cases last week and a regional surge this week. Infected students have vacated hostels and some examinations have been postponed. The decision followed health authorities' directives and department heads' requests; seven-to-14-day protocol shaped the extension. There are over 4,000 students on campus, with cleaning, spraying and fogging conducted to curb spread. District records show 48 chickenpox cases this month; the state tallies 589 this month and 31,318 cases in the year, with nine deaths. Kalamassery municipal chairperson Jamal Manakadan urged decisive measures to prevent spread, noting the need for precautions while authorities deem the situation manageable.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘患者急増のため、クサット大学がオンライン授業に切り替え
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の感染症で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、ケララ州での症例急増（年間31,318例、死亡9例）と大学の授業オンライン化という社会的対応があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 水痘（Varicella）はワクチンで予防可能な既知疾患であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、インド・ケララ州での局地的な症例急増と大学の対応は地域的な注視対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : 51 cas d'Ebola enregistrés à ce jour (Division provinciale de la santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: 51 Ebola cases recorded to date (Provincial Health Division) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: In Tshopo Province, Ebola virus disease has reached 51 notified cases, with 20 deaths and 25 recoveries, according to the National Program for Health Promotion and Communication (PNCPS/DPS) in Kisangani, in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. A new death was reported on Thursday, bringing the death toll to 20, with two deaths this week. Seven health zones have reported Ebola cases in Tshopo; five are in Kisangani city, and two are elsewhere in the province. Hubert Loanga Tembele of PNCPS/DPS warned against rumors and misinformation that deter patients from seeking care at Ebola Treatment Centers or push them toward traditional healers and prayer houses. He condemned threats and violence against response teams, and patients fleeing treatment centers, which worsens transmission. He urged communities to own the response, trust health teams, and adhere to prevention and barrier measures.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ出血熱、これまでに51症例を記録（州保健局）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の継続的な拡大（51症例、死者20名）で、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと医療忌避・暴力等の対応阻害要因があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約39%（20/51）と高く、複数の保健区にまたがる拡大、治療忌避や応答チームへの暴力など流行制御を困難にする要因が報告されている。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限の有無については記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola vaccine enters clinical trials in Africa as DR Congo battles outbreak
