article.articleSummary: Phase Ib trials of the Oxford ChAdOx1 Ebola vaccine began in Uganda on Oct 6 as part of the DR Congo Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak, which has 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths since May. Seven Congolese provinces are affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo and South-Ubangi. A Moderna candidate has also received ethics approval for Phase Ib in Uganda after Phase Ia in Canada in August. The Bundibugyo virus outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. In August, Congo allocated 70,000 Ervebo vaccines (targeting Zaire ebolavirus) from the stockpile, with over 7,700 frontline workers vaccinated. Kenya reported its first imported case—the patient died after traveling from Congo. CEPI announced a $16.5 million partnership with Minapharm Group to develop a Bundibugyo vaccine candidate.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラワクチンがアフリカで臨床試験開始、コンゴ民主共和国はアウトブレイクと戦う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクは8,728例・4,205死亡と深刻で、ケニアへの越境輸入例（死亡）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア（輸入症例・死亡）やウガンダ（臨床試験実施国）、カナダ（ワクチン第Ia相試験地）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であり、国際的な支援（CEPI、Moderna、Oxfordの介入）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Quase metade dos municípios está em alerta para Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly half of the municipalities are on alert for Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Nearly half of Brazilian municipalities are under alert or risk for Aedes aegypti, per the second cycle of LIRAa (May–August). Of 3,732 municipalities reporting, 49.2% recorded concerning indices. Dengue remains the main threat, with 470,500 probable cases as of 26 September 2026, down from 1.5 million in the same period 2025 (~70% decline). Chikungunya fell 43% to about 67,900; Zika declined 35% to 2,141. Primary breeding sites are household items (pots, dishware) 42.3%; water storage containers 26.1%; tires and waste 23%, with regional variation: more tires/litter in the North and more water reservoirs in the Northeast. To curb transmission ahead of summer, Brazil plans to train over 300,000 Community Health Agents, deploy Endemic Disease Control Agents, use ovitraps, spraying, and larvicidal stations, and apply Wolbachia. Public actions include covering water tanks, cleaning gutters, removing standing water, and proper disposal of tires, cans, bottles, and debris.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの自治体の約半数がネッタイシマカに対して警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱は前年比で大幅減少傾向にあるが、依然として多数の自治体で媒介蚊リスクが高く、夏季前の継続的な監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2026年の症例数は2025年同期比で大幅減少（デング熱約70%減）しており、現時点では季節性の媒介蚊対策に関する平常的な公衆衛生報道と判断される。夏季に向けた今後の症例動向を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 8 600 cas d'Ebola et 4 178 décès, la riposte renforcée dans sept provinces
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: more than 8,600 Ebola cases and 4,178 deaths, intensified response in seven provinces.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is contending with its 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak. As of October 8, 2026, government figures show 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths, with 2,259 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.2%). Transmission remains active, with 62 new confirmed cases, 30 deaths and 24 recoveries recorded in the last 24 hours. The outbreak spans seven provinces and 64 health zones, with Ituri province the principal hotspot, accounting for about 74.8% of confirmed cases. In North Kivu, the Alimbongo health zone reported four cases, including two deaths. Vaccination campaigns continue in Bas-Uélé and have been launched in Makiso-Kisangani and Mangobo in Tshopo province. Notably, 11 health zones have recorded 42 consecutive days without new cases, signaling progress toward interrupting transmission. Authorities continue intensified response: epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, safe burials, patient care, and vaccine deployment to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ症例8,600件以上、死者4,178人、7州で対応強化
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%の大規模エボラ流行が7州64保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高いためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行として継続中。一部保健地区で42日間新規症例なしの進展も見られるが、全体として依然活発な伝播が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Nova vakcina protiv ebole ulazi u klinička ispitivanja u Africi dok se DR Kongo bori protiv epidemije
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola vaccine enters clinical trials in Africa as DR Congo battles an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda hosts Phase Ib trials of the ChAdOx1 Ebola vaccine (University of Oxford) targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, starting October 6, following Phase Ia in the UK in July; another candidate from Moderna recently secured ethics approval for Phase Ib in Uganda after Phase Ia in Canada in August. DR Congo reports 8,728 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 4,205 deaths since May, across seven provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and South Ubangi. Kenya reports its first imported case, a patient who died after travel from Congo. The current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists; 70,000 Ervebo doses were allocated in August for use in this outbreak (Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus). Over 7,700 frontline workers have been vaccinated. In August, CEPI announced a $16.5 million deal with Minapharm Group to advance a Bundibugyo vaccine candidate.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラワクチンがアフリカで臨床試験開始、コンゴ民主共和国はエボラ流行と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続し、死者4,205人・症例8,728人に達し、ケニアへの越境症例も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・カナダ・英国はワクチン試験や輸入症例の発生国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないか、主題である流行発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: MP screens 1.12 lakh TB patients under intensified drive
article.articleSummary: Intensified TB screening in Madhya Pradesh identified 1.12 lakh TB patients, up from 25,000–30,000 previously, through JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) teams—comprising MY Bharat volunteers and NCC cadets—conducted door-to-door screening and early treatment linkage. The drive, launched at Gandhi Medical College, Bhopal, with Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda virtually inaugurating the teams, aims to accelerate TB elimination by ensuring six months of therapy, nutritious food, and Nikshay Mitras support. Pregnant women are urged to complete antenatal check-ups. State-wide screens also cover non-communicable diseases such as hypertension, diabetes, fatty liver disease, and sickle cell anemia. Eight TB-free gram panchayats, three Nikshay Mitras, and five health officials were honored; the event drew over 200 in-person attendees and more than 5,000 virtual participants.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州、強化キャンペーンで11.2万人の結核患者をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核検診・啓発活動を報じる内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 既知疾患(結核)のルーティンスクリーニング活動の報道であり、新規発生や異常事態ではないため対象国locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Minas Gerais alerta para possibilidade de nova epidemia de dengue em 2027 - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais Health Secretariat warns of the possibility of a new dengue epidemic in 2027 - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, faces potential dengue epidemic in 2027, after the 2024 outbreak—the worst on record with over 1.6 million cases and more than 1,000 deaths. Health Secretary Fábio Baccheretti notes arboviruses—dengue, chikungunya, and zika—cycle in roughly three-year epidemics; the last major wave was 2024, with a 2027 cycle anticipated. Climate factors—rising temperatures and increased rainfall, amplified by El Niño—are expected to elevate Aedes aegypti transmission risk across the state. Dengue could affect all of Minas Gerais, while chikungunya may hit northern regions, Triângulo Mineiro, and Vale do Aço at different times. Responses include expanding dengue vaccination, Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes and a biofactory for release, plus chikungunya vaccine rollout and dengue vaccination in parts of the population. Emphasis on eliminating domestic mosquito breeding sites (80-90% of foci) and community engagement, with drone surveillance supporting inspections.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州保健局、2027年のデング熱新規流行の可能性を警告 - BH 24 Horas
triage.triage_reason: 2027年における将来的な流行可能性についての予測・注意喚起記事であり、現時点で実際の症例急増や異常事態は報告されていないため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: India Backs Kenya's Ebola Fight, Sends 6,000 PPE Kits
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a single imported Ebola Virus Disease case from the Democratic Republic of Congo; the patient died on 6 October 2026, with no evidence of wide transmission. The response is guided by verified epidemiological data, and Kenya remains vigilant. India donated 6,000 PPE kits to support health workers, signaling international solidarity. Kenya’s National Incident Management System has been active since May 2026, with national and county emergency structures on high alert. Surveillance has intensified at health facilities and communities; 4,971 health workers have been trained in Ebola preparedness and response. Entry screening continues at 15 Points of Entry, with over 652,000 travellers screened. Additional support comes from WHO (1,000 PPE kits) and partners including the United States Government, IGAD, Africa CDC, and other development partners.

article.articleHeadline: Nadda, Delhi CM Launch JOSH Teams to Boost Youth-Led TB Fight
article.articleSummary: TB in India: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda and Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched JOSH Teams under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan to boost youth-led community action against tuberculosis. In New Delhi on Oct 8, Nadda cited WHO data showing a 21% decline in TB incidence nationwide and treatment coverage rising to 92%. He framed TB elimination as a people’s movement, not just government action, stressing youth engagement. JOSH Teams will roll out in the first phase across 11 states, with expansion planned. Delhi CM Gupta highlighted collaboration with the Ministries of Youth Affairs and Sports and Defence to extend reach, help raise awareness on prevention, early detection, and treatment, and reduce stigma. The initiative aims to mobilise youth and communities to make timely care accessible and advance the TB Mukt Bharat objective of nationwide elimination.

triage.notes: 記事はTB発生率が21%減少し治療カバレッジが92%に向上したとの好転データを示しており、政策イベント報道であって疫学的シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Aedes: quase metade dos municípios está em alerta ou risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Newspaper: Aedes mosquitoes: nearly half of municipalities are on alert or at risk.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry announced the second cycle of the LIRAa Rapid Indices Survey for Aedes aegypti, showing that 49.2% of the 3,732 Brazilian municipalities submitting data are at alert or risk for the mosquito that transmits dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The May–August survey results, released on Oct 7, 2026, indicate ongoing Aedes aegypti infestation risk across many areas, though overall infection data improved versus the previous year. Dengue cases continue to fall. The findings are intended to help Brazilian states and municipalities direct prevention and vector-control actions, focusing resources on areas with higher indices of mosquito presence to curb arbovirus transmission.

article.articleHeadline: 中共隱瞞麻疹和新冠疫情 疊加感染恐致命 | 麻疹疫情 | 十一長假 | 多重感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CCP Conceals Measles and COVID-19 Outbreaks; Co-infections Could Be Fatal | Measles Outbreak | National Day Long Holiday | Multiple Infections
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in New York State triggers a disaster emergency as the United States reports nearly 3,900 measles cases this year—the highest in 35 years—with New York declaring a state disaster on October 5. China’s health authorities allege concealment of a measles outbreak and warn of a multi-virus environment, with more than 20 circulating pathogens led by SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). After the National Day holiday, infections from COVID-19 and influenza A rise, heightening risks of co-infections and severe disease, including pneumonia and fatal outcomes. In southern China, dengue fever and chikungunya have persisted for months in Guangdong and Guangxi, while measles cases in China were about 60 in July–August, though actual numbers are said to be higher, especially among minors. Beijing funeral homes report increasing deaths from heart attacks and strokes, with concern about transmission from infectious disease hospitals such as You’an and Ditan.

triage.notes: 記事は反体制系メディア(NTDTV)の報道で、中国当局による感染症隠蔽を主張する内容。公式データとの裏付けが乏しく、米国ニューヨーク州の麻疹非常事態は対象国リスト外（米国）のため除外。中国南部（広東・広西）でのデング熱・チクングニア熱の長期流行、麻疹の過小報告疑惑について続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă! Tot mai multe țări iau măsuri la granițe, după suspiciunile de ciumă din Rusia. Unde sunt verificați călătorii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert! More and more countries are taking border measures after suspicions of plague in Russia. Where travelers are being screened.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Irkutsk, Siberia, reports the death of a 28-year-old employee at the Institute of Antiplague Research after severe pneumonia. Officials say the pneumonia is of unknown cause and no plague cases have been confirmed in the Irkutsk region, though pneumonic plague is suspected pending laboratory results; about 200 people who had contact with the woman are under surveillance or in quarantine. Border controls have been intensified across several countries: Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan increased screening; Uzbekistan and Mongolia raised surveillance; Indonesia tightened checks at entry points including Bali. Armenia is considering enhanced entry screening and has created an inter-ministerial group led by the health minister to coordinate measures. The World Health Organization says the initial risk to the general population is reduced but cautions that data are incomplete; Europe is very low risk, Russia low, and the Irkutsk region between moderate and low.

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul está em alerta para casos de SRAG, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul is on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) alert in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, per Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin released Oct 8, 2026. MS is among states at SRAG alert level, though no long-term rise; metapneumovirus cases are increasing there. Nationally, SRAG remains stable or fluctuating over six weeks, with increases in the last three; rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and Covid-19 are growing. RSV and influenza B SRAG cases are declining, while influenza A remains stable and low. The bulletin notes a slight uptick among children and adolescents 2-14; higher alert levels in Alagoas, Roraima, Sergipe due to pediatric increases. Capitals Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, Sao Luis, Vitoria also show rising SRAG. In 2026 Brazil has 161,053 SRAG cases; RSV, rhinovirus, and influenza A are most frequently detected. Children under 2 are most affected by cases; elderly 65+ most deaths. Vaccination: maintain COVID-19 shots; pregnant women should vaccinate against RSV.

article.articleHeadline: Munger News: रात के अंधेरे में खून के नमूनों से हो रही परजीवी की तलाश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Munger News: The search for parasites using blood samples in the dark of night.
article.articleSummary: Lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) control efforts are underway in Munger district, India, with a comprehensive 'Night Blood Survey' to detect microfilariae. District Vector-borne Disease Control Officer Dr. Raman Kumar notes that blood samples from 2,673 residents across blocks have been collected to gauge true infection rates and halt transmission. Sampling is conducted 10 PM–2 AM because the parasite's microfilariae are active at night; if detected, patients receive immediate treatment with Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) and Albendazole. Teams of ANMs and ASHA workers aim to collect at least 300 samples per selected area. The vector for transmission is Culex mosquitoes. Early detection and timely treatment are the primary prevention strategy. The article does not report confirmed cases or deaths to date.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Kenya muscle sa riposte, des failles dénoncées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya steps up its response, weaknesses exposed.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola virus disease case, with the patient dying in Nairobi, prompting a strengthened national response and highlighting border-preparedness gaps. President William Ruto announced rapid contact tracing and isolation of all contacts, including 23 health workers who treated the patient, and the isolation of family members. Five isolation centers with 241 beds have been prepared. International support totals over US$9 million from the United States and US$400 million from the World Bank to bolster surveillance, treatment capacity, and protective equipment. Health professionals warn frontline agents, especially near border regions, still lack targeted training and adequate gear, calling for transparent assessment of national preparedness. Kenya and Uganda have launched an epidemiological investigation; the patient reportedly received care in the Democratic Republic of Congo before passing through Uganda to Nairobi, underscoring the need for cross-border data sharing and vigilant contact tracing.

article.articleHeadline: Rusia pone fin a las medidas de prevención por el posible brote de peste neumónica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Ends Preventive Measures Amid Possible Pneumonic Plague Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Russia halted preventive measures after Irkutsk region’s suspected pneumonic plague outbreak, with over 5,500 clinical analyses finding no health problems or dangerous pathogens. A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk and Far East Plague Research Institute died in Shelekhov; authorities have not confirmed plague, describing the case as pneumonia of unknown etiology. Two hypotheses under investigation: infection contracted in Thailand or an accidental laboratory exposure to pathogens at the workplace. The Kremlin welcomed US President Donald Trump’s offer of assistance but urged reliance on Russian health authorities as investigations proceed. Meanwhile, the U.S. issued a provisional alert regarding a possible pneumonic plague in the Siberian region. The situation centers on the Irkutsk area and ongoing scrutiny of exposure and diagnostic results.

article.articleHeadline: Jaboticatubas orienta estudantes sobre doenças transmitidas pela água em ação educativa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaboticatubas guides students on waterborne diseases in an educational outreach.
article.articleSummary: On October 6, 2026, Jaboticatubas hosted an educational outreach at Escola Estadual Leônidas Marques Afonso focusing on waterborne diseases, with emphasis on schistosomiasis. Organized by the Municipal Health Department through the Health Surveillance and Zoonoses coordinations, the program delivered guidance on transmission, risk factors, symptoms, and prevention. Attendees heard from epidemiology clinician Mariangela Baeta da Silva and Vector Control/Schistosomiasis reference José da Piedade Gonçalves. The briefing covered key water-related diseases, safe water consumption, personal and food hygiene, and sanitation's role in public health. The initiative aimed to translate knowledge into daily practices for students and to share information back with families and the community. The event underscores the municipality's ongoing emphasis on preventing exposure to contaminated waters and protecting school communities through education and surveillance integration.

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: 49% dos municípios avaliados no Brasil estão em alerta | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: 49% of municipalities evaluated in Brazil are on alert | CNN Brasil.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, about 49.2% of 3,732 Brazilian municipalities reporting data in the 2nd cycle of the Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) survey (May–August 2026) are on alert or at risk for Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Brazil has 5,569 municipalities. Breeding sites are mainly in containers (plant pots/trays, bottles, etc.) at 42.3%, water-storage reservoirs (tanks/cisterns) at 26.1%, and tires/solid waste at 23%. Regionally, the North emphasizes tires and solid waste; the Northeast emphasizes water-storage containers; the Southeast, South, and Central-West emphasize plant containers and bottles. With summer approaching and El Niño intensifying conditions, the Health Ministry aims to guide prevention and control by identifying alert areas and tailoring actions. Recommended measures include regular inspections, emptying or securing containers, keeping water tanks closed, storing bottles inverted, cleaning gutters/drains, and proper disposal of tires, cans, plastics, and debris year-round.

article.articleHeadline: Paradoja felina: Países con más gatos son muy felices, pero solo si no tienen un peligroso parásito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cat Paradox: Countries with more cats are very happy, but only if they don't have a dangerous parasite.
article.articleSummary: Across 93 countries, a 2026 PLOS One study finds national happiness correlates with cat density and wealth, while exposure to Toxoplasma gondii associates with lower well-being. Happiness scores (Gallup, 2022–2024) correlated with cats per 10,000 people (r=0.62) and GDP per capita (r=0.80). Toxoplasma gondii exposure inferred from serology in pregnant women using IgM for recent infection and IgG for past infection correlated negatively with happiness (IgM r=-0.54; IgG r=-0.33). Cat density linked to fewer parasites, not more. Wealth may drive indoor cats and veterinary care, reducing infection in richer nations. Notable outliers include China showing high happiness despite low cat density, and Finland with the highest happiness and relatively high cat density. Limitations include ecological country-level data; correlations do not prove causation; prenatal serology; mixed counts of pets and stray cats; and unmeasured confounders like climate or sanitation. Published 2026 in PLOS One.

article.articleHeadline: In the shadow of Ebola: Scenes from the outbreak's frontlines
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Congo is confronting its worst Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 8,000 people infected and over 4,000 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus species, for which there is no known treatment or vaccine. The report emphasizes the scale of the crisis and the lack of approved therapies or vaccines for this strain. It does not provide details on clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or any imported or exported cases in the excerpt. The information conveys the seriousness of the current Ebola situation in Congo due to a strain without available targeted medical countermeasures.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Health Alert - U.S. Embassy Kampala, Uganda (October 7, 2026)
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-06 Kenya reported a Bundibugyo virus disease (Ebola) case. As of 2026-10-08, there are no known Ebola cases in Uganda. The patient traveled by land from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Uganda, then onward to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport via Jambojet flight #8523 on October 3 after leaving Entebbe. Uganda’s Ministry of Health is conducting contact tracing for a person believed to have traveled from DRC to Kampala on October 2 and departed Entebbe International Airport on October 3. Ebola is described as a rare, severe viral hemorrhagic fever. Health guidance emphasizes monitoring health for 21 days after travel to Ebola-affected areas, maintaining malaria prophylaxis, and seeking medical advice if symptoms appear; consult Uganda MOH and CDC resources for updates. Embassy Ugandan contacts and general health information are provided for travelers and providers.

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana fecha escolas e deixa mais de 8 mil alunos sem aula na Grande BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies outbreak closes schools and leaves more than 8,000 students without classes in Greater Belo Horizonte.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies outbreak in Lagoa Santa, in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region (Greater Belo Horizonte), Brazil, has led to municipal school closures. The outbreak has 241 notified cases with 50 new cases in recent days. About 8,000 students from 25 municipal units are missing classes on Oct 8 and 9, with return planned for Oct 19. No laboratory confirmation details or infection source are provided in the report, and there are no deaths noted. The situation underscores pediatric education disruption within the Belo Horizonte area due to the scabies outbreak. Overall, the incident underscores the impact of communicable skin infections on schooling in urban areas around Belo Horizonte. Public health officials are monitoring incidence and advising hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: 人間の疥癬アウトブレイクで学校が閉鎖、ベロオリゾンテ都市圏で8000人以上の生徒が休校に
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、学校閉鎖や8000人規模の影響という社会的関心の高まりがあり、続報の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬は致死性が低く国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しないが、学校閉鎖という社会的影響があるため経過観察とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia da por cerrado el supuesto brote de peste en Siberia pese a las dudas de la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia declares the alleged plague outbreak in Siberia closed despite WHO doubts.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, Russia’s consumer health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, declared all preventive measures over an alleged pneumonic plague outbreak in the Irkutsk region near Lake Baikal to be concluded. Over 5,500 analyses across five laboratories found no pathogens or dangerous microorganisms. About 200 people who had contact with the deceased Daria Shipílova, 28, an employee at the Institute of Epidemiology and Pest of Irkutsk and the Far East, were monitored; no laboratory accidents were reported, and the deceased was vaccinated with strong immunity. The regional health situation is described as calm with no health risks. The WHO was informed promptly, and information was shared with 14 member countries; no population risk is confirmed. A rumored second plague case was denied; only one death occurred from pneumonia of unknown origin. Rumors linked patient zero to Thailand, though Thai authorities have not confirmed travel. The US, China, and Mongolia have shown interest; US discussions with Putin were framed as indicating the outbreak is under control.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、WHOの疑念にもかかわらずシベリアでの疑惑のペスト流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ロシア当局は病原体未検出として流行終息を宣言したが、WHOが疑念を示しており、タイとの関連も未確認のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（対象国リスト外）。タイ・中国・モンゴルは関心を示したのみで、発生国として確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOの疑念があるため今後の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Quase metade dos municípios brasileiros está em alerta ou risco para infestação pelo Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost Half of Brazilian Municipalities Are on Alert or at Risk of Infestation by Aedes aegypti
article.articleSummary: Almost half of Brazilian municipalities assessed for Aedes aegypti infestation risk. The LIRAa survey (May–August 2026) included 3,732 municipalities, with 49.2% showing alert or risk indices for mosquito presence. Despite this, arboviral activity decreased in 2026: by September 26, about 470,500 probable dengue cases, a roughly 70% drop from 2025’s ~1.5 million. Probable chikungunya cases fell 43%; probable Zika cases fell 35%. Breeding sites were mainly in small containers (about 42.3% of sites such as plant pots, dishes, bottles), 26.1% in water-storage structures (cisterns, tanks), and 23% in tires and waste. In the Southeast, small containers are prominent breeding points. With hot, rainy months ahead, authorities urge elimination of standing water and regular home inspections. Prevention relies on public participation and coordinated action by municipalities and epidemiological surveillance teams to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの自治体の約半数がネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の感染警戒または危険域にあると発表
triage.triage_reason: LIRAa調査により約半数の自治体で蚊の発生リスクが指摘されているが、デング熱等の症例数は2026年に大幅減少しており、季節的・予防的な通常サーベイランス記事であるため、現時点では緊急シグナルとは判断できない。
triage.notes: 2026年のデング・チクングニア・ジカの症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、記事の主旨は雨季を前にした予防喚起であり、緊急性の高いシグナルではない。今後の雨季における症例推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 170 gestantes são diagnosticadas com sífilis em Teresina somente este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 170 pregnant women are diagnosed with syphilis in Teresina this year alone.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Teresina, Brazil, has 175 confirmed syphilis cases in pregnant women (through 6 October 2026) and 58 congenital syphilis cases, reported during the Outubro Verde awareness campaign. In 2025, the city recorded 308 gestational syphilis and 87 congenital cases. Preliminary 2026 data indicate a downward trend from 2025, attributed to ongoing surveillance, broader diagnostic access, and improved care. Syphilis is caused by Treponema pallidum and is primarily sexually transmitted; congenital infection occurs when transmitted from mother to fetus during pregnancy or delivery. Early diagnosis and treatment in pregnancy are crucial to prevent neonatal infection. Rapid tests are available at Basic Health Units and the Centro de Testagem e Aconselhamento, with results in about 30 minutes. Public health services provide free treatment, including benzathine penicillin; prevention also includes condom use and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: テレジーナで今年だけで170人以上の妊婦が梅毒と診断される
triage.triage_reason: 既知の性感染症（梅毒）の地域的な発生状況報告であり、前年より減少傾向にある。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、通常の公衆衛生監視活動の一環と考えられる。
triage.notes: 梅毒・先天性梅毒は性感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト空気感染等のアウトブレイクリスクとは異なる。2025年と比較し減少傾向にあると報告されており、通常の年次監視報告の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia da por concluidas medidas profilácticas ante posible brote neumónico en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Deems Prophylactic Measures Complete in View of a Possible Pneumonic Outbreak in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor declared all preventive measures against a possible pneumonic plague outbreak in the Irkutsk region of Siberia (near Lake Baikal) completed. Investigations across five organizations (three strictly scientific) used bacteriological, biological, genetic-molecular analyses and mass spectrometry. About 200 contacts of the deceased Daria Shipílova, a 28-year-old worker at the Irkutsk and Far East Institute of Plague Research, were monitored; more than 5,500 clinical analyses found no dangerous pathogens. Officials noted no accidents or safety violations at the institute and that Shipílova was vaccinated with strong immunity. The regional epidemiological situation is calm with no health risk. The WHO was informed promptly, and data were shared with 14 member states. A second pneumonic plague case was denied; only one death occurred from pneumonia of unknown etiology. Earlier rumors linked patient zero to Thailand and Yersinia pestis; international interest from the US, China, and Mongolia followed, with President Trump offering to speak with Putin and rejecting a bioweapon theory.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでの肺ペスト発生疑いに対する予防措置完了を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 発生国ロシアは監視対象国に含まれず、記事内で言及されたタイ・中国も実際の発生地ではなく噂・国際的関心の文脈に過ぎない。また事態は収束済みで二次感染なし。
triage.notes: 実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州（Lake Baikal近郊）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイはパシェント・ゼロに関する噂として言及されたのみで実際の発生国としての根拠はなく、中国も国際的関心を示した国として言及されているに過ぎない。ロシア当局は予防措置完了を宣言し、二次感染なし、5500件以上の臨床検査で危険な病原体は検出されず、疫学的状況は平穏と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina brasileira contra malária vivax começa a ser testada em humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian vaccine against vivax malaria begins human testing.
article.articleSummary: Vivaxin, a Brazilian vaccine candidate against malaria caused by Plasmodium vivax, received Anvisa authorization to begin first-in-human trials. Developed by UFMG in partnership with USP and Cristália, the phase 1 study will enroll 48 healthy adults (ages 18–59) to evaluate safety, adverse events, and the immune response, with 360 days of follow-up. The trial aims to establish immunogenicity and safety, not efficacy; upcoming phases will test larger groups for infection prevention. There is currently no vaccine available for vivax malaria. Malaria remains a challenge in Brazil, particularly in the Amazon region, which hosts the highest case load. In 2025, Brazil reported more than 118,000 locally acquired cases. If safety and immunogenicity are favorable, Vivaxin would proceed through further regulatory steps before broader use.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア（三日熱マラリア）に対するブラジル製ワクチン、ヒト初の臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発の臨床試験開始に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアワクチン開発（臨床試験開始）に関する科学・医療ニュースであり、既存のマラリア流行状況（2025年ブラジル国内で11.8万件以上）への言及はあるが、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態ではないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre Porcina Africana Amenaza a los Cerdos Silvestres de Asia - Diario CAMBIO 22 - Península Libre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Swine Fever Threatens Asia's Wild Boars - CAMBIO 22 Daily - Free Peninsula.
article.articleSummary: ASF threatens Asia's wild boars: African Swine Fever endangers 12 endemic Asian wild pig species, with five Critically Endangered and one Endangered; others not yet formally assessed. Since ASF emerged in China in late 2018, the virus has spread across Asia, causing extremely high mortality in domestic pigs and wild populations. A group of 31 scientists published the first comprehensive roadmap in Nature Reviews Biodiversity to guide governments and conservation groups. The eight prioritized actions include strengthening surveillance and early warning, expanding captive-breeding programs, and establishing emergency financing mechanisms, plus ex-situ/in-situ conservation and cross-sector collaboration within a One Health framework.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱、アジアの野生イノシシを脅かす - CAMBIO 22 日刊紙 - ペニンスラ・リブレ
triage.triage_reason: 動物（野生イノシシ）の保全に関する学術的ロードマップの紹介記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はASF（アフリカ豚熱）の2018年以降のアジア全域への拡大と野生イノシシ種の保全課題を扱う総説・提言記事で、特定国での新規発生報告ではない。中国は歴史的背景として言及されているのみで、対象国での具体的発生情報はないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: casos de SRAG por rinovírus aumentam no Acre, aponta boletim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Rhinovirus-related SARI cases are rising in Acre, according to bulletin.
article.articleSummary: Rhinovirus-related severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases are rising in Acre, Brazil, according to Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin released 2026-10-08. Nationally, SARI due to rhinovirus shows an increasing trend, with metapneumovirus and SARS-CoV-2 also rising. In Acre, the capital Rio Branco is at alert level with a 75% probability of case growth; it appears among cities with alert activity alongside Aracaju, Porto Alegre, São Luís, and Vitória. COVID-19–related severe cases show a slight uptick in Acre, Mato Grosso, Goiás, Distrito Federal, and São Paulo, though still at low incidence. By state, Alagoas, Roraima and Sergipe have SARI incidence at alert/risk/high risk with growth signals in the last two to six weeks (to Epidemiological Week 39). Metapneumovirus SARI cases are increasing in the South, Southeast, Northeast, and Mato Grosso do Sul.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：アクレ州でライノウイルスによるSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）症例が増加、公式速報が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス速報（Fiocruz InfoGripe）であり、ライノウイルス・メタニューモウイルス・COVID-19によるSARI症例が複数州で増加傾向にあるが、現時点で重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく通常の季節性変動の可能性が高い。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、メタニューモウイルス、SARS-CoV-2）による季節性SARI増加の定例サーベイランス報告。重症度・死亡率等の具体的データが不足しており、公式統計の推移を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: الطاعون يعود إلى دائرة القلق.. ماذا تخشى واشنطن من موسكو؟ | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague returns to the circle of concern... What does Washington fear from Moscow?
article.articleSummary: Death of 28-year-old Russian researcher Daria Shibelova in Siberia, at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research, after an acute pneumonia sparked fears of pneumonic plague and potential lab exposure. Russian authorities say there is no evidence of plague and nearly 5,000 tests on contacts found no infections. Washington seeks more information; US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged Moscow for transparency, while President Donald Trump said the incident is unlikely linked to a biological weapons program. No basis for a global plague pandemic is cited; the concern centers on political opacity and possible clandestine experiments or modified strains as part of a bioweapons program. Western analyst Bahaa Mahmoud notes rising Russo‑Western tension over bioweapons, while WHO officials say no clear outbreak report, and UN dynamics—Russia’s veto power and China’s alignment—complicate transparency.

triage.headline_ja: ペストが懸念の的に再び…ワシントンはモスクワの何を恐れているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所研究員の死亡を巡り肺ペストや生物兵器関連への懸念が政治的に高まっているが、ロシア当局は感染の証拠なしとしており（約5000件の接触者検査も陰性）、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例はロシア（イルクーツク）での単発の死亡例に関する政治的・外交的緊張が主題であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）における発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。中国はUNの政治的文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の感染事例発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: China extends 2 mln USD grant to Kenya for Ebola preparedness, drought relief
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 8, 2026, Kenya received a 2 million USD cash grant from China to bolster Ebola preparedness and drought relief. One million funds Ebola preparedness infrastructure in very/high-risk counties; the other supports drought response. The grant was handed over in Nairobi by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan with National Treasury Principal Secretary Chris Kiptoo and Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni, and a handover certificate was signed. Kenya has reported its first imported Ebola case, a citizen who had lived in the DRC for seven years and died during treatment in Nairobi. President William Ruto has ordered intensified surveillance at ports of entry to curb transmission. East Africa faces drought and predicted El Niño-related floods from October through early next year. China highlighted ongoing cooperation under FOCAC and the Global Development Initiative.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ケニアにエボラ対策・干ばつ救済のため200万ドルの助成金を供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来の輸入エボラ症例が発生し死亡例も出ており、国家レベルでの水際対策強化や国際支援（中国からの資金援助）が行われているため、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的波及の懸念があるシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例および中国からの支援であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは患者の居住歴として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生自体を報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Levantamento aponta alerta ou risco para Aedes aegypti em quase metade dos municípios brasileiros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Survey indicates a warning or risk for Aedes aegypti in nearly half of Brazil's municipalities.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's health surveillance reveals 49.2% of 3,732 municipalities that submitted data show alert or risk for Aedes aegypti, in the second cycle of the Rapid Indices survey (May–August 2026). Dengue cases dropped about 70% year-over-year to roughly 470,500 probable infections; chikungunya fell 43% to 67,900; Zika decreased 35% to 2,141. The survey also highlights the main household mosquito breeding sites: plant pots, dishes, bottles, and small containers (42.3%), water storage containers (26.1%), tires and accumulated trash (23%). In response to heat expected with El Niño, the Ministry of Health intensified prevention: over 300,000 community health agents trained; use of ovitraps and larvicidal dissemination stations; and deployment of Wolbachia-based biological control. Data reflect nationwide trends across Brazil with ongoing efforts to curb vector proliferation and arboviral transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 調査によると、ブラジルの市町村のほぼ半数でネッタイシマカに対する警戒または危険があることが判明
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、蚊媒介リスクのサーベイランス情報であって新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）の罹患数減少とベクター対策強化を報告する定期サーベイランス情報であり、症例数は前年比で大幅に減少している。

article.articleHeadline: Mhoni Vidente advierte por peste neumónica: "Estamos en alerta a nivel mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mhoni Vidente warns of pneumonic plague: "We are at a global alert level."
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is alleged to have escaped from a Russian laboratory after a drone incident, with warnings of potential spread to other countries including Mexico and the United States. The claim followed the Oct 2, 2026 death of a 28-year-old employee at a Siberian infectious-diseases institute, prompting surveillance of about 200 colleagues. Authorities say the deceased died of pneumonia, with no official confirmation of pneumonic plague or a lab leak. The World Health Organization has asked for information and considers the risk of spread outside Russia to be very low. The claimant, Cuban clairvoyant Mhoni Vidente, ties the episode to the Russia–Ukraine war and predicts a more aggressive bacterium than typical plague, causing illness within days and death by day seven. She alleged that over 200,000 people could have been exposed in Russia, Siberia, parts of Asia and China, though this exposure figure is unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 占い師ムオニ・ビデンテ、肺ペストについて警告「我々は世界的な警戒レベルにある」
triage.triage_reason: 記事はキューバの占い師による未確認の予言・噂に基づくものであり、WHOも拡大リスクを非常に低いと評価しており、公式な感染症イベントとしての実態がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシアでの死亡例に関する未確認情報を占い師が解釈したもので、信頼性の低い情報源に基づく。対象国（中国など）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事内で実際の発生国として明示されていないため除外。WHOは公式にロシア国外への拡散リスクを非常に低いとしている。

article.articleHeadline: What You Need to Know About Zika Virus
article.articleSummary: Zika virus is transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, and can spread via sexual contact, mother-to-fetus transmission, and blood transfusions. Most infections are asymptomatic; when present, symptoms include fever, rash, headache, joint and muscle pain, and red eyes. In pregnancy, Zika poses a risk of fetal microcephaly and other congenital abnormalities, miscarriage, or stillbirth. CDC guidance urges pregnant or breastfeeding individuals to avoid travel to areas with known transmission and recommends delaying conception after travel. Diagnosis relies on blood, urine, or tissue testing, most reliable in the first two weeks; tests may confuse active infection with past exposure or resemble dengue. No vaccine or specific antiviral therapy exists; management is supportive. Notable past outbreaks occurred in Uganda (1947), Nigeria (1954), Micronesia (2007), French Polynesia (2013–14), and Brazil (2015), with limited US activity and no continental US local transmission since 2018.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ジカウイルスに関する一般的な解説記事であり、過去の流行事例を紹介する内容にとどまるため。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な医療解説記事であり、現在進行中の具体的なアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ブラジルは過去（2015年）の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現行イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases reach 236 as administration intensifies fogging
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Noida have reached 236, prompting intensified surveillance and fogging in hotspots and vulnerable areas. The district administration has issued notices to more than 140 residential complexes and individual houses to reduce mosquito breeding. Teams are conducting regular inspections to locate breeding sites, especially in stagnant water found in coolers, flower pots, rooftops, construction sites, drains, and other water-holding containers. Anti-larval measures are being taken wherever larvae are detected, with residents urged to prevent standing water around homes. Officials plan to strengthen surveillance, sanitation, and vector-control measures across sensitive areas in Noida and Greater Noida, including Sector 22, Sector 2, Dadri, Greater Noida West, Alpha 2, Gaur City, and nearby villages. Sruti Verma, district malaria officer, stresses continuous community participation alongside regular fogging and anti-larval work. Precautions include full-sleeved clothing, repellents, avoiding breeding sites, cleaning coolers, covering overhead tanks, and disposing discarded tyres and containers that collect rainwater.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者236人に増加、行政が燻蒸を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのノイダ市における季節性デング熱の局地的発生で、行政による通常の媒介対策が実施されており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インドでは毎年季節性にデング熱が発生しており、本記事は地方自治体の通常対応を報じるもの。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: U Španiji muškarac preminuo od majmunskih boginja nakon moguće zaraze u bolnici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Spain, a man died of monkeypox after a possible hospital-acquired infection.
article.articleSummary: In the Basque Country, Spain, a 61-year-old man with cancer died this week at Donostia/San Sebastián Hospital from monkeypox, with hospital transmission suspected after sharing a room with another patient later confirmed to have mpox; the other patient was isolated and discharged with home isolation. This is the first mpox death recorded in the Basque Country. More than 30 people, mostly healthcare workers who had contact with patients, have been vaccinated and are under health surveillance; officials say the risk of new infections is very small. Monkeypox is an Orthopoxvirus transmitted mainly through close skin-to-skin contact, especially with lesions; symptoms include rash, mucosal changes, fever, headaches, muscle and back pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy, with death possible in severe cases. In Oct last year, Madrid reported the first autochthonous mpox transmission (Clade 1b), linked to higher fatality (~3.6%), with cases in DRC, Burundi, Sudan, and Chad; WHO declared a PHEIC in Aug 2024, lifted Sept 2025.

triage.headline_ja: スペインで、院内感染の可能性があるサル痘（エムポックス）により男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本事例はスペイン・バスク地方での院内感染による単発死亡例であり、対象国（DRC等）は過去のクレード1b PHEIC文脈での言及に過ぎず、現在の主題イベントの発生国ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はスペイン（バスク地方）での院内感染によるmpox死亡例。DRC・Burundi・Sudan・Chadは昨年(2024年)のクレード1b PHEIC宣言の背景説明として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため、本イベントは監視対象地域外のシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases stabilise in Chennai as hotspots reduce from 590 to 300, says Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases stabilised in Chennai with hotspots dropping from 590 to 300, Tamil Nadu Health Minister K.G. Arunraj said on 2026-10-09, ahead of the Northeast monsoon. Across Tamil Nadu, 21,655 dengue cases were reported from January 1 to October 7, with ten deaths; Chennai now reports a statewide 301 dengue cases being treated in hospitals. The Greater Chennai Corporation has collected ₹7.5 lakh in fines from building owners for mosquito breeding, with ₹10,000 as the first-violation fee and higher penalties for subsequent violations. About 3,700 mosquito-control workers are deployed in the GCC, conducting home visits every seven days. The state runs roughly 1,000 fever-screening medical camps daily. Minister Arunraj warned of potential spikes after the monsoon and pledged more vector-control resources. Regarding Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu’s health, treatment protocols were reviewed by doctors from Rajiv Gandhi Government General Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイのデング熱症例が安定化、ホットスポットは590から300に減少と保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: インドで流行性のデング熱に関する定例報告であり、症例数は安定・改善傾向にあり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性流行病であり、本記事はチェンナイ・タミルナードゥ州での対策状況と症例数の改善を報告する定例ニュース。モンスーン後の再流行への警戒はあるが、現時点で緊急対応を要する兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde alerta para risco de proliferação do Aedes aegypti com combinação de chuva e calor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health warns of the risk of Aedes aegypti proliferation with a combination of rain and heat.
article.articleSummary: Rain, high humidity, and rising temperatures across São Paulo state fuel renewed risk of Aedes aegypti proliferation, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. Health authorities warn that domestic hidden breeding sites can sustain transmission; residents should inspect yards and indoor spaces to remove any standing water. In 2026, São Paulo reports 60,965 dengue cases and 43 deaths. A state-level information campaign highlights containers such as plant pots saucers, gutters, discarded tires, bottles, and inadequately sealed water storage tanks as common breeding grounds. Early symptoms to watch for include sudden high fever, headache, body and joint pains, and skin rashes; alarm signs—severe abdominal pain, frequent vomiting, dizziness, or bleeding—require immediate medical care and avoidance of self-medication. For prevention and guidance, consult the Dengue 100 Dúvidas portal run by the state.

triage.headline_ja: 雨と暑さの組み合わせでネッタイシマカ(Aedes aegypti)繁殖リスクに警戒、保健当局が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州での季節性のデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱媒介蚊対策の定例的な注意喚起であり、新規の異常事態ではないが、症例数・死亡者数の規模から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のベクター対策キャンペーンであり、ブラジル・サンパウロ州における毎年恒例のデング熱予防啓発の性質が強い。2026年の累計症例数(60,965件)・死者数(43名)は言及されているが、これが例年と比較して異常な水準かどうかは記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Corumbá e Ladário concentram 29% dos casos prováveis de dengue em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Corumbá and Ladário account for 29% of probable dengue cases in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil: Corumbá and Ladário together account for about 29% of probable dengue cases this year, with 1,125 of 3,875 notifications through 26 September. Corumbá has 982 probable cases (1,020.1/100k) and Ladário 143 (664.4/100k). Eleven municipalities exceed the high-incidence threshold of 300/100k, led by Santa Rita do Pardo at 2,077.7/100k; others include Costa Rica, Jardim, Paraíso das Águas, Batayporã, Angélica, Vicentina, Pedro Gomes, and Dois Irmãos do Buriti, in addition to Corumbá and Ladário. Statewide incidence is 140.6/100k. Dourados has the second-most notifications (463) but 190.2/100k; Campo Grande has 59 cases (6.6/100k). The state totals 2,234 confirmed dengue cases, with 1 death confirmed and another under investigation (an 11-year-old from Bonito, who died on 28 June; no comorbidity reported). In the last 14 days, 12 new cases across multiple municipalities, all low-incidence. Serotypes DENV-1 to DENV-4 detected in some areas; DENV-4 under investigation for vaccine-related considerations; cities not named.

triage.headline_ja: コルンバとラダリオがマトグロッソ・ド・スル州のデング熱疑い症例の29%を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の地域的なデング熱流行であり、通常の季節性拡大の範囲内と考えられるが、一部地域で高い罹患率と死亡例があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、特定地域での高罹患率報告はあるが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の兆候はない。州全体の罹患率(140.6/100k)は一部市町村で突出しているが、死亡例は1件確定・1件調査中にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza testes em humanos de vacina brasileira contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes human trials of Brazilian malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa authorized on 7 October 2026 the first human trials of Vivaxin, a Brazilian malaria vaccine targeting Plasmodium vivax, the most common malaria parasite in Brazil. Developed by the Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG), the University of São Paulo (USP), and Cristália, the vaccine aims to fill a gap since current vaccines target Plasmodium falciparum. The Phase I study will enroll 48 healthy, malaria-naive volunteers, randomized to receive Vivaxin or placebo. Participants will be monitored for adverse events and the vaccine’s ability to stimulate an immune response over a year. The regimen comprises three doses at 28-day intervals. Outcomes from this phase will guide progression to assessing preventive efficacy. According to UFMG’s CTVacinas coordinator, Professor Ricardo Gazzinelli, Vivaxin could support malaria elimination efforts in Brazil and other Latin American countries.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、ブラジル産マラリアワクチンのヒト臨床試験を承認
triage.triage_reason: マラリア発生イベントではなくワクチン開発の臨床試験承認に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア感染拡大ではなく、Plasmodium vivax対応ワクチン（Vivaxin）のフェーズI試験承認に関する科学・医療ニュース。感染症アウトブレイクの情報ではないため対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient tests negative in Wajir
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Wajir County, Kenya, tested negative. A 20-year-old man at Habaswein Sub-County Hospital presented with suspected Ebola virus disease after traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo, via Uganda, to Kenya. Preliminary laboratory results from the National Public Health Virology Laboratory in Nairobi ruled out Ebola. Health authorities conducted the tests following assessment of his clinical presentation and travel history. Governor Ahmed Abdullahi stated the result is NEGATIVE for Ebola Virus Disease and that monitoring and appropriate medical care will continue under established public health protocols. The suspected case, reported in Habaswein in Wajir South Sub-County, prompted a rapid public health response; officials urged residents to stay calm and rely on official updates. No confirmed cases or ongoing outbreak reported; authorities are vigilant for unusual illness signs and will report any developments.

triage.headline_ja: ワジールで疑われたエボラ患者、検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 疑いのあったエボラ症例はケニアの検査機関で陰性と確認され、対象国（DRC等）での確定例・流行は報告されていないため見送り。
triage.notes: 事例はケニア（非対象国）での疑い例であり、検査陰性で確定。DRC・ウガンダは渡航歴としての言及のみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade dos municípios brasileiros está em alerta ou risco | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: nearly half of Brazilian municipalities are on alert or at risk | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a nationwide Aedes aegypti risk, with 49.2% of evaluated municipalities (3,732 cities) in alert or risk per the LIRAa Rapid Indices survey, conducted May–August 2026. Aedes aegypti is the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Breeding sites: plant pots and plant trays 42.3%; water storage reservoirs such as water tanks and cisterns 26.1%; tires and solid waste 23%. Regional patterns show the North dominated by tires and debris; the Northeast by water storage containers; the Southeast, South, and Center-West by plant containers. Public guidance urges regular home inspections to remove breeding sites, focusing on plant pots/trays, bottles, buckets, tires, gutters, drains, and water tanks. Reservoirs and solid waste should be emptied when possible and kept sheltered from rain; bottles stored inverted; gutters and drains kept clean; tires, cans, plastics, and debris disposed of properly.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ：ブラジル自治体の約半数が警戒・リスク状態
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土でデング・ジカ・チクングニアの媒介蚊リスクが高まっているが、具体的な感染者数や重症例の報告はなく、季節的な予防啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 米国フロリダ州が発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文はブラジル国内の蚊媒介リスク調査に特化しており、フロリダでの発生事例は言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade dos municípios está em alerta ou risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: Nearly half of municipalities are on alert or at risk.
article.articleSummary: Aedes aegypti remains a persistent threat in Brazil as a nationwide LIRAa survey across 3,732 municipalities found 49.2% at alert or risk for infestation as of May–August data released Oct 7, 2026. Despite dengue cases down about 70% by Sept 26, 2026, to 470,500 probable cases from 1.5 million in 2025, and chikungunya down 43% to 67,900, and Zika down 35% to 2,141, ongoing transmission risk persists. Breeding sites concentrated in small containers (plants, vases) 42.3%, water reservoirs 26.1%, and tires/trash 23%. Regional patterns: tires/trash in North; water tanks in Northeast; domestic containers prevalent in Southeast/South/Central-West. Prevention measures: 300k+ Community Health Agents, ~2k municipalities using ovitraps, targeted spraying, larvicidal stations, and Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. Summer and El Niño may shift rainfall patterns. Home prevention tips include covering water tanks, turning over containers, cleaning gutters, and removing standing water and debris.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ：自治体の約半数が警戒または危険レベルに
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数は前年比で大幅減少しているが、全国調査で約半数の自治体が蚊の発生リスクまたは警戒状態にあり、今後の感染拡大の可能性を継続的に注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年から大幅減少傾向にあり、記事は予防的な蚊媒介サーベイランス報告が主題。ブラジル国内の公衆衛生対策（コミュニティ保健員、オビトラップ、ウォルバキア蚊）が進行中で、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生危機とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ρωσία: Τι γνωρίζουμε μέχρι στιγμής για τον αιφνίδιο θάνατο εργαζόμενης σε ινστιτούτο μελέτης της πανώλης - tempo24.news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia: What we know so far about the sudden death of a female employee at a plague research institute
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Daria Sipilova, a researcher at the Institute of Plague Research in Irkutsk, Siberia, died on 2 October from an unknown type of pneumonia, prompting a precautionary quarantine of about 200 people in contact with her. Nearly 5,000 lab tests found no plague infections among contacts, and Sipilova was vaccinated, suggesting immunity to dangerous pathogens she worked with. Russia's Rospotrebnadzor said on 8 October that there is no outbreak risk and began relaxing preventive measures. Unverified social-media rumors about causes circulated, including a lab spill of live bacteria, travel to Thailand or Moldova, or proximity to the Mongolia border; none are supported by public evidence. Pneumonia can have multiple causes; plague (Yersinia pestis) is possible but unconfirmed. Plague has three forms—pneumonic, bubonic, septicemic. Plague remains endemic in Africa, the Americas, and Asia; Siberia is also endemic. WHO and the United States seek more information; Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan tightened border controls.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア：ペスト研究所の女性職員の突然死について現在判明していること
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明の肺炎による急死で、周辺国が国境管理を強化しWHO・米国も情報収集に動いており、IHR基準の複数（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 事案はロシア・イルクーツク（シベリア）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国は発生地としては含まれない。タイ・モンゴル・モルドバへの渡航歴は未確認の噂として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。ペスト菌感染は接触者約5000件の検査で陰性であり、死因は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança nas Américas e Brasil reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spreads across the Americas, and Brazil reinforces vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles spreads across the Americas; Brazil strengthens vaccination and surveillance. As of October 5, 2026, Brazil reported 52 imported cases: São Paulo 41, Amazonas 10, Rio de Janeiro 1. In the US, 2026 measles activity reached the highest level in over 35 years, with more than 90% of cases unvaccinated or vaccination status unknown. Across the Americas, the US, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru and Canada account for >95% of confirmed cases in 2026 per PAHO. Brazil remains free of endemic measles transmission, a status reaffirmed by PAHO in November 2024 after losing it in 2019; 2023–2025 Brazil reported 85 cases with no deaths. Vaccination coverage improved: 2025 first-dose MMR 93.10% nationwide; São Paulo 94.39%; Amazonas 89.54%. Four major campaigns in 2026 (São Paulo: >3.8 million doses; Amazonas ~192k). Dose zero for 6–11 months is allowed in defined scenarios, not replacing routine doses; vaccination remains key under SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が米州で拡大、ブラジルはワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 米州全域で麻疹が拡大し、米国では35年ぶりの高水準に達するなど異常な状況であり、国際的拡大のリスクも認められるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおける輸入症例とワクチン接種強化策を中心に報じているが、米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダなど米州全体での麻疹拡大状況もPAHOデータとして言及。対象国リストにはブラジルのみ該当。ブラジル国内では死亡例なく、麻疹の地域内常在化は維持されていない状況。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue prevention measures intensified as cases rise
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Prayagraj surpass 100, prompting intensified vector-control measures. Fogging and anti-larva spraying are being conducted in seven hotspots—Teliyarganj, Allahapur, Dhoomanganj, Mundera, Naini, Jhunsi and Phaphamau. Govindpur and Salori report the highest counts between Sept 1 and Oct 8. To curb transmission, the health department has deployed QRTs comprising one malaria inspector, one supervisor and two spray members per team, along with Domestic Breeder Checkers (DBC) for dengue prevention and control. Teams are engaging residents, checking for water stagnation and mosquito breeding, and inspecting indoor sources such as refrigerators, tanks, flowerpots, coconut shells and old unused vehicles for larvae. DBCs are conducting fogging twice daily in the localities they supervise, with emphasis on the hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の症例増加に伴い、予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インド・プラヤーグラージで例年みられる季節性デング熱の増加に対する通常の対策強化であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の媒介蚊対策（防除・薬剤散布）の記事であり、死亡者数や重症度についての言及はない。季節性の流行対応として地域保健当局が対応しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Campinas elimina mais de 100 criadouros do mosquito da dengue com drone
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas Health Department Eliminates More Than 100 Aedes aegypti Breeding Sites Using a Drone
article.articleSummary: On 8 October 2026, Campinas’ Grupo de Resposta Unificada (GRU) eliminated more than 100 Aedes aegypti breeding sites at ten properties across nine neighborhoods, using a drone to identify larval habitats and locksmith access for unoccupied homes. Targeted areas included Parque das Flores, Vila Boa Vista, Cidade Universitária, Bosque de Barão, Ponte Preta, Vila Industrial, Vila Georgina and Jardim Ouro Branco. This was the 32nd operation of the year, with 283 properties inspected in 2024, and involved the Municipal Health Secretariat, Civil Defense, COFIVT, Seclimas, Procon, Setec and the Municipal Guard. The 41st Arboviruses Alert lists 34 high-risk neighborhoods citywide across East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South and Southeast, including Vila 31 de Março, Jardim Garcia, Vila Proost de Souza, Jardim Shangai, Jardim Leonor and Ponte Preta. Preventive guidance urges removing standing water, refreshing plant pots every two days, sealing water tanks, and closing unused toilets. By 5 October 2024, dengue cases reached 4,096 with no deaths; about 1.3 million home visits and 53,300 insecticide nebulizations; roughly 80% of breeding sites are inside residences.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス保健局、ドローンを活用してデング熱媒介蚊の発生源100カ所以上を駆除
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱対策（蚊の発生源駆除）に関する定期活動報告であり、死亡者もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年ブラジルで流行する風土病であり、本記事は自治体の定例的な予防活動（防除作戦）を報じたものにとどまる。死亡者0名、症例数も特段の急増を示す記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: نعمة عابد لـ"النهار": تجنبوا السفر لمناطق تفشي إيبولا.. وراجعوا تحديثات "الصحة العالمية" | تقارير ومتابعات | النهار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Naama Abed to An-Nahar: Avoid traveling to Ebola outbreak areas... and review WHO updates | Reports and Follow-Ups | An-Nahar
article.articleSummary: WHO representative in Egypt, Dr. Naama Abed, urges travelers to avoid areas with Ebola outbreaks and to monitor official updates before flying. In interviews with An-Nahar, he notes strong surveillance and rapid response in Egypt and emphasizes adherence to guidance from the Ministry of Health and Population. For those planning travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo or other regions reporting Ebola cases, travelers should consult official Health Ministry and World Health Organization websites to identify affected areas and regions. He warns that travel should be avoided unless essential until the outbreak situation improves and the disease is under control. Ongoing risk assessment and maps of outbreak zones are updated as developments occur, reinforcing the importance of obtaining information from official sources for travel decisions.

triage.headline_ja: ナアマ・アーベド氏（WHOエジプト代表）、An-Nahar紙に語る：エボラ流行地域への渡航を避け、WHOの最新情報を確認するように
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行について、WHO代表が渡航自粛を呼びかけており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 本記事はエジプトのWHO代表による渡航勧告であり、エジプト自体でのエボラ発生を示すものではない。実際の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、エジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا تحت المجهر.. الصحة العالمية تكشف لـ"النهار" خريطة الخطر وموقف مصر | تقارير ومتابعات | النهار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Under the Microscope: WHO Reveals to Al-Nahar the Risk Map and Egypt's Stance
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, Ebola remains monitored across Africa, with the Democratic Republic of Congo continuing as a high-risk area due to ongoing infections and deaths, and not yet under full control. The WHO assessment places high risk in the DRC and in neighboring African countries sharing land borders; elsewhere in Africa and globally the risk is low. In Egypt, the risk is considered very low, underpinned by a strong surveillance system for early detection of suspected cases and trained rapid-response teams ready to intervene. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, not through respiratory routes, implying slower transmission than airborne diseases like COVID-19. Travelers to Congo or other outbreak zones should consult official sources (Ministry of Health, WHO) and avoid nonessential travel to affected areas until control is achieved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱を監視下に―WHOがアルナハールに語るリスクマップとエジプトの立場
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を依然として高リスク地域と評価しており、死亡例が継続し制御下にないため、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の懸念がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はエジプトにおけるリスクは非常に低いと述べており、主題はDRCでの継続的なエボラ発生状況。エジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية لـ"النهار": الوضع في الكونغو الديمقراطية لا يزال عالي الخطورة بسبب إيبولا | تقارير ومتابعات | النهار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization to Al-Nahar: The situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains high-risk due to Ebola | Reports and Updates | Al-Nahar
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, the World Health Organization says Ebola remains a high-risk situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, per Dr. Naima Abed, WHO representative in Egypt. While Ebola has been brought under control in some areas, transmission continues in the DRC and full containment has not yet been achieved. The latest WHO assessment also flags high risk for other African countries sharing land borders with the DRC. By contrast, the overall risk level in other African countries and globally is considered very low. Authorities continue to monitor developments and implement measures to curb spread, emphasizing adherence to health protocols and the health authorities’ recommendations. The interview with Al-Nahar underscores the need for vigilance and ongoing public health measures to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、アル・ナハールに語る：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱状況は依然として高リスク
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ出血熱を依然高リスクと評価し、国境を接する国々への拡大リスクも指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: エジプトは記事の発信国であり、感染発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。WHOはDRCと国境を接する国への拡大リスクを指摘しているが、具体的な国名は本文に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Unproven 'cures' pushed online amid plague concerns
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, reports circulated online that a woman at a plague research institute in Russia’s Irkutsk region died from plague, but Russia has not confirmed the death and local authorities traced her contacts with no health issues detected. Online, influencers promote a $300 “plague kit” claiming to help avoid emergency rooms, including doxycycline and ivermectin, with discount codes linked to The Wellness Company led by Peter McCullough; a Facebook video drew over 161,000 views, and Rogan O’Handley highlighted doxycycline to his followers. Medical experts caution against self-treatment: doxycycline requires known exposure and can disrupt the gut microbiome, while ivermectin is not indicated for bacterial plague. Plague remains treatable with antibiotics when exposure is confirmed, and there is no evidence of a North American outbreak. The episode echoes misinformation seen during hantavirus incidents and the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, where unproven remedies circulated.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト懸念のさなか、未証明の「治療法」がオンラインで拡散

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola patient tests negative in Wajir
article.articleSummary: 20-year-old man suspected of Ebola at Habaswein Sub-County Hospital in Wajir County tested negative after preliminary results from the National Public Health Virology Laboratory in Nairobi. The result ruled out Ebola, according to Wajir Governor Ahmed Abdullahi. The patient had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Kenya, prompting testing after assessing clinical presentation and travel history. Authorities will continue monitoring and providing medical care per public health protocols. The suspected case in Habaswein, Wajir South Sub-County, prompted a rapid response from health workers, the County Department of Medical Services, Public Health and Sanitation, and national partners. Residents were urged to stay calm, avoid unverified information, and report unusual signs to the nearest health facility, with the county reiterating readiness to respond to threats.

article.articleHeadline: Brasil autoriza ensayos clínicos de su primera vacuna contra la malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil approves clinical trials of its first malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Brazil authorizes phase 1 trials of Vivaxin, its first malaria vaccine, after Anvisa approval. Vivaxin targets Plasmodium vivax, prevalent in Latin America and Asia, and results from a collaboration among UFMG, USP, and Cristália (CT-Vacinas). The study will enroll 48 healthy adults (18–59) with no malaria history at the Clinical Investigations Center, Hospital das Clínicas, UFMG, Belo Horizonte. Participants will receive three doses at 28-day intervals or placebo, with about a year of follow-up to assess safety, adverse events, and immunogenicity across dose levels; efficacy will be evaluated in later trials. WHO-approved vaccines RTS,S/AS01 and R21/Matrix-M target P. falciparum. In 2024, P. vivax accounted for 63.1% of malaria cases in the Americas; globally, about 9.9 million vivax cases occurred that year, and in Brazil, 99% of autochthonous malaria cases were in the Amazon last year (118,037 total).

article.articleHeadline: Staffel fünf kommt im Dezember: ARD: Neue "Charité"-Staffel behandelt Cholera in Berlin 1831
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Season five premieres in December: ARD's new "Charité" season tackles cholera in Berlin, 1831.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Berlin in 1831 is the focal setting of Charité season five (streaming December 18, 2026; TV December 22, 2026). The historical drama follows Overath, a young assistant physician who is actually a woman, as Berlin grapples with cholera and the public health response. Cholera is a highly infectious diarrheal disease caused by Vibrio cholerae. Transmission is mainly via water contaminated with feces or vomit, and contaminated food; severe dehydration and electrolyte loss can cause death within hours if not rapidly rehydrated. In the 19th century, cholera spread globally from the Ganges Delta in India, with multiple pandemics; outbreaks worsen after natural disasters or conflicts that disrupt water supplies. The season returns to historical storytelling after a science-fiction fourth season set in 2049.

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul está em alerta para casos de SRAG, aponta Fiocruz - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul is on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases, Fiocruz points out - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-08, Mato Grosso do Sul is on alert for severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases, per Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin. MS shows elevated SRAG alert levels, but no long-term uptrend; metapneumovirus detections are rising. Across Brazil, SRAG cases are stable or fluctuating over six weeks and increased in the last three weeks, with rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and COVID-19 among growing viruses. RSV and influenza B SRAG cases are decreasing; influenza A remains steady and low. A slight rise in SRAG among children and adolescents aged 2–14 is noted. States with higher alert include Alagoas, Roraima, Sergipe; capitals Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, and Vitória. In 2026 Brazil recorded 161,053 SRAG cases, with RSV, rhinovirus, and influenza A most detected. Under-2s have most cases; deaths are highest in those 65+. Recommendations: keep COVID-19 vaccination up to date for priority groups; pregnant women should be vaccinated against RSV.

article.articleHeadline: Autorizan el inicio de las pruebas clínicas de una vacuna brasileña contra la malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regulators authorize the start of clinical trials of a Brazilian malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 8 October 2026, Brazil's Anvisa authorized phase 1 clinical trials of Vivaxin, a malaria vaccine developed by Brazilian scientists, enrolling 48 healthy volunteers aged 18–59 with no malaria history. The trial will be conducted at the Clinical Investigations Center of the Hospital das Clínicas of UFMG in Belo Horizonte. Vivaxin results from a collaboration between UFMG, USP, and Cristália, led by the CT-Vacinas center. The phase 1 study uses a three-dose regimen at 28-day intervals with a one-year follow-up to assess safety and immunogenicity; efficacy will not yet be determined. Current WHO-recommended vaccines target Plasmodium falciparum, while P. vivax remains prominent in Latin America and Asia. In 2024, vivax accounted for 63.1% of estimated malaria cases in the Americas and about 9.9 million cases globally; 99% of Brazil's autochthonous malaria last year occurred in the Amazon.

article.articleHeadline: Unproven 'cures' pushed online amid plague concerns
article.articleSummary: Plague concerns in North America surge as unproven remedies circulate after reports from Russia’s Irkutsk region that a plague research institute employee died are unconfirmed; as of 2026-10-08, authorities traced contacts and found no related illnesses. Online influencers promote a 300 kit containing doxycycline and hard-to-find prescription meds like ivermectin, with discount codes; The Wellness Company led by Peter McCullough promotes it, and Rogan O'Handley (DC Draino) highlighted doxycycline. Experts caution against self-treatment: doxycycline is used for plague with exposure, and broad use risks gut microbiome disruption and antibiotic resistance; ivermectin is not used for bacterial disease. The piece notes the outbreak is not a pandemic threat and cites prior misinformation during hantavirus cases and the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the DRC as grifters exploit fear.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza testes em humanos de vacina brasileira contra malária | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes human trials of Brazilian malaria vaccine | CNN Brasil.
article.articleSummary: Vivaxin, a vaccine against Plasmodium vivax, received Anvisa authorization for first-in-human trials, published 7 October 2026 in the Diário Oficial da União. Phase 1 will enroll 48 healthy volunteers aged 18–59 with no malaria history, randomized to three vaccine doses versus placebo. Three-dose schedule at 28-day intervals with 360-day follow-up at the Clinical Research Center of Hospital das Clínicas da UFMG, Belo Horizonte. Developed by UFMG’s CTVacinas in partnership with USP and Cristália, Vivaxin aims to complement RTS,S/AS01 and R21/Matrix-M targeting P. falciparum. If safe and immunogenic, results could support malaria control and elimination in Brazil and Latin America. In Brazil, malaria concentrates in the Amazon region, with autochthonous cases mainly in Acre, Amazonas, Amapá, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Roraima and Tocantins.

article.articleHeadline: Alerta urgente: Anvisa libera testes da 1ª vacina brasileira contra a malária em humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent alert: Anvisa authorizes trials of Brazil's first malaria vaccine in humans.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-08, Brazil's Anvisa authorized the first human trials of Vivaxin, a Plasmodium vivax–targeted malaria vaccine developed entirely in Brazil by UFMG, USP, and Cristália. The Phase 1 study will enroll 48 healthy adults (18–59) who have never had malaria, at Hospital das Clínicas da UFMG in Belo Horizonte. Participants will be randomized to receive varying doses of Vivaxin or placebo, with three injections at 28-day intervals and about a year of follow-up to assess safety, immunogenicity, and determine the optimal dose. Regulatory approval for clinical testing does not imply commercialization. Plasmodium vivax accounts for the majority of malaria cases in the Americas (over 63%), and transmission occurs via female Anopheles mosquitoes. The initiative underscores Brazil’s pharmacotechnical autonomy in vaccine development; further trial updates are anticipated.

article.articleHeadline: Russia & China Held Secret Plague Drill Weeks Before Deadly Outbreak - Slay News
article.articleSummary: Darya Shipilova, 28, died Oct 2 at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute after a severe illness; Moscow insists it was pneumonia of unknown cause and denies an outbreak, though plague is suspected. In Aug 24–27, China and Russia held a cross-border infectious-disease drill in Fuyuan (Heilongjiang) with an imported-plague scenario, plus a tick-borne Disease X and post-flood responses; the Irkutsk institute’s director Sergey Balakhonov attended. The drill report did not link to Shipilova’s illness. Post‑death, about 200 contacts were quarantined and up to five Irkutsk hospitals operated in epidemic mode; restrictions have since eased. By Oct 7, Rospotrebnadzor said roughly 90% of contacts were released, ~5,000 tests for dangerous pathogens were negative, and no microorganisms linked to Shipilova were found. Beijing confirmed ongoing cooperation; a Chinese post urged stockpiling and warned of possible northeastern lockdowns (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning).

article.articleHeadline: 周曉輝：俄現不明疫情與武漢爆發新冠有何異同
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhou Xiaohui: What are the similarities and differences between the unknown outbreak currently in Russia and the Wuhan COVID-19 outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 6, 2026, Russia disclosed that a 28-year-old employee at the Irkutsk Siberia and Far East Anti-Plague Research Institute fell severely ill in late September and died Oct 2 from an unknown pneumonia. About 197 contacts were identified, with 189 placed under medical observation; a large aluminum plant tightened masking. Online rumors alleged a laboratory accident releasing plague, but epidemiologist Mikhail Favorov doubted this, citing protective gear and low infection risk. The piece connects the incident to broader suspicions of lab-origin bioweapons, noting alleged bioweapons research at both the Wuhan Institute of Virology and the Irkutsk institute, citing a former U.S. arms-control envoy. It also references Aug 2026 China–Russia biosecurity drills in Heilongjiang and recalls the 2019 Wuhan World Military Games drill as context. The article highlights opacity and US travel advisories toward Russia, and cites Trump’s comments on potential lab involvement.
