article.articleHeadline: East Africa: China's Malaria Success Offers Lessons for East Africa's 2030 Elimination Push | South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: East Africa has four years to deliver on its 2030 malaria elimination ambition, urging a shift from broad control to a targeted system built around finding, investigating, and responding to every case. The piece draws lessons from China's seven-decade journey: malaria burden once neared 30 million cases annually in the 1940s; indigenous transmission was eliminated in 2017, and the World Health Organization certified China malaria-free in 2021. For East Africa, the emphasis is on rapid case detection, strict investigation, and swift response to interrupt transmission chains. The article uses Nairobi as a regional anchor and contrasts the long-term success in China with the region’s shorter timeline, framing the push as an accelerated, case-centered approach rather than general control to hit the 2030 target.

article.articleHeadline: China gives Kenya Ksh260M grant for Ebola, drought response
article.articleSummary: Kenya received a 260 million Kenyan shilling grant from China on Oct 8, 2026, split 130 million for Ebola preparedness and 130 million for drought mitigation, handed to the National Treasury by China’s ambassador Guo Haiyan and PS Chris Kiptoo. This follows Kenya’s confirmation of its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease case on Oct 6, 2026, in a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled via Kampala to Nairobi, was admitted to Nairobi Hospital, and died on Oct 5. National surveillance shows 4,971 health workers trained, 652,584 travellers screened at 15 entry points, 263 alerts investigated across 17 counties, and 267 samples tested with one positive. 28 contacts identified (including 23 passengers and 4 crew from the same flight). Five facilities designated for Ebola care: Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Port Reitz Hospital, and Nairobi Hospital. Authorities emphasize vigilance and hygiene to prevent spread.

The World Health Organization had on May 17 declared the situation a public health emergency of international concern, with high regional risk.

article.articleHeadline: Contact tracing: Brace for the worst Ebola scenario
article.articleSummary: Kenya faces Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease after a single confirmed case, with warnings of a worst-case trajectory as contact tracing falters and exposed individuals do not report to quarantine. As of 8 October 2026, laboratory results were pending verification. Authorities identified 66 contacts, but only 10 were quarantined; officials warn the true number could exceed 100 given interactions at airports, airlines, hospitals, and social settings. A 20-year-old man in Wajir, who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Kenya by road and presented with cough, headache, and severe anaemia, is being treated as a suspected hemorrhagic fever case after interacting with hundreds along the route, including in Isiolo. Kenya remains at risk of importing more cases as cross-border travel from DRC continues. Experts urge rapid, comprehensive contact tracing and strict quarantine to prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: 接触者追跡：最悪のエボラシナリオに備えよ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国からウガンダ経由でケニアに入国した患者がエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)疑いとして確認され、接触者追跡が不十分なまま越境感染拡大のリスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 疑い症例はケニア（Wajir/Isiolo）で確認されたものであり、患者はDRCからウガンダ経由で入国した渡航者。DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない（DRCはリストにあるが発生国ではなく経由・出身地のため除外）。ラボ結果は確認待ちの段階。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 80% dos criadouros do mosquito da dengue estão dentro das casas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 80% of dengue mosquito breeding sites are inside homes.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mogi das Cruzes, Brazil, shows progress in H1 2026 with 36 confirmed cases, down from 241 in H1 2025 (−85.1%), and 614 total notifications (−72.2%), with no dengue deaths for a second consecutive year. Despite improvements, authorities warn that over 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are inside homes, highlighting crucial resident participation to curb transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city’s ongoing NPCA-led surveillance includes domiciliary inspections, larviciding via drones in large reservoirs and hard-to-reach areas, and a public reporting channel (Zap Dengue). Home prevention guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water, sealing water tanks, covering trash and containers, turning containers upside down, cleaning gutters, and weekly property visits. Access for health workers during inspections is requested to sustain control efforts and community protection.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱媒介蚊の発生源の80%以上が家庭内にある
triage.triage_reason: デング症例数は前年比大幅減少しており、公衆衛生対策の啓発記事であり、異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年比85.1%減、死亡者なしと改善傾向。家庭内での予防啓発が主旨の記事。

article.articleHeadline: 西伯利亞研究員驟逝惹議　肯亞驚傳首例伊波拉死亡 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Siberian researcher dies suddenly, sparking controversy; Kenya reports its first Ebola death
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, a 28-year-old female laboratory worker at a Siberian plague research institute died of pneumonia of unknown cause, prompting international scrutiny. The U.S. CDC is closely monitoring inbound travelers from the region, with DHS coordinating surveillance; Russia reports nearly 5,000 tested contacts and finds no dangerous pathogen, asserting no outbreak risk. In Kenya, authorities confirmed the country’s first Ebola death; the patient, who had arrived in Nairobi from the Democratic Republic of Congo, died after arrival, exhibiting fever, muscle aches, and subcutaneous bleeding, underscoring border screening gaps and triggering intensified cross-border containment. Separately, the World Health Organization published updated guidelines urging lifestyle changes—improved diet, regular physical activity, and professional counseling—for children rather than weight-loss drugs, to address rising global pediatric obesity.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアの研究員が急死し物議を醸す一方、ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱による死亡例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで確認された初のエボラ死亡例はコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者であり、国境を越えた感染拡大・越境検疫の不備を示唆するためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ死亡例だが、患者はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)から到着しており、感染源・発生国はDRCと考えられるためDRCを検証済み地域とした。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。また、シベリアの研究員の死亡は別事案（ペスト研究所関連）であり、対象国リストに該当する国はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is here; stay vigilant, experts urge Kenyans
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease case on October 6, 2026, with experts urging vigilance. The Bundibugjo strain carries about a 50% fatality rate, as seen in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak has recorded over 8,300 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan victim’s burial occurred at Langata Cemetery. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or other body fluids and is not airborne; incubation is 2–21 days. Preventive measures include regular handwashing, use of sanitiser, avoiding contact with the sick, avoiding crowded places, and avoiding bush meat; seek medical care promptly when symptoms appear. Kenya Red Cross and government teams are conducting risk communication, contact tracing, and safe burials per WHO protocols; suspected cases can be reported to 1199 (Kenya Red Cross) or 719 (Ministry of Health). Uganda had prior cases; France reported a case recovered in July. Do not panic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは今ここに：専門家がケニア国民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,300例超・死者4,000人超の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中で、致死率約50%、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行を背景に、ケニアでの輸入症例確認、ウガンダ既往例、フランスでの回復例について報じている。ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever outbreak: Gov't must prioritise local vaccine manufacturing - SEND Ghana
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in Ghana prompts calls for local vaccine manufacturing. As of June–September 2026, Ghana reports about 450 suspected yellow fever cases nationwide, with 74 suspected in the Upper West Region and 3 confirmed as yellow fever there. SEND Ghana's Harriet Nuamah Agyemang urges the government to prioritise domestic vaccine production to strengthen outbreak preparedness and reduce reliance on external sources. She calls for evaluating the vaccine manufacturing initiative and the activities of the vaccine institute established by the previous government, and for closer public–private collaboration to secure or produce vaccines quickly in emergencies. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh noted the ongoing suspected cases as authorities respond to the situation across the country.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病流行：SEND Ghanaが政府に国内ワクチン製造の優先的推進を要求
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ全土で約450人の黄熱病疑い例（うち3例確定）が報告され、保健省も対応中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡者数や重症度の詳細は記事に記載されておらず不明。黄熱病はIHR(2005)Annex2で特定疾患として扱われ、蚊媒介性のため国際拡大リスクが高い。ワクチン製造能力強化の議論は公衆衛生対応力の課題を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana needs emergency health fund to respond swiftly to outbreaks - SEND Ghana
article.articleSummary: Ghana needs a dedicated public health emergency fund to enable rapid outbreak responses, says SEND Ghana. The fund would reduce bureaucratic delays in mobilising resources during emergencies, allowing swift interventions across the country. Authorities are managing suspected yellow fever cases nationwide, with about 450 suspected cases recorded between June and September 2026; 74 were recorded in the Upper West Region, of which three have been laboratory-confirmed as yellow fever. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh notes the 2026 yellow fever activity. SEND Ghana also urges strengthening local vaccine manufacturing capacity, exploring partnerships with private producers to boost vaccine supply and secure isolation spaces. Overall, the calls emphasize preparedness and timely resource deployment to curb transmission and support vaccination during outbreaks in Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、アウトブレイクへの迅速な対応のため緊急医療基金が必要 - SEND Ghana
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱疑い例が6月から9月の間に約450件記録され、うち3件が検査で確定。保健大臣も言及しており、公衆衛生上の懸念と対応体制強化の必要性が示されている。
triage.notes: 黄熱はIHR Annex2で常に通知対象となりうる疾患。ワクチン製造能力強化や隔離施設確保の要請があり、アウトブレイク対応の資源不足が課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Fumigation must begin immediately to contain suspected yellow fever - SEND Ghana
article.articleSummary: Ghana faces suspected yellow fever with calls for immediate fumigation of affected communities to curb spread. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh said about 450 suspected yellow fever cases were recorded nationwide from June to September 2026, including 74 in the Upper West Region, with three of those 74 laboratory-confirmed as yellow fever. Authorities emphasize suspected cases must undergo laboratory confirmation before attributing illness or deaths to yellow fever. The government has sent samples to Senegal for further testing and cannot officially declare a yellow fever outbreak until confirmation is received. SEND Ghana Director Harriet Nuamah Agyemang urged urgent fumigation and warned that delays could worsen fear and transmission. She criticized bureaucratic delays in releasing emergency funds, calling for rapid mobilization of resources during health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: 疑わしい黄熱病の拡大を抑えるため直ちに燻蒸を開始すべき - SEND Ghana
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで450例の黄熱病疑い例（うち3例が検査確定）が報告され、公衆衛生上の懸念とともに政府対応の遅延への批判や緊急資金動員の要請など社会的・政治的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: セネガルは検査協力先として言及されているのみで、セネガル国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。また、セネガルは対象国リストにも含まれない。確定例は3例のみで、残りは疑い例であり、ラボ確認前の段階であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Issue 12 Consensus Recommendations to Prevent Mucormycosis After
article.articleSummary: Mucormycosis prevention after respiratory viral infections is guided by 12 consensus recommendations coordinated by West China Hospital, Sichuan University, published in iFungi. The panel aims to prevent secondary mucormycosis in patients recovering from influenza or SARS-CoV-2. It follows the 2021 COVID-19–associated surge of mucormycosis, notably in India, with more than 50,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths. Forty-nine experts from 44 institutions across eight countries used PubMed/Embase/Cochrane/CNKI/Wanfang databases and a two-round Delphi process; all statements reached 100% agreement; evidence was graded by the 2009 Oxford CEBM system. Four principal risk groups were defined: (1) critically ill on mechanical ventilation; (2) immunocompromised (diabetes, transplantation, HIV, etc.); (3) stage 4–5 CKD; (4) structural lung disease. Recommendations cover education/personal protection, vaccination against influenza and COVID-19, mask use, and timely diagnosis and antiviral therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家らがウイルス感染後のムーコル症予防に関する12項目のコンセンサス勧告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2021年のインドにおけるCOVID-19関連ムーコル症流行を踏まえた予防コンセンサス勧告（ガイドライン）の発表であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・四川大学華西病院主導の専門家パネルによる予防ガイドライン発表であり、2021年のインドでの流行は過去の事例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生事象ではない。新規アウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: SMS orienta população sobre prevenção e cuidados contra a catapora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SMS informs the public about prevention and care for chickenpox.
article.articleSummary: Vitória da Conquista, Bahia, Brazil, reports 44 confirmed varicella (chickenpox) cases through Epidemiological Week 39 of 2026, up from 32 in the same period last year. The Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) and the Epidemiological Surveillance unit monitor cases and issue guidance to families and institutions. Vaccination is the primary preventive measure: varicella vaccination is part of the public childhood schedule, with dose 1 at 15 months and dose 2 at 4 years (up to age 6, per the National Immunization Program). Varicella transmits via respiratory secretions and lesion fluid; infected children should stay home during the contagious period to avoid transmission, especially to pregnant women and immunocompromised individuals. In 2026, four outbreaks were identified—two in hospitals and two in daycare/school settings. No varicella deaths have been recorded since 2011 (SIM). Symptoms include red spots, vesicles, itching, fever, malaise. Suspected cases can contact Vigilância Epidemiológica at (77) 3229-3145.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、水痘の予防とケアについて住民に情報提供
triage.triage_reason: 水痘の通常の季節的発生で、症例数も前年と大差なく、死亡例もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: Brazilで発生しているが水痘は定期予防接種のある既知疾患であり、対象国リストにBrazilは含まれるものの、イベント自体のリスクが低いためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios ainda estão em alta no país, alerta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses are still on the rise in the country, Fiocruz warns.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian Fiocruz’s weekly InfoGripe bulletin (2026-10-08) reports rising activity of respiratory viruses nationwide. The population is urged to keep up to date with COVID-19 vaccination, and pregnant people should also be vaccinated against Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). Nationally, there is a mild uptick in Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases among children and adolescents aged 2–14, with stabilization in other age groups. SARI cases caused by RSV and influenza B are declining, while influenza A–related hospitalizations remain at low, stable levels. Regionally, Alagoas, Roraima, and Sergipe exhibit SARI activity at alert, risk, or high-risk levels in the past two weeks, with signs of growth over the prior six weeks. The bulletin underscores continued vigilance for emerging respiratory infections.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で呼吸器系ウイルスの流行が依然として高水準、フィオクルスが警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザB、RSV等）に関する通常の定期サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、特別な社会的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: FiocruzのInfoGripe週報による季節性呼吸器感染症の定例モニタリング情報。一部州（Alagoas, Roraima, Sergipe）で警戒レベルの上昇が見られるが、全体として通常の季節変動の範囲内と判断される。
